Entries.Description: Ejen Ali is appointed as the pilot of Project Satria, a new armoured suit with the help of an Artificial Intelligence programme specially designed to optimise the physical performance and mental skills of MATA agents while carrying out their secret missions.

Entries.Title: Fuze
Entries.Description: A long-buried WWII bomb found in central London sparks a mass evacuation, providing the perfect cover for a bank heist.

Entries.Title: Blücher
Entries.Description: Set against the backdrop of April 9, 1940, a night etched in history, aging 64-year-old Colonel Birger Eriksen is in command of Oscarsborg Fortress, a critical choke point that all ships must navigate on their approach to Oslo.

Entries.Title: No One Like Me
Entries.Description: Once celebrated as a prodigy, Yang Qianhuan, the third disciple of the Imperial Observatory, is cast into obscurity with the rise of Xu Qi'an. Despite being told that his fate is sealed, he refuses to surrender, determined to defy destiny and reclaim his place through his own strength.

Entries.Title: Gayong
Entries.Description: Biography about the late great Dato' Meor Abd Rahman, grandmaster and founder of Silat Gayong Malaysia.

Entries.Title: Knightfall
Entries.Description: Infamous former spy catcher Charles Knight must work with his estranged daughter to avert a homeland security bloodbath and survive a terrifying home invasion

Entries.Title: Stardom American Dream 2025 in Neon City
Entries.Description: Stardom American Dream 2025 in Neon City was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom and produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling of America. The event took place on April 18, 2025 in Paradise, Nevada, at the MEET Las Vegas. It was main evented by Maika, HANAKO, and a returning Megan Bayne against Konami, Momo Watanabe, and Texas independent wrestler Kalientita. This was also the final event for Mina Shirakawa as a member of the Stardom roster.

Entries.Title: Zamach na papieża
Entries.Description: At the Kremlin's behest, Bulgarian secret services, along with Polish comrades, are preparing an assassination attempt on the Pope. The best candidate to cover up the tracks and eliminate the assassin is retired SB agent Kazimierz Brunowski, nicknamed "Bruno," who has only one month left to live.

Entries.Title: The Last Shot
Entries.Description: Petch wants out of the assassin’s life, but escaping the past isn’t easy. Torn between love, loyalty, and revenge, he’s forced into one last job. With every shot, the stakes rise—his future and freedom rest on the final bullet.

Entries.Title: Bazooka
Entries.Description: A cop and a businessman team up on a mission to capture a serial killer, using a series of elaborate games to track him down.

Entries.Title: Coka Chicas
Entries.Description: When Sarah and her best friends Jessica and Chanel arrive at a dreamy Caribbean resort from their Parisian suburb, their goal is not to sip mojitos and dance the bachata. The three 25-year-olds are in fact “coka chicas”, drug mules, hoping to make their dream of opening a nail bar come true through a single drug smuggling hustle. Everything seems to be going to plan until Jessica is stopped by the police while they are boarding the plane back to France. The circumstances of her arrest are suspicious and when Sarah and Chanel start looking for her, she is not to be found at any police station or hospital. Bound by the sacred bonds of friendship the girls decide to stay and find Jessica, far from imagining the magnitude of the secrets they are about to uncover and the danger that will be unleashed…

Entries.Title: The Misadventures of Vince and Hick
Entries.Description: A recently released-from-prison car thief gets roped in with an overly ambitious con man and must help him deliver a prized car to a dangerous kingpin within 48 hours.

Entries.Title: 疯狂大逃亡
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Black Zone
Entries.Description: An unknown object crashes and disables all electronics within a fifty mile radius, later causing extreme manias to surface within the affected population. At its center, one man is enhanced by the extra-worldly object. Desperate for answers, the government hunts him.

Entries.Title: Wanted
Entries.Description: When one of three sworn brothers betrays the others in a ruthless bid for power, the bond they once shared is shattered. Years later, the youngest brother, Ye Liang, rises from near death to protect his fallen brother’s daughter and fulfill a blood oath—risking everything to bring the traitor to justice.

Entries.Title: Shaunki Sardar
Entries.Description: A mentor returns from prison to find his former proteges transformed. Their reunion stirs up complex bonds of loyalty and hidden tensions as they face their shared past and present challenges.

Entries.Title: GayKings
Entries.Description: In a world where violence proves manhood, a quiet boy falls for the one person who makes him feel safe—his senior, who can never know the truth.

Entries.Title: The Old Way
Entries.Description: In a chaotic era rife with bandits, rogue gangster Peng Yinan and his brothers Lei Wu and Ma Ming scrape by as outlaws. A mysterious woman Zhuang Yue hires them with a gold bar to kidnap a bride from a ruthless bandit stronghold. During the mission, Peng discovers his long-sought archenemy—the man who massacred his family years ago—hidden among the criminals. Fueled by vengeance, Peng launches a brutal assault to settle scores and annihilate the gang.

Entries.Title: Red Silk
Entries.Description: 1927 Trans-Siberian Express. Secret documents that will determine the future of the USSR and China are being transported across Russia. Under the guise of ordinary passengers, foreign intelligence officers and real thugs are hiding, ready to do anything for the sake of documents. A young Red Army soldier and a former Tsarist agent have to team up to uncover a common enemy.

Entries.Title: Mirai
Entries.Description: Following the historic Kalinga battle, where King Ashoka of the Maurya dynasty emerged as the winner, he chose to walk the path of peace instead of continuing warfare. Yet, the kingdom appointed nine warriors to protect some ancient scriptures rumored to have the ability to make someone divine or godlike.

Entries.Title: Polar
Entries.Description: MG, a policewoman who has been expelled from the Corps due to the problems with alcohol and drugs that she has had since the loss of her son, receives a call from a man asking her to look for Macarena Gómez, a popular TV actress.

Entries.Title: Madha Gaja Raja
Entries.Description: Raja, a witty and fearless young man, becomes entangled in a conflict with a corrupt industrialist while trying to protect his family, friends and the woman he loves.

Entries.Title: No. 1 Sentai Gozyuger: TegaSword of Resurrection
Entries.Description: TegaSword dies?! The disaster that triggered the outbreak of the Universe War in the past. TegaSword was defeated by a Calamity remnant named Pestis. All it needs to revive is the ring that is the core of the stolen TegaSword. To retrieve the ring, the Gozyugers jump into the body of TegaSword, where Pestis is hiding and face many challenges!  Will the five "outcasts" be able to unite and overcome the challenges? The shocking truth behind the birth of TegaSword is revealed for the first time?! Fight, Gozyuger! Revive the giant TegaSword! Protect the dreams and wishes of people!!

Entries.Title: 鬼平犯科帳 老盗の夢
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Majhail
Entries.Description: Tensions between rival criminal families break out when the arrival of a new police commander disrupts their uneasy truce.

Entries.Title: Indian 3: War Mode
Entries.Description: Banished by the very people who sought his return to end corruption, Senapathy's two track mission converges into a single track as he takes upon eradicating corruption into his own hands.

Entries.Title: STRxRamkumar Balakrishnan
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The 100
Entries.Description: When a young woman's suicide and a spate of robberies and murders rattle the city, IPS officer Vikrant is drawn into a web of secrets, grief, and betrayal. As he digs deeper, he's not just cracking a case-he's standing up for dignity, justice, and the courage for women to rise again.

Entries.Title: Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger formation lap: Settlers of the Galaxy
Entries.Description: Before Sakito and Byun Diesel return to Earth as seen in Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger's 16th episode, "Purple Settler", we witness this universe-spanning tale of the Settler duo, Sakito Homura and Byun Diesel, before their return to Earth after over a decade of absence.

Entries.Title: Stand Your Ground
Entries.Description: Former Special Forces operative, Jack Johnson, uses the Stand Your Ground law to seek vengeance for his wife’s murder, igniting a brutal war against a local crime lord’s family and ending in an explosive showdown.

Entries.Title: Fight for Tomorrow
Entries.Description: Former mob leader Shi Sanburo is released from prison and works as a car parker while trying to start a small pub business. One day, Sanburo is caught and sees his son in the police station. Knowing that he has stirred up troubles with gangsters, Sanburo tries to resolve the problem. Never would he expect the leader to be the son of his once triad brother, who double-crossed him and put him in jail. The sons will now fight at the Boxing Championship, bearing the conflicts of their own and the histories of their fathers. Chan Tai-lee, director of Tomorrow Is Another Day[14th], explores a troubled father-son relationship this time, driven by a compelling performance from veteran actor Patrick Tam.

Entries.Title: Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX -Beginning-
Entries.Description: High-school student Amate Yuzuriha lives peacefully in a space colony floating in outer space. But when she meets a war refugee named Nyaan, Amate is drawn into the illegal mobile suit dueling sport known as Clan Battle. Theatrical compilation of the first few episodes of Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX.

Entries.Title: Normal
Entries.Description: In the aftermath of a bank robbery, interim sheriff Ulysses uncovers a criminal conspiracy at the heart of his small-town community.

Entries.Title: Phoenix
Entries.Description: A teenage boxer accused of a high-profile political murder is quietly sent to a juvenile reformatory, where relentless assassination attempts test his survival. As he battles for his life and identity behind bars, he must summon inner strength to confront a dangerous past and hostile enemies.

Entries.Title: Keep Quiet
Entries.Description: A weathered tribal cop and his new trainee must find a ruthless fugitive, whose return to their rural Indigenous reservation has exposed its darkest secrets and could ignite a violent gang war.

Entries.Title: Slum Dragon
Entries.Description: A young man torn between protecting the slum he grew up in from a predatory property developer and following his dreams of escaping the slum and breaking out of the cycle of poverty.

Entries.Title: The Great Flood
Entries.Description: A disastrous great flood sweeps the planet. On what may be the last day on Earth, a desperate fight ensues to save a child from a flooding apartment.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Special Edition Hashira Training Arc Part 1
Entries.Description: A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 56–59, The members of the Demon Slayer Corps and their highest-ranking swordsmen, the Hashira. In preparation for the forthcoming final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji, the Hashira Training commences. While each carry faith and determination within their hearts, Tanjiro and the Hashira enter a new story.

Entries.Title: Kamen Rider Gavv: Invaders of the Candy House
Entries.Description: After being pulled through a door, Shoma finds himself in a peaceful world where Dark Treats do not exist?! In this world, Hapipare still exist, but a young man named Taorin who has Gavv works there. Taorin has no memory of his past, and Shoma decides to help him recover his memories.  Meanwhile, a man named Caries begins indiscriminately attacking the town, and the peaceful world is transformed! The two struggle to restore peace and arrive at a huge Candy House. The two are on the verge of grasping something, but Caries transforms with an unknown Gochizo and corners Shoma and the others! What is the soruce of the overwhelming power that this most terrifying enemy has obtained?! What are Taorin's lost memories?!

Entries.Title: Stardom American Dream 2025 in Sin City
Entries.Description: Stardom American Dream 2025 in Sin City was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom and produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling of America. The event took place on April 17, 2025 in Enterprise, Nevada, at the Silverton Veil Pavilion. It was main evented by Maika going 1-on-1 with Thekla.

Entries.Title: The Furious
Entries.Description: When his daughter is snatched off the street, simple tradesman Konggu fights his way through a complex web of criminals in a frantic attempt to win her back by any means necessary. His only ally is tireless journalist Navin. The two men from utterly different backgrounds must learn to trust, collaborate and draw on combat skills from their own hidden pasts.

Entries.Title: Identity
Entries.Description: A sketch artist and a cop work together to unravel the identity of an elusive killer using the descriptions of his face, etched into the memory of an eye-witness to the brutal crime

Entries.Title: Extras for Chasing The Dragon
Entries.Description: The film tells the story of the fearless and determined Wu Guohao and his childhood friends, Big Wei and Little Wei, who smuggle themselves from Guangdong to Hong Kong in search of a better life. They gain the favor of the shrewd and meticulous Inspector Xu Le and eventually rise to dominate both the criminal and law enforcement worlds in Hong Kong. Xu Le initially joined the police force as an idealistic young man, aspiring to serve the people and uphold justice, only to discover that the entire system was deeply corrupt.

Entries.Title: Reflection in a Dead Diamond
Entries.Description: When the mysterious woman in the room next door disappears, a debonair 70-year-old ex-spy living in a luxury hotel on the Côte d'Azur is confronted by the demons and darlings of a lurid past in which moviemaking, memories and madness collide.

Entries.Title: Faster
Entries.Description: A former racer returns to the sport through a racing academy, where she meets Will. As they fall for each other, they become rivals competing for the Formula 1 championship, forcing her to choose between love and victory.

Entries.Title: The Grey Men 2
Entries.Description: When the regime of Laika was changing, black and white undercurrents were surging. Some people wanted to make a fortune, some wanted to use this to whitewash, some wanted to escape from Laika, and some wanted to establish a foothold in Laika... The police placed an undercover police officer, Zheng Zha, lurking among the biggest black force in Laika, Boss Song, but they didn't know that there were others who wanted to take this opportunity to take revenge on Boss Song.

Entries.Title: 120 Bahadur
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Adangathey
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Clone Cops
Entries.Description: A gang of outlaws defend their hideout until they discover a shocking secret about who they are and what they're up against. Now it's a race against time as they look for a way to escape certain doom at the hands of the Clone Cops.

Entries.Title: Undercurrent
Entries.Description: A new type of drug emerges in Harbor City, leading investigators to a two-year-old armed drug smuggling case—with all clues pointing to the Hongtu Group. Lu Yunlong, a recently transferred undercover agent, infiltrates the organization and gains the trust of its chairman, Li Hong, after saving his life. However, he soon discovers that the group's second-in-command, Chen Biao, is the very man who murdered his teammate years ago. Teaming up with fellow undercover agent Xu Li, Lu engages in a deadly battle against the drug cartel. Through life-and-death confrontations, they ultimately succeed in dismantling the entire syndicate.

Entries.Title: Hunting Season
Entries.Description: An overprotective father and his feisty 12-year-old daughter, who take in a mysterious young woman who washes ashore on the bank of a local river. The father-daughter duo’s lives are forever changed by the arrival of this stranger and by the ruthless drug lord who will stop at nothing to possess her.

Entries.Title: HIT: The Third Case
Entries.Description: The Homicide Intervention Team (HIT) sends ruthless police officer Arjun Sarkaar to find a group of killers and stop their grisly murder spree.

Entries.Title: Smashing Frank
Entries.Description: Four young people plan a heist to fight back against rich boomers, only to be caught in a wealthy church’s money laundering conspiracy.

Entries.Title: Dog 51
Entries.Description: In the near future, Paris is divided into three zones that separate social classes, and no one can escape ALMA, a predictive AI that has revolutionized law enforcement. When ALMA’s creator is assassinated, Salia, a top agent, and Zem, a jaded cop, are forced to work together to solve a murder that may expose the dark secrets of the system they serve.

Entries.Title: Gangstas
Entries.Description: On the streets of Antwerp, Badia, Junes and Volt are trying to tear themselves away from their past, but the underworld is inexorably pulling them back in. Adamo has worked his way up to become one of the most influential figures in the Antwerp drug trade. He becomes ever more entangled in a web of power and danger. His friends have to make a choice: stay loyal to Adamo or choose safety.

Entries.Title: High Ground
Entries.Description: When a mysterious prisoner lands in jail, a border town sheriff faces the wrath of a brutal cartel.

Entries.Title: The Lost Princess
Entries.Description: After an Ayahuasca vision transports him to a haunted castle, Alec meets Hanna who tales him the story of her mother's forced marriage and how the forbidden passion with her father was in danger when the princess pregnancy became obvious

Entries.Title: Tougen Anki: The Stage - Nerima Arc -
Entries.Description: In Nerima, Tokyo, the Oni and Momotaro clash once again.

Entries.Title: Peak Confrontation
Entries.Description: Chu Tiankuo, who was born as a gangster, was framed to participate in the gambling king competition to win the golden mask. During the competition, he was framed and rescued by a princess of an alien tribe and accidentally got the clue of the golden mask. Unexpectedly, the various people who were looking for the mask got the news and waited for an opportunity to move. A peak confrontation immediately kicked off at the border. During the confrontation, Chu Tiankuo also accidentally learned about his father's experience. For his father and his own mission, Chu Tiankuo resolutely threw himself into the battle.

Entries.Title: Banduan
Entries.Description: A former convict's chance to reunite with his daughter is nearly destroyed due to one chaotic and deadly night.

Entries.Title: Alpha
Entries.Description: Two fierce female agents tackle dangerous missions in a thrilling world of espionage, as they navigate perilous situations, execute daring stunts, and face unexpected turns in this action-packed adventure.

Entries.Title: Cyborg Tasuke Isshin
Entries.Description: Tasuke Isshin is the 25th generation head of the Isshinya Fresh Fish Shop in Kota, and is an office worker at Choden Industries. He is a popular, kindhearted man who can't help but help people in trouble.  Choden Industries is troubled by sabotage by Iwayama of the Owashi Conglomerate. Tasuke is shot down by someone on his way to work but is resurrected as the Cyborg Tasuke Isshin / Cyborg 1 Heart by the genius scientist, Managing Director Okubo! However, Iwayama has also become a cyborg called Cyborg Rock 1 and appears in front of Tasuke and attacks him! The true identity of the Owashi Conglomerate is the merchant of death, Blue Ghost! Will Cyborg Tasuke Isshin defeat his enemies?

Entries.Title: Snake Woman
Entries.Description: The elite hunters of the Wu Shang tribe venture deep into the enigmatic Old Mountain, only to be attacked by a mysterious creature. The sole survivor, "Snake Master," escapes with a horrifying truth—the attackers were monstrous beings with human heads and serpent tails. The mountain has long been shrouded in eerie legends of the "Snake Woman"—could they be real? Snake Master teams up with the mountain keeper, Chen Shu, and a squad of elite mercenaries to return to the mountain. But as their investigation unfolds, a bloody and brutal forbidden truth begins to surface. In this hunt… who is truly the prey?

Entries.Title: Mundije
Entries.Description: Ilir Luma, a martial arts master specialized in the Pelasgian art of "Mundije", escaped the communist regime, when he was only 14 years old. He'd witnessed the hanging of a poet in the city of Kukes, Albania. In Germany, at a Taekwondo school, he meets Ana, who became his student and his girlfriend. Ilir promised to be there for her, whenever she needs him. Thirty years later, Ana is kidnapped and sent to Mexico. Ilir risks his life to rescue his kidnapped girlfriend, and battles the most dangerous fighters in the world.

Entries.Title: Kettavanu Per Edutha Nallavanda
Entries.Description: In the heart of North Madras,  Mahat, a fearless and street-smart guy, falls for Aishwarya Dutta, a spirited young woman who is kept under strict control by her uncle, Annachi, one of the richest and roughest businessmen in the area. Mahat with the help of his quirky and loyal elder friend Motta Rajendran, sets out on a hilarious and daring mission to win her love—while dodging her uncle’s watchful eyes and ruthless ways.Meanwhile, a self-proclaimed pirate and treasure hunter, Yogi Babu, believes he is the long-lost brother of Jack Sparrow. On his quest for hidden riches near a remote resort, he stumbles upon an unexpected treasure—a bear that falls in love with him! As Yogi Babu desperately tries to escape the bear’s affection, his treasure hunt takes an unpredictable turn, leading to a chaotic and side-splitting chain of events.

Entries.Title: Darwish
Entries.Description: A charismatic con artist drawn into a world of danger, deception, and unexpected romance. As he navigates high-stakes escapades and faces deeply personal trials, his journey takes an unforeseen turn — one that may lead him toward redemption and unlikely heroism.

Entries.Title: Cotton Candy Bubble Gum
Entries.Description: After his mom gets engaged to a vindictive cop, Carter, a 21-year-old mama’s boy still living at home, must secure a paid promotion at his internship by the end of the day or find a new place to live. To land the job, his boss gives him a seemingly impossible list of tasks to complete: get his Jeep detailed (the Jeep gets towed), babysit his teenage son (Carter loses the kid), set up his birthday party (a model ODs on the living room floor), and recover a sex tape (a world-famous rapper kidnaps his best friend after a failed blackmail attempt). If Carter can conquer this wildly chaotic day, he might be ready for the real world after all.

Entries.Title: Troll 2
Entries.Description: Nora, Andreas and Captain Kris leap back into action when a dangerous new troll awakes — and this time they'll need more help to take it down.

Entries.Title: Four Rivers Six Ranges: The Untold Story of Tibet
Entries.Description: 4 Rivers 6 Ranges is based on the book “Flight at the Cuckoos Behest”  by Dorjee Wangdi Dewatshang

Entries.Title: Shakthi Thirumagan
Entries.Description: A tribal woman is brutally assaulted and killed. Her newborn is mercilessly abandoned in a dump yard, left to die. But fate intervenes — an old man discovers the infant and decides to raise him as his own. The child, named Kittu,After the old man’s death, Kittu is left to fend for himself,determined to confront his mother’s killer.

Entries.Title: Super Icyclone
Entries.Description: A climatologist cuts her anniversary celebration short to save her family - and all of North America - from an unimaginably destructive storm.

Entries.Title: Throbbin' 84
Entries.Description: The year in 1984. A self styled back street career criminal  in the exploding world of video production begins to take over the streets with his gang of punks. On the case cops, Davidson and Reynolds discover an intricate underground world of queer punks, gender benders, and an ex Top Dog prisoner with a secret.

Entries.Title: Sardar 2
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Sukajan Kung Fu
Entries.Description: A guy goes to the cinema, watches kung-fu movies and wishes he could be just as strong, when someday he gets a magical jacket that gives him the strength he is looking for.

Entries.Title: Revenge
Entries.Description: Samir “Gio” Daoudi, a young man whose life is shattered when his brother is murdered in a gangland execution in Amsterdam. As Gio rises through the ranks of Europe’s drug underworld, he becomes a key player in a brutal cycle of retaliation, trafficking, and betrayal that stretches from the streets of Amsterdam to the ports of Tangier. Meanwhile, prosecutors Sabine and Yorick uncover a vast encrypted communication network used by criminals to coordinate hits and drug shipments. When a crown witness comes forward and they start closing in on Gio, the lines between justice and vengeance blur.

Entries.Title: Dream Hacker
Entries.Description: Due to her age, Professor Jennifer Connelly is often described as a science prodigy. A genius of our time, with five Phd's psychology, psychiatry, neurology, physics and chemistry. Jennifer's primary studies are in dreams and the effects they have on the waking mind. For the past 6 years, her studies have led her to theorize that with the right equipment, she can not only watch and record someone else's dreams but maybe even influence them in a subconscious way. To prove this theory, and believing it may have military applications, Oxford obtains a substantial government grant to build the equipment Jennifer needs to journey into this new unknown area of neural science.

Entries.Title: Death Whisperer 3
Entries.Description: When Yee is captured by a mysterious cult, Yak and his friends embark on a desperate journey to rescue her. Their path leads them to a cursed village shrouded in dark secrets, vengeful spirits, and ancient rituals. As the horror unfolds, survival turns into a battle against forces beyond their control. The deeper they venture, the darker it gets.

Entries.Title: A Writer's Odyssey 2
Entries.Description: Novelist Lu Kongwen fell into the trough of life and decided to destroy his novel "God Killing" with his own hands. In the novel world, the protagonist also embarked on a journey of resistance in order to resist the predetermined fate.

Entries.Title: Kamen Rider Majade with Girls Remix
Entries.Description: Rinne Kudo, who is studying abroad in England, sees her classmate kidnapped by Yoko Minato right in front of her. Rinne returns to Japan with Sophia's guidance, who is investigating a series of female kidnappings, and decides to investigate the case with Girls Remix. They head to the scene of the crime with Reika Shindai to investigate a case suspected to involve an alchemist. At that moment, Yoko appears again and attacks them, but a woman who looks like Clotho appears and fights Yoko. Will Rinne be able to solve the case and save her classmates?!

Entries.Title: Bulk
Entries.Description: When an over zealous scientist pushes his experiments with string theory too far - his brane explodes. That's "brane" not "brain" - but that means someone has to sort out the mess he has created. Our hero Corey Harlan is sent in - kicking and screaming - to find the heart of the brane and its creator Anton Chambers. Now manifested as a normal townhouse hosted by the enigmatic and multi-dimensional Aclima - his adventure begins. A house where opening a door from one room to another can lead you to other worlds not just the kitchen.

Entries.Title: Prisoner of War
Entries.Description: British RAF Wing Commander James Wright is captured by the Japanese during WWII and forced to fight in brutal hand-to-hand combat. The Japanese soldiers get more than they bargained for when Wright’s years of martial arts training in Hong Kong prove him to be a formidable opponent.

Entries.Title: Abroad
Entries.Description: After the disappearance of his girlfriend, a foreigner man lost in a hostile land becomes the main suspect and his desperate research for her turns into a fight to stay alive.

Entries.Title: Balti
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Kuttram Pudhithu
Entries.Description: When Kadhiresan, a disturbed soul masked as a food delivery man, kills and gets arrested for the horrific murder of ACP Sathya’s daughter Preethi, reality fractures and tensions intensify—until Preethi returns back from the dead unharmed five days later, challenging not just law and logic, but the very nature of truth and existence.

Entries.Title: 96 Minutes
Entries.Description: Former bomb disposal expert, Song Kang-Ren, and his fiancée, Huang Xin, board a high-speed train that contains a bomb. At the same time, Liu Kai, a well-known physics teacher who was involved in an affair scandal, also boards this same train in order to win back his wife, Ting Juan, who took the prior high-speed rail to return home in frustration…  After all, can the bomb be successfully defused this time? and resolve the crisis?

Entries.Title: Anti Drug Operations
Entries.Description: SWAT captain Shen Ao joins an anti-narcotics team on a remote island, uncovering a drug ring using drones. When his daughter is kidnapped, he undertakes a solo mission to rescue her and dismantle the operation.

Entries.Title: Prisoners in Space
Entries.Description: A desperate call for help as the residents of Moonbase Alpha are hurled into an interplanetary power struggle. As tensions rise, disaster strikes when a routine mission becomes a nightmare...

Entries.Title: Cop & a Half
Entries.Description: In the heart of bustling Johannesburg, a mismatched duo takes the crime-fighting scene by storm in a South African action-comedy. When a by-the-book cop is reluctantly paired with a smooth-talking informant, sparks fly as they navigate the treacherous underworld of drug trafficking. With unlikely camaraderie, they pursue a ruthless gang of drugdealers, leaving chaos and laughter in their wake.

Entries.Title: Zero
Entries.Description: Two Americans wake up in Dakar, Senegal, with bombs strapped to their chests ticking down from ten hours. Guided by a threatening voice on the phone, these men complete a series of violent tasks that spark widespread protest against Western influence in the city.

Entries.Title: Doctor Who: Gallifrey
Entries.Description: Ian Levine's AI construction of an unproduced serial for season twenty-three of Doctor Who.

Entries.Title: Tiger Squad
Entries.Description: The Tiger Squad an elite special operations unit of the Red Army, during a Red-Blue military exercise conducted by the People's Liberation Army. The team faces intense challenges and engages in a dramatic showdown with the opposing Blue Army special forces. The outcome of their confrontation remains uncertain as they prepare for their next top-secret mission.

Entries.Title: Death World
Entries.Description: In this ultraviolent, retro-wave gorefest set in a dystopian landscape, an alley rat is chosen to save the crumbling planet from an alien sentinel.

Entries.Title: A Woman Scorned
Entries.Description: Jas and her sister Laura are interrupted on their family weekend break in the country side by a group of local men intent on terrorising them. When Laura is attacked and killed by the group, Jas discovers her lifeless body back at the cabin they've hired. She is instilled with grief, rage and fury and intent on hunting down and taking out the gang by whatever means necessary as justice for her sister's murder.

Entries.Title: Manila's Finest
Entries.Description: Manila's Finest is a crime thriller set during the first quarter storm in 1970s where policemen Homer, Conrad, and Billy are consumed by murder case of troublemaking teenagers in the slums.

Entries.Title: Ground Zero
Entries.Description: An Indian army officer embarks on a mission leading to India’s most successful counter-terrorism operation in history.

Entries.Title: Vanangaan
Entries.Description: Trouble follows Kottee, a deaf-mute and hot blooded do-gooder, when he gets a job at a special home for the underprivileged and his quest for justice leads him into conflict with the law and strains his relationship with his sister, Devi.

Entries.Title: The Last GunFight
Entries.Description: ​In a ruthless underground tournament, the world's top assassins fight to the death. But hidden among them is a rogue crew with its own deadly agenda: infiltrate the competition, survive the bloodbath, and take down the mastermind pulling the strings.

Entries.Title: Daveed
Entries.Description: A celebrity bodyguard finds himself in trouble when he crosses an infamous boxer.

Entries.Title: Ambulance
Entries.Description: Two feuding Saudi paramedics stumble upon a briefcase containing 2 million Riyal and become unwittingly entangled in a high-stakes kidnapping and ransom plot.

Entries.Title: Abyss
Entries.Description: 11 years ago, inspector Malik couldn’t solve a kidnapping case and a little girl died. Now with only a few days before the crime gets classified, he decides to reopen the case. Malik owes it to the mother and to himself. As he digs into the past, a child is kidnapped again. The pattern is the same one as a decade ago, it’s no coincidence. Malik knows he has a few days to make things right and to bring justice.

Entries.Title: Atonement
Entries.Description: Single father Lung (Ronald CHENG) and his daughter Ying (FU Shun Ying) are each other’s only dependence. Despite the huge debt left by his ex-wife, Lung believes in good karma for good people, until he loses his beloved daughter in a kidnap while travelling in Thailand.  Lung abandons all his faith. He marries a Thai Chinese, Lan (Chrissie CHAU) and starts a new life in Thailand, but he never leaves the past behind. All these years he has been gathering information of the kidnap gang, and vows to take justice into his own hands at any cost…

Entries.Title: Revolver Rita
Entries.Description: Revolver Rita is an upcoming Tamil movie. The movie is directed by Kaddipudi Chandru and will feature Keerthy Suresh as lead character.

Entries.Title: The Devil and the Daylong Brothers
Entries.Description: Three cursed brothers seek revenge on their long-lost father who sold their souls to the Devil before their births.

Entries.Title: Elite Target
Entries.Description: Alexia flees killers who murdered her father. A haunted vigilante, Gable, becomes her protector despite his inner demons. As they dodge assassins, their growing bond forces both to face deep truths about themselves.

Entries.Title: Rider
Entries.Description: A young woman working as a rider is forced to make a dangerous delivery that will put her life at risk during a night filled with urgent personal problems that she must solve through phone calls.  Millions of people make a living as riders around the world, Fio’s story of redemtion is but one of them.

Entries.Title: The King, the Swordsman and the Sorceress
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Scarlet
Entries.Description: After failing to avenge her father's murder, Princess Scarlet, wakes up in the "Land of the Dead." In this world filled with madness, if she does not achieve her revenge against her nemesis and reach the "No End Place," she will become "Void" and cease to exist. Can Scarlet find a way to live at the end of her endless journey?

Entries.Title: Firrkie
Entries.Description: Firrkie is a Bollywood action drama movie, directed by Ankoosh Bhatt. The movie stars Neil Nitin Mukesh, Karan Singh Grover, Jackie Shroff, Kay Kay Menon, and Sandeepa Dhar in lead roles.

Entries.Title: California King
Entries.Description: When mattress store manager Perry's childhood crush, Lynette, announces she's leaving town, he panics. Desperate to prove himself, he and his reckless best friend, Wyatt, concoct a harebrained scheme to "rescue" her younger brother from a fake kidnapping--only to accidentally pull off a real one.

Entries.Title: Warlord
Entries.Description: Revolt is on the horizon in the ancient city of Lloris, ruled with an iron fist by the merciless Sheriff and The Brute. Believing their mystical powers could help free the oppressed citizens from tyranny, a young human seeks out the aid of the reclusive elves and their legendary Warlord. However, with both sides harbouring secrets, and hiding their true motives, this tentative alliance between the humans and elves may bring about the downfall of them all.

Entries.Title: Vinci 2
Entries.Description: Cuma, a retired master thief living peacefully on Spain’s Andalusian coast, rejects one last job, until rival Chudy, Cuma’s former partner turned adversary, plots a massive heist in Kraków with a ruthless new crew and no place for him. Driven by pride and the need to reclaim his title as the world’s greatest burglar, Cuma returns, reunites old allies, assembles a fresh team, and prepares to face Chudy on his own terms.

Entries.Title: Tamura Yuto: ISOLATED
Entries.Description: Someone has kidnapped Renji Himuro, the second-in-command of the Kyowakai, the largest yakuza group in Japan. Thinking that the kidnappers must be Chinese mafia, Yuto Tamura ventures into the enemy’s hideout alone to rescue Himuro. However, the opponents who appear are martial arts masters from various countries!  Tamura defeats one opponent after another, but as he continuous fighting his strength is exhausted and he finds himself in a desperate situation. Can he come through in the clutch? And who was behind the set up?

Entries.Title: Unstoppable
Entries.Description: In the distant future, the Earth has become a dazzling intersection of immigrants from various planets in the vast universe, known as the "Interstellar City". On this future planet, an unprecedented disaster is quietly approaching - the Pegasus meteor shower suddenly hits the Earth like a doomsday rain. Mediator Haitang surprisingly discovered that these meteor meteorite fragments contain terrible energy that causes organisms to mutate strangely. As the mutation incidents continue to escalate, the Earth has fallen into unprecedented panic and turmoil. In order to explore the truth behind the meteorite fragments, Captain Qin Long of the Interstellar Administration leads Haitang and the technological wizard Ivan on an adventure journey across the stars and against the clock. In this adventure, they not only have to fight a desperate battle with ferocious and abnormal mutant monsters, but also uncover a huge conspiracy that may rewrite the fate of the Earth.

Entries.Title: Burner
Entries.Description: Ex-con single mom Kiki rebuilds her life and regains custody of her teen daughter, until her violent drug-dealer ex returns. To protect herself and her daughter, she must eliminate him without getting caught.

Entries.Title: 4 Tigers
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Orphans
Entries.Description: Gab and Driss, childhood friends on bad terms since they left the orphanage, now have opposite lives - one is a cop with the IGPN, the other a fixer for thugs. When their first love dies in a suspicious accident, her 17-year-old daughter, Leïla, takes Gab's gun and sets off on the trail of a powerful organization willing to do anything to cover the case up. Forced to team up, the orphans must stop her before she crosses a line she can't return from...

Entries.Title: Nine-Ring Golden Dagger
Entries.Description: During the Northern Expedition of Yongxi in the early Song Dynasty, General Yang Ye heroically sacrificed himself, and his posthumous reward, the Nine-Ring Golden Dagger, fell into Liao territory. A decade later, his daughters, Yang Baba and Yang Jiumei, set out to reclaim it, facing relentless dangers. On their return, they ally with Jiao Guangpu, a former soldier of Yang Ye. Together, they outwit and overcome three enemy attacks, ensuring the dagger’s safe return to Song lands.

Entries.Title: Absolute Dominion
Entries.Description: In the year 2063 AD, the world faces catastrophe as zealots and extremists wage a global holy war, crumbling cities and dismantling entire countries in the name of spiritual superiority. Desperate for a solution to save humanity from itself, the world's governing bodies vote to establish a radical new form of diplomacy called The Battle of Absolute Dominion, a fierce martial-arts tournament featuring the best fighters in the world to determine a champion whose faith will govern humanity and restore peace for the future.

Entries.Title: Sankranthiki Vasthunam
Entries.Description: When a renowned tech entrepreneur is kidnapped upon returning to India, a police officer recruits her ex-boyfriend, a former cop now living a quiet family life, to assist in the rescue mission.

Entries.Title: McWalter
Entries.Description: McWalter, a legendary American elite agent, is falsely accused of a series of attacks all around the globe. Determined to clear his name, he goes on the run to solve the mystery, thwart a earthwise conspiracy, and save the world…

Entries.Title: Spy Puzzle
Entries.Description: Qiu Xinzhi is sick of the anxiety-ridden undercover life, but a missing-persons case once again lands him in a dangerous and confusing situation. He originally plans to pretend to be an undercover agent to solve the case, but he does not know that behind the complexity, a greater crime and conspiracy has already bared its fangs to him. To solve the case, Qiu Xinzhi relies on his wisdom to punish and eliminate evil. Ultimately, the suffering people are rescued and the mastermind behind the scenes is brought to justice.

Entries.Title: Tales of Jovia Anthology
Entries.Description: An elocutionist introduces several sci-fi stories that occur in the Jovian Cinematic Universe, featuring a high-tech bounty hunter loses his bounty on a forest planet, a scientist who debates the meaning of life with his robot in a crash, love and betrayal, monsters on new and distant planets, sword fighting rebels, boxing in the asteroids, and a group wilderness trip gone wrong

Entries.Title: Valiant One
Entries.Description: With tensions between North and South Korea, a US helicopter crashes on the North side. The survivors must work together to protect a civilian tech specialist and find their way out without the help of US military support.

Entries.Title: Maine Pyar Kiya
Entries.Description: Searching for Nidhi in Madurai's streets, Aryan faces mounting danger and tension at every turn. Time runs short as he navigates growing chaos to stay alive.

Entries.Title: Kung Fu Slayers
Entries.Description: A good-natured vampire must use his powers to defeat an old nemesis, who has kidnapped his son.

Entries.Title: Romeo S3
Entries.Description: DCP Sangram Singh Shekhawat is a gritty and determined police officer, hell-bent on dismantling a powerful drug cartel that has gripped the city in fear and addiction. His mission takes a sharp turn when he crosses paths with an investigative journalist chasing the same truth from the opposite side of the law.

Entries.Title: Blood and Blades in the Snow
Entries.Description: In the 23rd year of the Wanli era during the Ming Dynasty, border general Zhan Congwen is framed for colluding with Japanese pirates by treacherous court officials, leading to the execution of his entire family. His son, Zhan Hong, escapes and flees to Qinchuan Town, where he meets and falls in love with Xiahou Ying. However, he soon discovers that her father, Xiahou Batian, was involved in his father’s case. As the truth slowly unravels, Zhan Hong ultimately succeeds in his vengeance and is appointed as the Commander of the Imperial Guards (Jinyiwei), continuing to purge corruption from the court.

Entries.Title: The Wide West
Entries.Description: 1907. The first-ever sumo delegation from Japan, led by Sumo Legends, travels through the United States to Washington D.C. to meet with President Theodore Roosevelt.  When the train is stopped for track repairs, they have to stop in a dangerous Western town, where trouble awaits…

Entries.Title: New Abarenbō Shōgun
Entries.Description: The eighth shogun, Tokugawa Yoshimune, fights against evil rampant in Edo while blending in with the common people as Tokuda Shinnosuke, the third son of a poor samurai retainer, commonly known as "Shin-san". The story depicts Yoshimune, who is shaken by the issue of succession, the drama within Edo Castle, and a difficult case involving a conspiracy that occurs in the castle town, with the addition of new characters and a sense of the era.

Entries.Title: Kraken
Entries.Description: Marine biologist Johanne is doing research on a fish farm in Vangsnes, a rural community located by the fjord, when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two local teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see? At the bottom of the deepest fjord rests a mythical monster as large as a mountain, with a myriad of arms ready to crush and devour anything they can grab.

Entries.Title: LUPIN THE IIIRD: Zenigata and the Two Lupins
Entries.Description: Inspector Zenigata pursues Lupin as the prime suspect behind a terrorist attack. But when he manages to confront the famous thief, he quickly deduces that the bomber is a second, fake Lupin. Now, it's up to Zenigata to capture both Lupins and solve the mystery behind the bombing.

Entries.Title: Code 3
Entries.Description: A burned-out paramedic tries to survive his last 24 hours on the job while training a new recruit.

Entries.Title: Sambosa Chapati
Entries.Description: "Sambosa Chapati" follows the journey of Fareed, a brave young man who takes on illegal activities to support the oppressed and help them reclaim their rights. Along with his assistant, Waheed, they navigate a series of comedic and action-packed events while offering their services to those in need. Their operations come under police scrutiny, leading to a verdict of seven years in prison unless they can secure waivers from their clients. With 30 waivers obtained, they embark on a journey to India to find the last client who has returned home, encountering various challenges along the way.

Entries.Title: Organ Child
Entries.Description: A series of tragic events unfolds after Chang Chi-Mao's daughter goes missing as an infant. Chang becomes consumed by revenge against a powerful criminal organization suspected of kidnapping her. Along the way, he clings to the hope that his daughter may still be alive, determined to rescue her and break free from their dark fate.

Entries.Title: Fateh
Entries.Description: Ex-Special Ops officer Fateh Singh springs back to action when a girl falls prey to a cybercrime syndicate. Racing against time, can he bring down the mafia?

Entries.Title: In Broad Daylight
Entries.Description: The plot follows the journey and rise of an international gang leader who commits many frauds around the world.

Entries.Title: Dominic and the Ladies' Purse
Entries.Description: Dominic, a former Circle Inspector dismissed due to a hidden color blindness that led to a crucial error, now struggles as a broke, divorced ex-cop living with an old landlady he can't pay. A seemingly simple case of lost property draws him into a complex murder mystery.

Entries.Title: GCW: Tournament of Survival X
Entries.Description: Game Changer Wrestling (GCW) held their 10th Tournament of Survival back at the Showboat Hotel in Atlantic City on June 7th 2025. The 10th installment of this deathmatch tournament saw 10 wrestlers all challenge each other for one of deathmatch wrestling's top trophies. Several up and coming talent including Dr. Redacted & Mr. Danger were involved as well as the shocking deathmatch debut of Shotzi Blackheart. This was a can't miss event streamed exclusively on TrillerTV+.

Entries.Title: Badnaam
Entries.Description: Following his release from prison, an outlaw with a tragic past challenges a ruthless crime boss for control of the local alcohol black market.

Entries.Title: AEW Dynasty: Zero Hour
Entries.Description: AEW Dynasty starts with the Zero Hour pre-show! Join Renee Paquette, RJ City, and Jeff Jarrett as they break down the card, followed by exciting bonus matches: AR Fox & Top Flight take on The CRU & Nick Wayne, and Max Caster facing a surprise challenger.

Entries.Title: Ballerina Assassin
Entries.Description: After a devastating betrayal wipes out her entire spy network, an elite female assassin embarks on a relentless mission to dismantle the syndicate responsible.

Entries.Title: Keluang Man
Entries.Description: Borhan, a former patient at a mental hospital in Tampoi, lives a life as a mysterious hero named Keluang Man. He uses his martial arts expertise and his wits to fight crime in the small town of Kluang. Borhan must face a major threat when a secret criminal organisation emerges, led by his archenemy, Shamsir. Aided by his friend Inspector Sahab, Borhan struggles with internal conflicts, questions about his sanity, and the challenges of being a true protector.

Entries.Title: Gemini
Entries.Description: Colly leaves her home planet of Gliese to find her twin sister, Josi, who was left on earth as an infant. The two are faced with the hardest decision of their lives; be split up and accept their fate on their respective home planets or fight and hunt on Earth to stay together.

Entries.Title: Jangar
Entries.Description: A man arrives on an island to escape a troubled past and battles a vengeful antagonist who follows him there.

Entries.Title: 6 Jilake
Entries.Description: A lone warrior who is on a personal mission unexpectedly forced to stay at a remote village to help protect the villagers from a group of notorious bandits known as '6 Jilake'.

Entries.Title: Off the Grid
Entries.Description: After a morally-bankrupt company tries to weaponize a brilliant scientist's revolutionary technology, he goes off the grid to safeguard humanity. When the company sends a strike force to find him, they make their biggest mistake of all – they weaponize the man they are trying to catch.

Entries.Title: Delivery Run
Entries.Description: A food delivery driver gets caught in a deadly chase in the icy Minnesota wilderness, pursued by a crazed snowplow driver for unknown reasons, facing life-threatening situations and forced to outsmart his relentless pursuer alone.

Entries.Title: До последен дъх
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Kitty & the Viper
Entries.Description: In the futuristic city of Nouveau San Francisco, a hard-boiled hero "the Viper" and his rage fuelled pet partner "Kitty", will attempt to stop an egomaniacal industrialist "the Jackal" from an evil plan to create a pollution apocalypse.

Entries.Title: Mark
Entries.Description: An upcoming action film starring Kichcha Sudeepa and Naveen Chandra, directed by Vijay Karthikeyaa

Entries.Title: L2: Empuraan
Entries.Description: Five years after becoming Chief Minister of Kerala, Jathin Ramdas's move to align with communal forces led by Balraj 'Baba' Bajrangi, triggers Stephen Nedumpally aka Khureshi Ab'raam to return with his Man Friday Zayed Masood to save his home state and settle scores.

Entries.Title: South Wind 3: Gas geben
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 我是拳手
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Prey
Entries.Description: A cult known as the Wendigo Clan hunts down various random people to appease their almighty creature. Years ago, one man attempted to put an end to their plans; a survivalist named B.J. Vega. He's dead but has a son.

Entries.Title: Money Game$
Entries.Description: After successfully leading his team to crack a major fraud case, the leader of the Anti-Fraud Society, Zeng Miao Zhu, uncovers an even larger conspiracy lurking in the shadows. He then assigns elite members Lam, Arrow, Big Mouth, and Ba Jie to infiltrate the money game controlled by Tang Gang. Their mission is to become the spokespersons for the project, quickly attracting a large influx of funds while simultaneously collecting evidence of criminal activity. However, after Tang Gang reaps enormous profits, the plan takes a sudden turn.

Entries.Title: Dacoit
Entries.Description: Revolves around a broken-up couple who cross paths again in a violent dystopian world.

Entries.Title: Playdate
Entries.Description: Down-on-his luck Brian, just fired from his job, becomes an unexpected stay-at-home dad to his 10 year old son. On his first day, he accepts a playdate invitation from Jeff, another stay-at-home dad, who turns out to be an unexpected loose cannon. The two fathers and their sons spend the day on the run, facing a deadly conspiracy.

Entries.Title: Kidnapping Inc.
Entries.Description: A group of kidnappers take the son of a wealthy presidential candidate in Haiti. Doc and Zoe are two amateur gangsters tasked with delivering the young man to their ruthless boss. With a hitman on their trail, Zoe accidentally kills the hostage. Panicked, Doc and Zoe come across Patrick and his very pregnant wife Laura. Patrick looks exactly like the senator’s dead son. Doc and Zoe decide to abduct the couple and replace the candidate's son with Patrick.

Entries.Title: A Hard Place
Entries.Description: A group of criminals on the run in a cold, winter forest find themselves caught in the middle of an ancient feud between the monsters that rule the day and the creatures that rule the night.

Entries.Title: Kesari Veer
Entries.Description: The movie narrates the tale of Hamirji Gohil, a brave warrior who fought against the Tughlaq Empire to protect the Somnath Temple and the Hindu faith.

Entries.Title: Starbright
Entries.Description: A young orphan escapes the realities of her life by fantasizing about, and then entering, a fairy tale world.

Entries.Title: The Demon Hunter
Entries.Description: To save his wife A Rou, Lang Wujue sets out on a dangerous demon-hunting journey but is tricked by Daoist Baiyun and transformed into a beast. With A Rou’s awakened spirit, she begins a long, difficult quest to break the curse and restore his humanity.

Entries.Title: KD – The Devil
Entries.Description: In the early 1970s, a petty criminal Kaali unwittingly involves himself with underworld thugs, catalyzing events beyond his control.

Entries.Title: Bleed for Past
Entries.Description: The emergence of an underground drug trafficking ring plunges minor gang leader Old Dog and local crime boss Third Brother into a life-and-death crisis. A reckless young man named Dongzi becomes unwittingly entangled in the turmoil, rising to become Old Dog's most trusted lieutenant. The mysterious sudden death of gang patriarch Master Ge creates a power vacuum, triggering a bloody struggle as ruthless contenders battle for dominance while shadowy forces manipulate events from behind the scenes. Dongzi's true identity appears to conceal deeper complexities.  In this maelstrom of gunfire and betrayal, the brotherhood between Old Dog and Dongzi - forged through shared survival - faces ultimate betrayal within a blood-soaked labyrinth of intrigue. An earth-shattering conspiracy unfolds. On the carnage-strewn battlefield where human nature undergoes ultimate trials, only the survivors will write the final chapter of this high-stakes gambit...

Entries.Title: Fights Break Sphere 4: Escape
Entries.Description: After preventing a war between the Snake Tribe and the Human Clan, Xiao Yan embarks on a journey to strengthen his powers with his companions. Along the way, he prepares for a crucial duel with a powerful rival, but their quest takes a dark turn when Qinglin is suddenly abducted in the Tagore Desert.

Entries.Title: Broken Wings 2: Olivia
Entries.Description: A bomb explodes in a cafe, at the same time as Leong is released from prison. Sadikin orders Pandu to investigate Leong's trail. Pandu's time is increasingly taken up with Olivia, his daughter who needs the presence of a father after her mother died of illness. Luckily there is Suri, Olivia's teacher, who tries to fill the void by approaching Olivia. Because of Olivia, Pandu and Suri's relationship becomes closer. But the situation becomes more dangerous for Pandu because his face is seen when the ambush and revenge action are about to be carried out.

Entries.Title: The Final Run
Entries.Description: Pierce Butler, a former Marine and long-retired marijuana smuggler, whose wife is suffering from a rare type of cancer, must return to his drug-running ways and make one Final Load in order to save his house, his company, and his wife.

Entries.Title: Jurassic Reborn
Entries.Description: When cutting-edge research leads to the creation of living dinosaurs, a team of scientists on a secluded island must risk their lives and confront the now-growing creatures to prevent the animals from escaping and attacking the mainland.

Entries.Title: Panji Tengkorak
Entries.Description: Panji, who sold his soul to black magic to avenge his wife's death, intended to end his life, but found his body now shackled by black magic that controlled his soul. After wandering aimlessly, Panji met an old warrior who asked for his help to chase a bandit who had seized a sacred heirloom that was said to be able to eliminate the power of black magic. Panji accepted the offer that dragged him into a long war between two kingdoms and revealed the reality of his dark past.

Entries.Title: Checkered Ninja 3
Entries.Description: Upcoming third Checkered Ninja film slated to release in August of 2025

Entries.Title: The Unholy 2
Entries.Description: Ustadz Qodrat now embarks on the next journey to find his wife, Azizah and once again strike the revenge of evil powers.

Entries.Title: Impak Maksima 2
Entries.Description: Abang Joe, a motorsport center owner, hired a young man named Rudy who had been jailed for his involvement in illegal racing activities. Rudy began carrying out his duties in the arena with determination to improve himself and feels that this is his chance to gain as much knowledge as possible if he wants to become a legal car racer and drifter. However, this journey will bring challenges and heartache as he encounters both new friends and foes.

Entries.Title: Double or Nothing
Entries.Description: Two cousins embark on a high-energy race against the clock to find $50k when the mob discover one of them has been skimming from their Gold Coast workshop.

Entries.Title: UFC Fight Night 258: Imavov vs. Borralho
Entries.Description: UFC Fight Night 258: Imavov vs. Borralho (also known as UFC Fight Night: Imavov vs. Borralho and UFC on ESPN+ 116) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on September 6, 2025, at the Accor Arena in Paris, France.

Entries.Title: Tatsujin Warriors
Entries.Description: A group of rogue martial artists take over a peaceful city and it is down to Hikaru, an ex-con fresh out of a five-year prison sentence for manslaughter, to take out the violent gang. She recruits other martial arts heroes to destroy the criminals and will use her legendary Whip Fist Karate.

Entries.Title: Singh vs Kaur 2
Entries.Description: Singh vs Kaur 2 is an upcoming Indian Punjabi-language romantic comedy film directed by Navaniat Singh and produced by Gippy Grewal's Humble Motion Pictures and SVF Entertainment. Serving as a standalone sequel to the 2013 film Singh vs Kaur, it stars Gippy Grewal and Shehnaaz Gill, scheduled for worldwide release on 2 October 2025.

Entries.Title: God's Soldier
Entries.Description: A hard-as-nails nun must take on a rogue agent to protect a child in her care who harbours a special gift. When she is left for dead and her chapel is destroyed, she is given a second chance at life, fighting back in a brutal pursuit for revenge, doing everything in her power to save the chosen girl from a fate worse than death.

Entries.Title: Paradise
Entries.Description: "Can't we all just live together?" It would be nice, but for the twin brothers Il-do and Yi-do, it's just a wishful thought. Born under a cursed fate due to their parents' original sin, one must die for the other to live. To avoid this, they have deliberately cut off contact. However, when Yi-do, who works for a gang, gets stabbed, Il-do somehow hears about it and rushes to donate blood, saving his brother's life. But instead of gratitude, Yi-do attacks him the moment he sees him.

Entries.Title: ALL YOU NEED IS KILL
Entries.Description: When a massive alien flower known as "Darol" unexpectedly erupts in a deadly event, unleashing monstrous creatures that decimate the population of Japan, Rita is caught in the destruction—and killed. But then she wakes up again. And again. Caught in an endless time loop, Rita must navigate the trauma and repetition of death until she crosses paths with Keiji, a shy young man trapped in the same cycle. Together, they fight to break free from the loop and find meaning in the chaos around them.

Entries.Title: Padai Thalaivan
Entries.Description: An elephant trainer fights to find his beloved pachyderm after it is captured by poachers.

Entries.Title: Mazaka
Entries.Description: The path to true love does not run smoothly when a father and son seek marriage at the same time.

Entries.Title: Mnemonix
Entries.Description: Following the death of half of the global population by a virus, a scientist has introduced a new form of life: the Mnemonix.

Entries.Title: The Land That Time Forgot
Entries.Description: Present-day survivors of a sunken naval vessel capture a Russian sub, only to find themselves stranded on an island filled with deadly, prehistoric creatures

Entries.Title: Diesel
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Vaamana
Entries.Description: Explores the emotions and lifestyles of ordinary people, with a compelling hero Guna pursuing vengeance against antagonists. His actions are driven by his past life, which influences his present and future.

Entries.Title: LYF - Love Your Father
Entries.Description: A beautiful father-son duo navigates love, betrayal, and redemption amidst a betting mafia and police chase, unveiling a heartfelt journey of debts and dreams.

Entries.Title: Insaaf: Tale of Legends
Entries.Description: Yusuf, a brutal underworld kingpin, clashes with a relentless cop as a mysterious vigilante wages war on crime. As loyalties blur and vengeance builds, a high-stakes battle unfolds where justice teeters-hero, villain and avenger converge.

Entries.Title: Son Sefer
Entries.Description: A driver with hours left until retirement, an engineer who is the silent hero of the sky and passengers... All in the same vehicle, but in different lives. On the night of July 15, an ordinary journey turns into the route of destiny.

Entries.Title: The 4 Points
Entries.Description: Two LAPD Detectives take you on a bumpy, suspenseful ride along the streets of Los Angeles as Detectives Shane Murphy and Dre Allen navigate the twists and turns of life above and underground to stop a major gang war from exploding in the very same streets they grew up in only to find out a person very close to them is calling all the shots.

Entries.Title: Hunting Grounds
Entries.Description: Desperate to find refuge for her children, Chloe Marvino runs away from her Mafia tied husband, and finds shelter in a cabin with a recluse drifter named Jake. But as her husband's henchmen draw closer to her, it turns out that Jake is the biggest enemy of them all.

Entries.Title: Blind Cop 2
Entries.Description: When an influx of illegal weapons trafficking explodes onto the scene, a grieving blind police officer must purge the city streets or risk mass chaos breaking loose.

Entries.Title: Andhra King Taluka
Entries.Description: A fun filled slice of life entertainer

Entries.Title: Road to Vendetta
Entries.Description: In Asia, a mysterious assassin organization operates under the guise of a noodle shop hidden in a bustling city, serving as a haven for killers. Assassin No. 4, orphaned at a young age and raised in the noodle shop, is sent to Japan to eliminate a yakuza boss. However, he is unexpectedly ambushed by his client, a Japanese girl seeking revenge. To exact her vengeance, she spares no expense in hiring the assassin and attempts to enlist No. 4 in her grand revenge plan, only for their actions to inadvertently provoke a relentless pursuit by the yakuza, putting both their lives in danger...

Entries.Title: Drug Bust Storm
Entries.Description: Border drug lords thrive as anti-narcotics police fight fiercely. Vice Captain Xiao Ruolan falls into a trap during a raid, missing, while an impostor infiltrates the force. Drug lord Chen Qiang plots a major deal. Conflicts erupt: real vs. fake Xiao, cartel infighting, and gunfights. Who survives when the truth emerges?

Entries.Title: Kamen Rider Gotchard GRADUATIONS
Entries.Description: Taking place after the events of the Kamen Rider Gotchard TV series, the time is approaching for each of them to leave for their individual tomorrows. After graduating from high school, Houtaro Ichinose's dream remains the same: to become a big-time alchemist. Renge Icho and Sabimaru Tsuruhara are also moving on to the next stage. As for Rinne Kudo...

Entries.Title: Kamen Rider Blade 20th Anniversary STAGE&TALK
Entries.Description: The recording of the Kamen Rider Blade 20th Anniversary STAGE&TALK event based on the performance in Amagasaki (February 10, 2024) and bonus footage from the performance in Kasukabe (December 7, 2024). The event features a brand new story taking place 20 years after the series ended, and features the debut of Kamen Rider Leangle King Form.

Entries.Title: No Escape
Entries.Description: Set against the sweeping backdrop of China’s Inner Mongolian grasslands in the early 1990s, Impossible to Escape is a visceral crime-action thriller that pits relentless justice against ruthless lawlessness. Directed by Feng Baoning, the film follows veteran detective Zhang Xiao (played by Su Xin), a seasoned officer leading a task force to dismantle the brutal criminal empire of Guan Xiongfei (Du Yiheng), a merciless gangster terrorizing the region with audacious heists and savage violence.

Entries.Title: Cinco Tipos de Medo
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Throne of Seal The Movie: The Crownless God
Entries.Description: The legendary epic of Elekes, re - presenting the glorious path of the great Necromancer of the Undead Scourge, Elekes.

Entries.Title: Clash
Entries.Description: Liu Yonggan, a food delivery guy nicknamed the “Bolt of Shapingba,” gathers thirty buddies to form a ragtag underdog football team called the “Dock Workers” and compete at the Eternal Bowl championship.

Entries.Title: The Last Lap, Guys!
Entries.Description: A hilarious parody of American action movies, in which the main characters save the world in a humorous way, fighting against the bad guys. Exciting action scenes on snow, water and in the air further enhance the atmosphere, while a witty parody celebrates the action genre.

Entries.Title: Blazing Fists
Entries.Description: Ikuto and Ryoma grow close after meeting in juvenile detention. Motivated by Mikuru Asakura's words, they set their sights on the martial arts event Breaking Down, but looming rivalries threaten to derail their dream.

Entries.Title: War on Drug
Entries.Description: Anti-narcotics officer Kang Miao is on the trail of a notorious drug lord known as “Old Kite”—only to discover he is none other than his long-lost brother, Lei Ting! A 12-year-old grudge resurfaces: Lei Ting had been forced into working for the drug cartel in order to save Feng Ling. As their cat-and-mouse game intensifies, the two brothers find themselves pointing guns at each other. When justice collides with family ties, Lei Ting sacrifices himself for redemption, while Kang Miao holds firm to his beliefs, vowing to dismantle the drug network. A gripping tale of moral struggle and the clash between good and evil—on the path to eradicating drugs, every step is paved with blood and tears.

Entries.Title: Balkanika: Dark Side
Entries.Description: A drug smuggling crew from Bosnia-Herzegovina faces chaos when a Syrian migrant's explosives attract ISIS terrorists into the country, forcing them into a deadly game of loyalty and survival on the Bosnia and Herzegovina-Croatia border.

Entries.Title: 危情风云
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: One Spoon of Chocolate
Entries.Description: Fresh out of jail, a military veteran relocates to a small Ohio town where many of the residents have a horrifying social agenda, leading the hardened vet to enact his own brand of brutal justice.

Entries.Title: Attack Of The Machine
Entries.Description: The fate of humanity lies in the hands of a select few brave space explorers who are on a critical mission to face off against The Machine.

Entries.Title: Dayı: Bir Adamın Hikâyesi 2
Entries.Description: A ruthless gangster dispenses justice according to his own code of honor.

Entries.Title: Aldnoah.Zero (Re+)
Entries.Description: A movie compilation of the first and second cours of Aldnoah.Zero and also includes the new animation to conclude the series, Aldnoah.Zero: The Penultimate Truth.

Entries.Title: Magik Rompak
Entries.Description: A leading magician who assembles a reluctant crew for an audacious and daring heist to steal a priceless gem. As their pasts intertwine and the stakes rise, the team must perfect the art of illusion, confront their own vulnerabilities, and orchestrate the ultimate vanishing act to protect their futures.

Entries.Title: Horn Hunting Village
Entries.Description: The government launches a brutal campaign to eradicate the Kijo, half-human, half-demon hybrids. Their method: hunting and severing the horns of demons…

Entries.Title: Chavín de Huántar, el rescate del siglo
Entries.Description: On December 17, 1996, MRTA terrorists took hundreds of people hostage at the residence of the Japanese ambassador in Lima, Peru, including ministers and high-ranking military officials. For 126 days, the country remained in suspense as the Peruvian Army secretly planned Operation Chavín de Huantar, an intervention led by Commander Juan Valer. On April 22, 1997, after months of planning, Peruvian commandos carried out a rescue operation that kept Peru and the world on edge.

Entries.Title: Operation: Aunties
Entries.Description: When a dark web trafficking attempt impacts her family, blockchain expert Dr. Carol Cleavers joins forces with her best friend to take down a dangerous cyber operation exploiting women.

Entries.Title: Assassination: 1932
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Entertainment District Infiltration Arc
Entries.Description: Tanjiro and his friends accompany the Hashira Tengen Uzui to an entertainment district where Tengen's female ninja agents were gathering information on a demon before they suddenly disappeared. In order to investigate, Tanjiro and the others disguise themselves as women to sneak in. As they close in on their target, the demon reaches out for the courtesans of the district.

Entries.Title: The Lightning Code
Entries.Description: Teenage inventor Miles Fletcher unlocks the lost secret to limitless energy, catching the attention of Luxos Energy, a corporation posing as heroes. Just as he perfects his invention, they betray him—stealing his work and shutting him out. With nowhere to turn, Miles must decide—give up or trust his friends and fight back. In a high-stakes battle of ingenuity vs. industry, he races to stop Luxos before they turn his discovery into a weapon.

Entries.Title: The Workout
Entries.Description: After a tragic mob hit, an Army Ranger loses his wife. Consumed by vengeance, he abandons his workout video plans to relentlessly hunt down the mobsters responsible.

Entries.Title: Gates of Flesh
Entries.Description: A group of friends attempt to escape the city after an outbreak of demon-possessions. The friends seek shelter in an abandoned church, but their plans for escape are ruined when one of them becomes possessed.

Entries.Title: Reloaded 3
Entries.Description: In a world of crime, a journalist investigates a deadly new drug of a ruthless cartel and becomes their target. Jimmy Cloud is tasked the same, leading to a dangerous clash of fates.

Entries.Title: Deep Mountain Sniping
Entries.Description: In the spring of 1938, Japanese forces occupied the Jiaodong region of China. The village of Tiandao, located deep in the Kunyu Mountains, was chosen by the Japanese as a central stronghold. Lieutenant Colonel Watanabe Taro was dispatched with a unit to eliminate resistance in Tiandao Village. The village, whose inhabitants had lived as hunters for generations, faced the sudden invasion with fierce resistance, creating a heroic and fiery epic of youth amidst blood and fire.

Entries.Title: Silent Bite
Entries.Description: A gang of bank robbers take shelter in a motel after a Christmas Eve bank heist. Unbeknownst to them, they are not the most dangerous thing seeking refuge on this cold Christmas night.

Entries.Title: Agen +62
Entries.Description: Dito and Martha are two secret agents from PUANAS (National Agency Center), the lowest-ranking secret agency in Indonesia. Ironically, because of this low status, their data was spared from the massive hack that leaked intelligence information across the country. Seizing the opportunity, PUANAS takes on its biggest mission to uncover the nation's most troubling case—online gambling.

Entries.Title: Bendasing
Entries.Description: The world has been attacked by a type of virus brought by aliens, which causes humans to turn into zombies. At the same time, a number of aliens have descended to Earth and are eliminating anyone who is not infected by the virus.

Entries.Title: Dinoman the Movie: The Birth of Mudeungsan Dinosaur!
Entries.Description: Far away from the universe… The dinosaur, Dr. Tru who escaped from Dino World is on the verge of destruction due to a meteor impact! He accidentally crashed into a spaceship to Mudeung Mountain in Gwangju, Korea! Four dinosaur eggs from Seokseokdae hatched to the dinosaur hero, Dinoman to protect the earth! Three years later, the space robot specialized in martial arts invades the earth to catch endangered animals. Dinoman and his friends are dispatched in cool vehicles, defeating them with great wit and courage!!

Entries.Title: Sarbala Ji
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: All the Lost Ones
Entries.Description: In a dystopian and climate-ravaged future America torn apart by civil war, a group hiding in a remote cabin become the target of a ruthless rebel militia leader and his platoon, viciously hunted in a fight for survival.

Entries.Title: Aasma
Entries.Description: At the pinnacle of the splendor of the Himalayas sits the Kashmir valley, one of the most stunningly picturesque places on earth. But today, its grandeur has also become ubiquitous with the ravages of terrorism and counter terrorism operations. Under these circumstances, anyone roaming these hills would tell you the shocking truth: that combat soldiers are statistically safer than women.

Entries.Title: 7FATES: CHAKHO
Entries.Description: Anime short film based on the webtoon 7FATES: CHAKHO

Entries.Title: Virgin Punk: Clockwork Girl
Entries.Description: The story follows Ubu, a young woman who finds herself living the dangerous life of a bounty hunter. As she grapples with her inner turmoil, she becomes entangled in a world filled with chaos and the desires of the powerful and eccentric individuals around her.

Entries.Title: Kung Fu Kenzo
Entries.Description: When Kenzo's boring office job, aggravating boss and the local bullies get too much for him, his Kung-Fu-inspired alter ego pushes him to break out of the mundanity and regain control by fighting back.

Entries.Title: C.I.C. - Central de Inteligência Cearense
Entries.Description: A secret agent from the Ceará Intelligence Agency is Brazil's last hope for recovering stolen data from a top-secret project that threatens to destroy the country's beaches.

Entries.Title: Tiro Certo - Rio em Chamas
Entries.Description: The film brings the story of Benito Terranova, a sniper on the edge of the psychological abyss who faces organized crime to do justice.

Entries.Title: Abu Si Raksasa
Entries.Description: Sofian, who is investigating mysterious disappearances of anglers at a lake in KL, accidentally recorded a gigantic lizard-like monster surfacing briefly. The video was uploaded to YouTube and it caught the attention of Zaara, who believes the monster is her escaped pet gecko named Abu, but she has no idea how it has grown so big. Sofian & Zaara started to investigate, but when the sightings became frequent, they started to cause public commotion and it became a national security issue.

Entries.Title: Stolen Girl
Entries.Description: In 1993, Maureen’s six-year-old daughter Amina is snuck out of the country by her ex-husband, Karim. After years of unsuccessful attempts to find her, Maureen intersects with a professional retriever of internationally abducted children who promises to help her find Amina in exchange for her collaboration.

Entries.Title: The Death of Snow White
Entries.Description: Pursued by her stepmother for eternal beauty, Snow White flees into a terrifying forest and aligns with seven bloodthirsty dwarves - cold-blooded assassins with a knack for brutal killings. Her spirit is tested in this grim fairy tale.

Entries.Title: Going Places
Entries.Description: After covering up a hit and run on the way to their valedictory desert getaway, three high school graduates face the true test of their friendship when they become entangled in a deadly crime ring imbroglio.

Entries.Title: July 7: Who Killed the President of Haiti?
Entries.Description: A curious college student travels to Haiti to unravel the life of the president. What she finds is...unspeakable. While investigating the past of President Moïse for a memoir, Shedeline walks into the heart of a life-changing event for her, Haiti, and its president; as she gets a front-row seat to the chaos and intrigue of a bloody political firestorm. This unexpected turn of events shakes her and introduces a terrifying twist to what she thought would be an ordinary story. Now, her memory is heavy with the answer to the prodigious question hanging over an unsettled nation. Who killed the president?

Entries.Title: The Mystery of the Silk
Entries.Description: In the early years of the Western Han Dynasty, a devastating fire destroys the imperial silk destined as tribute to the Xiongnu—a catastrophe that reignites turmoil across the Western Regions. Jiang Yu, an elite emissary of the court, is dispatched under secret decree to investigate the arson and avert a crisis on the frontier.
