Meanwhile, his beloved Cannu, a silk-weaver turned folk hero, rallies the people of Shiquan to replenish the lost tribute and save the empire from disgrace.  As Jiang Yu ventures alone into the treacherous Western Regions, he must confront an impossible choice: loyalty to the Han Dynasty’s fate… or the whispers of his heart

Entries.Title: Dhurandhar
Entries.Description: Set in the world of Indian intelligence, Dhurandhar follows a covert officer on a high-stakes mission rooted in historical events. The film blends high-octane action sequences, Shakespearean betrayals, and intricate espionage tradecraft, centered on the lives of the unknown men.

Entries.Title: ZombieCON Vol. 1
Entries.Description: A group of cosplaying friends trigger a zombie apocalypse and are forced to traverse a zombie-infested Los Angeles to save their loved one.

Entries.Title: Paradise Records
Entries.Description: Cooper is trying to keep the doors of Paradise Records open with its motley crew of entertaining employees, even as the world works against him.

Entries.Title: Ultraman Arc the Movie: The Clash of Light and Evil
Entries.Description: A mysterious space sage entrusts Yuma with challenges that surpass the limits of his imagination with a stake too high. He asks, "Should you fail… then you… will lose your power as Arc." The burden of protecting Hoshimoto City alongside SKIP members are twisted by Sascal, who manipulates them, sending challenge after challenge toward Yuma.  Battling giant kaiju, an evil alien bent on destruction, and a warped dimension where even time itself is distorted, Yuma must confront the ultimate test. Will he... will Ultraman Arc overcome the greatest challenge yet and protect the future, surpassing the limits of the power of imagination?

Entries.Title: The Damnation
Entries.Description: Struggling debt collector, Jefri, awaits the birth of his second child with Ella in her 8-month pregnancy. Haunted by the loss of their first child, their high hopes for the baby’s arrival. When complications arise, they unknowingly turn to an illegal maternity clinic run by a twisted doctor and nurse couple, Iwan and Sandra. Jefri and Ella must fight for their survival as the clinic sacrifices unborn children to demonic forces. A terrifying night of damnation ensues, with them battling the survival of Ella and their unborn child from the clock-ticking and unexpected horrors.

Entries.Title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26
Entries.Description: An animated anthology of 8 short films adapted from Tatsuki Fujimoto’s early works, created from ages 17 to 26. Based on the manga collections 17-21 and 22-26, and brought to life by 6 different studios, the project explores the raw beginnings of the Chainsaw Man author, where surreal comedy, eerie worlds, and emotional intensity first took shape.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Special Edition Swordsmith Village Arc Part 1
Entries.Description: A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 45–49, Tanjiro's journey leads him to the Swordsmith Village, where he reunites with two Hashira, members of the Demon Slayer Corps' highest-ranking - Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji. With the shadows of demons lurking near, a new battle begins for Tanjiro and his comrades.

Entries.Title: LUPIN THE IIIRD THE MOVIE The Immortal Bloodline
Entries.Description: The story follows Lupin and his team as they seek a treasure on a mysterious unmarked island.

Entries.Title: Red Blood Rescue
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Be Forever Yamato Rebel 3199: Part 3: Ultramarine Asteroid
Entries.Description: Third film in the theatrical version of Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199, covering chapters 7–10. In 2209, a mysterious "Grand Reverse" invades Earth's capital, defying defenses. The former Yamato crew reunites on a secret order, embarking on a perilous journey as an unknown invader threatens humanity's fate.

Entries.Title: Crossing Lines
Entries.Description: Cairo, a reformed criminal, enjoys his new life as a gang exit counselor. When his nephew Hamza disappears, Cairo discovers he had secretly joined his former gang. Despite his pledge to avoid violence, frustration with the police's lack of action pushes Cairo to seek help from his former underworld connections. His investigation leads him into Copenhagen's criminal scene. Despite his efforts to avoid violence, his past instincts resurface.

Entries.Title: Tokyo MER: Nankai Mission
Entries.Description: A massive volcanic eruption has occurred on a remote island in the southern seas, creating an unprecedented disaster. The Nankai MER members must go save everyone in the island.

Entries.Title: Garo: Taiga
Entries.Description: Lurking among us are the Horrors, ancient enemies of our kind hailing from another realm. Holding the line against them, down through the ages, are the Makai Knights. Across generations, the men of the Saejima family have assumed the lupine aspect and magical armour of Golden Knight Garo—Raiga, before him Kouga, and before him Taiga, whose spirit has watched over his descendants. Little of Taiga’s tale has been revealed—until now. A new adventure harkens back to Taiga’s tenure as Garo, recalling his childhood training, his dedicated pursuit of his demonic foes, and the challenge he faces when a sacred artifact containing the souls of four elemental guardian spirits is stolen by Jado, a powerful Horror, who plans to unleash legions of evil into our world.

Entries.Title: Hierarchy
Entries.Description: In an undisclosed area of Texas after two adoptive brothers become entangled in criminal activity, forced to evade law enforcement and the greedy Russian mafia.

Entries.Title: Armed
Entries.Description: A group of veteran marines steal a shipment of weapons from the military only to find a Cold War era robot that hunts them down, determined to complete its mission. Nothing can stop this deadly killing machine.

Entries.Title: FOXBODY
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Sambarala Yetti Gattu
Entries.Description: In a land ruled by a ruthless tyrant, a young man embarks on a dangerous quest to dismantle the warlords empire and free his people from oppression.

Entries.Title: Mr.Robot
Entries.Description: A futuristic world where robots have become popular, Tae-pyeong is possessed by a robot body in an unfortunate accident. He meets Nana, whose life is threatened by her evil uncle, who killed her brother to take over the company. The story of a robot who sacrifices his entire body to protect a child in danger.

Entries.Title: Men of Sacifice 2
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Ikatan Darah
Entries.Description: A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.

Entries.Title: Zombie Land Saga: Yumeginga Paradise
Entries.Description: Zombie Land Saga: Yumeginga Paradise builds upon the original TV series' unique setting with an expanded scale. The idol group Franchouchou, which initially set out to revitalize a region, is reborn in this film as a symbolic entity carrying the future of the Earth. While preserving the quirky charm of zombie idols, the film’s direction is more dazzling, suited to the theater screen. In particular, the climax's live performance scene introduces new potential in idol anime by seamlessly blending music and drama, offering both laughter and heartfelt emotion.

Entries.Title: A tiro limpio
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Akaal: The Unconquered
Entries.Description: Set in 1840s Punjab, Sardar Akaal Singh and his village as they face a vengeful assault by Jangi Jahan and his forces after the death of Maharaja Ranjeet Singh. Amid broken truces and escalating tensions, the fearless Sardars must rise against overwhelming odds to protect their land. Will they prevail against this formidable foe?

Entries.Title: Masameer Junior
Entries.Description: After a dire lesson on bad behavior, three unruly six-year-olds embark on a chaotic quest for the ultimate "good deed" — unleashing mayhem at every turn.

Entries.Title: Marching Powder
Entries.Description: Middle-aged Jack, arrested for drugs, strives in six weeks to repair his marriage, curb a bullying in-law, and guide his stepbrother in the right direction, but all efforts fail as his life spirals further out of control.

Entries.Title: Badh
Entries.Description: When police officer Ilias is shot and left in a coma, Alma must reconnect with her former identity as Badh, a ruthless intelligence operative and skilled assassin. She brutally eliminates members of the Khoury family one by one, unleashing the fury of their leader Mansour, only to discover that Mansour is working with Joana, her former secret service unit officer.

Entries.Title: Borbaad
Entries.Description: After a heartbreak by Nitu, Ariyan Mirza seeks revenge, guided by his father Adib Mirza's wisdom. Their story transforms from romance to violence, culminating in courtroom confrontations over justice.

Entries.Title: WWE Best of Raw 2024 Special
Entries.Description: Raw plays host to in-ring classics, jaw-dropping confrontations and shocking twists in this best of 2024 recap.

Entries.Title: Sneak Me in Your Closet My Prince
Entries.Description: When mafia heir Sebastian hides from assassins in Gabriel's hotel room during his wedding day, their reunion reignites old feelings. After his fiancee's betrayal, Gabriel marries Sebastian instead but family secrets threaten their future.

Entries.Title: Gundik
Entries.Description: A former soldier gets a job to rob a house, but it turns out that the house is the house of Nyai, a concubine a.k.a Gundik.

Entries.Title: Bubba
Entries.Description: Mia arrives at her sister’s veterinary clinic, carrying a heavy bag and an injured dog named Bubba. As the sisters prepare to leave together, Mia’s phone pings with messages from her controlling boyfriend, Mitch, demanding to know where she is. When Mitch unexpectedly appears outside the clinic, Mia is forced to abandon her escape plan and fabricate a story to cover her tracks. As tension simmers between the couple, Mia is faced with an agonizing decision: escape her abusive boyfriend or stay behind to protect her beloved dog, Bubba.

Entries.Title: UFC Fight Night 259: Lopes vs. Silva
Entries.Description: UFC Fight Night 259: Lopes vs. Silva (also known as UFC Fight Night: Lopes vs. Silva  and Noche UFC 3) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place September 13, 2025, at the Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, Texas, United States.

Entries.Title: Angry Rescue
Entries.Description: An international security company assigns Long Xiaohu and his comrade Gao Feng to escort an unknown creature. On their return journey, they are unexpectedly ambushed by armed gangsters, leading to a disastrous incident. Framed as kidnappers, they face severe misunderstandings from their families and colleagues.

Entries.Title: AAA Triplemanía XXXIII
Entries.Description: Triplemanía XXXIII was the premier annual supercard of Lucha Libre AAA World Wide (AAA), held on Saturday, August 16, 2025, at the Arena CDMX in Mexico City, Mexico. This event marked a historic shift, as it was the very first Triplemanía staged under the ownership and creative influence of WWE, following their acquisition of AAA on August 1, 2025.

Entries.Title: Bad Day at the Office
Entries.Description: The film follows Karl Davis waking in a wrecked hotel room with no memory of what’s happened, where he is, or even who he is.

Entries.Title: Panda Plan 2
Entries.Description: They are back! What new adventure will they going on?

Entries.Title: Jules
Entries.Description: Determined to reclaim her identity, Jules defies her boyfriend's ban on motocross, igniting a fierce battle between love and ambition as she races against the ghosts of his past.

Entries.Title: Operation Sámán
Entries.Description: Based on the true story of Operation Shaman Shield, when Hungarian soldiers evacuated 540 people, including 180 children, from Afghanistan as NATO forces withdrew. Coming Fall 2025.

Entries.Title: Dutch III: International Gangster
Entries.Description: A month before Dutch's "Month of Murder" trial, Roc and Angel are imprisoned. Craze takes charge but is wary when contacted by Joseph Odouwo, Kazami's wealthy, powerful relative. Odouwo's plans may endanger them.

Entries.Title: Bleed For Justice
Entries.Description: The peace of Donghai City was shattered by a gang shootout, as the duo assassins, Chainsaw and Yangyang, stormed a money house and emptied its assets. The assassins were acting under the orders of corporate mogul Zhao Ping'an, in a classic case of betrayal among criminals. Meanwhile, SWAT teams were deployed, setting up an inescapable dragnet. Under heavy resistance, the authorities successfully apprehended the criminals, completely thwarting the international conglomerate's attempt to transfer their assets.

Entries.Title: Forsaken Mercenary
Entries.Description: He's the deadliest man in the galaxy with a secret that could be his undoing.

Entries.Title: Chaotic Jianghu: Divine Weapons Rivalry
Entries.Description: When a legendary divine weapon resurfaces, it sets off a frenzy in the martial world as heroes compete to claim it and dominate the jianghu. But beneath the hunt lies a shocking secret that triggers a web of rivalries and conspiracies.

Entries.Title: Jigel
Entries.Description: Jigel is a romantic comedy thriller. The hero Nandu is an expert 'locker technician' who cracks anylocker or safe in his own inimitable style. His character is very stylishly mountedwith all new and old gimmicks.

Entries.Title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Special Edition Swordsmith Village Arc Part 2
Entries.Description: A recap of Kimetsu no Yaiba episodes 50–55, Tanjiro's journey leads him to the Swordsmith Village, where he reunites with two Hashira, members of the Demon Slayer Corps' highest-ranking - Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito and Love Hashira Mitsuri Kanroji. With the shadows of demons lurking near, a new battle begins for Tanjiro and his comrades.

Entries.Title: 鬼平犯科帳 暗剣白梅香
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Bramhaarjun
Entries.Description: A Souvik Dey film.

Entries.Title: Golpes
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: LegendSaravanan02
Entries.Description: Legend Sravanan's Next Film with Director Durai Senthil Kumar

Entries.Title: Atena
Entries.Description: Athena was abused by her father during her childhood. Years later, without answers and marked by the absence of justice, she decides to take matters into her own hands in similar cases in the city where she lives. With the help of journalist Carlos, she travels to Montevideo where she finds her father and faces her past head-on, seeking revenge.

Entries.Title: Shogun's Ninja
Entries.Description: The descendants of the legendary Fuma ninja clan face off against the Tokugawa shogun's family of Yagyu samurai as they kidnap women in the hopes of finding a concubine for the shogun

Entries.Title: Sri Sri Sri Raja Vaaru
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Killing Mary Sue
Entries.Description: A corrupt senator arranges for the murder of his biggest liability, his erratic burnout stepdaughter, only for her to unwittingly discover her natural talent as an untouchable killer.

Entries.Title: Lop Nor Tomb
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Kamen Rider Gavv: Gourmet Snacks and Woo!-mai Wakamen!!
Entries.Description: In order to defeat the Granute, Shoma will use new Gochizo to transform into a new form and assist! These new Gochizo are the Kungfu Ramen Gochizo and the Choco Treasure Gochizo.

Entries.Title: Red Bird
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Jongli
Entries.Description: Liza made a difficult decision at the moment of the birth of her illegitimate child in the hospital. So she had no choice but to abandon the child in the dustbin. As she was leaving the baby in a dumpster on the road behind the hospital in the dark of night, she came face to face with Dr. Tithi—the very doctor who had delivered Liza's baby in the operating theater. Tithi brought her back to the hospital and began to tell her a story. A story intertwined with Tithi herself, a 6-year-old girl named Pakhi, and a wild-hearted man named Johnny.

Entries.Title: Supa Eleph
Entries.Description: Supa Eleph saves the city from a new evil monster robot of Mr Evil.

Entries.Title: Ishq-E-Lahore
Entries.Description: A poor man decide to clear the city from gamblers &  drug dealers.

Entries.Title: Doğulu
Entries.Description: After being released from prison, where they had been incarcerated for many years, Fırat Doğulu and his companion Akın find themselves embroiled in a relentless quest for revenge.

Entries.Title: UFC 312: Du Plessis vs. Strickland 2
Entries.Description: UFC 312: du Plessis vs. Strickland 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 9, 2025, at the Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, Australia.  A UFC Middleweight Championship rematch between current champion Dricus du Plessis (also former KSW Welterweight Champion) and former champion Sean Strickland headlined the event.

Entries.Title: Detective Kien: The Headless Horror
Entries.Description: Detective Kien investigates a headless body found in a rural Vietnamese village during the Nguyen Dynasty. As supernatural elements emerge, he faces chilling twists in this 19th-century mystery.

Entries.Title: Soorya
Entries.Description: A heartwarming tale about a young man,rediscovering and reinventing himself embarking on a fulfilling journey of life.

Entries.Title: Hidden Tides: 12 Hours of Terror
Entries.Description: A high-stakes, heart-pounding tale revolves around a massive gambling fortune. Multiple factions engage in a brutal and fierce battle to seize the money inside a remote mountain villa. Trapped inside, the villa’s occupants fight back using warehouse tools to set traps and counterattack. Every moment is a fight for survival. Ultimately, justice breaks through the darkness as the wail of police sirens signals the end of the blood-soaked, greed-driven conflict.

Entries.Title: LOSER
Entries.Description: Jo and Andrew, two carefree young men, spend time together smoking weed and wandering around the city. When they decide to steal a packet of cookies from a minimarket. What starts as a simple robbery turns into a mind-blowing chase through the streets of the city, leading Jo to a state of almost delirium.

Entries.Title: Omniscient
Entries.Description: While in Singapore, a spy is unknowingly sent on a suicide mission and hunted for a valuable device in his possession.

Entries.Title: Red Flower
Entries.Description: Military legacy drives twin brothers in 2047 India. Their paths divide when one receives a classified assignment, while rejection leads his brother to join opposing forces

Entries.Title: Princess Principal Crown Handler: Chapter 4
Entries.Description: The fourth film of Princess Principal: Crown Handler.

Entries.Title: The Street Avenger
Entries.Description: When a young girl being raised by a single father loses him to gang violence she turns to law enforcement but they are no help. She tries to take the law into her own hands and finds out being a vigilante

Entries.Title: Donde Tú Quieras
Entries.Description: Ramiro Guerrero, a successful professional, is wrongly accused of a devastating crime. With his life in shambles, he fights to prove his innocence while facing a web of corruption and danger.

Entries.Title: Play Dirty
Entries.Description: With Internal Affairs coming down on him, a corrupt cop must take out the competition of the crime boss he moonlights for if he wants to survive long enough to get out of town first.

Entries.Title: Mrigaya
Entries.Description: Based on real events, Mrigaya follows the investigation of a sex worker's brutal murder and robbery in a red-light area of Kolkata. As the case unfolds, the police uncover disturbing truths about those connected to the crime.

Entries.Title: Kamen Rider Gavv: Guilty Parfait
Entries.Description: After the events of the series, Shoma continues his research for "Light Treats" to replace Dark Treats, Hanto continues his research as a freelance writer as keep daily records of the battle of the Kamen Riders, and Rakia remains alone in the Granute World. However, a new incident occurs in the once peaceful human world, forcing Shoma to rush back to the battlefield. What serious abnormality has occured to Hanto's body? What is the current state of the president's daughter, Lizel Jaldak, who is stuck in the human world? The final battle of the candy Kamen Riders begin!

Entries.Title: German Horror Story - Teutonic Terror Tales
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Thunderbolt Fantasy: The Final Chapter
Entries.Description: In a world inhabited by cool puppets, brave heroes fight to prevent magic swords from falling into the wrong hands. Stylishly choreographed duels, double-crossings, mystical powers, and cool one-liners…

Entries.Title: Under Fire
Entries.Description: Story unfolds in the scorching heat of the Mexico border, where rival drug dealers Griff and Abbott arrive at a remote drop point for a routine drug deal. But when the exchange goes down, both reveal undercover badges — Griff is FBI, Abbott is DEA — and neither knew they were working the same case.

Entries.Title: 3 Cold Dishes
Entries.Description: Three women from Nigeria, Côte d'Ivoire and Benin reunite seventeen years after surviving sex trafficking to dismantle the powerful men behind their pain. From the streets of Lagos to the shadows of Abidjan and Cotonou, they execute a cold, calculated mission — each move sharpened by trauma, sisterhood and strategy. What begins as vengeance becomes a fight for identity, justice and survival in a world that never expected them to rise.

Entries.Title: Evil of the Rat
Entries.Description: Reporter travels with his companions and encounters a little girl who stops the road to ask for help. In order to save the girl, they get involved in a catastrophic incident in which a group of mutated rats attack human beings.

Entries.Title: We Are Storror
Entries.Description: At the peak of their death-defying careers, the seven friends of parkour team Storror embark on what could be their final project: a globetrotting quest to conquer four extreme environments. Faced with harrowing accidents and personal conflicts, the team grapples to maintain the bonds that have united them since their beginnings as ragtag street kids.

Entries.Title: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
Entries.Description: After a cop’s daughter witnesses a brutal murder, she teams up with an unlikely ally to unravel the mystery before becoming the killer’s next target.

Entries.Title: MMA Cop
Entries.Description: When a beautiful journalist pursues a story on a child sex trafficking operation, she becomes hunted by assassins. Her only hope? A rogue, wisecracking detective with a penchant for violence.

Entries.Title: Dengard
Entries.Description: The tale of two tribes. A battle for the jewel that brought them apart.

Entries.Title: Lake George
Entries.Description: Four years after a heist gone wrong, two childhood friends, Rio and Psych, are thrust into a high-stakes journey. When Psych discovers his imprisoned father is being held for ransom with only 24 hours to pay $100,000, the pair embarks on a desperate mission to secure the funds.

Entries.Title: Phra Ruang: Rise of The Empire
Entries.Description: The tale of a confrontation with a formidable enemy, poised to seize the throne. It is time for the two kings to set aside their differences and unite in order to protect and preserve their kingdom.

Entries.Title: Wolf Girl
Entries.Description: Wolf Girl fights for justice but it seems that she is not strong enough so her childhood friend is always there to help with magic!

Entries.Title: Agincourt
Entries.Description: A group of workers at a factory re-enact The Battle of Agincourt in cardboard suits of armour. King Henry rallies his troops with an inspirational speech as they face an overwhelming French army. When the French messenger offers ransom The King rejects the bargain and the battle ensues in a flurry of cardboard. And death. But mostly cardboard.

Entries.Title: Super Kuuga Exhibition EXTRA EPISODE Revisited
Entries.Description: Released as part of Kamen Rider Kuuga's 25th anniversary celebrations, Detective Kaoru Ichijo visits café Pole Pole for the first time in a long time, and looks back to the events that happened 25 years ago.

Entries.Title: 新逃学威龙：卧底高校
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Gintama: The Best of Gintama on Theater 2D
Entries.Description: Movie version of the Shinsengumi Crisis arc (episodes 101-105) and the Kabukicho Four Devas arc (episodes 210-214) which were screened in selected theaters in Japan.

Entries.Title: Gangland: The City of Crime
Entries.Description: A deadly feud emerges between a powerful gangster and his former friend.

Entries.Title: Dark Secrets: Game of Death Chapter 2
Entries.Description: Directed by Timo Rose.

Entries.Title: The Omro Heist
Entries.Description: A bank robbery goes wrong in a once quiet Wisconsin small town. The locals must stand up to take down an evil gunman who will kill anyone that gets in his way.

Entries.Title: Hard Justice
Entries.Description: Marine Grace Thompson joins the LAPD following the footsteps of her brother Michael. But when Michael is murdered, Grace must piece together the puzzle by following leads of corruption and cover-ups that run deeper than she ever imagined.

Entries.Title: Where Heroes Die
Entries.Description: During Word War II, an Air Corps pilot must rescue a group of POWS on a German island before the Invasion of Normandy.

Entries.Title: Risqué
Entries.Description: Fired from a strip club, a vengeful dancer masterminds a high-stakes heist with fellow strippers to take down the corrupt boss and the men who underestimate them.

Entries.Title: 1 More Round
Entries.Description: Jackie Despain is in the for the fight of her life. In order to get custody of her young niece, the aspiring mixed martial artist, does the one things she knows she is good at - fight. If she can win enough fights within the brutal, high stakes world of mixed martial arts and sign a professional contract, she can win back her niece. As Jackie blazes a violent path towards her goal, she must rely on the guidance of her hardened trainer, Hank.

Entries.Title: 5 Minutes
Entries.Description: a man is told by his creator that he doesn't have much time left

Entries.Title: The Gentleman
Entries.Description: Aging ex-soldier Theo meets weekly with prostitute Olga to reminisce. After Olga's murder, Theo seeks bloody revenge, attracting attention of alcoholic cop Iborra and hitman Herodes.

Entries.Title: In and Out
Entries.Description: Hipis’ gang gives Oskar one last chance to stay alive. He has to pull off a big deal to buy his way out of their hands. It was supposed to be a quick job — but it turns out his partner is a complete lunatic.

Entries.Title: Адель
Entries.Description: In 2041, the USSR and China create a new techno-socialist superpower, where the main weapon is a person united with AI. Police captain Mark Sokolov hides inside himself Adele - an artificial intelligence fused with his brain since infancy. Investigating a murder, Mark faces betrayal, state secrets and an internal struggle for control over his own body and the fate of humanity.

Entries.Title: Ninjago Legends: Monstrosity
Entries.Description: In search of his friends, Kai ventures into the mysterious Land of Monsters, where terrifying creatures lurk at every turn. He’s not the only one fighting for survival in this brutal environment... What horrors will Kai face on his journey?

Entries.Title: Penjagal Iblis: Dosa Turunan
Entries.Description: Ningrum, a 19-year-old girl, was accused of being the perpetrator of the murder of a family while performing ruqiah. But she swore that she was not a murderer - but a devil's slaughterer. When a reporter tried to dig up the truth, he was caught in a battle between Ningrum the devil's slaughterer and the devil worshiper.

Entries.Title: Informant
Entries.Description: Detectives have their informant, a.k.a. ‘straw’, to arrest criminal organizations under investigation practices. Tae-bong is working as a straw in a smuggling office. Incompetent detective Nam-hyuk is using him to replace the sorrow of not having a string to pull. While doing his duty in the smuggling gang, an incident exposed Tae-bong’s identity. Without knowing his situation, Nam-hyuk is trying to steal the smuggled goods to turn his life around. But he is dragged into a mysterious crime as he enters another office by accident. At the brink of death, Tae-bong gets through the crisis by chance but loses all the money he has saved after being involved in the incident with Nam-hyuk… A cooperation begins between a detective and an informant, for Nam-hyuk to break the case and for Tae-bong to get his money back!

Entries.Title: UFC Fight Night 257: Walker vs. Zhang
Entries.Description: UFC Fight Night: Walker vs. Zhang (also known as UFC Fight Night 257 and UFC on ESPN+ 115) is an upcoming mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that will take place on August 23, 2025, at the Shanghai Indoor Stadium in Shanghai, China.

Entries.Title: Hollywood Grit
Entries.Description: When his daughter vanishes from a Hollywood jazz club, a detective must battle mobsters, starlets, and his own demons to unearth the sinister truth lurking behind LA's neon lights.

Entries.Title: Legasi: Bomba the Movie
Entries.Description: After successfully rescuing several teenage climbers from Mount Kinabalu, Amir a member of the Special Tactical Rescue Operations Team (STORM) and his mentor Eddy became closer. But Eddy was involved in a tragic accident and felt guilty for the incident. When the tower of TEXVIN 118 caught fire, Amir was assigned to lead this important mission. The situation became more tense when a firefighter was also trapped inside the building. Will Amir succeed in saving them or will the past tragedy repeat itself?

Entries.Title: Viper
Entries.Description: A trio of covert operatives in an elite group of assassins-for-hire are bound by the strictest code of conduct: no romantic entanglements.

Entries.Title: Veera Chandrahasa
Entries.Description: Kulinda, a noble of Kuntala, discovers an abandoned boy in the jungle and names him Chandrahasa for his radiant smile. Raised with love, Chandrahasa grows into a virtuous young man, unaware of the powerful enemies plotting against him.  But his unwavering faith shields him from harm. Each failed attempt only brings downfall to his enemies, turning foes into allies. Chandrahasa emerges as a symbol of divine grace, protected by the gods.

Entries.Title: White Rabbit II
Entries.Description: A deranged  student is drawn into a circle of madness by an accelerationist CIA agent due to his crippling addiction to Chinese confectionery.

Entries.Title: Varunan
Entries.Description: In a world on the brink of chaos, a seemingly ordinary conflict two rival water supply businesses becomes the unexpected catalyst for a potential war, when one begins hiding illicit arrack beneath their water cans. Petty squabbles escalate into violent confrontations as loyalties are tested and betrayals mount.

Entries.Title: Gangster Alla Prankster
Entries.Description: Arjun, an unemployed guy, starts a YouTube Channel named WEBMASTER and Pranks people, recording and uploading to YouTube. While pranking, he falls into his own trap.

Entries.Title: Daagi
Entries.Description: Nishan spent more than twelve years behind bars. The story begins as he steps out of prison, only to find that the world he left behind has changed drastically. Society refuses to accept him as one of its own. Thus begins Nishan's struggle to survive in an unfamiliar world.

Entries.Title: Say Who Die
Entries.Description: The tale of a set of twins whose bond is tested by secrets, family dysfunction, and choices that spiral into chaos.

Entries.Title: Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger VS. King-Ohger
Entries.Description: Nicola, who has ascended to the throne as the queen of Planet Trickle, has decided to form an alliance with Planet Chikyu. Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger has been invited to act as witnesses. However, a remnant of the Hashiriyan named Manhole Grumer appears and steals the jewel that's been passed down in the Trickle royal family from Nicola! Furthermore, Minongan, one of Dagded's five jesters appears and steals the Ohgercalibur ZERO, which was prepared for the alliance ceremony! The Ohsama Sentai King-Ohger rushes to the scene and fights alongside the Boonboomger, but the warriors are separated by Manhole Grumer's mysterious power. Taiya and the others were scattered across the stars, each take action to escape from this dire situation. Soon, a dangerous heartbeat begins to resonate from deep underground. As a powerful evil awakens, will the two great Super Sentai be able to come together again fight together?! The battle for the three planets begins now!!

Entries.Title: We Die Tonight
Entries.Description: When two bleeding people fall into the store, the staff has to barricade themselves. To protect the unknown people from an armed gang trying to break in and finish the job.

Entries.Title: Invincible
Entries.Description: A debt-ridden boxer is kidnapped by mobsters and must put his physical abilities to the test in order to survive.

Entries.Title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Chrome Alone 2: Lost in New Jersey
Entries.Description: When a mysterious toy company seeks to profit off the turtles' new hero status, the brothers follow the clues to New Jersey and make a shocking discovery in this all new original short.

Entries.Title: Z! The Magical Girl
Entries.Description: Zatanna Zatara’s origin is explained in this feature length continuation of Max Landis’ Kryptonian Epic. It is the longest piece of visual media dedicated to the character in the history of DC.

Entries.Title: Digimon Adventure-BEYOND-
Entries.Description: Time has passed since that summer adventure, and there are even more children with partner Digimon now. However, because of their unique nature, many children face the looming shadows of persecution and being targeted for military use. While Taichi and Yamato are working to rescue children, they are attacked by mysterious Digimon.

Entries.Title: Intruders: Who is the Trespasser
Entries.Description: To develop a potent anti-cancer drug, a research team ventures to a secluded island in search of an ancient plant known as "Fire Prison Vine Lotus". On the island, they encounter attacks from prehistoric creatures and uncover Jurassic-era ruins. After numerous challenges and securing the plant's stamen, the team faces relentless pursuit by velociraptors, leading to their separation, with only three members surviving the ordeal.

Entries.Title: Harsens Island Revenge
Entries.Description: WWI veterans on Harsens Island square off against the infamous 'Purple Gang' over illegal liquor in the 1920s.

Entries.Title: Action! Action!
Entries.Description: Action! Action! is a high-octane action-comedy bursting with adventure, betrayal, loyalty, and love. When a close-knit crew is hired to steal a priceless Al Capone painting from the Mob Museum in Las Vegas, their plan is derailed mid-heist by an unseen enemy.  Hunted, and out of time, they must uncover who set them up before everything crashes down. With explosive stunts, sharp comedy, and an over-the-top finale, Action! Action! delivers a relentless thrill ride from start to finish.

Entries.Title: Papers
Entries.Description: Trapped in the middle of the world-shaking Panama Papers scandal, Ana Mendez must fight the system, the global media and her own ethical compass to try to restore her reputation and save her family.

Entries.Title: Serra das Almas
Entries.Description: In Pernambuco, a jewel robbery brings together an old group of misfits, with catastrophic results. Watched over by ghosts from the past, each of them will have to find their own way to freedom.

Entries.Title: The Martial Artist
Entries.Description: When MMA rising star Ibby 'The Prince' Bakran shines in a local fight, the world’s largest promotion company offers him a deal he can’t refuse.  Now aligned with the sport’s top developing athletes, Ibby has a clear path to becoming great.

Entries.Title: Harimau Merah: Konflik Bermula
Entries.Description: Hakin, a police officer goes undercover and infiltrates the Red Tiger gang and manages to gain the gang's trust. Hakin not only succeeds in uncovering their crimes but also has to face the brutal criminals. However, he is betrayed, plagued by moral dilemmas and his loyalty is tested as he fights to uphold justice without his identity being known.

Entries.Title: Flash Drive
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Sahak Gangster
Entries.Description: Sahak was raised by Pak Andak, a notorious local gangster who saw him as the future leader of the Bunga Merah Gang. Everything changed when Pak Andak was arrested while attempting to rescue his niece Maya from their traditional rival, the Pak Man Gang. After serving five years in prison, Pak Andak was released. On the very day of his release, he was ambushed and fatally shot, dying in Sahak`s arms. With his last breath, Pak Andak charged Sahak with a critical mission: to uncover and avenge his murderer. Sahak becomes a wanted man, disappearing from the murder scene and becoming the primary suspect in Pak Andak`s killing. Sahak is determined to honour Pak Andak`s final request and seek revenge.

Entries.Title: Saturday Night Inside Out
Entries.Description: A young man accidentally locks himself out of his apartment late one evening and must find a way back inside before potential disaster strikes.

Entries.Title: The Dam
Entries.Description: The film takes place during the full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine. After the Kakhovka dam is blown up, a detachment of Ukrainian soldiers led by a female fighter with the call sign Mara finds themselves in a secret Soviet bunker at the bottom of a reservoir where the USSR conducted human experiments during the Cold War. The consequences of these experiments are still in the bunker in the form of the half-living corpses of Soviet soldiers. Now, in order to survive, Ukrainians need to defeat the Soviet zombies, their own fear, as well as overcome internal disputes and trust each other.

Entries.Title: Guts
Entries.Description: A son honors his mothers wish by leads life of an honest cop down a righteous path, where his every moral choice integrity invites relentless adversaries. Can he endure them and uphold justice?

Entries.Title: UFC Fight Night 250: Adesanya vs. Imavov
Entries.Description: UFC Fight Night 250: Adesanya vs. Imavov was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on February 1, 2025, at the anb Arena in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. A middleweight bout between former two-time UFC Middleweight Champion Israel Adesanya and Nassourdine Imavov headlined this event.

Entries.Title: The Blind Reaper
Entries.Description: Gu Bei, a blind beggar, witnesses a horrific massacre—an entire town and a wealthy family brutally slaughtered. Moved by the kindness of Lan Qiuyao, the young heiress who once gave him a bowl of rice, he sets out to uncover the truth behind the tragedy. However, the real culprit, Nan Zhulang, attempts to silence him by force.  When Lan Qiuyao is brutally murdered, the fire long dormant in Gu Bei’s heart ignites once more. He sheds his humble guise and returns as the legendary killing god of the battlefield—"Ye Bu Shou" (The Unyielding Reaper). With his unmatched skills and unshakable sense of justice, he seeks vengeance for the slaughtered townspeople of Qing Shi and the thirty members of the Lan family, delivering bloody retribution to those who deserve it.

Entries.Title: MAD
Entries.Description: After running around the city all day, Mandy finally realizes something a little too late.

Entries.Title: Desert Lone Hero
Entries.Description: During the Ming Dynasty, Shen Shijie, the wealthiest merchant in the world, used the ancient art of Qimen Dunjia to construct the Tianji Vault, sealing away his immense fortune before his death. However, after his passing, bandits targeted his family, kidnapping his descendant, Shen Yuxin. To rescue Shen Yuxin and protect the Tianji Vault, Duan Shilang rallied a group of martial heroes to venture deep into the deserts of the Western Regions. Along their perilous journey, they faced countless challenges, leading to an epic clash between the forces of good and evil—a breathtaking battle of life and death, filled with swordplay and heroism.

Entries.Title: MIERDA
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Girl Climber
Entries.Description: Professional climber Emily Harrington has summited Everest, 8000-meter peaks, and dominated the competition circuit but, her greatest challenge extends beyond the physical. To cement her legacy in the male dominated world of elite rock climbing, she sets her sights on a career-defining 24-hour ascent of Yosemite’s El Capitan.  Caught between the pursuit of personal ambition and the ticking biological clock of life, a near-fatal fall forces Emily to reckon with what she’s willing to risk. Equal parts gripping survival story and intimate portrait, Girl Climber isn’t just about breaking records, it’s about breaking barriers. Amongst Yosemite’s legendary boy’s club, Emily isn’t proving she is the best *Girl Climber-- she's proving she is one of the best. Period.

Entries.Title: Dilruba
Entries.Description: Siddhu,scarred by a tragic past, reluctantly accepts the love proposal of Anjali, only to face breakup again. Adding to the chaos, His ex Maggie returnsto make amends for her mistakes, while a ruthless goon sets his sights on Siddhu.

Entries.Title: Snake Island Survival
Entries.Description: After tragically losing his wife while protecting a monitoring buoy, Zhang Yong falls into despair and quits the marine monitoring team, resorting to fishing to support his daughter. Years later, a typhoon brings him back into contact with his old station chief, and together, they uncover a case of marine pollution. Led by the chief, a group ventures into the mysterious Sea Snake Island to uncover the truth behind the pollution—only to find that the island is fraught with dangers far deadlier than giant serpents: human treachery. Defying life-threatening perils, the group ultimately safeguards the marine habitat’s peace. Through this mission, Zhang Yong finally lets go of his past, emerges from his grief, and resumes his duty as a guardian of the sea.

Although he wishes to end his mission, Inspector Nazri urges him to continue in order to combat crime. Entries.Title: The Savior of the World
Entries.Description: An ancient demon is reborn after a hundred years, intent on uniting the three realms under its rule. Disciples of the Celestial Master Sect rise up in resistance. In its final moments, the demon transfers its soul into the body of the sect's future leader, Wang Xian Zhi, waiting for the right moment to return.  As an adult, Wang Xian Zhi sets out to suppress the demon's power. Alongside his close friends Zhu Yan and Xiao Ling’er, he journeys to Banbu Duo in search of the legendary artifact that can seal the demon - the Supreme Heavenly Tome. After enduring countless hardships, the trio finally reaches Wangchuan, only to face an even greater threat.  Jiang Fang Mu, driven by his desire to claim the position of sect leader, summons a deadly enchantress to eliminate them. Once again, the three find themselves in grave danger. Will their quest for the Heavenly Tome be able to continue?

Being a rejected child at an early age, he got the chance to be intimate with the roller coaster of life, making him like a rock. He wants to destroy the empire of perpetrators in Parasi to regain his mom's prestigious image but discovers the shocking truths one after the other in his way. The circumstances are against him but his mother is always there to embrace, to lead, and to support him.

At a remote gas station in Nowheresville, California, shopkeeper Hiro, stranded traveler Tonya, and gruff trucker Ron clash in a heated altercation. When an emergency broadcast warns of extraterrestrial craft overhead—and a bleeding stranger stumbles in off the street—the group must decide whether to trust the approaching beings or prepare for a fight that could alter the fate of the universe.

Entries.Title: Worlds Apart
Entries.Description: While navigating the challenges of caring for his ailing mother and the relentless grind of day-to-day life, Dee finds himself thrust into a surreal ordeal when inexplicable events begin to unfold. Dee's already fragile world is shattered by encounters seemingly beyond the realm of human comprehension. Struggling to make sense of these strange occurrences, Dee must summon courage he never knew he possessed as he delves into the mysteries that threaten to consume him and his loved ones. Using the love for his mother as his guiding light, Dee embarks on a journey of self-discovery and survival, where he must confront the unknown and protect those he holds dear from forces that defy explanation.

MENA PRESENTED BY MONSTER ENERGY DURING UFC 318 FIGHT WEEK  FIRST U.S. POWER SLAP EVENT OUTSIDE OF LAS VEGAS  EVENT STREAMS LIVE AND FREE TO A GLOBAL AUDIENCE ON YOUTUBE ON FRIDAY JULY 18  Power Slap 14: The Bell vs Mena features three marquee title matches  Headlining Power Slap 14 at the XULA Convocation Center will be a heavyweight title match between current Power Slap Heavyweight Champion, Damien “The Bell” Dibbell (5-0, 3 KOs), and No. 3 ranked Heavyweight Wes “The Boom” Mena (4-0, 2 KOs). When he realizes that finishing high school also means the breakup of his crew, he decides to ruin everyone's student plans and give them one more year of carefree fun. In order to save his friends from the hardships of entering adulthood, he plans to hack into the innovative system of the Ministry of Education and change the results of their final exams. In this daring action, he involves a group of high school students with the smallest chances of passing their final exams and... his long-lost grandfather, full of controversial life wisdom. Will Kapsel's brilliant plan succeed? Will the boy manage to change the course of events and keep his friends by his side?

Entries.Title: Pale Moon
Entries.Description: During the Tang Dynasty, Prince Jian Li Yong conspired with the corrupt minister Ma Lifu to exploit the emperor's critical illness. They placed Crown Prince Li Chun under house arrest and seized control of the court, plotting a coup. General Lin Yan of the Imperial Guards and Chen Li, the chief constable of the Nine Gates, found themselves entangled in this dangerous conspiracy. Compelled to act alone, Lin Yan embarked on a perilous mission to rescue the imprisoned crown prince. With the farm isolated and no one else around to help, the sisters must quickly shift from surviving farm life to surviving the fight of their lives.

Beneath its beauty hides a kingdom of exploitation and fear ruled by a hypocritical priest “Baba,” who preys on innocents in the name of faith. A boy named Abhay survives a horrific ritual sacrifice with the help of Bhavani, who plants the seed of revolt—only to lose her husband in a direct clash with Baba. Years later, Abhay struggles to save his ailing mother but is ensnared in a sinister plot to bomb a massive temple inauguration and divide the nation. Now, he must save his mother, protect thousands of innocents, and end the tyranny. If he fails, the sacrifice will be his own. If he succeeds, his balidan will be remembered for generations.

Entries.Title: Captain Hook - The Cursed Tides
Entries.Description: In the aftermath of a devastating defeat by his archnemesis Admiral Smee, the notorious Captain James Hook finds refuge in the coastal town of Eldritch Landing, where he forms an unlikely alliance with Silas Blackweather, a local blacksmith seeking retribution for his sister's murder. As they evade Smee's Redcoat Soldiers in the island's dense woodland, ruthless sword fights, ancient curses and conflicting motives will challenge their shared quest for revenge. Together, Hook and Silas navigate uncharted waters to confront the treacherous Admiral Smee, embarking on a journey that will redefine Captain Hook's enduring legacy.

Entries.Title: Balas Balik

Entries.Title: Heavens: The Boy and His Robot
Entries.Description: In the not too distant future, humanity has harnessed cosmic forces and expanded its reach far beyond Earth. But this is no new golden age. The eternal struggle for resources remains, pitting the water-starved Empire of Mars against our species’ home planet. The Second Great War has raged for decades. Kai’s father has fallen in battle, his mother gone missing on a mission to Saturn. Now 18 years old, Kai is determined to do his part (and find his mother), and follows in his father’s footsteps to the Mecha Corps Academy. Though brilliant in theoretical matters, Kai is physically weak, and hides the asthma that would disqualify him. With the support of his squad—overachiever Waye, easygoing Ean, neurotic Ren, and the sympathetic if incomprehensible brute Rock—Kai earns his place at the controls of his own mecha, which he names Little Dragon. So begins the deep bond between Kai and his robot, which will need to be strong as steel if either will survive the incredible challenges ahead.

Entries.Title: Mirror 4: Quantum Protocol
Entries.Description: Max Storm, international spy from M.I.R.R.O.R, is tied up in the secret lair of the evil villain Dmitri Vladimir. He needs to find a way to escape captivity and save the world from killer drones, before time runs out.

Entries.Title: Until the Last Breath
Entries.Description: Dennis, a young amateur boxer, struggles with anxiety and frustration over not being the best version of himself. With the help of his brother, he trains to defeat the biggest rival: his mind. An exploration of the sacrifices that must be made to achieve your goals.

Entries.Title: Boycot Coyote
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Fistful Of Bullets
Entries.Description: In 1878 a youthful bounty hunter by the name of Django sets out on a journy of redemption.  every bounty could be his last but this doesn't stop the hero from capturing a tonic seller who has been giving people a mad virus.

Entries.Title: Poshington: The Grand Finale
Entries.Description: Five years after he left Poshington, Max gets a spooky visit from Angel Gabriél, telling him he must return. Upon his arrival, he discovers a terrifying mystery that plunges him into a time - travelling adventure with the fate of the world in his hands. For one last time, can Max save Britain?

Entries.Title: Legendinės legendos FELICITÀ
Entries.Description: Legendary legends Orestes and Džilda, summoned by a humble journalist to cover their triumph, set off for the San Remo Song Festival, where the ideal stage and family duo navigate the labyrinthine maze of a relationship, where clouds of jealousy and ambition loom.

Entries.Title: Ally vs the Dead
Entries.Description: When a gluten-born virus spreads through her office, a bullied receptionist must battle her zombified coworkers to save her injured father.

Entries.Title: Unrelenting Drug Interdiction
Entries.Description: To defeat the cunning drug lord Yuan Lin, Cheng Ying of the SWAT police team employs a ruse in which she seriously injures her close friend Chen Zhongyi in a fight at the police station. After being fired from the police force, she infiltrates the drug dealing world as an undercover agent and discovers that the drug lord Yuan Lin is more devious than imagined. To complete the mission, Cheng Ying has no choice but to risk her life. Ultimately, she dies and passes on the intel through her corpse, which leads to the arrest of all the drug lords.

Entries.Title: Moon Valley Quest
Entries.Description: In 1988, a video game geek and failed musician is recruited by a retired battle general to defeat an evil beast and his gang in order to restore the freedom of Moon Valley's citizens in this music driven fantasy action adventure.

Entries.Title: Xenobot
Entries.Description: Rene Del Toro is a young man surrounded by people that want to hurt him, from politicians to bullies, his family and the syndicate, struggles to understand. After being witness to his parents' assassination, he becomes involved in a drowning accident where he becomes Xenobot, a DNA altered frog man with superpowers. He now begins a new journey to find out who killed his parents and what happened to his sister and himself.

Entries.Title: Free Money
Entries.Description: Asian-Australian Wen is in for a surprise when she tags along to Chinese New Year lunch with Aunty Poh and her friends... The Aunties take the honour of fighting to pay the bill very seriously. When limbs start flying, Wen and Aunty Poh come to terms with the importance of friendship and family.

Entries.Title: Frost Fight
Entries.Description: Two agents fight the ultimate battle of wit and skill to secure a confidential package: a package for which they are prepared to put their lives on the line.

Entries.Title: Starting Quarterback

Entries.Title: The King Rise Again
Entries.Description: Upon learning from the Empress that he has a son Tianxing, the King Muye sends his finest warrior Manshu to search for the heir. While the warrior is away from the palace, his own father stages a rebellion and seizes the throne.

Entries.Title: Gevi
Entries.Description: Gevi is a Tamil Survival Thriller Film That Follows Mandharai and Malaiyan's Struggle for Justice in a Rural Village Near Kodaikanal. The Film Explores Themes of Love, Survival, and Bureaucratic Apathy, Highlighting the Community's Fight Against Corruption and Adversity. A Powerful Story of Hope and Resilience

Entries.Title: Blue Weasel

Entries.Title: Mr. & Mrs. Aslan
Entries.Description: Luna Aslan (Yolanthe Cabau) is an undercover agent who, with the help of her colleague Niels (Thijs Boermans), arrests top criminal Baris (Murda) after a blood-curdling mission. At home, however, Luna has to deal with an even bigger challenge: her husband Emre (Sinan Eroglu). He knows nothing about her double life, but is beginning to notice her secretive behavior. Thanks to his conniving cousin Ferhat (Nesim El Ahmadi), Emre becomes convinced that Luna is cheating. When misunderstandings pile up and it turns out that Baris is targeting both Luna and Emre, Mr. and Mrs. Aslan pull out all the stops to save their lives and marriage.

Entries.Title: Rally - From Paris to the Pyramids
Entries.Description: This action-packed adventure for family audiences follows Reodor Felgen, a brilliant but eccentric inventor, and his two unlikely friends — Solan, a daring magpie, and Ludvig, a timid hedgehog — as they attempt to redeem themselves by competing in the legendary Paris-to-the-Pyramids rally. Equipped with their extraordinary racecar, Il Tempo Gigante, the trio embarks on a high-stakes journey through bustling Paris, the perilous Italian Alps, and the scorching Egyptian desert. With their home, friendship, and lives on the line, they must prove that ingenuity and determination can conquer any challenge.  A thrilling follow-up to The Pinchcliffe Grand Prix

Entries.Title: Shrouded Recursion
Entries.Description: A secret agent is tasked with an impossible task, until she learns that she is in a time loop. Can she figure out the puzzle before the situation gets even worse?

Entries.Title: Loki IRL
Entries.Description: After numerous losses, aspiring artist Bianca and her living cartoon demon, Loki, are called out online. To prove they're not idiots they had to beat up an influencer.

Entries.Title: City Rush 4
Entries.Description: Surging crime, a virus and android assassins led by a mysterious gangster boss force special agents Ace and Nea into action.

Entries.Title: Super Ninja Neko
Entries.Description: Check out Ninja Neko in action!

Entries.Title: Zhaza
Entries.Description: In a small town, a corrupt major learns that his daughter has been raped by the chief of police. He takes him hostage and fights off the rape squads, while trying to save his daughter and establish a relationship with her.

Entries.Title: DEADRINGER
Entries.Description: Set in current day 2020's, a girl named Sylvia, whose haunted past manifests itself in her current day life. While not only navigating her mind, she has to navigate the horrors of the woods that encapsulates all that she fears.

Entries.Title: ESWY
Entries.Description: ESWY is a love story that keeps finding its way back. It is magical happenstances and ill-fated heroes, undying love and miraculous past-lives, crazed villains and unbelievable twists that tear through the fabric of reality and beckon you to dream. Are you ready to hop onto an adventure across lifetimes?

Entries.Title: Being Friends With Rocks
Entries.Description: Samul Jeeorge is back and learns a valuable lesson: who can you really trust in the end?

Entries.Title: One In The Chamber
Entries.Description: Wealthy Socialite Julian Livingston has been murdered, his fiance seeks out a lone Detective Liam Grisby, whose taken an interest in Gretchen to solve the mystery of the ominous stalker that has made a threat on her life. Will Grisby be able to put the pieces of the case together in time?

Entries.Title: Bare Hands
Entries.Description: Davide, a good kid with the eyes of a child and the body of a grown man, is kidnapped one night and locked inside the dark trailer of a truck.  He becomes a prisoner of a mysterious organization that forces him to fight, bare-handed, in brutal underground matches that can end only one way: the death of one of the two fighters.

Entries.Title: Instinto primario
Entries.Description: A comedy short film about Lily, a young teacher starting out at an elementary school. There, the supervisor strives for perfection and integrity, while Lili strives for creativity and empathy. A short film that redefines what it means to inhabit a teaching space, the community, and the identity of our country.

Entries.Title: Redemption
Entries.Description: A handsome young man, tired of his day job, alleviates his boredom by going on dates with women every night. However, his plans backfire when one of his dates is unexpectedly murdered one night. Police remain hot on his trail as this murder mystery slowly unfolds.

Entries.Title: Dernier Leurre

Entries.Title: Thank You For Loving Me

Entries.Title: Blue Devils
Entries.Description: Joi and friends turn to stripping after job loss. When a friend is assaulted by the club owner, they plan a heist for justice. As they target a bigger club, a police raid leads to a gripping hostage crisis, testing their bond and strength.

Entries.Title: Boyz for Life
Entries.Description: When the notorious "Fufu: The Furious Frenchmen" steals Escobar's last stash from the LAPD evidence room, mismatched detectives Larry and Bernie are on the case. Hijinks ensue as they swap identities to protect witness Julia, navigating LAPD bureaucracy and a cast of quirky characters.

Entries.Title: Tử Chiến Trên Không
Entries.Description: Tử Chiến Trên Không follows Bình, an aviation security instructor on a flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Fifteen minutes after take-off, the flight descends into chaos when a ruthless group of hijackers led by Long seizes control. As the crew’s resistance only fuels the hijackers’ brutality, they unleash terror in an effort to break into the cockpit. Bình must rely on his intelligence and strength—alongside the courage of the passengers and crew—to fight back and bring the hijackers down.

Entries.Title: My Little Pony The Movie: Shattered Harmony
Entries.Description: In a desperate final battle against Queen Chrysalis, Cadence must overcome her heartbreak and reignite the power of love before the world succumbs to darkness forever.  Will her shattered heart doom Equestria, or can she prove that love’s light can outshine even the deepest despair?

Entries.Title: A Luta
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: BOWLING

Entries.Title: Mr. Melvin
Entries.Description: Stripped of purpose and poisoned by corporate evil, the Toxic Avenger is turned against Tromaville. Now, in this definitive cut of Parts II and III, he must confront the monster he's become before his town and soul are lost forever.

Entries.Title: Iron Gun: Final Vendetta
Entries.Description: Millie Montgomery, a special agent, is on a mission to investigate the Iron Gun. In an attempt to explore her only lead, she’s paired with Braden Dunn, who happens to be closely related to what she’s searching for. Together, they must beat Valerie, an evil supervillain, in finding the Iron Gun and evading her long-standing vendetta against Braden.

Entries.Title: Anacondas: Silent Scream
Entries.Description: A village in the amazon is attacked by anacondas, the village chief knows that the best way to deal with this situation is to call : The Venom Order. Once they arrive there, they will have to face this terrible threat.

Entries.Title: Power Slap 13: Dumpling vs. Da Hawaiian Hitman
Entries.Description: PRESENTED BY MONSTER ENERGY  During International Fight Week on Friday, June 27 at 6PM, catch the hard-hitting action of Power Slap 13: Dumpling vs Da Hawaiian Hitman.  Headlining Power Slap 13 will be a super heavyweight title match between current Power Slap Super Heavyweight Champion Dumpling (2-0-1) and No. 2 ranked contender Dayne “Da Hawaiian Hitman” Viernes (2-2). Dumpling aims to defend his newly won title for the first time after claiming the Power Slap championship following a unanimous decision over Layne “Da Crazy Hawaiian” Viernes at Power Slap 11 earlier this year. Da Hawaiian Hitman plans to make the most of his first opportunity at the belt and exact a measure of revenge for his brother’s loss against Dumpling and begin his reign as the new world champion.

Entries.Title: Best Of Joy
Entries.Description: Michael Jackson, a young and struggling singer, feels overshadowed by the world’s obsession with fame and perfection. When a masked supervillain named Spotlight and his twisted father, Gary Mayor, form the Spotlight Seven to terrorize Los Angeles, Michael must rise beyond his insecurities to stop them. Along the way, he gains unlikely allies: Brad, his witty and stoic bodyguard; Samantha Carpenter, his love interest;  and Goku, a misguided martial arts master. Together, they face trials, betrayals, and epic musical showdowns.  The journey culminates in a spectacular showdown against the Spotlight Seven, forcing Michael to prove that being a true star isn’t about the spotlight—it’s about the joy you bring to others.

Entries.Title: Density
Entries.Description: A narcotic noir Short Film following the destructive path of 4 flatmates, desperately seeking to enhance their fincancial and psychoactive situation. AKA: Oceans Eleven gone wrong between four unsuccessful Roommates.

Entries.Title: Matadores de Aliens do Espaço Sideral
Entries.Description: Friends Erick and Tobias discover that aliens have infiltrated the city. Now, they must stop the aliens from abducting a child with special abilities.

Entries.Title: E.V.E.
Entries.Description: When her sister is murdered, an enslaved android must battle her ruthless owner to escape captivity.

Entries.Title: Trapped
Entries.Description: Short drama film made in 5 days on the BFI Film Academy at Film Oxford 2024. Two uni students go to their accommodation for the first time, but is all as it seems?

Entries.Title: Ending
Entries.Description: "Ending" is a dystopian drama set in a world where a rebellious faction known as The Resistance opposes a tyrannical regime called The Order. The story centres on Arthur Hughes, a legendary rebel leader, who is captured and interrogated by Lieutenant Thomas Bennington, a former comrade turned traitor. The intense, dialogue-driven narrative unfolds in a prison setting, exploring themes of loyalty, betrayal, and the moral complexities of rebellion. As Arthur and Bennington confront their past and ideological differences, the film delves into the psychological and emotional struggles of fighting for freedom in a seemingly hopeless battle.

Entries.Title: Beach
Entries.Description: Karthick, an orphan raised by a church father, lives in a ladies' hostel under his guardian’s care and works as a bank executive. Amrita, raised by her handicapped brother, struggles with her family’s past debt while working as a salesgirl in Chennai.  A misunderstanding brings Karthick and Amrita together, leading to a blossoming romance. As Amrita gradually overcomes her fears and confesses her love, their lives take a dark turn. A gang of ruthless teenagers lurking on the beach targets them, attacking Karthick and abducting Amrita.  Can Karthick save Amrita? What unfolds next is a gripping tale of survival, courage, and fate.

Entries.Title: Walter Ninja
Entries.Description: Walter is convinced he’s a ninja, dedicating his days to training and meditating on the arts of Ninjutsu. His brother Nacho, who financially supports them both, grows increasingly frustrated with Walter’s obsession and urges him to get a "real" job. Tension builds between the two when Nacho confesses he feels ashamed of Walter’s behavior.

Entries.Title: Spider-Man: A New Purpose
Entries.Description: Fan Made Spider-Man Film. Plot TBD.

Entries.Title: Pikmin Plush Adventures R2
Entries.Description: 6 months after the events of Pikmin Plush Adventures R, Olimar and Louie are sent back to PNF-404 to collect treasure after they inadvertently plunge their company into debt, but upon returning, they find there’s more trouble than they left! It’s up to the PikMEN to collect treasure, stop evil aliens, and save the planet!

Entries.Title: Elite Force: B.R.I. - Body Recovery Immmusination

Entries.Description: A retired veteran finds transitioning into civilian life tough, when a woman with a big problem enters his RideShare begging the question, can you really escape fate?

Entries.Title: La Sube
Entries.Description: High and drunk at a party, Lucas will have to recover something that he lost in order to escape from the club. To achieve that, he will have to fight the security guards, discovering new and shocking abilities.

Entries.Title: AFTERWORLD
Entries.Description: In a dystopian future where human genetics have evolved, a new breed of individuals—Variants—possess extraordinary abilities. However, the world’s leaders deem them a threat, unleashing an elite militia known as the Dark Hunters to hunt them down. Amidst this chaos, two sisters, Eve and Mia Levison, find themselves at the center of a brutal war for survival.  Captured by the ruthless Grand Huntress, Eve is held prisoner while Mia, a powerful Variant, launches a daring assault to rescue her. As Mia fights her way through the heavily fortified Sector Thirteen, Eve struggles against her captors, discovering the deep-seated hatred fueling Cleo’s crusade.

Entries.Title: The Curse of Crescent's Crown

Entries.Title: The Ride

Entries.Title: My Friend Is a Murderer

When there is only one month left from the statute of limitations of 15 years, he comes to a quiet village to hide, pretending to be the missing son of an old woman with dementia. However, the intense fight between  environmental groups and the county office gets him exposed. Will he have to pay for his crimes?

Entries.Title: Me.exe
Entries.Description: Rain, a struggling college esports player, enlists the help of an AI program designed to improve poor gaming performance — only to find that its intentions are far more sinister than she ever could have imagined.

Entries.Title: Before the World Ends
Entries.Description: As an asteroid hurtles toward Earth, a quiet neighborhood is declared a red zone, destined to collapse under the impending shockwaves. Residents rush to evacuate to safety—everyone except Noi, the weary owner of a small, timeworn barbershop. Refusing to abandon the place she has built her life around, she chooses to face the end on her own terms.

As The Time For TJ To Move Out Comes, The Boys Plan One More Movie Before One Of Them Leaves Forever. However, Things Go Awry When A Dark Figure From Their Past Threatens Everything. Can Spencer, Sean, TJ And Travis Save The Day One More Time With The Smallest Casualties possible? Hell Nah.

Entries.Title: Melody's Parade
Entries.Description: A man loses a woman in the crowd. Suddenly, an explosion. The parade erupts in to chaos. Her ghost travels through the streets of New York looking to save him.

Entries.Title: Junk World
Entries.Description: 1,042 years before JUNK HEAD, a robot named Robin escorts a human commander on a mission to the underground city of Carp Bar.

Entries.Title: Strange Memories
Entries.Description: The reclusive cultivator You Wenhua and the enchantress Ye Qianmo have met and forgotten each other across multiple lifetimes. Meeting again in the 21st century, the Celestial Lord manipulates Ye Qianmo to approach You Wenhua in three forms: a domineering lady, a mature woman, and a cold beauty to obtain his vital essence.

Entries.Title: Napalm Dreams

Napalm Dreams follows a platoon of American soldiers—each harboring a troubled past—as they confront the brutal realities of combat and the psychological toll of their secrets. Bound by shared trauma and dark humor, the men struggle to hold onto their humanity as the war—and the truth—close in around them.

Entries.Title: The Woman with a Name or Two
Entries.Description: Centuries after the collapse of modern civilization, a gang of scavengers trade stories with a shifty merchant about the elusive Woman, first thought to be a wasteland myth.

Entries.Title: Cursed of the Dead Countess
Entries.Description: Tutkum, a university student, is researching an old necklace for her thesis. Guided by her professor, she will visit another professor to hear about past events related to the necklace.

Entries.Title: Slop Gaming: The Movie
Entries.Description: Famed prophet Yap Dollar gazes into his crystal ball, and foresees that evil wizard Freaky Varg has a plan to resurrect the Great Slop Beast OJ Simpson. To oppose his evil, he calls for five mighty champions, the only humans capable of foiling his dastardly scheme - Adin Ross, Hailey Welch, MrBeast, IShowSpeed, and Kai Cenat.

Entries.Title: Weaving
Entries.Description: Soohyun, a solitary professional boxer, is preparing for a match when she spars with Minkyung, an amateur who boxes as a hobby, and takes a solid hook from her. After the hit, Soohyun begins to feel drawn to Minkyung, who suddenly enters her life, causing her match preparation to falter.

Entries.Title: Chroma Force Forever

Entries.Title: Lobster Hunt

Entries.Title: Hoagie

Brendan Bean, a kindly family man, finds himself face to face with the bizarre creature, and before long a friendship for the ages develops. Meanwhile, the depraved Benny Piazza leads his deranged militia on a violent quest to reclaim the magical homunculi.

Entries.Title: The Reunion

Entries.Title: TNA Border Brawl
Entries.Description: “The Border Brawl” will stream live on May 25 from the Canada / USA border in Niagara Falls, Canada, exclusively for free on Zone·ify.  The event features wrestling icons Brutus “The Barber” Beefcake, “The Mountie” Jacques Rougeau, Barbie Blank “Kelly Kelly,” UFC’s Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, and many others

Entries.Title: Sensation: Cruise
Entries.Description: Mykola Kuńko works as an unlucky TV reporter in early 2000s Ukraine. Together with his trusty camerawoman, Zhenya, he is wandering aimlessly through life, from one boring news story to another. One morning, when they are about to go to the premiere of a new rip-off action film, they stumble upon their biggest sensation yet.

Entries.Title: A Journey to the Fictitious Point
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Let's Settle This!
Entries.Description: In an Auckland Chinese diner, cynical Elle regrets swiping right on old-fashioned Winson. His kung-fu hero profile feels like a catfish, and he's annoyed she arrived late. Just as they're ready to leave, a mountain of food arrives—Winson's classic Chinese over-ordering. Guilt and hunger keep Elle at the table. Tensions rise as she mocks traditional dating, and he accuses her of being "not Chinese enough." Their clash turns physical—tea is served, chopsticks fly, kung-fu ignites.

Entries.Title: Running
Entries.Description: A petty criminals life falls into a nightmarish loop after stealing a bag of cash from his partner.

Entries.Title: Gold of Rio Bravo: Sheriff Kelly's Story

One of the skirmishes with cutthroats forces Sheriff Kelly to reveal to Ivan the secret of the "Confederate gold" stolen during the American Civil War.

Entries.Title: 48 NOIDED MOVIES

Entries.Title: Idi Mazha Kattu

Entries.Title: Super courier

One day, after defending a respected judge from a group of thugs, he receives an unusual offer—to become the driver for the judge’s daughter, Sabina. However, he soon realizes that his real job is to be her bodyguard, as a powerful enemy of the family is willing to do anything to take her away. When Sabina is kidnapped, Timur must cast aside his fears and become a hero to save her and uncover why she is so important to the criminals.

Entries.Title: Harmony Inc.
Entries.Description: Inexperienced recruits of a groundbreaking medical company enter a client’s memories with the means to eliminate the haunting nightmares that remain of her childhood home, only to confront a defensive subconscious that threatens to erase them instead.

Entries.Title: Sakazuki
Entries.Description: Two agency assassins cross blades in an empty bar when they find they're on the same gig.

Entries.Title: Ireke: Rise of the Maroons
Entries.Description: Betrayed by his uncle and sold into slavery, a young West African prince finds himself on a brutal Jamaican plantation, where a forbidden love and a looming rebellion draw him into an alliance with escaped slaves – the Maroons – forcing him to rise as the leader of a revolution that could shake the colonial world.

Entries.Description: Two siblings navigate their way to safety through a desolate forest amid a collapsing and divided Philippines in the Year 2035. But as looming threats lurk on their path, both only have each other to survive in a dark and perilous time of the nation.

Entries.Description: A newlywed couple embarks on the honeymoon of a lifetime, only to discover they are the unwitting victims of a cruel and sadistic vacation experience.

Entries.Title: Troubleshooters 2: Roachbots
Entries.Description: When Dr. Kari Forbes is attacked and killed by his latest creations, laser blasting roach bots, Troubleshooter Sandoval Wolf is brought in to round up the little terrors. He is aided by diminutive metallic partners, Mini-Troubleshooters.

Entries.Title: Snatching Gold from the Tiger's Mouth
Entries.Description: In 1937, when the July 7 Incident broke out, the Japanese army started to invade China and plundered China's strategic resources such as gold to pay for military expenses. The Eighth Route Army Jiaodong Military Region fighters and hunters Yu Dongfeng and other people together with the bloodbath, through the hardships of thousands of miles to transport gold, fighters and the people and the Japanese invaders launched a protracted life-and-death struggle, and ultimately transported the gold to the Party Central Committee in Yan'an, a powerful support for the national war of resistance.

Entries.Title: Para atrapar el viento

Entries.Title: Backlash

Entries.Title: Fear

Entries.Title: The Incident

Entries.Title: Elio

Entries.Title: The Science Adventures of Tom and Huck

Entries.Title: Sketch
Entries.Description: When a young girl’s sketchbook falls into a strange pond, her drawings come to life—chaotic, real, and on the loose. As the town descends into chaos, her family must reunite and stop the monsters they never meant to unleash.

Entries.Title: Lego Disney Princess: Villains Unite
Entries.Description: After Ariel, Moana, Tiana, Rapunzel, and Snow White thwarted Gaston's plan to take over all of their kingdoms, he calls upon Ursula, Jafar, and the Evil Queen to help take the Princesses down once and for all. The Princesses learn about Gaston's scheme and recruit a few friends of their own with the help of Magic Mirror: Aurora, Belle, and Cinderella! Together, the Princesses team up for an ultimate showdown of good versus evil.

Entries.Title: Spermageddon
Entries.Description: Two narrative threads: one is an emerging love story between awkward teens Jens and Lisa, who are having sex for the first time; the other, an eventful quest of Simon the Semen and his friends to reach the golden goal, the Egg.

Entries.Title: Dora and the Search for Sol Dorado
Entries.Description: Dora, Diego, and their new friends trek through the perilous dangers of the Amazonian jungle in search of the ancient and powerful treasure of Sol Dorado to keep it out of enemy hands.

Entries.Title: Fountain of Youth
Entries.Description: A treasure-hunting mastermind assembles a team for a life-changing adventure. But to outwit and outrun threats at every turn, he'll need someone even smarter than he is: his estranged sister.

Entries.Title: Kayara
Entries.Description: A courageous and athletic teenager, Kayara dreams that she is destined to be the first female to break into the league of Chasquis - the official messengers of the Incan empire. As she learns what it takes to be a Chasqui along with its challenges, she tackles every mission she gets and discovers the ancient stories of her land and her people.

Entries.Title: Mickey 17
Entries.Description: Unlikely hero Mickey Barnes finds himself in the extraordinary circumstance of working for an employer who demands the ultimate commitment to the job… to die, for a living.

Entries.Title: The Legend of Ochi
Entries.Description: In a remote village on the island of Carpathia, a shy farm girl named Yuri is raised to fear an elusive animal species known as ochi. But when Yuri discovers a wounded baby ochi has been left behind, she escapes on a quest to bring him home.

Entries.Title: TRON: Ares
Entries.Description: A highly sophisticated Program called Ares is sent from the digital world into the real world on a dangerous mission, marking humankind's first encounter with A.I. beings.

Entries.Title: The Phoenician Scheme
Entries.Description: Wealthy businessman Zsa-zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they soon become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists, and determined assassins.

Entries.Title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
Entries.Description: In the wake of the devastating war against the RDA and the loss of their eldest son, Jake Sully and Neytiri face a new threat on Pandora: the Ash People, a violent and power-hungry Na'vi tribe led by the ruthless Varang. Jake's family must fight for their survival and the future of Pandora in a conflict that pushes them to their emotional and physical limits.

Entries.Title: Z-O-M-B-I-E-S 4: Dawn of the Vampires
