Entries.Title: 非人哉：限时玩家
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Reality of Hope
Entries.Description: Virtual reality creator Hiyu is facing kidney failure. His online friend Photographotter travels from New York City to Stockholm to be a live donor to Hiyu.

Entries.Title: The mythical tale of the Tollundbog sisters
Entries.Description: In a small Danish village, people bear masks in public resembling someone who has wronged them. A new rule is set in place that you can now legally murder someone, if their face is worn by enough people. This leads local outcast sisters to go ham on the fisherman, who scammed their mother decades ago.

Entries.Title: How Are You?
Entries.Description: A group of animals living on a mysterious island try to overcome their personal traumas.

Entries.Title: Barbie
Entries.Description: Fentanyl trafficking. A highly lucrative sex industry. Foreign wars, armed rebel militia, late stage capitalism, Russian electioneering and sweet, sweet oil - everything we deserved from a live action Barbie film.

Entries.Title: Twins Hinahima
Entries.Description: Two girls dream of going viral on TikToker until they discover something strange in their videos.

Entries.Title: The Mud Under My Window
Entries.Description: One of Emma’s mothers is too busy; the other is too far away. One is rejected, the other idealised. Out of a trivial tension, an intimate and unsettling face-to-face confrontation suddenly arises.

Entries.Title: The meaning of Bunny's dream
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Fungi and Parasites
Entries.Description: An experience with fungi and, mainly, parasites.

Entries.Title: Dear Freddie
Entries.Description: A young girl gets broken up with, right before her 5 year anniversary. When ex casually asks her to drop his things off at his place, she sees it as more than just an errand- it's a final insult. She decides to revenge him with a letter instead.

Entries.Title: Children in the Fire
Entries.Description: This movie celebrates the human spirit. Ukrainian children's resilience, strength, and ability to overcome tragedies and losses make each story a great inspiration for everyone. They had the strength to overcome the darkest moments that today's war brought upon them and win this war with dignity. These little heroes can, through their stories, inspire others.

Entries.Title: Scout
Entries.Description: A girl on a totally not dangerous journey through the wilderness…

Entries.Title: Глупая собака
Entries.Description: The dog's silly antics have been getting on the nerves of its elderly owner for a long time. But is there a hidden meaning to its behavior?

Entries.Title: AN ANIMATED DOG READS JOHN BERGER, HARAWAY, AND KAFKA
Entries.Description: During the COVID-19 pandemic, 23 million American households adopted pets, reflecting the growing urge for animal companions. The evolving, yet complex bond between humans and animals lies at the core of Artist in Focus Matthew Lax’s AN ANIMATED DOG READS JOHN BERGER, HARAWAY, AND KAFKA which explores the complexities of human-dog relationships through cultural and philosophical lenses.

Entries.Title: Ovary-Acting
Entries.Description: A harried thirty-something woman is forced to decide whether she wants to be a mother after unexpectedly giving birth to her reproductive organs at her sister’s baby shower.

Entries.Title: Zashikiro
Entries.Description: Harada's current project based on true stories, including events the director went through himself.

Entries.Title: Never Fall in Love.
Entries.Description: Doggy Dong and Gold fell in love. Gold’s dad kept warning him not to fall in love. He never wanted to listen. Life has beaten him hard because the words from his dad were coming true…

Entries.Title: North
Entries.Description: Young Gerda sets off into the great unknown in search of her friend Kai, who has mysteriously vanished.

Entries.Title: Sixty-Seven Milliseconds
Entries.Description: Through a reconstruction combining computer-generated images with surveillance footage and the story of a victim, we question the legitimacy and excesses of law enforcement in France.

Entries.Title: Field Recording
Entries.Description: A meandering joke about three dreams.

Entries.Title: Dull Spots of Greenish Colours
Entries.Description: War for our attention has suddenly become an actual war. Information technologies appear not just as mere means for somebody’s ends but as something having their agency, as one of the acting forces rendering possible a horrific event, which is very hard to accept and almost impossible to comprehend. We have no control over it and are doomed to scroll through the newsfeed.

Entries.Title: From Ground Zero
Entries.Description: "From Ground Zero" is a compelling project that brings together 22 short films created by talented filmmakers from Gaza. Launched by Rashid Masharawi, a notable Palestinian filmmaker, the initiative emerged amid the backdrop of conflict, aiming to provide a platform for young artists to express themselves through their craft.  Each film, ranging from 3 to 7 minutes, presents a unique perspective on the current reality in Gaza. The project captures the diverse experiences of life in the Palestinian enclave, including the challenges, tragedies, and moments of resilience faced by its people. With a mix of genres such as fiction, documentary, docu-fiction, animation, and experimental cinema, "From Ground Zero" showcases a rich tapestry of stories that reflect the sorrow, joy, and hope inherent in Gazan life.

Entries.Title: Memorias Encuadradas
Entries.Description: One hundred years of the cinematic memory of a small country told through motion graphics. A brief tour of previously unseen images and forgotten fragments of Costa Rican cinema, which, amid state efforts and industrial ambitions, prevailed throughout the 20th century.

Entries.Title: Baggage
Entries.Description: Three girlfriends check in their baggage at the airport, but one is carrying a little more than the others. As they travel along the conveyor belt to security, can she hide what’s inside?

Entries.Title: Cute High Earth Defense Club ETERNAL LOVE!
Entries.Description: Movie commemorating the franchise's tenth anniversary.

Entries.Title: Wastelandia
Entries.Description: Wastelandia is a slice of life comedy series which follows neurotic dropout Zoe, ambitious art student Alice, and terminally online retail worker Moth as they navigate their early twenties and all the weirdness that comes with becoming an adult.

Entries.Title: Lost In McDonaldland
Entries.Description: McDonald's is bringing the old mascots back for a brand-new animated short film.

Entries.Title: Carcassonne-Acapulco
Entries.Description: As flight 7836 reaches cruising speed above the Atlantic Ocean, the pilot, co-pilot and flight attendant are startled by an unexpected knock at the door! Should they open the door, or not?

Entries.Title: Death is a Giant Peanut
Entries.Description: Sent to purgatory after an allergic reaction, a girl forms a surprising bond with the apparition of Death.

Entries.Title: BFF
Entries.Description: Five hilarious stories in one film about three best friends - Ben, Frida and Freddie - who turn everyday challenges into real adventures. Its theme of friendship not only makes the film a great tool to talk about emotional literacy, but also gives you the chance to hear first-hand about the nuances of animation, the genre of the series and its release in cinemas as a film.

Entries.Title: Street parker's whistle
Entries.Description: Street parker attracts the money with his whistle

Entries.Title: Paranoid Kid
Entries.Description: On that familiar night, a sense of anxiety and fearful emotions came over me. Countless thoughts and questions followed.

Entries.Title: Down in the Dumps
Entries.Description: Cinelli is a perfectionist ladybird. When her red wing sheath are stolen, she falls into a deep depression. But then she learns that her true worth goes far beyond her looks.

Entries.Title: if you seek amy
Entries.Description: Distortions and deconstructions of Y2K pop stars' seductive images and iconic hits.
In a dystopian world where soldiers are reduced to numbers, #45 begins to question his march toward an uncertain fate and must choose between obedience and freedom.

Entries.Title: This Is Not Your Garden
Entries.Description: Rooted in wetlands, páramos and centennial forests at the verge of disappearing, memories and a speculated future collide. 500 years of exploitation, exile and resilience are nourished by a collective pain and a desire to crack through it all.

Entries.Title: View From the Floor
Entries.Description: A singer confronts inspiration porn, exploitation, and impostor syndrome in pursuit of a life on the stage without legs.

Entries.Title: Kyiv Cake
Entries.Description: In modern Ukraine, a child is born into a poor family. The parents do everything possible to survive, but just when the crisis reaches its peak, a new danger flares up.

Entries.Title: Glasses
Entries.Description: Yujin breaks her glasses and visits an optician. During an eye exam, she sees a house in a field and finds herself inside. There, she meets three shadow selves, reconciles with them, and gains a new perspective. Finally, she leaves the house and gets new glasses.

Entries.Title: Basia. Radzę sobie!
Entries.Description: The bright Basia can handle anything! Nothing is a problem for her. Well, maybe not entirely. Sometimes everyone has to ask for help, especially when they're learning new things. When a bookshelf falls apart, Basia asks her parents to fix it, which ends up with the entire apartment being renovated. During a trip to the mountains, the girl has to learn to ski, with the help of her father and uncle. Picking mushrooms or painting a room is no big deal for her. One thing can definitely be said about this charming five-year-old - she copes with boredom like no other!

Entries.Title: Medo de Cachorro
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Papercuts
Entries.Description: Papercuts is an animated memoir focused on the many trials and tribulations of a life in the arts. For over two decades, Eric Power has been working as an indie animator specializing in cut paper stop motion. Join him on a journey through all the highs and lows of a life spent in the arts.

Entries.Title: Ritardando
Entries.Description: Rumbling in the distance. Concentrated harp playing. A barricaded apartment. David does his best to shut out the rest of the world so he can practice in peace. A neighbor knocks his door and wants him to seek safety in the basement, but David is not interested. He believes in art, not war.

Entries.Title: The Last Blossom
Entries.Description: Autumn 2023. Akutsu, an elderly inmate serving life in prison, is on the verge of a lonely death in his single cell. A talking Housenka flower says to him, "What a rotten life you had." Akutsu starts reflecting on his past. Summer 1986. Akutsu is living with Nana and her son Kensuke in a shabby apartment with a garden full of Housenkas. It is the tale of a one-night victorious comeback by a dying yakuza, and his family's story told by a flower that blooms in prison.

Entries.Title: Forever
Entries.Description: A young adult comes home to organize his father’s belongings and inadvertently finds his childhood VR goggles, which open up memories of the past. In his early childhood, his father died unexpectedly, leaving him without closure. Through the VR goggles, he discovers that he may have a second chance to say goodbye to his father.

Entries.Title: Cortinilla SMMX - 11va Edición
Entries.Description: Pollo, a drawn bird, escapes from the pages of a notebook to embark on a surreal journey to the SMMX Festival. A two-minute short film, used as a trailer for the Stop Motion Mexico Festival.

Entries.Title: Traveler
Entries.Description: A raccoon on a voxel boat talks about his job.

Entries.Title: TV or The Disturbance on Forest Hill Road
Entries.Description: A police patrol is drawn into a vortex of fictional worlds, triggered by the extensive TV consumption of a little boy.

Entries.Title: The Magic Hour
Entries.Description: Two brothers’ mission to fix their mom’s broken tablet, before she comes home, is met with a series of challenges.

Entries.Title: Epitaph
Entries.Description: An obituary writer finds his world shaken after receiving an email notifying him of his own death. Amidst distorted visions, reality manipulations, and ethereal encounters with Death, he is forced to face the inevitability of his end.

Entries.Title: Feeder
Entries.Description: Short animated film which depicts the "feeder" with one of her clients.

2008 is a 10-minute comedy-drama starring Nickelodeon actress Michaela Jill Murphy and Anja Kao Nielsen, following a young girl navigating her dysfunctional queer household as California voted to repeal gay marriage during the 2008 election.

Entries.Title: Геройчики. Незваный гость
Entries.Description: Roma plans to perform at a school competition and show a huge starship assembled from a construction set. The toy, equipped with the latest technology, immediately attracts the attention of uninvited guests - mysterious space pirates. They are trying to steal the starship. Roma's friends - Pinky, Bublik, General De Krol, Fly, Gloria, Ko-Ko and the ninja lizard O-Rush - will have to fight the aliens, and also test the strength of friendship, reflect on mutual assistance, courage, bravery, the right to make a mistake in everyone's life, and also the ability to forgive.

Entries.Title: Palomita
Entries.Description: A hungry pidgeon finds a box of popcorn, down on a bench, and tries to reach it. The only thing it stops him to get it it's the rain.

Entries.Title: Mugge & Super Happy
Entries.Description: When the codes for Sofia and Mugge's ingenious new game invention, Super Happy, are stolen and misused by an unknown mastermind, the two friends must embark on an adventurous virtual world to save all the inhabitants of the town of Basserup from being swallowed up by the game forever.

Entries.Title: The Girl Who Cried Pearls
Entries.Description: A fairytale for all about a girl overwhelmed by grief, a boy who loves her, and how greed leads the purest of hearts to commit the vilest of actions. A timeless and universal story, both strange and familiar, from meticulously crafted puppets and miniature sets. The film uses a hybrid technique of frame-by-frame animation, live-action and CGI to achieve a depth of emotion and expressiveness unseen in a puppet-based medium.

Entries.Title: Holy Heaviness
Entries.Description: It is a fact of life that love evolves, and relationships change. Using caricatures, this animated film captures resilience as an inevitable response to dependency. A tender yet meaningful take on life's stages and ages.

Entries.Title: SPIRITUS - Die Sinfonie des Chaos

Entries.Title: Remember To Enjoy The Light Before It’s Gone
Entries.Description: In this reflective short film, the Weeknd speaks to his younger self, encouraging him to ask questions about the future and remember the light before it's all gone.

Entries.Title: Butter

Entries.Title: Philosophical and Physical Model of a Tea Bag
Entries.Description: An ordinary day in the life of Shola and Pat-pat. They fish, walk and discuss the topic of existence. Shola finds the meaning of life in a tea bag, and Pat-pat completely disagrees. Where is the truth and are questions of universal philosophy so important in the face of friendship?

Entries.Title: The Life and Miracles of Saint Nicodemus of Tismana
Entries.Description: In the style of Christian-Orthodox icons, Liviu Bărbulescu animates the story of Saint Nicodemus in a highly instructive way. Alas, this veneration of a holy figure is soon revealed to be an artistic satire of the crimes of the Orthodox Church in Romania.

Entries.Title: Ako y el Oscuro Mundo de Atar

Entries.Title: Cowgirlies 01: Pony Express

Entries.Title: The Graffiti
Entries.Description: The moment the first gleam of sunlight trickled in gently stirring the folds of a shallow sleep… that was when the graffiti appeared. The film brings a prose poem by Makoto Takayanagi to life, read here by the poet himself.

Entries.Title: Vodi
Entries.Description: A cartoonist returns to his family home to seek his fortune in Hollywood, where he's plagued by strange visions and revelations of his family's bizarre history with a forgotten cartoon character that could be his ticket to success.

Entries.Title: Beyond the Horizon
Entries.Description: A group of people sleep standing up with their heads down. Light appears and disappears. People wake up. They look around, looking for a source of light. They return to their original position and sink back into sleep. The light appears and disappears. People wake up, look around and fall asleep. The light reappears and disappears. People wake up again, look around again and fall asleep again. Light appears but does not disappear. People are starting to walk towards the light. The film Beyond the Horizon is a metaphorical story about the eternal human search for the meaning of one's existence and one's place in the world, as well as the states and situations that individuals and society go through during that search.

Entries.Description: A short animated film about censorship.

After making friends with Little Mouse, who looks almost like him, Andulis is surprised to find out that, unlike his own dwelling, Little Mouse’s house is not upside down.

Entries.Title: Очень неудобный крокодил
Entries.Description: A very awkward Crocodile accidentally destroys the store where he works, because he has such a big head and such small paws... He tries to remain friendly, but in response he only receives condemnation and ridicule. Upset Crocodile meets Raccoon, who is also not having the best day. Together they complement each other and solve common problems.

Entries.Title: Homemade Gatorade
Entries.Description: A woman embarks on a road trip to deliver homemade Gatorade to a mysterious online buyer...

Entries.Title: The Shyness of Trees
Entries.Description: Hélène, 40 years old, comes to visit her aging mother in the French countryside. But her mother isn't being her usual self. She seems to have formed a strange bond with the plants, insects, and the old oak tree at the end of her garden...

Entries.Title: Sappho
Entries.Description: Inspired by fragments of poems by Sappho (Island of Lesbos, 600 BC), the first female author known to the Western World. The narrative alludes to Sappho’s poetic expressions and the multiple readings of her figure throughout history.

Entries.Title: mnemonic
Entries.Description: Building thinks thought, has realization. landscape in translation.

Entries.Title: MAMALONACITAS
Entries.Description: A mother buys her teenage son a new pair of shoes from a mall.

Entries.Title: My Grandfather Is a Nihonjin
Entries.Description: Noboru is a 10-year-old boy in search of his cultural identity. He turns to his grandfather Hideo, to find out more about his family. Despite always avoiding his past, his grandfather agrees to tell his story. As Noboru delves into his family history, he discovers he has an uncle he’s never heard about.

Entries.Title: Becoming Air
Entries.Description: Breathe deeply: in 3 years, your molecules will circle Earth, as today’s oxygen came from nature.

Entries.Title: Generatio Spontanea
Entries.Description: Life is short, but there’s magic. The shadow of a small tree magically grows and evolves as the light transitions from dawn to dusk. The poetic artwork combines still photography with hand-drawn stop-motion animation.

Entries.Title: Le Tour De Canada
Entries.Description: Two cyclists face off in a brutal cross Canada bike race.

Entries.Title: Marginalia
Entries.Description: When a young monk gets creative in the scriptorium, things take an unexpected turn as his doodles come to life!

Entries.Title: House at the End of the World
Entries.Description: An isolated woman tries to deal with her phobias and traumas at three different age stages of her life.

Entries.Title: Allah is Not Obliged
Entries.Description: When ten-year-old Birahima’s mother dies, he leaves his native village in Guinea, accompanied by the sorcerer and cook Yacouba, to search for his aunt Mahan. Crossing the border into Liberia, they are seized by rebels and forced into military service. Birahima becomes a child-soldier. Fighting in a chaotic civil war alongside many other boys, Birahima sees death, torture, dismemberment and madness but somehow manages to retain his own sanity.

Entries.Title: Memory Hotel
Entries.Description: A unique and surreal story about post-war Germany and a masterpiece of analogue film making. Director Heinrich Sabl worked over 25 years on this stop-motion marvel.

Entries.Title: Autorretrato
Entries.Description: Anette questions her identity as she walks through the city.

Entries.Title: Fireman Sam - The Great Show
Entries.Description: In Fireman Sam - The Big Show, the ever-helpful fireman Sam faces a series of exciting adventures in Piekepolder!

Entries.Title: All Hail the Duck King
Entries.Description: When Bill struggles with artist’s block, a figure from his past emerges - leading him on a journey to embrace his true self.

Entries.Title: The Reach
Entries.Description: The year she turns ninety-five, Stella starts to see ghosts of her dead friends and loved ones, including her late husband Bill. They tell her to join them in crossing the Reach, an ice bridge that forms over the ocean between her home of Koati Island and the mainland in winter.

Entries.Title: Gugusse
Entries.Description: Gugusse is a gruff lonely man stuck in traffic. A strange bird will male the wait all the more hellish.

Entries.Title: In The Belly of a Snake
Entries.Description: fell into the belly of a snake And spent the night without a dream of coming back. If serpent chose to spit what’s left of me Then at the break of dawn what will I be?

Entries.Title: The Boulder Theory
Entries.Description: After falling in love with a boulder, two glyptodons brawl over their shared romantic interest.

Entries.Title: Balloonerism
Entries.Description: The short film companion to Mac Miller's Balloonerism follows a group of school friends who are transfigured by the music of a chord organ and launched into a shadow world. Swallowed by the turtle of time, they must plod through the underbelly of adulthood.

Entries.Title: Frames
Entries.Description: The interactions between figure and paper, animating person and animated world, and tuba and double bass lead to dynamic confrontations and balancing acts. The environment is constantly reshaped by overlapping sheets of paper. A space is created in which the figure transcends the boundaries between the frames.

Entries.Title: Dracula a duex
Entries.Description: a two minute gothic animated short following the bloodthirsty character of Dracula.

Entries.Title: Last Call
Entries.Description: Claudia Chow lives for the rush—reckless rides, wild nights, and adrenaline-fueled chaos. But her mind is haunted by visions of a seductive Serpent Woman, whispering, “Your body is my body.” When a high-speed crash sends Claudia spiraling between reality and illusion, her nights grow darker and more unhinged. The Serpent Woman’s voice becomes impossible to ignore, leading Claudia on a journey of desire, destruction, and transformation.

Entries.Title: A memoria das pedras
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Булгаковъ
Entries.Description: The film tells about Mikhail Bulgakov's work in the early twenties of the last century as a journalist in Moscow newspapers and magazines. These were difficult and hungry years. The Moscow of those years comes to life on the screen.

Entries.Title: The Car
Entries.Description: An animation from Ben Holt that follows a turtle as he makes the treacherous journey along a busy street.

Entries.Title: Iyanu: The Age Of Wonders
Entries.Description: When Meje, the living embodiment of the seven deadly sins, threatens the land, young warriors Dara and Ishe must rally the mythical Divine Ones to prevent an age of darkness.

Entries.Title: My Brother, My Brother
Entries.Description: Perceiving life as something shared by two. Through a split (dual) narrative, identical twins Omar and Wesam, recount their shared memories: from their time in the womb of their mother to the moment they are tragically separated. Written and directed by twin brothers, Saad and Abdelrahman Dnewar, My Brother, My Brother, combines 2D animation with live-action cinematography to chronicle a deeply affectionate and tender narrative about existing without the other.

Entries.Title: Forgotten Bloodlines: Agate
Entries.Description: Realistic CG documentary film focusing on prehistoric creatures of the Agate Fossil Beds during the Miocene, following Moropus and Daeodon, as they and other animals grow and adapt to the changing environment.

Entries.Title: Dog Ear
Entries.Description: Eleven-year-old Berci spends an afternoon alone with his dog, struggling with the emotions left behind after witnessing his parents' violent fight the day before. As his suppressed feelings surface, he releases his anger and aggression in tense and emotional interactions with his dog. These raw expressions eventually help Berci find relief and discover the quiet, transformative strength of forgiveness.

Entries.Title: The Yellow Wallpaper
Entries.Description: A Super 8 adaption of Charlotte Perkins-Gilman's The Yellow Wallpaper.

Entries.Title: Na Galiza de Vizoso
Entries.Description: An animation tribute for graphic artist Xosé Vizoso, responsible for developing Galician visual culture through his work and during his path at the Sargadelos factory, where he became heir to the language built by Isaac Díaz Pardo and Luis Seoane.

Entries.Title: Resolution
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Connection
Entries.Description: Andy and Jen have mind-blowing sex, and in good ‘ol lesbian fashion, their connection is much deeper than they thought it would be. Pun intended.

Entries.Title: Drained
Entries.Description: Truck driver Teddy's late night stop at a gas station takes a dark turn when he meets the mysterious hooker Katerina, leading to unexpected consequences.

Entries.Title: The Final Stair
Entries.Description: As an apocalyptic flood engulfs their city, a mother and her two children find themselves trapped within the fragile walls of their home. With the waters rising relentlessly, she must summon every ounce of strength physical and emotional to guide her family upward through collapsing floors and the ghosts of memory. Each level ascended reveals not only the devastation outside but the deeper toll of survival within. Above the vast sea, the stars glimmer as both a beacon of hope and a desperate call for salvation. The Final Stair is a haunting meditation on resilience, sacrifice, and the fragile light of humanity in the face of overwhelming catastrophe

Entries.Title: Жил-был тигр
Entries.Description: The story of an unusual friendship between a tiger and a goat in a seaside zoo. About how a spontaneous goat helped a bored tiger find freedom.

Entries.Title: His Boy
Entries.Description: Woo-jin, a boy who is at the funeral of his parents who died in a car accident, meets a boy named San.  During the 3-day funeral, the two become closer but...

Entries.Title: Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle Movie
Entries.Description: Movie for Hypnosis Mic: Division Rap Battle.

Entries.Title: The Puffins & the Magic Portal

Entries.Title: expressive videotape

Entries.Title: FLEDGELINGS
Entries.Description: Four feathered childhood friends bond over their shared obsession with dinosaurs. One day, the pressures of growing up threaten to tear them apart.

Entries.Title: Tamagawa-kun Wants to be a Cat
Entries.Description: For Tamagawa, volunteering at a cat café is the only relief from his stressful job. The manager tells him to, "relax and learn to be spoiled," but he doesn't know what that means until a new customer, Rai Shindo, comes to the café and tells Tamagawa he wants to keep him as a cat! Enter their strange, but fateful relationship. A pure-hearted and soothing romantic comedy.

Entries.Title: All Alone Together
Entries.Description: The story of a Cow in the high desert as he finds friendship and belonging among unexpected company – a tiny Dragon.

Entries.Title: Tom and Jerry: Chaos Chronicles
Entries.Description: Jerry breaks glass of milk and he runs away with Tom to outside; Jerry throws dynamite to Tom then explodes, Tom goes to sleep he dreams about food such pizza cheeseburger chicken drumstick until about Spike bulldog and Spike beats Tom in Tom's dream, Tom wakes up to mocking Spike bulldog, Spike comes to Tom and he's angry then Spike beats Tom, Tom wants beat Meccano with punching and kicking but Meccano beats Tom, Jerry kills Meccano with dynamite, At the end Spike bulldog Chases Tom then Tom Chases Jerry

Entries.Title: Sendokai Sengate
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Harmony
Entries.Description: Lully, a musical chimera, finds out that his music gives color to the world. He goes out to discover his universe and its chimeras. They join him for a musical journey in which Lully struggles to fit in. They don't give up and listen to each other until they finally reach musical and visual harmony.

Entries.Title: The Hell (Two Kinds of Life)
Entries.Description: Jae-young, an ordinary woman in her mid-20s is sentenced to death by an angel, and ascends to Heaven. Going to Heaven means nothing to her because she assumes Heaven is devoid of reason and humanity. But she accepts her fate and proceeds to bid farewell to her mother and friend. During her farewells, the desire for life starts to torture her.

Entries.Title: Rufus: The Sea Serpent Who Couldn't Swim
Entries.Description: Rufus does not really fit in - in his community of sea serpents, he is the only one who can't swim. But when disaster strikes and their secret island needs protection, Rufus must face his deepest fear and save his family.

Entries.Title: Woodland
Entries.Description: With the help of a magical flute, the old forest creature keeps a dark cloud cover at bay, which blocks out the sunlight and causes the plants to wither. But one day, the flute itself begins to wither because it is a fragile “flower flute”. Desperate, the forest creature sets off in search of a new flower, while the surrounding nature becomes increasingly lifeless...

Entries.Title: Astrodomus Never Predicted AI
Entries.Description: Dying young is not an option anymore

Entries.Title: Rainbow.
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: My Lillie
Entries.Description: A love-struck young man gifts his love with never-ending flowers, slowly destroying his garden and soon his relationship.

Entries.Title: Ashes of Conviction
Entries.Description: Burr tried to endure Hamilton, but they ended up with the most famous duel in history.

Entries.Title: Нелётная погода
Entries.Description: The dog Lucky is in the Arctic for the first time, everything is new and scary for him. The situation gets worse: a new acquaintance, the North Wind, entangles Lucky in a dangerous adventure. The story is based on real events and, as in reality, the film ends well. Lucky even flew, although the weather was not suitable for flying, as often happens in Norilsk.

Entries.Title: Menino Gepeto
Entries.Description: This is the story of Geppetto, an 11-year-old boy who likes to create his own toys. His father, Genaro, is the one who builds them using wood from fallen trees in the Enchanted Forest. But what Geppetto doesn't know is that the Fairy Godmother lives there, who has the power to give life to his wooden toys.  The forest is beautiful, but all this wonder is under threat! Our characters will get involved in a great adventure to stop the evil Mr. Machado from illegally cutting down a single tree!

Entries.Title: Reflejo rosa
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Velos y almas
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Gorillaz Live (YouTube Music Nights)
Entries.Description: Gorillaz debut album performed live in full at Copper Box Arena, London on 29th August 2025.

Entries.Title: First Flight
Entries.Description: Three baby birds, one big challenge—their first flight! But as the frogs begin their peculiar performance, the sky turns into a whirlwind of improvisatio — some birds twirl, some hover, and others just hope for the best.

Entries.Title: TRUST
Entries.Description: The future is just a little more technologically advanced than today. People spend more time in the metaverse, and the number of cyber crimes has increased.  In order to improve the efficiency of crime control, the operators of the metaverse have begun to give AI the authority to act as investigators.  One day, Violet, an AI investigator specializing in interviews, is assigned to interrogate a girl named Mia.  At first, Mia is uncooperative with Violet, but her attitude changes when she hears Violet's name.  When Mia hears Violet's name, her attitude changes.  What is Mia's revelation, and what is the "truth" that Violet has discovered in the closed interrogation room?  A neo-noir suspense with a new visual sensation.

Entries.Title: Short Cuts : KILL BILL VOL.1
Entries.Description: Quentin Tarantino's Kill Bill Vol. 1 revisited in a one-minute animated clip by Ylang Lebot.

Entries.Title: A Mouse Hunt for Christmas
Entries.Description: A small mouse family plans a quiet Christmas outside the city, but their celebration is disrupted when humans unexpectedly appear. As the mice try to hide their preparations, the humans react to the noises behind the walls with determination.

Entries.Title: Felina
Entries.Description: Felina, a woman capable of becoming a panther, or perhaps a panther capable of becoming a woman, lives in love with a blind pianist.

Entries.Title: Tendre Rêve
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: No Strings Attached
Entries.Description: When the baggage of her past takes the form of an indestructible balloon, Faith must face her past and learn to let it go, or risk living forever with a balloon attached to her wrist.

Entries.Title: The Imp
Entries.Description: A girl is standing in line at a government office, waiting for her turn. As she stands there, she becomes increasingly annoyed by the people joining the line, invading her personal space. She screams, and a small creature (Madness) jumps out of her. It begins to wreak havoc, and no one has the slightest idea how to stop it.

Entries.Title: Dr. Seuss's The Sneetches
Entries.Description: As long as there have been Sneetches on beaches, the Star-Bellies and Moon-Bellies have lived separate lives. But when two young Sneetches form an unlikely friendship, they teach their communities that differences don't need to be avoided, they can be celebrated.

Entries.Title: Intermission
Entries.Description: After the lead of the school musical is rendered suddenly indisposed, her understudy has a few moments before she has to step up and fill her shoes.

Entries.Title: Old Gods of Atlantis
Entries.Description: On life in the death of empire; what remains of a place that once was.

Entries.Title: Poločas rozpadu
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Dolly Baby - Rhythm & Flesh
Entries.Description: In a world where humans are treated like dolls—every part replaceable—Adisa, a struggling musician, faces pressure to buy a new voice before a career-defining gig. Desperate, he turns to the Body Shop, a chaotic underground clinic.  The procedure could change everything for him… but is this what he really wants?

Entries.Title: Limbo of Roots
Entries.Description: A burning room. Crawling vines. City bustling. Trees living and dying. Roots breathing. Nightmare.

Entries.Title: Cold Feet
Entries.Description: Outside, a great storm. Inside, by the warmth of the hearth, a couple doesn't know that tonight will be unlike any of the last forty years…

Entries.Title: I Adore You
Entries.Description: At the end of the weekend, Louis has to say goodbye to his friend Antonin, with whom he is secretly in love. However, just a few days before his departure, Antonin prefers to flirt with Pauline, who quickly interferes with the duo. For Louis, stealing his place is out of the question. So he takes refuge in his imagination: where Pauline doesn't exist.

Entries.Title: Passing By
Entries.Description: A girl unexpectedly meets her childhood best friend, torn between rekindling their bond or letting the moment fade away.

Entries.Title: Hacia el progreso
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Secret Theatre
Entries.Description: A woman offers a lock of hair to her magical puppet theatre. She turns the crank handle, and it gives her a gift, the artifact absorbs her into a performance of puppets and insects where her presence will illuminate life.

Entries.Title: Thelma's Perfect Birthday
Entries.Description: Thelma is a little penguin who is not like the others. She doesn’t like snow very much, or freezing water, and she wishes she could fly. Was that because she was born in the Great Forest, and partially raised by her best friends, Cat Vilhelm and Mouse Sophia?  Living in the Land of Ice again, Thelma also worries about her upcoming birthday. What if Birthday doesn’t find her snow-covered house - will she have to stay for forever? When Thelma tries to organize a Birthday Party for her forest friends, she tumbles into a great adventure that will teach her all she needs to know to become a proper penguin.

Entries.Title: Die Meeresschutzstadt
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Lost Touch
Entries.Description: Amelia is the sole survivor on a damaged spaceship. Caught in the gravitational pull of a planet, she struggles with grief and isolation. When a mysterious presence appears, she is torn between the past and the future.

Entries.Title: Le Dévoreur de Couleurs
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Cowbells Are Ringing
Entries.Description: The clock is ticking! An old lady and her cow have to rush off on a hot air balloon adventure. What are they up to? And why is the cow so anxious?

Entries.Title: Outlandish
Entries.Description: A sheltered child ventures out of their safe house into a dangerous forest in search of their missing friend.

Entries.Title: Sparks
Entries.Description: Fumiko is a young girl with a vivid imagination and a heart full of dreams. Everything changes when she receives a special toy, a red panda named Chima, who becomes her best friend and source of joy. However, as time passes, Fumiko must face great challenges that shake her spirit and her relationship with Chima. As hope begins to fade, Fumiko embarks on an emotional journey to rediscover the meaning behind her dreams. In her search, she finds more than just inspiration, she rediscovers a part of herself that was once lost.

Entries.Title: 5am
Entries.Description: A collection of solitary urban images intersect with each other.

Entries.Title: Poppa
Entries.Description: An unlucky dude encounters a sticky situation after accidentally swallowing bubblegum.

Entries.Title: Edge of Time
Entries.Description: The magical cosmic energy "Taisu" flew into the ocean and merged with the toy girl in the crystal ball on the bottom of the sea, becoming a girl "Akira" who could move in the water. One day, Akira saved the girl who fell into the water while trying to retrieve her toy. In this way, Akira, who was also lonely, quickly became friends with her. The two played and frolicked in the sea, spent a happy time, and agreed to meet again tomorrow morning.

Entries.Title: Alles ist relativ relativ
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Fling
Entries.Description: A nice romantic dinner in a restaurant goes awry when it’s revealed one of them has a monstrous secret.

Entries.Title: Miles and Flowers
Entries.Description: A road trip movie about two boys trying to escape the horrors of war on a journey that could be their last chance to survive. One is desperate to save his family, while the other seeks to redeem himself from his past.

Entries.Title: Basia. My Little World
Entries.Description: Another installment of the series loved by the youngest viewers, which faithfully reflects the style and humor of the adapted books. Each episode tells a new adventure, filled with joy, good values and great fun.

Entries.Title: As if swallowed by earth
Entries.Description: Olivia, a young woman living abroad, returns to her hometown in Mexico in the hope of reconnecting with her past. But the violence she witnessed as a  child has not abated, and the journey rekindles memories that are impossible to reconcile with.

Entries.Title: Stitch
Entries.Description: May falls apart and puts herself back together.

Entries.Title: L'Aigle et le roitelet
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Sound of Letting Go
Entries.Description: Janus is on his way to propose to his girlfriend, when he runs into his ex-girlfriend, June. After an awkward meeting, which makes Janus insecure about himself, he reminisces about their lost love, and through song tells the story of how the two  met, broke up and eventually moved on. In the end, our protagonist lets go of that part of himself, and feels ready to take  the next big step in life.

Entries.Title: A Metamorphosis
Entries.Description: In A Metamorphosis, Lin Htet Aung transforms the uncanny and absurd experiences of what it is like to grow up with state television propaganda into a kind of counter-broadcast, redefining the compositions and narratives that defined them. This distorted, eerie broadcast explores the daily experiences of living in a dictatorship and the imagery you get accustomed to as a child, accompanied by a lullaby that will haunt you afterwards: Yee, lé-lé! Yee, lé-lé-

Entries.Title: What I See
Entries.Description: Art student Ian Jing impresses the realism-loving art teacher Mrs. Hui from the get-go. Following her advice, he draws exactly what he sees, straining his eyes in the process. To Mrs. Hui’s horror, Ian’s artwork gets progressively blurrier. In turn, his online fame skyrockets, as art critics on social media praise his unique style as an abstract artist. They ascribe deep, profound (pretentious) intentions and meanings to his stylistic choices, when all he's actually doing is drawing exactly what he sees.

Entries.Title: Until Morning
Entries.Description: Follow two groovy souls as they head to the disco underground and boogie on the dance floor of love.

Entries.Title: Dormilón
Entries.Description: Dormilón lovingly cares for the abandoned cinema he’s made a home. Every night he records his dreams, in which he is the star performer of the theater, rather than its former-janitor. On a stormy night, Dormi’s carefully crafted life is challenged when his nightmares accumulate and confront him. Dormilón will have to overcome his fears and embrace his insecurities to be a more complete version of himself.

Entries.Title: The Greatest Thing Ever: A Garden Cartoon Movie
Entries.Description: Embark on an enchanting journey with Lenny Lion and Lucy Lamb in their first-ever movie as they explore the vast Garden in search of "The Greatest Thing Ever!" There's just one catch The Boss never revealed what this treasure is! Could it be hidden treasure, a royal crown, cosmic adventures, or prehistoric wonders?

Entries.Title: YOU ARE BRAVE
Entries.Description: A kid gets a stomachache.

Entries.Title: After Us
Entries.Description: In the future human beings are abandoning planet earth. This animated short story captures the final journey of three animals who are left behind.

Entries.Title: O Gorila - Versão Definitiva
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Литера
Entries.Description: Copying books is a very boring job. So one Monk shirks his work in every possible way, risking falling under the hot hand of the strict Abbot. However, his laziness unexpectedly opens up new horizons for him.

Entries.Title: Turma da Mônica Jovem: Incertezas
Entries.Description: The end of the holidays has arrived and it's time to go back to Limoeiro! While the gang gets together to organize a welcome party for Milena, Monica tries to deal with the expectation of receiving the perfect dating proposal.

Entries.Title: Good Luck to You All
Entries.Description: A young girl plays with her dolls and robots, unaware that she may hold the future of humanity in her sticky hands. Good Luck to You All is a burlesque cautionary tale on our latest shiny toy: artificial intelligence.

Entries.Title: After fire
Entries.Description: A boy confesses his love to a girl — and turns to stone forever.

Entries.Title: Still Moving
Entries.Description: After her divorce, a mother drives a rented moving truck with her daughter in the passenger seat. The two head into a new future, only to discover the pain and difficulties of leaving the past behind.

Entries.Title: The Last Chapel
Entries.Description: Mid-wedding at a Vegas-style chapel, a celebration comes crashing to a halt when the iconic, deceased pink poodle Poolvis Poodle’s greedy Estate steps in and shuts it down.

Entries.Title: How a River Is Born
Entries.Description: Ayla wakes up in a mountainous landscape, surrounded only by vegetation and a river. Driven by curiosity and a desire to get to know the place, she goes on a journey of discovery and diving. As she discovers where she is, she also discovers herself.

Entries.Title: Miyuu in October
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: My Little Pony The Movie: Infection
Entries.Description: Soarin is haunted by a fragment of his alicorn magic he thought he had sealed away. Twilight and Soarin are tasked by Princess Celestia to find this fragment which had taken a physical form, and kill it before all of Equestria is drained of its magic.

Entries.Title: Natura fugit
Entries.Description: Animated short film based on the drawings of the artist Jesus Mari Lazkano and showing us the transformation of the Mer de Glace glaciar in Chamonix.

Entries.Title: ApoKalypse
Entries.Description: Apo, a directionless skateboarder with dreams of going pro, finds himself trapped in a shopping mall when entitled customers consuming "Ratartarre" (a rat poison marketed as a COVID cure) transform into ravenous "brain dead" zombies sporting Karen haircuts. Together with his best friend Jamal and his crush Cho from the Korean chicken restaurant, Apo discovers that the zombies have unusual weaknesses. As the army surrounds the mall with mysterious intentions, the trio must battle through hordes of brain deads screaming for "MANAGRRR" to find a way out before time runs out.

Entries.Title: Planet Spoilia
Entries.Description: Kim and Park have been wandering the universe for 500 years in search of 'answers' when they crash land on the strange planet of Spoilia. On its odd surface, they find an alien body and realise that the planet has more secrets to uncover. A mix of live action and claymation, this cosmic adventure was created by the director in his living room over the course of two years.

Entries.Title: Bar Croquette freestyle
Entries.Description: After watching a Bollywood film, a woman yearning for excitement begins to question the storyline of her own life.

Entries.Title: HYSTERESIS
Entries.Description: A mad scientist trying to create life pushes his experiments too far.

Entries.Title: Jimmy Two-Shoes
Entries.Description: Lucifer hires Heloise to blacken Jimmy Two-Shoes' heart after consistent ruining his schemes.

Entries.Title: Rukeli
Entries.Description: Johann Wilhelm Trollmann becomes middleweight champion in Nazi Germany. He is the first Roma boxer in the world to win the title. He is famous for his dancing fighting style. With the enactment of the racial laws, he is imprisoned in Wittenberge and Neuengamme concentration camps, where he dies at the age of 37. He decides to die as a champion and fights with a Nazi kapo who challenges him. Rukeli, which means tree, the Gipsy, knocks out the Nazi and the entire apparatus of power.

Entries.Title: INFINITY IN BOTH DIRECTIONS
Entries.Description: An avant-garde short film accompanied by a "radio edit" of PRPL PPL's free jazz album “Facial Recognition." The album served as the soundtrack for a gallery installation of the same name inspired by David Lynch's  "Six Figures Getting Sick," and featured 35mm footage by Beck Simon. This short was produced at the David Lynch Graduate School of Cinematic Arts, and is dedicated to the memory its late namesake.

Entries.Title: Chalisa
Entries.Description: A journey through Hanuman’s magical life.

Entries.Title: Fallen Houses
Entries.Description: A personal story set against the backdrop of the 1980 Irpinia earthquake, narrated by a father to his son. This event becomes a universal paradigm for exploring the story of those who were forced to leave their homes and migrate. People are intrinsically linked to places, and these places hold the memory of those who inhabited them.

Entries.Title: Plumpin
Entries.Description: Meet Plumpin!  A character from the minds of Ivan Dixon and the team at Studio Showoff.  This animated short film premiered at Pictoplasma 2025 and went on to screen at multiple festivals worldwide. It won Best Australian Animation at MIAF. It was scored by ‪Felix Colgrave‬ and animated by ‪Studio Showoff‬

Entries.Title: ReRooted
Entries.Description: A bored warehouse worker's quest for an enduring legacy as an animator takes a darkly comedic turn when she signs up for an eco-friendly burial.

Entries.Title: A TISZÁN
Entries.Description: At dawn, Ottó reopens his little ferry and helps all those living in his Hungarian countryside travel across the river.

Entries.Title: Chicha la chicharra
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Little Frog Man
Entries.Description: The absurd story of an appropriately named little frog man and the path of havoc he leaves behind him. Watch as his shenanigans catch up to him in Little Frog Man.

Entries.Title: Working Girls
Entries.Description: A humorous yet raw and authentic study of women’s reproductive labour across the marriage-market continuum, including, sex work, erotic dancing, surrogacy and egg donation, paid domestic work and unpaid domestic/care work across India, while also offering a comparison of the law’s highly differential regulation of these apparently disparate forms of female reproductive labour.

Entries.Title: Potlems
Entries.Description: In a town of ever-smiling porcelain children, Ginger is created with a fatal flaw: a frown is painted on his face by accident. Upon realizing, the Fire God, his creator, stops his song in horror: Ginger needs to be corrected.

Entries.Title: Desmembro
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Three of Cups
Entries.Description: 3 vampires go on a hunt to recover their cups from a museum, but first must evade an overzealous security guard.

Entries.Title: Written in the Stars
Entries.Description: Memories of a couple over the years and how their love transcends to create another life.

Entries.Title: O menino que engoliu o choro
Entries.Description: Based on the book of the same name by renowned author Cris Pàz (formerly known as Cris Guerra), this delicate and moving short film invites us to reflect on the emotions we silence and the feelings we keep hidden.

Entries.Title: High Sugar
Entries.Description: A police officer has a fever dream after having too much sugar.

Entries.Title: For When I Think, There is This Heaviness That I Would Rather You Not Carry
Entries.Description: A very short story about creative block.

Entries.Title: Little Shrew (Snowflake)
Entries.Description: A little shrew searches for Hope as she makes her way across a bombed-out city.

Entries.Title: L'Entre deux
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Unliked
Entries.Description: Marcos, an insecure teenager, faces a monster that arises from the bullying he endures. To survive, he must uncover the hidden strength within himself and confront what torments him.

Entries.Title: The course of nature
Entries.Description: Jimmy loves nature and Charlie hates Jimmy.

Entries.Title: Cadaverous Dreamscape of an Unborn Maggot
Entries.Description: Experimental animation made with nails, hair, teeth and a doll.

Entries.Title: Submerged Head
Entries.Description: A figure wanders through a snow storm, arriving in the crosshairs of an unseen weapon.

Entries.Title: Stone of Destiny
Entries.Description: The Stone of Destiny longs for freedom and wants to overcome its self-doubt. So it embarks on a journey and meets strange creatures in strange places.

Entries.Title: Jakomeka, Luv Estrim
Entries.Description: It is no coincidence that Lucas, has been in a state of crisis since his little activity in 2024 on YouTube, where he promised heaven, sea and earth for his content, but failed miserably after a series of personal events that marked him, and made him isolate himself from his reality in the United States in a small place he bought to make a store, excusing it as a mere and ephemeral “hobby”. Now, back to his old life, in an extravagant attempt to return to what he once was, Lucas sets himself the challenge of spending the entire month of January of the current year, in an isolation chamber of an independent American company called “JAKOMEKA”, where his actions, more than provoking an air of hope, would culminate in the rupture of his close circle.

Entries.Title: The Tragedy of the Maned Wolf
Entries.Description: After losing everything, a sentimental Maned Wolf wanders around Brazil in search of a new home.

Entries.Title: Snooze Quest
Entries.Description: PJ spends a sleepless night getting roped into a sniper revenge plot.

Entries.Title: Memory Lane
Entries.Description: Memory Lane is a heartwarming film shedding light on families with loved ones suffering from dementia.

Entries.Title: Baile con la muerte
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Brown Morning
Entries.Description: Charly lives happily with his old blue dog and his little pink cat. When a brown cat tries to sneak into his house, he ignores it. When a cute little brown pug plays in his garden, he doesn't care. But little by little, brown animals invade his life...

Entries.Title: SWIPE
Entries.Description: She tries to swipe her way to happiness, but after an exhaustive body count, she resorts to assembling her dream boy from left over parts. Welcome to the Meet Market!

Entries.Title: Stones
Entries.Description: Losing someone is such a one and only pain, and yet is it one of the most universal. A life is so vast and yet so small, and there is comfort in that realisation.

Entries.Title: A Sparrow’s Song
Entries.Description: Inspired by a true story, a widowed air raid warden in the midst of World War II struggles to overcome grief and rediscover joy in her life – until she finds a dying sparrow she hopes to save.

Entries.Title: Terrible Lizards
Entries.Description: The first episode of Dinosauria Volume 2, and sixth overall instalment.

Entries.Title: FIGURE IN TRASFORMAZIONE
Entries.Description: A geometric evolution from a little point to a circle and then to a point again.

Entries.Title: Sulaimani
Entries.Description: One evening, Alia and Neena, two young Indian women, dine at Sulaimani, an Indian restaurant in Paris. The meal stirs up buried emotions and "unleashes" certain memories that slowly reveal why they left their country.

Entries.Title: Os 3 Porkinhos
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Shadow
Entries.Description: In this experimental animated film, a woman explores the layers of her body and inner world. Through symbolic display of separation and reconnection with oneself, the film explores the dynamics of roughness and tenderness in relationship with oneself. An intimate journey exploring the complexity of self-acceptance and inner harmony.

Entries.Title: In My Dreams
Entries.Description: Surreal animation made with CGI and AI-generated imagery.

Entries.Title: كلّ هذا الموت
Entries.Description: An old Beirut resident checks the obituaries page and attends funerals daily. His "mourning" routine reveals a journey of grieving and accepting the loss of a loved one, a home and a city.

Entries.Title: Debra Out of Water

Entries.Title: The Last Solution
Entries.Description: Within the confines of a massive wall, a group of children plays as if there were no tomorrow

Entries.Title: The Painting
Entries.Description: Utilising the Alexeïeff-Parker pinscreen technique, this visually poetic non-narrative film revisits Diego Vélasquez’s 1652 portrait of Queen Mariana of Austria with genuine feeling.

Entries.Title: Rosetta
Entries.Description: An extroverted, cheerful, dreamer, Rosetta was raised in the “Traveling Circus of Pitibiribas”. From a very young age, she dreamed of following her parents' profession and become a circus clown, but when offered the opportunity to perform in public for the first time, she gets nervous and gets her number wrong. Consumed with the feeling of failure, she runs away before she could fulfill her dream

Entries.Title: MOTOR GIRL
Entries.Description: In the glamorous, male-dominated world of motorsport, racecar driver Mia de Milo stands as the sole female competitor. As cracks begin to form in Mia's confidence and her vehicle falters, her personal insecurities begin to overpower her, and the line between body and machine begins to blur.

Entries.Title: No More Work
Entries.Description: A man, depressed by his day-to-day life, ventures into the woods. Events ensue.

Entries.Title: The Sycamore
Entries.Description: Two weary travellers seek out shade and sustenance from an idle tree. Based on the fable, "The Travellers and the Plane Tree" by Aesop.

Entries.Title: Creature
Entries.Description: A coming of age documentary-fiction about an adolescent girl Lola who befriends a mysterious creature on the shore of her new hometown. Throughout their day spent together, Lola explores feelings of longing and belonging.

Entries.Title: House Trap
Entries.Description: When a farm mouse steals the final piece of a jigsaw puzzle, an estranged family is brought together over a game of cat and mouse.

Entries.Title: Cordélicos - A origem do Cabra da Peste
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Dies Irae
Entries.Description: Semi based on real events...

Entries.Title: Family Circus
Entries.Description: A giraffe reflects on life in polyamory, an elephant ponders the complexities of a heterosexual relationship, and a small bird shares the unexpected consequences of divorce. Openhearted and insightful, this animated ensemble of circus animals offers candid tales of their experiences with family and relationships.

Entries.Title: Exit The Red Room | A David Lynch Tribute
Entries.Description: An animated tribute to the legendary David Lynch.

Entries.Title: La Reine et la Statue
Entries.Description: On a volcanic planet, a queen, having lost her beloved king, resurrects by mistake the statue of the king lying on the tomb. An impossible love story begins between the queen and the statue.

Entries.Title: Volatile: Kali
Entries.Description: A twisted "killer" story set over a rainy night in the gloomy lanes of North Calcutta, where a woman haunted by a childhood abduction becomes the prey of a merciless murderer and must face the darkest corners of her past to survive.

Entries.Title: The Bell
Entries.Description: A young woman returns to a special place from her childhood.

Entries.Title: Merrimundi
Entries.Description: A twisted utopia unfolds, as singing cherubs melt to the sound of decay. Crafted by a sentient machine from the future, it unveils its own version of paradise.

Entries.Title: On the Other Side...
Entries.Description: One-sided love is like a seed quietly planted in the stomach. It awakens slowly, sprouting and blossoming, by the hair behind the neck, by the itch of wind-tossed hair brushing across fingers. That itch becomes a desire, a desire to reach to the other side…

Entries.Title: Hacker Leonilia
Entries.Description: An elderly hacker with a personal crisis needs to use her skills and memories to escape a metaverse in order to have a second chance.

Entries.Title: A Bird Hit My Window and Now I'm a Lesbian
Entries.Description: After a mysterious stranger shows up at Gray's doorstep holding the corpse of a dead bird, an impromptu funeral changes the way Gray views herself and her lesbian identity.

Entries.Title: Family Dinner
Entries.Description: Tonight, dinner starts with a slice of tomato.

Entries.Title: Into the Reds Tale
Entries.Description: An abomination mimic creature enters the story of 'Little Red Riding Hood' and disguises itself as her, tricking the Big Bad Wolf into walking into a trap

Entries.Title: The Way You Look Tonight
Entries.Description: A man and a woman who are in a cold and distant relationship find out that they suffer from the same strange ailment.

Entries.Description: A farmer dreams his seed becomes a big tree.

Entries.Description: Blargh is a passive little feller. Everything just kind of happens around him, while he’s keeping it all in. So much that he discovers a ball of black goo in his stomach.

Entries.Title: Little Red Riding Hood
Entries.Description: An interpretation of the classic story of Little Red Riding Hood, expressed through a continuous metamorphosis of images in an abstract environment.

Entries.Title: Crónicas

Entries.Title: Silent Tides
Entries.Description: Time pushes everyone forward, like silent tides carrying each person toward an unknown destination. On the journey called "life," we drift along distant currents toward an "end" that may or may not exist. We can only keep moving forward or backward, get lost in the ebb and flow, or find ourselves caught in the same repeating waves.

Entries.Title: Thomas and Friends: Sodor Sings Together
Entries.Description: In preparation for the big Sodor Sings Festival - the biggest musical event on the - the engines are hard at work to make the night one to remember.

Entries.Title: The Magician
Entries.Description: Sulina, 1910. It is the inauguration of the first electric power station in this Romanian port city. In the jubilation of a modern and cosmopolitan crowd, Ilarion, a prestidigitator from another time, tries to play his last card.

Entries.Title: The Chipmunk and the Squirrel
Entries.Description: The Chipmunk learns that the Squirrel is moving in across from its home. Curious and excited to befriend the newcomer, the Chipmunk approaches with a small gift. But the Squirrel only responds with an unreadable expression and a curt attitude. Still, the Chipmunk doesn’t give up and keeps finding ways to express its feelings.

Entries.Title: A Cowboy in Lisbon
Entries.Description: Tired of my city, I imagine the arrival of a cowboy in Lisbon.

Entries.Title: You and Idol Precure♪ the Movie For You! Our Kirakilala Concert!
Entries.Description: "You and Idol Precure♪" will appear at the "No.1 Universe" Idol Festival!  What is the secret hidden on the mysterious island...?  One day, Uta and her friends are invited by the coral fairy, Totto to appear in the "Super Miracle Idol Festival" held on a mysterious island called AiAi Island!  In a hu~ge venue, many different idols, including robots and animals, gather♪  The biggest idol festival in the universe is about to begin! Or so they thought...?  Suddenly, a mysterious monster appears, and AiAi Island and the world are caught up in a crisis...  And what's more, they've been transported back in time!?  The clue to saving them from this crisis is hidden in the legend of the island's goddess and the mysterious idol-hating girl Tera, whom they met on the island...?  That's not all! "Wonderful Precure!" and "Soaring Sky! Precure" will also be rushing over to AiAi Island!  C'mon! Sing, dance, and please the crowd - a kirakiLive concert is about to begin!☆

Entries.Description: A group of neighbours, each focused on their own goals, must learn to communicate and consider one another. But when small, everyday actions trigger unexpected consequences, they are forced into interactions that challenge their independence.

Entries.Description: A short directed by loundraw. Made as a collaboration between Z-Kai Group, loundraw, and FLAT STUDIO.

Entries.Description: Back once more in the province, Alex and her mother cook the very peculiar but comforting and warm Humba, fondly reminiscing about her grandmother.

Entries.Title: Awaiting the Lightning Bolt
Entries.Description: Renato, an eccentric Renaissance inventor, dares the impossible: capturing a lightning bolt in a jar!  Fuelled by ambition and defying the skepticism of his peers, he races against time in a thrilling journey, where each storm offers an extraordinary glimpse into the mysteries of nature and the power of love.

Entries.Title: Casual
Entries.Description: Exploring negotiations of intimacy and monogamy in casual relationships. Our two protagonists share the sweet thrill of peeking into a stranger's intimate life, but are confronted with the question: Which is more vulnerable to talk about, sexual desires or romantic dreams?

Entries.Title: Sweet Cabanyal
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Memoria
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Hypersensitive
Entries.Description: Hypersensitive recounts the turbulent, surrealistic journey of a young woman struggling to understand her unique take on the world. Drawing on her own childhood memories as well as her fertile imagination, filmmaker Martine Frossard paints a compassionate portrait of a woman on a quest for healing in a society with little tolerance for difference. Rich in symbolism inspired by plant life, her film is a heartfelt plea for us all to take greater heed of our emotions, even the most painful ones—reminding us that to be sensitive is to be alive.

Entries.Title: 2nd Day & the End of the World
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Gold rush
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: I'll Come Back for You
Entries.Description: Murilo, a Black graffiti artist from São Paulo, Brazil, shares his memories in an animated diary blending 2D, 3D, and live-action about his best friend, childhood, and the Brazilian hip-hop scene.

Entries.Title: Inmuebles
Entries.Description: In the course of a real estate search a poem is produced. Images play around this drift between properties.

Entries.Title: They
Entries.Description: In a town overrun by grumbling citizens caught in clouds of complaint, a hopeful hero and his trusty dog hatch a plan to encourage a return to better days. However, things seem to backfire... until disaster strikes, and a surprising twist unites the masses in unexpected solidarity.

Entries.Title: Death’s Peak
Entries.Description: After digging up his dead brother, David carries the body up a dangerous mountain in pursuit of their childhood dream, hoping it will bring him peace

Entries.Title: My Little Pony The Movie: The Death Of Trixie Lulamoon
Entries.Description: While Twilight Sparkle and friends embark on a desperate race across the stars, Trixie unearths buried truths about herself. Truths that likely should have remained forgotten...

Entries.Title: DON'T SLEEP IN
Entries.Description: Follow Nap Queen as she suffers through what many would call a divine punishment for the deadliest sin: ignoring your alarm.

Entries.Title: I Wish I Were a Star
Entries.Description: A narrator muses on why they want to be a cosmic star.

Entries.Title: What's next?
Entries.Description: Super ancient creatures, tempting devils, greedy human, women's fixed fate. A fairy tale or a prophecy? Wake up. It's your time.

Entries.Title: Zona de Meteoros
