Entries.Title: Saggy Bosoms
Entries.Description: Inspired by old Danish folklore, this whimsical dark fairytale tells the story of twin girls Maja and Marlena escaping from their abusive mother, to seek refuge with the enchanting forest lady nicknamed “Saggy Bosoms”  whom their mother had warned them about.

Entries.Title: Thunderhead
Entries.Description: When a young woman is overcome by panic, her mind transforms into a terrifying, dark world. She flees a devastating thundercloud that is hot on her heels and must overcome her fears to escape this nightmare.

Entries.Title: Dead End
Entries.Description: Located in a futuristic Dhaka City from the 2100s. We follow Zayn Khan our protagonist, a genius engineer trying to fulfill his father's dream. However, he gets intertwined with a street racing gang named 'The Hawks', lead by Alvan Haque.

Entries.Title: Rossi Boomer
Entries.Description: Rossi returns as the protagonist of a surreal and comical journey to discover the future, driven by the hope of finally finding happiness.

Entries.Title: M Stop Motion
Entries.Description: A superhero claims he must strike epic poses before he can rescue someone from a fire.

Entries.Title: Murmuration
Entries.Description: Piet, an elderly man in a nursing home, finds himself limited in his actions when he suddenly begins to transform into a bird. Although he is still accepted within the group, he feels that it's time to join a new flock.

Entries.Title: Love Does Not Stop
Entries.Description: A short animated tribute to Georgia’s beloved dog Kupata (“Sausage”), created in celebration of Children’s Day.

Entries.Title: Stoned for Christmas
Entries.Description: A multimedia whirlwind and a love letter to weed, Stoned for Christmas follows the adventures of one cannabis courier delivering at Christmas time.

Entries.Title: Tapeworm Alexis & the Opera Diva
Entries.Description: Tapeworm Alexis helps Maria Callas rise to the 'Prima Assoluta' – a success story that ends in the biggest opera scandal of all time: the diva's voice fails, and the dream team has to go into hiding.

Entries.Title: Let LOVE sing it's SONG
Entries.Description: In a surreal, post-breakup limbo, Violeta —a necromancer— turns her ex-lover Smoke into bones during a heated fight. Trapped in a ghostly train that symbolizes their failed relationship, Smoke lies dormant… until Violeta passes by once more. What follows is a strange and emotional chase, a dance through memory and regret, as the two are pulled back together in a haunting, silent reconciliation.

Entries.Title: Rose Fluo
Entries.Description: A miraculous Rose is seeking their place in this world. Let’s tell you the story of this quest.

Entries.Title: TÁVOLBAN
Entries.Description: A young Garabonciás goes on a journey through unfamiliar lands and wondrous sights.

Entries.Title: Because Today is Saturday
Entries.Description: It is Saturday, a day of rest. A woman wakes up early so that she can give herself a birthday present: some time to write. But whenever an inspirational moment occurs, it is interrupted by domestic situations that claim her attention: the children, laundry, the meals. The mental load of those tasks ends up being unbearable and she reaches a breaking point.

Entries.Title: Wilfred Buck’s Star Stories
Entries.Description: Guided by the wisdom of Ininew astronomer Wilfred Buck, this immersive experience shares four Cree star stories, exploring the cosmos to teach us how to live a good life with future generations in mind.

Entries.Title: Bone-Skinny
Entries.Description: Desperate to lose weight, Chloe stumbles upon an infomercial for "MagicSlim," an all natural herbal supplement that promises effortless weight loss. Ignoring the strange warning about lighting accompanying candles, she eagerly drinks the smoothies, only to wake up dramatically thinner overnight. As the pounds melt away at an alarming rate, an eerie presence begins lurking in the shadows, growing closer each night. Unaware that she is being devoured by a sinister force, Chloe soon realizes too late that her dream body has come at the ultimate price.

Entries.Title: Fish
Entries.Description: A love-hate relationship between a girl and her pet fish which leads to regret.

Entries.Title: Fairy of Shampoo
Entries.Description: The protagonist's favorite pastime? Singing in the shower! And the Shampoo Fairy? They live for those duets. But pesky obstacles keep interrupting shower time. Can the determined Shampoo Fairy overcome the chaos and get the protagonist squeaky clean?

Entries.Title: Ordinary Life
Entries.Description: A breath of air, a movement, a touch and, in between, a dissolution. Gestures of everyday life in variation, sensual, floating in pastel colours.

Entries.Title: My 3 Little Deaths
Entries.Description: Three moments, three invisible wounds, stop time and fragment a life. In a world where dreams are confused with nightmares, an inner voice roams landscapes distorted by fear, pain, and loss. Each intimate death blurs reality and forever transforms the way we see the world. A sensorial journey to the heart of the irreparable, where human fragility is revealed in its rawest and most poetic form.

Entries.Title: The Thing Is Lost
Entries.Description: The Thing Is Lost is an abstract audiovisual experience inspired by the ever monotonous, oppressive and omnipresent existence of inner dialogue.  This film is an emotional journey through expressions, confusions, colors and affections. A journey in the hope of “finding” or “being found.”

Entries.Title: Pufferfish
Entries.Description: In an ocean full of big, bad fish, the pufferfish must act as tough as possible, but looks can be deceiving.

Entries.Title: Pebble to Pebble
Entries.Description: June 2013, it’s time for the eagerly-awaited event at the Youth Cultural Center in city Brique-sur-mer: the end-of-year drama class show. Through a chain of untimely events, the two stars of the play find themselves stuck outside the theatre hall.

Entries.Title: Uncomfortable Encounter
Entries.Description: Shelly the digital snail assists in a social interaction.

Entries.Title: Eusebeia
Entries.Description: In an endless desert, a weary group trudges forward, burdened by the weight of their packs. Among the travelers is Sov, frail and struggling against the relentless terrain. When exhaustion overtakes him, he collapses, slipping away from the group. As the others press on, Sov awakens alone in the vast emptiness, forced to confront the desert—and himself—in a journey of survival and revelation.

Entries.Title: Peleliu: Guernica of Paradise
Entries.Description: The Battle of Peleliu was fought on the lovely Pacific island of that name by Japanese and American forces toward the end of the Pacific War. A work of fiction based on historical fact, this movie views the battle through the eyes of Tamaru, a 22-year-old soldier and aspiring cartoonist seeing his first combat. A chronicle of the “truth” as seen by a young man struggling to come to terms with war in an era when war was the norm.

Entries.Title: Obscura Justiça
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Shadows of Ourselves
Entries.Description: The refugee, the fled, the persecuted. The hidden, the migrant, the foreigner. The newcomer, seen with distrust, looks of fear and suspicion. In this evocative sand animation by filmmaker Pedro Serrazina, shadows, contrasts and a disturbing sound construction relive ancestral prejudices of the other, so ancient and so present. Clandestine words, whispered phrases, memories written on winter nights by candlelights.

Entries.Title: ESCAPISM
Entries.Description: A beautiful place, the same old place. Shapes of blues and greens flow with grace, a feast of rêverie for the eye. Wind, water, sun, light, the world dances with the mind. Peace and melancholy sing as everything flows and goes.  Choking on comfort, locked in this world, one can simply waltz with their thoughts. In this ballad of wonders, there's only one way in and no way out. Fragmenting reality, the hues twirl along with the music. This could go on forever.  This is the mind's favorite game. No resisting. Now diving into escapism.

Entries.Title: Visions
Entries.Description: A young man who can see colourful creatures invisible to everyone else has his life turned upside down when he meets a girl who can also see them.

Entries.Title: Her of Orion
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Sky City
Entries.Description: A young man travels to Stockholm to sell ergonomic shoe insoles. Back in Thailand, his wife and child wait, as he hopes to one day bring them to Sweden. A heartfelt and captivating exploration of dreams and perseverance in a visually stunning depiction of Stockholm.

Entries.Title: internet friends who disappear
Entries.Description: a short animation about internet friends who disappear...

Entries.Title: O Medo Tá Foda
Entries.Description: In a sunny desert, Revo takes an action that could bring him problems that go beyond his personal uncertainties. Between pedaling and a mysterious fog, on this escape journey, the protagonist meets people with essential advice to overcome his fear.

Entries.Title: Acts of Slime and Stone
Entries.Description: Alone and desperate in a dark cave, O creates his ex-girlfriend in a blob of slime and must confront old patterns in their relationship and his own self-image.

Entries.Title: SamPie
Entries.Description: Amidst the challenges of poverty, Sam, a 12-year-old gay boy, learns to embrace true beauty—not in the clothes he wears, but in accepting himself. With Pie and Kuya Rael, comes the story of family love, societal obstacles, and the journey towards accepting the world of a child with the heart of a mermaid.

Entries.Title: VOIDBOUND
Entries.Description: An astronaut and her robot must escape from the bottom of a black hole.

Entries.Title: Loca!
Entries.Description: Two inquisitive kids, Tamo and Haru, might be the last people on Earth. They explore the silent, overgrown ruins of what was once rural Japan, documenting their discoveries in a notebook. When they come across a disused commuter train, and find out that it’s operational, who knows where it will take them?

Entries.Title: STARGAZER
Entries.Description: STARGAZER is my final film from my time at Vancouver Film School, I was mostly focused on effects animation for this project, enjoy :]

Entries.Title: Pietra
Entries.Description: Daydreaming of unlikely relationships, the flower, as delicate as it is revolutionary, represents an act of love in the midst of the suffocation and embrace of a classic Portuguese neighborhood.

Entries.Title: Meltdown
Entries.Description: With the help of his friend, an autistic circus performer must overcome a meltdown when an unfamiliar location leaves him overwhelmed.

Entries.Title: Lo NormⱯl
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Ensenada'55
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: RANDAGHI
Entries.Description: Nico decides to follow Livio after the two boys stumble upon each other. Even though the path seems clear, the awareness of their free spirits will make them grow, making them abandon the last link with the material world where they no longer belong.

Entries.Title: Arguments in favor of Love
Entries.Description: An animation featuring the voices of Inês Castel-Branco and Jack Haven which includes arguments between couples, taken from life, between ghosts.

Entries.Title: Weathered
Entries.Description: Strung along by the backdrop of a hard-to-grasp outside world, we follow a life-size puppet who yearns to connect to its own rhythm. The rhythms of the city itself become a key contribution to the emotional movement.

Entries.Title: Short cuts :  Ladj Ly's Les Misérables
Entries.Description: Ladj Ly's Les Misérables, broadcast on ARTE, is reviewed in a one-minute talk by director Valentine Zhang.

Entries.Title: Turtle Pleasure
Entries.Description: A turtle makes a couple of phone calls.

Entries.Title: Entrega Espacial
Entries.Description: In the midst of space chaos, a frantic pizza delivery woman encounters a chance for tranquility in a delivery.

Entries.Title: KAZE’S ORIGIN STORY! The first Ultra Legendary Brawler!
Entries.Description: The origin of Kaze, the first Ultra Legendary Brawler!

Entries.Title: The Anxious Person + Returning Something to the Shop
Entries.Description: Millie buys some new boots at lunchtime and wears them back to the office - but they are too tight - and now she's worn them! Why did she buy them? her best friend June asks helpfully..... She nervously imagines what the assistant will say when she takes them back and how she will have an answer for everything ...

Entries.Title: From Potato to Fry!
Entries.Description: A silent film that traces the journey of a Belgian potato towards its destiny as a fry... in the Brussels Frietmuseum.

Entries.Title: bubble skin
Entries.Description: A disorienting realm where reality itself flickers and fragments. Through a visceral exploration of digital distortion and failing verification processes, this challenges your perception and dares you to question what lies beneath the surface. Are we truly awake to the genocides and wars raging beyond our privileged bubbles, or are we content to remain ensnared by manipulated realities? This is a personal call to shatter the illusions, to seek deeper truths, and to recognize the profound fortune of our existence amidst global turmoil.

Entries.Title: Brain Space
Entries.Description: Propelled into her own mind, Rhi explores the thoughts, fears and impulses that shape our internal world. When her inner child is threatened by the shadows of her own trauma, her fear turns to anger and she must fight back to regain control. From desperation to acceptance, she learns to choose life.

Entries.Title: HAZA
Entries.Description: A Hungarian girl enjoys a last day with her family before leaving.

Entries.Title: The Crooked Heads
Entries.Description: A forgotten Polish neighborhood drowns in the haze of coal mine smoke. A young man shaves his head, dons a tracksuit, and faces his brother's shadow and the weight of his past.

Entries.Title: Son
Entries.Description: The example of a Mars rover overcoming difficulties on the red planet inspires a boy confined to a wheelchair.

Entries.Title: Moksha
Entries.Description: In a dark, apocalyptic world where every falling star brings Earth one step closer to total darkness, a lonely inventor desperately works on a machine that can send the stars back into space. When the last star crashes to Earth, the inventor manages to place it in his completed machine just in time. Everything seems to be turning out fine—until the machine suddenly explodes. The star goes out, and all hope seems lost...

Entries.Title: Life in the clouds
Entries.Description: "Life in the clouds" tells a part of the protagonist's life, Q, above the clouds with his pet. In an age of uncertainty and loneliness for Q, they suddenly meet Y, a foreigner of a similar race. Friendship and some feelings soon flourish.

Entries.Title: I AM GLITCHING
Entries.Description: A robot designed for flawless precision follows a life of strict routine and mathematical order. One day, a small disruption breaks his rhythm, sparking curiosity about imperfection. As he ventures off his programmed path, he begins to fall in love with errors for their unpredictability, each mistake drawing him deeper into a journey of self-discovery and revealing the beauty of flaws, and the raw essence of human nature.

Entries.Title: The Simpsons: Yellow Planet
Entries.Description: The Simpsons become the protagonists of a National Geographic-style mockumentary, showing daily life and human behavior from a wild and natural perspective.

Entries.Title: At Wilberts End
Entries.Description: At Wilberts End is an upcoming lego animated shortfilm created by NickCraftNL, it's a parody of "The Worlds End"  What's a better way to celebrate your birthday with your friends then doing The Golden Mile around your town?

Entries.Title: Fien & Teun gaan op schattenjacht
Entries.Description: Join Fien, Teun, Sem and all their animal friends on a real pirate adventure in their latest movie! With lots of fun - well-known and new - songs!  Nephew Sem is coming to stay with Fien and Teun on the farm and they are super excited! The three of them are going on an adventure and of course the animals are allowed to come along too. When they are just on their way, they already make a big discovery. They find an old boat with a chest full of pirate clothes and ... a treasure map! That can only mean one thing: It's time for a treasure hunt!

Entries.Title: S The Wolf
Entries.Description: A middle-aged man reflects back on his tumultuous adolescent phase while sitting in his childhood bedroom. Through intricate and deeply personal musings somehow all tied to his hair - hair growing or hair receding - we, over time accumulate meaning into the larger journey of his life.

Entries.Title: Faustbook (20th Anniversary Director's Cut)
Entries.Description: Inspired by Christopher Marlowe's The Tragical History of Doctor Faustus and Goethe's Faust, Faustus develops an obsession with his namesake, Johann Georg Faust. As Faustus delves deeper into man and legend, he enters a labyrinthine realm.

Entries.Title: TIHANY'S ECHO
Entries.Description: On the peninsula of Tihany, a shepherd princess tends to her flock of golden goats by using her beautiful voice, catching the attention of the King of Lake Balaton.

Entries.Title: The Lost Funhouse
Entries.Description: Wink must escape a wacky dream world

Entries.Title: City of Delivery
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Welcome to Noxus
Entries.Description: The 2025 Season Cinematic for League of Legends and equally the first chapter of Riot Games' next show following Arcane. Animated by Fortiche Productions.

Entries.Title: Cowgirlies 03: Let Love Win
Entries.Description: Love ain’t nothing but a gunfight.

Entries.Title: I Like You
Entries.Description: Ever get that weird feeling when you try confessing to a crush?

Entries.Title: Galaxy Apartment☆Cosmo Hills
Entries.Description: An asteroid at the farthest reaches of the galaxy. There, a retro Showa-era apartment building stands alone. Cass, the only tenant and in arrears with rent, is arguing with her robot landlord, Chami, who tells her she has to work again today. Then, a "package" arrives, containing a baby in a prison uniform. The apartment is surrounded by a group of thugs who come after the baby...

Entries.Title: Usa la imaginación
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Nothing Will Die
Entries.Description: Five baby birds are born into a threatening and overwhelming world. As their mother struggles to protect them from merciless predators, the baby birds fight their own battles for her attention. A story of survival, the cycle of life, and hope amidst the unforgiving realities of nature.

Entries.Title: Sisisisisisisisisisisisi
Entries.Description: The incessant repetition of courtesy gestures: thus echoing the oppressive hypocrisy of the suit-and-tie working world, the assembly line of communal capitalist living, an asphyxiating echo chamber.  A microcosm in 4 sets of 11 sheets of paper with hand-drawn animated cycles.

Entries.Title: Mother of Dawn
Entries.Description: In the void of night, a hungry creature looks for food and perpetuates an everyday cycle.

Entries.Title: Scarlett's Colorful Friends
Entries.Description: A mysterious government project known as Project: Mystic has been leaked by a whistleblower. It was an experiment about the effects of magic on the human body and was conducted on children. This of course begs the question: What happened to the children?

Entries.Title: Our Precious Autumn
Entries.Description: Our Precious Autumn follows Ami, a young manga artist struggling with burnout. After several sleepless nights, she collapses and awakens in a dreamscape, facing three encounters that help her rediscover her reason for drawing.

Entries.Title: MY LITTLE PONY THE MOVIE: OUTBREAK
Entries.Description: A strange infection is spreading across Equestria. Mysterious cloth-like ponies have appeared and any pony they touch becomes a mindless husk. As the disease threatens Ponyville Princess Celestia sends Twilight Sparkle and her friends on a desperate mission to meet up with an old friend of hers, Shadow Tempest, to have a cure made. At the same time, Apple Split begins to uncover a secret Soarin has been hiding from him. What Care Package had done to him during Operation Lost Cause.

Entries.Title: Bon Appetite
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: How I Made Ellie
Entries.Description: A short film on how Jamieson Senkyr (RetroMiller 1997) created Ellie Watson.

Entries.Title: MAcrodosis
Entries.Description: Tino, a carefree young man, takes a hallucinogenic mushroom he accidentally found in his mother’s urn. However, his night takes an unexpected turn when his mother manifests herself, bringing along friends from Tino’s childhood. What begins as an ordinary evening turns into a surreal journey, filled with encounters with the bizarre, conversations with the beyond, and attempts to tie up loose ends.

Entries.Title: In Loving Memory
Entries.Description: Esther Hoffman remembers her late husband and reminisces about the life they built together.

Entries.Title: Buttermilk
Entries.Description: A ”knight” seeks the help of an alchemist in order to become a witch.

Entries.Title: Pachamama
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Draft Paper
Entries.Description: An unfulfilled fashion designer faces the moral implications of creating his art when given an intriguing new opportunity during World War II.

Entries.Title: ash
Entries.Description: a teenage boy falls in love with an amazing but broken girl. he believes he can fix her, but her priorities leave him obsessed with unfulfilled dreams and desires.

Entries.Title: The Apple Never Falls
Entries.Description: In a remote village, a boy struggles under the suffocating grip of his dictatorial father. As he desperately seeks freedom, he soon realises that escape is not as simple as it seems.

Entries.Title: Supper
Entries.Description: A table is set with an array of symbolic objects - fish, apple, hourglass, diamond, and a heart -prepared as an intricate meal. A colossal entity sits to partake. Is this entity a deity, the universe, or the essence of nature itself? The eternity humanity so fervently desires and the meaning it tirelessly seeks are reduced to nothing more than a single meal for this vast, inscrutable being.

Entries.Title: A Man Who Takes Pictures of Flowers
Entries.Description: The life of Jung Myung Kim, who spent 40 years photographing wildflowers, unfolds in stop-motion animation. His 1.5 million still photographs are transformed into time-lapse video, seamlessly woven together with stop-motion characters.

Entries.Title: Water Girl
Entries.Description: Mia has spent her whole life freediving, fishing and gliding through seaweed and rocks. Time has passed, tracing its lines on her body, and shaping the landscapes around her. Loved ones have vanished. Tonight, Mia remembers.

Entries.Title: CHARGE
Entries.Description: An arrogant rider chases a star into a storm.

Entries.Title: Sora and the Big Tree
Entries.Description: Sora arrives at a mysterious hotel and spends a few days there, learning many things.  One night, guided by the light, she steps into a large tree, where a magical space awaits her, with sparkling gems all around.  Sora is absorbed in collecting the colorful, sparkling gems.  What do these sparkles show?

Entries.Title: Mambo No.2
Entries.Description: Betti’s date with Tom seems perfect—until her bowels stage a rebellion, turning the evening into a battle against her own body.

Entries.Title: Tule
Entries.Description: Tule is a poetic 2D animated mixed media short film championing awareness and hope. A young Pomo girl serves as the narrator of our project. Her poetic contemplations ring true with convictions shared by her Pomo community at Clear Lake, California. She revels in the local nature’s glory, but dread strikes when she faces today’s careless pollution damage that impedes cultural practices.

Entries.Title: Life with an Idiot

The documentary aims to challenge the traditional norms of gender and to give voice to those whose experiences are often marginalized. It marks a significant step in Greece’s cinematic exploration of LGBTQ+ themes and is a pivotal contribution to the global conversation on gender identity.

Entries.Description: Follows the journey of a pitiful yet charming robot through a monotonous cleaning shift, surrounded by looming abstract artworks. Over the course of the night, he discovers the ability of art to transport emotions to life, and in the process – his own creativity.

Entries.Title: LOTUSLAND

Entries.Title: ÉBĒM

Entries.Description: A cosmic journey unfolds as Nommo, alien amphibian beings, arrive on Earth through Mali's Dogon people. This unique African story blends animation, music, and verse to explore queer themes and otherworldly encounters.

Entries.Title: Autokar
Entries.Description: 8-year-old Agata's journey from Poland to Belgium in the 1990s transforms the reality of migration into an imaginative initiation experience through her perceptive lens.

Entries.Title: it will pass
Entries.Description: A small creature is pulled by its own lifeline through a world where it must adapt and learn to cope with life.

Entries.Title: Flight of Monochrome Feathers
Entries.Description: This animated documentary visualizes an interview with Keyvan Mahjoor, an Iranian visual artist living and working in Montreal, Canada.

Entries.Description: To retrieve his stolen egg waffle, Cowboy unknowingly boards a tram that transports him from 1980s Hong Kong to 2025.

Entries.Title: For She’s Lived It Ten Times Or More
Entries.Description: A girl, in her own mind is going through the possibilities of interactions that she might encounter at a party; playing back the tapes and thinking about how she is going to respond to them.

Entries.Title: Paper Swords
Entries.Description: After an intense pretend-play fight, a girl finds herself cautiously attempting to explain death to her younger sister in a way that is comforting yet grounded.

Entries.Title: Winter in March
Entries.Description: The animated short film is based on a true story of a young couple from Saint Petersburg and tells about helplessness in the face of a repressive state, departure from which becomes a surreal nightmare.

Entries.Title: MÉLASSE
Entries.Description: Inspired by the sinking of the Amoco Cadiz in 1978. Off the coast of Brittany, an oil spill from a supertanker devolves into an ecological disaster.

Entries.Title: TurmOil
Entries.Description: A climate activist reflects on her alienation from our modern society, her decision to take action against it, and the events that led to her arrest. An urgent story delivered through a striking blend of animation styles.

Entries.Title: i **** you
Entries.Description: until now, there's conflict on what 4-letter word to use.  i grieve.  i grieve unopened doors that were closed too soon.

Entries.Title: TV Insomnia
Entries.Description: A lysergic nightmare where forgotten characters star in stories that never existed.

Entries.Title: PAYDIRT
Entries.Description: A lich brings home groceries for her undead housemates.

Entries.Title: The Outsider
Entries.Description: A lonely prisoner longs to escape isolation and experience human connection. Based on the short story by H.P. Lovecraft.

Entries.Title: Essence of Yourself
Entries.Description: In a moment of turmoil, stress, and overwhelmment, Celly, the brain cell, escapes her body seeking excitement in the outside world, unaware that her body is in grave danger, if she doesn't take a break.

Entries.Title: En bons thermes
Entries.Description: In the Hungarian thermal baths, two Hungarian grandfathers are playing chess like a Western-style duel.

Entries.Title: OH NO
Entries.Description: Leyla is out shopping for a pizza dinner with her girlfriend Catie, but her ADHD makes this simple task a lot more difficult than expected.

Entries.Title: The Unnamable
Entries.Description: A cryptic young creature takes the train from Dublin to Sandycove, confronting ideas of a splintered self-image, loneliness, and being seen in a fundamentally blind world.

Entries.Title: In Your Eyes
Entries.Description: An explorer is meeting the life of a woman through her eyes.

Entries.Title: Arachnophobia
Entries.Description: A seemingly harmless prank turns into a delirious nightmare revolving around spiders.

Entries.Title: Tonada de l'hirondelle
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: We're Kinda Different
Entries.Description: "Blessed be the cracked, for they let in the light." -Someone Special

Entries.Title: My Hand Feels Numb.
Entries.Description: An animated short film that explores the feeling of having your hand go numb.

Entries.Title: Lights, Haze
Entries.Description: Utopian symbolic playgrounds from memories are interconnected through sharp, flickering lights.

Entries.Title: I Go and Feed Her
Entries.Description: Mixed media animated short

Entries.Title: MÉRISTÈME
Entries.Description: In an effervescing forest, a humanoid creature assimilates with its surroundings to the point of confusing itself with this perpetually transforming reality.

Entries.Title: Black Traces of Childhood
Entries.Description: This documentary film reveals how domestic violence occurs in real families. This film takes the audience into the stories hidden behind the doors of houses that appear peaceful from the outside, revealing the mental and physical suffering experienced by the victims. This film also tells the story of their struggle to find a way out of the cycle of violence, as well as the process of recovering from this trauma, by presenting narratives from victims, experts and psychologists.

Entries.Title: Старый дед и внучек
Entries.Description: A claymation cartoon based on the fairy tale of the same name by Leo Tolstoy. An old grandfather became very feeble, which began to irritate his son and his wife. However, the little grandson taught the adults a lesson that made them change their attitude towards old age.

Entries.Title: Stuck
Entries.Description: A boy learns a whole new meaning behind being "stuck" to his electronics. This is his journey to become unstuck while realizing what is most valuable in his life has been in front of his face the whole time.

Entries.Title: Wings of Victory
Entries.Description: As usual, the owl was getting ready for sleep. But a sudden message about the outbreak of war changed everything. Following the call of her heart, this winged volunteer sets off on an unusual journey to find something that could help bring Victory closer.

Entries.Title: What Gives Me Strength?
Entries.Description: Have you ever wondered what gives you strength? This animation is a beautiful story about a little Hedgehog who grows tired of the monotony and "greyness" of life.

Entries.Title: Lets print the animation!
Entries.Description: The film, printed at the International Centre of Graphic Arts, draws inspiration from the exhibition Victor Vasarely: In Echo. Just as Vasarely's art explores optical illusions, movement, and geometric patterns, the film weaves together visual elements that create hypnotic effects and dynamic compositions. The film was printed "frame by frame".

Entries.Title: The Drive Home
Entries.Description: Three tired friends, driving home from a music festival, find themselves stuck in traffic. Frustrated they decide to turn off on to the small, unfamiliar country roads. As the group inevitably find themselves increasingly lost tensions within the car rise.

Entries.Title: ルカと太陽の花 第2章
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Putra
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Aleshenka
Entries.Description: A series of unexpected events lead the alien Alyoshenka to Earth. His appearance on the planet spurs supernatural forces into action. And still the cold space and his lost native planet call to him.

Entries.Title: Wilbur & Harold
Entries.Description: Wilbur and Harold attempt to discover what the stars taste like...  My second-year film at CalArts!

Entries.Title: Agent Blue: Part 3
Entries.Description: The third installment for the agent blue franchise.

Entries.Title: The Dreammaker
Entries.Description: A girl with the unique gift of making dreams visits every sleeping person at night. She creates their dreams and nightmares with the power that flows from her hair. A journey through the creation of our most common and confusing dreams leads to the beginning of her story... a road trip gone terribly wrong.

Entries.Title: Agent Blue: Part 2
Entries.Description: The second installment of the agent blue franchise.

Entries.Title: Kid Vampire
Entries.Description: Count Papa sends Kid Vampire off to human school. In search of blood, he discovers something even sweeter along the way - friendship.

Entries.Title: I Just Wanted To Say...
Entries.Description: Short animated film adapting the picture book by Yumi Shimokawara.

Entries.Title: Holy G Thy Angel
Entries.Description: Holy G, the planet’s guardian angel, struggles to recover the Mo-Nad’s degenerating baby-form. Film 2 in the DIAPHANUS Tetralogy.

Entries.Title: Te encontré
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: My Boyfriend is a Teddy Bear!
Entries.Description: On the way home, the teddy bear I picked up drunk from the pain of a broken heart became a person.  The man who introduced himself as a wish-granting teddy bear proposes to live with her, and she forgets the pain of her heartbreak by being with him.

Entries.Title: Trans
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Can You Hear Me?
Entries.Description: Nastia, who has lived abroad for years, starts to teach her mum how to use internet services. Different perceptions of technology become the starting point for exposing intergenerational conflicts and long-forgotten family threads. Can an intimacy regained via Zoom be a turning point for the future relationship between two adults?

Entries.Title: Kicia Kocia ma braciszka
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Narcissists Can't Be Choosers
Entries.Description: A minimum wage cashier finds herself in an uncomfortable situation after getting in an argument with a famous influencer.

Entries.Title: Cage
Entries.Description: A surreal reflection on authoritarianism, ritual, and the immigrant experience---told through a visual language of repetition, dread, and illusion.

Entries.Title: Tram
Entries.Description: This experimental film delves into the century-old history of Hong Kong’s iconic tram system. Through a nonlinear collage of industrial materials — wood, concrete and steel — the film reconstructs the tram as a contested vessel of cultural identity, embodying the tensions and transformations of urban modernity.

Entries.Title: Balconada
Entries.Description: Several neighbours become reconnected to both each other and the present moment.

Entries.Title: The Replicant
Entries.Description: The Replicant is a ballet of metallic humanoids, their shadows brushing and merging. Endlessly repeating.  Bodies multiply in sensual loops. Sweat becomes mercury. The heat rises as the silhouettes make contact.

Entries.Title: See it. Say it. Censored.
Entries.Description: This short PSA, produced with the help of Irish Hip Hop band Kneecap, compiles information from numerous sources to showcase the scale of atrocities carried out by the Israeli government and military against the people of Gaza.

Entries.Title: Short cuts : Roger Vadim's "... And God Created Woman"
Entries.Description: Roger Vadim's "... And God created Woman" with Brigitte Bardot, summarised in one minute by Marie Le Puil.

Entries.Title: Bloom
Entries.Description: The story starts with the flower on the head of the main character, and tells the story of Xiaochun, a monkey, who is the first to stand out in a world of rules and regulations that domesticate and suppress people's nature, and is the first to blossom his own “flower of nature”, thus making everyone's “flower of nature” blossom. The story of the “Flower of Nature”.The music design of the film is based on the traditional Chinese opera “Qinqiang”, an ancient and passionate form of music that complements the traditional Chinese art style of the film.

Entries.Title: 大猿魂 第1季先导片
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Moments
Entries.Description: A grandmother, who once dreamed of becoming a dancer, spent her youth clipping tickets, bound by duty. Marriage promised freedom, yet life wove tighter threads. Facing her own frailty, she casts off the past, rowing toward the unknown — refusing to let her daughter inherit her cage, vowing to dance forever.

Entries.Title: Egg Mama In "Carbon Cowboy"
Entries.Description: A dark, dank journey into the fetid alleyway of the fetish phantasm chicken soup soul. Starring everyone's favorite anthropomorphic egg Creep/Satanic doll maker, Egg Mama! Wherein Egg Mama encounters sordid sadists, disassociated divas, balding krautrock enthusiasts in bondage, yolky thugs and more! An accidental trip to an abandoned factory begets the ineffable cosmic cycle of life and death that our huevo heroine must tackle headfirst. Fun for the (w)hole family!

Entries.Title: Idyll
Entries.Description: In life, there are good things and important things. And then there are vital things. If you want to survive, you must not let comfort dull your instincts: you must fight for life long before war reaches your doorstep. And if war is already at your door, drawing the curtains won’t help, and it might just happen that the most sensible advice comes from where you least expect it – for example, from a life-experienced parrot.

Entries.Title: Formula vody
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Show
Entries.Description: The oldest group of kindergarten no. 14 in Wrocław is preparing to perform a Nativity play. The film allows the viewer to observe all the ups and downs of this process, but also to learn the answers to the basic questions that trouble 6-year-olds.

Entries.Title: Cortes tontos: un restaurante elegante, un abogado y una silla para bebés
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Out There
Entries.Description: The story of a neurodivergent boy Petya. He is different from others. He seems to live on the other side of the glass pane separating his world from ours. It is difficult for usual people to understand Petya and it is difficult for Petya to adjust to the world which is too complex for him. But if we become kinder and stretch out a helping and supporting arm, then in this huge and diverse world there will be a place for everybody, even the most special person.

Entries.Title: A Meal for Two
Entries.Description: Two dogs have a delicious meal in a restaurant.

Entries.Title: Trials for Miles
Entries.Description: Dorkha and Horatio are embarking on a quest but Tobias the goblin stopped them in their tracks. They must complete his "Goblin Trials" to resume their adventure.

Entries.Title: Fried!
Entries.Description: Following an accident on his drive home from an ageing nuclear facility, Dev becomes stranded at an isolated emu farm governed by two older mystic lesbians. Growing suspicious of their intentions, Dev begins to fear what role he has to play in their arcane plans...

Entries.Title: VESTIGE
Entries.Description: On his relentless journey towards progress and evolution, a symbolic creature gradually disrupts its once harmonious bond with nature.

Entries.Title: Witness: An Organima Film
Entries.Description: Creatures on a stone perform an ancient ritual. Beings in wood explore a withering world. A water droplet plays in its pond. An archive of the elements, 'Witness' renews our child-like ability to see hidden life in small universes.

Entries.Title: Sous l'écorce
Entries.Description: Gaëlle's world is falling apart. The group of boys she's been playing football with for years has begun to take an interest in girls.

Entries.Title: Ineffable
Entries.Description: Before time, before the world, there were only two—one made of fire, the other of ice. Lost in the void, they were never meant to meet, until the wind, in its fury, brought them together for an instant. In the clash of light and shadow, an impossible love was born—one as burning as it was destructive. But the universe does not forgive those who defy its order, condemning them to spin forever, always close, never together. Yet, in rare moments, when fate falls asleep, Sun and Moon touch—and the sky, in reverence, darkens to watch.

Entries.Title: Meditate like a Dolphin
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Cycle or Bicycle
Entries.Description: 62-year-old Albert loves cycling, while 65-year-old Paulette is more partial to less strenuous biking. Albert always wants to go faster; Paulette likes to take things slow.

Entries.Title: The Eating of an Orange
Entries.Description: The journey of figuring out your sexuality and of rejecting the power the conventions of heteronormativity can have. It is a celebratory NO to being told that as queer people we are in anyway unnatural and is a juicy rejection of the rigidity of binary modes.

Entries.Title: Shemergency
Entries.Description: Sher is a transgender superheroine, guardian of the trans* and queer community. Not all of Sher's missions consist in defeating supervillains; some are more mundane, at times ridiculous, but still with the support and help of her sisters in the times of need in mind.

Entries.Title: Akopa (Más Arriba)
Entries.Description: Victim of a future war, a girl must climb a tower to call for help.

Entries.Title: Off-Time
Entries.Description: For a harried tech worker, achieving any semblance of a work-life balance seems exhaustingly elusive—until time itself becomes unbalanced.

Entries.Title: Super Mr. Woods
Entries.Description: Super Mr. Woods is a surreal animated short that blurs the line between reverence and ridiculousness, offering a glimpse into an absurd world spiralling into consumer chaos. A mystic forest creature becomes a brand, a god, a myth, who serves as a mirror for our own consumer-driven culture.

Entries.Title: The Threshold
Entries.Description: In a world populated entirely by puppets who are unaware of their condition, a young couple finds themselves aimlessly wandering through an amusement park, yearning for excitement. He is a workaholic, consumed by his job, while she is on the brink of motherhood. Little do they know that their lives are about to be forever transformed.  In a secluded corner of the park, they encounter a group of actors led by a peculiar plague doctor. Together, they embark on a mesmerizing musical journey through time and space. Along the way, their perception of reality is shattered, leaving them to question the very essence of their existence. This extraordinary odyssey not only changes the course of their lives but also sets a new destiny for their future child.

Entries.Title: Pippo, the Flea
Entries.Description: Pippo, the Flea, finds a camel; however, the resident spider is not happy about it.

Entries.Title: This Land is a Woman
Entries.Description: Inspired by the poem Hamza by the great Palestinian poet Fadwa Tuqan, compares and connects the mystery of the fertility of the Palestinian land to the mysterious power of it's women.

Entries.Title: Is This the Mansion I Will Live in?
Entries.Description: Belgium is often seen as a safe haven for LGBTQ+ individuals, but many asylum seekers face discrimination and oppression upon arrival. An animated short highlights the challenges they encounter, including mistreatment and homelessness, during the lengthy asylum process.

Entries.Title: TOBY
Entries.Description: Toby and his human are enjoying a peaceful afternoon, but a fleeting flash of light outside the window breaks the harmony. Something has changed.

Entries.Title: Jackdaw
Entries.Description: In a world where mankind almost completely destroyed the environment, a child discovers the value of nature thanks to an unexpected friendship with a jackdaw.

Entries.Title: Seeds
Entries.Description: A little kiwi wishes to fly and takes to getting magical seeds that will grant his wish.

Entries.Title: Ryaba the Hen
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Wacky Horses!
Entries.Description: The story of a young adult who embarks on a journey into her mind, which takes the form of an amusement park filled with rides representing her psyche and creatures reminiscent of her thoughts and feelings. During her journey, she learns to accept herself, flaws and all, by meeting and interacting with her inner child.

Entries.Title: Feast
Entries.Description: One night, Lea and her geese are awakened by the howling of approaching wolves. Using a forest horn, she warns the village of the danger. The villagers attempt to defend themselves, but fear overwhelms them. Lea quickly hides the goslings in a small shelter and faces the wolves empty-handed. She starts throwing snowballs at them. The smaller wolves are deterred, but the largest one only smirks and continues toward her. Paralyzed, she drops a snowball to the ground. It begins rolling, grows in size, and sweeps the wolves away. Lea embraces her saved geese.

Entries.Title: VSEMIR - The Border at the Miren Cemetery
Entries.Description: In 1947, the cemetery of Miren was split by a new border between Italy and Yugoslavia, dividing the living and the dead. As life adjusted, people found ways to overcome the divide, showing that while borders are drawn on maps, human connection continues beyond them.

Entries.Title: Single Use
Entries.Description: Set in a far polluted future, a scavenger resourcefully creates to survive in this stop motion film.

Entries.Title: Blue Rider
Entries.Description: Inspector Bochard is part of the Blue Rider, an organization tasked with ridding the world of the flesh-eating monsters that lurk within it. But an unexpected encounter with a creature of extraordinary beauty will not leave him unmoved.

Entries.Title: Bright
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Caldeiro
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Sister of Mine
Entries.Description: A strange figure wanders inside a building: he presses elevator buttons, but each floor always promises the same landscapes of hallways, dark rooms, and a portrait of a woman with a cathedral background. The images intertwine until space becomes a mere illusion.

Entries.Title: Freelm
Entries.Description: The film was created in relation to a musical improvisation project in which Antonello Salis, Sandro Satta, Mark Dresser, and Massimo Carrano participated. The work is based on abstract animations made with various techniques directly on 35mm cinema film that are interspersed with live action sections that creatively document the stages of the jam session.

Entries.Title: Dungeons & Television
Entries.Description: Welcome to a world of fantasy, a realm of magic, monsters, and medieval lutes ’n’ flutes—and live television broadcasts. An expedition into the kingdom’s legendary dungeon unleashes a fire-breathing dragon, and a news crew is there to capture the moment!

Entries.Title: The Storm Manufacturing Co.
Entries.Description: Storms manufactured with linocut and monotype.

Entries.Title: The Piano
Entries.Description: One night, a young girl discovers her father bent over the keys at the piano, sparking a lifelong bond that resonates far beyond their final note.

Entries.Title: NEKOMANCIEN
Entries.Description: After the death of his owner, a powerful, benevolent witch beloved by the people, a magician cat wanders the land, hunting artifacts and creatures for a living: the Nekomancer.  While selling his finds, he learns of the existence of a fabulous treasure, an amulet of immortality. He sets off in search of this object, unwavering in the face of obstacles, distance and the terrifying enemy in possession of the amulet he covets. Faced with a lord driven mad and overpowered by the amulet's power, the Nekomancer's battle seems hopeless...

Entries.Title: Horde
Entries.Description: A crowd of people feel a sudden need to come to a mysterious tower standing in the middle of nowhere. Inside, they are unable to stop moving and dancing, and without even realizing it, they perform a ritual arranged by the creature spinning at the top of the tower.

Entries.Title: It's Been a While
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Time Of A Breath
Entries.Description: An inanimate body is touched by light, triggering an awakening, a sudden surge of life, fueled by a fantastical photosynthesis, lasting only for the span of a breath.

Entries.Title: The Murmur of Nu Shu
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Dilution
Entries.Description: Dilution is an experimental short film that explores the transit between resistance and (di)ssolution, between holding and releasing and a path towards obsessive repetition. They are layers, exposed pores, matter that oscillates between remaining or disappearing. The sound is not a background, but a puncture: friction, tearing, water that drags what still persists. A sensorial testimony of what refuses to vanish completely.

Entries.Title: Dawn
Entries.Description: Who we are, who we were, and who we will be are all part of our construction. A decision, a search for experiences, a new place without forgetting our origin. The encounter with the past will awaken sorrows and joys, memories of friendships that leave an everlasting mark. Through music, everything blossoms on the stage of a life creating.

Entries.Title: Mousse Crust
Entries.Description: Weird movie. Hard to describe. Flashes of random TV stuff, sewn together by sound, and re-drawn stupidly.

Entries.Title: The Boy Who Cheated Death
Entries.Description: In a world blurring reality and imagination, Syd, a little 8-year-old boy tries to hide his mother from Death. They embark on a hide-and-seek game as creatures of earth, Death being their predator. Finally, Death becomes the ultimate predator: Time.

Entries.Title: The Big Athlete
Entries.Description: Fascinated by the athletes he watches on TV, Pepe, a little and enthusiastic hamster, trains to be a runner. A little accident sends him flying out of his cage and, through a window, he sees that outside his home a marathon is about to start. Now Pepe has a new goal: get out of his home and participate in a marathon, fulfilling his dream.

Entries.Title: Ira
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Айтал уонна Аптаах Куус 2
Entries.Description: Aytal, a teenager with unusual abilities, becomes a real hero of the city. Gradually, he begins to become arrogant, use superpowers to achieve personal goals and eventually loses control over them. Having become arrogant, Aytal forgot about the importance of friendship and the support of his loyal comrades.

Entries.Title: THE PRINCESS AND THE BUGS
Entries.Description: A beautiful princess lives in a magnificent lotus palace. Keen to test the devotion of her numerous insect suitors, she declares that she will only marry the one who brings her a spark of fire.

Entries.Title: Radix
Entries.Description: Two creatures meet on a tree. Their encounter goes deep down to the roots and beyond.

Entries.Title: Shalabham
Entries.Description: A struggling artist going through a creative block rendering his mind void of inspiration.

Entries.Title: Paradaïz
Entries.Description: Welcome to a place where the houses have holes, tomatoes are ticking time bombs and snails wander the streets in search of a safe space. In Paradaïz, Sarajevo-born artist Matea Radic uses absurdist animation, archival images and her own slippery childhood memories to explore the real meaning of home.

Entries.Title: Hatker
Entries.Description: In a run down office, a group of people are stuck to the ceiling by their hats. Shaking, alienated, they do not seem to notice their situation. Every time an old telephone rings the office workers start disappearing one by one. Until Hatker tries to free himself, turning his world upside down.

Entries.Title: Fascinació Mútua
Entries.Description: Chance leads Eiko to live in Barcelona. There she meets a series of characters who, like her, also live between two worlds.

Entries.Title: Socio-Zombie
Entries.Description: What starts as a quiet night quickly turns chaotic at a neighbor's party. Cloe, an immortal zombie girl, is reluctantly forced to wake up when the noise from next door gets out of hand. Politely, she asks her neighbors to keep it down—but when they ignore her, she reaches her limit.  Determined to settle the matter, she grabs an axe from her shed and embarks on a vengeful hunt. After all, she did try to be reasonable.

Entries.Title: Feasting Junta
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The God Man
Entries.Description: The God Man is a 9.5 min short animated film that follows an interview of Jonah Weisman, the man who discovered the entity “The God Man” drifting through space.

Entries.Title: Eddie and I
Entries.Description: How do you face the unknown? 8-year-old deaf Ron fears his first camping trip. His mother comforts him with a story about 'Eddie the Camper,' a friendly forest monster. Despite her efforts, Ron’s fear lingers. After falling asleep, he awakens in a surreal forest and meets you, as Eddie. Together, you embark on an adventure, but there’s a barrier: Ron can’t hear, and you don’t know sign language. In this 25-minute VR journey, you’ll join Ron, learn to communicate, and navigate the forest together.

Entries.Title: Butter Bean - "Belly Ache"
Entries.Description: A lactose intolerant individual regrets their recent dietary choices.

Entries.Title: Manta Dreams
Entries.Description: A woman had a childhood dream to explore the world. Now she has grown up to be an overworked waitress living in a small apartment.

Entries.Title: How
Entries.Description: Through an opening between reality and subtle forms of poetry, surreal scenes and disturbing paradoxes reveal infinite loops of existence. An attempt to capture the schizophrenic beauty of human existence, in which rationality is merely a subjective anomaly at the edges of consciousness. A film that rather than giving answers is inspired by questions.

Entries.Title: Tears of the Sea
Entries.Description: A seagull contemplates the destruction of its ecosystem due to marine pollution.

Entries.Title: Fogo Corredor
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Beyond the Door
Entries.Description: An old woman reluctantly leaves her house and steps out into a white space with a bell. She drags her house with her and rings the bell, causing a door and its Gatekeeper to appear. She struggles to pull her house through the narrow door, and fights off the Gatekeeper who tries to stop her from doing so. Eventually, she fails and must let go of her house to walk through the door. However, she realises that she can immortalise her house through the memories she has of them and she willingly moves on, letting go of her worldly attachments.

Entries.Title: Force Times Displacement
Entries.Description: In a factory driven by endless ambition, a mysterious wooden idol grants every wish for success. A young worker devotes himself to it - until a hidden room reveals a different world and sparks a desire for change.

Entries.Title: ScumWillie's Trail
Entries.Description: When a young man named ScumWillie learns a shocking truth about his home, he is forced to choose if he should leave all he's ever known, or brave the world outside

Entries.Title: Windy day
Entries.Description: In a park, a family is enjoying a picnic, a businessman is working next to a grandpa playing with his dog, while two lovers are passionately kissing. The wind blows hard and disrupts their daily routine. It blows harder and harder, so hard that they all get swept away together. In the air, they meet and see their lives evolve toward new horizons.

Entries.Title: A Dance for Pandore
Entries.Description: The nocturnal walk of a man obsessed with his imagination.

Entries.Title: The Vickerilla Family Reunion
Entries.Description: A mellow and charming reflection on 10 years of family reunions is told through watercolor illustration and evocative sound clips.

Entries.Title: The Zone
Entries.Description: In times of conflict, a companion can be the final thread linking one to human connection. In Call of Duty: Warzone, communication is fractured, making it even harder to truly know those you play with. Dialogue is just a series of terse exchanges of orders and instructions; everything revolves around the game, everything is subsumed by war. Forming a meaningful connection with an anonymous player seems nearly impossible. In The Zone, the protagonists confront this challenge, pushing beyond the fleeting interactions dictated by random matchmaking. They seek to reclaim their humanity, engaging with pressing themes — religion, terrorism, and representation — subtly embedded in the game’s mechanics and geography.

Entries.Title: Silent Engine
Entries.Description: Who really benefits from technological progress? In Silent Engine, Korean interdisciplinary artist Kahee Jeong uses image and sound to examine the growing digital divide and the exclusivity of our technological future, revealing its impact on society.

Entries.Title: The Wings
Entries.Description: In the isolated, absurd stage of the Penalty Box, two aging hockey players discuss their sport, along with the world itself –– both of which seem to be leaving them behind.

Entries.Title: The Bitter and The Sweet
Entries.Description: Soushki and Kasha are two friends who work in the beet fields of their village. Soushki will find himself torn between his comfortable life with his friends and the powerful call of the forest.

Entries.Title: The Story of Three Sisters or How the World Came to Have Four Seasons Instead of One
Entries.Description: Suffocating in her older sister's flawless system, Mae, a young goddess, questions her tedious work of maintaining an eternal spring.

Entries.Title: Bliss
Entries.Description: Surrounded by the roots of a withering tree, the soul of an old woman departs from her former body. Unsure of where to go next, she finds guidance in a mythological snake who patiently leads her towards the afterlife.

Entries.Title: Hide the Body
Entries.Description: The purple one has to hide the body

Entries.Title: Cosmic Egg
Entries.Description: The Snake lays the Cosmic Egg, which births the Cosmos. The Cosmos can only exist until it is time for it to die, and for the next one to be born.

Entries.Title: Within
Entries.Description: A movie about personal experience with body dysmorphia. This seemingly invisible disorder can wreck one's world, but isn't impossible to defeat and sometimes it helps to find a new point of view. Our cells dance the perfect dance of life and together they create the whole, each one of us.

Entries.Title: The Graveyard Shift
Entries.Description: After a demon arrives at her workplace, a tired retail worker expects to find help within the Department of Paranormal Activity, only to be thrown into a bureaucratic maze instead.

Entries.Title: SYKOSE
Entries.Description: The line between imagination and reality rips as an anxious emo girl picks up a needle and thread.

Entries.Title: Seu Vô e a Baleia
Entries.Description: After the loss of his beloved grandfather, young Mundinho finds the whale the old fisherman always spoke of. As it rests beside him on the beach, day after day, Mundinho comes to terms with his grandfather's death with the help of a close friend.

Entries.Title: O Bicho Que Eu Tinha Medo
Entries.Description: In a place where masks hide smiles and fears, Luana discovers that true magic is being who we really are.

Entries.Title: Get Money
Entries.Description: A worker rat wins a jackpot from online gambling and uses the money to travel to a luxury resort. Thinking that he is lucky, he continues to gamble online and loses all of his money.

Entries.Title: Immature
Entries.Description: Immature is an animated documentary that explores the fluidity and complexity of gender identity through bodily imagery. Shaped by memory and imagination, it presents an intimate dialogue within the body. Fluid, fragmented, and ever-reforming, the film traces an ongoing journey of exploring gender, sexuality, and selfhood.

Entries.Title: 【3D DEBUT】GIIII~MURIN! × 3D Gigi Murin desu #GIGI3D
Entries.Description: The debut 3D stream from Hololive English talent Gigi Murin, featuring comedy, music, and plenty more! Originally streamed on Youtube on August 2nd, 2025

Entries.Title: PUSHING 20
Entries.Description: Follow Andre as he experiences an existential crisis right before his 20th birthday...

Entries.Title: Plinko and Mark
Entries.Description: Plinko & Mark revolves around the antics of Plinko and Mark, long-time friends and current roommates that live in an early-nineties New-York-esque city. The duo’s drastically different outlooks and approaches to life lead to plenty of entertaining scenarios.

Entries.Title: Once in a Body
Entries.Description: While dealing with a strange being that lives inside her, a woman seeks to reconcile with her sister over an incident from their adolescence.

Entries.Title: Normal Litio
Entries.Description: In a room (a mental prison): the only way out is to enter oneself.  Normal Lithium is inspired by bipolar disorder, the loss of self and hope, and the inner search for salvation.  Symbols accumulate in a journey to find balance, even as those same symbols wildly invade the image.

Entries.Title: Neither one or two
Entries.Description: Elena rediscovers after a long time the notebook of her maternal grandmother, Laura. She flips through it for the first time and through those pages revises her life. Convinced of a confession that Laura had made to her, namely that if one has a great desire then it should be whispered and entrusted to the paper of a notebook for it to come true, as a child she had immediately started writing. Today, at the age of 25, Elena no longer remembers her past wish, but she has a new one: to remember Laura.

Entries.Title: Carne
Entries.Description: 31 animated sequences that reveal isolated, tangential actions around the sacrifice of an animal during a rural celebration in Colombia.  These sequences construct a narrative that aims to create a void, a system in which the different scenes function as echoes around an uncertain and disturbing event, linked to the latent image of a destroyed body.

Entries.Title: Fantasy at 2000
Entries.Description: Some dolls take to dancing. But they have obvious flaws, harmless if they did not affect their characters more than symbolically. In fact to dance are princesses, prototypes of beauty.

Entries.Title: On the Way
Entries.Description: What does it mean to leave one's home and head for unknown destinations? What does it feel like to be swept away by an uncontrollable current? Every year, millions of people in Africa leave their homes in search of a better future. Often they settle in neighboring countries; all too often they reach Libyan shores and attempt the sea crossing. But at that point there is no return; there is only moving on.

Entries.Title: There Was The Moon!
Entries.Description: The video, presented as a degree thesis project, was born from the need to enhance the Pirandello Mines, a place rich in history, in Aragona, Agrigento, linked to sulfur and the figure of Luigi Pirandello, of which the family was the owner. The video is therefore born from the poetics of Pirandello’s works, combined with the suggestions of the place. There is no linear narrative but it presents itself as a dreamlike journey, also conducted following the music of Lero Lero, a band from Palermo that takes up the popular songs of Sicily.

Entries.Title: 18 Months
Entries.Description: The powerful true story of Pete and Dan — a gay couple who found an abandoned baby in a New York subway and spent the next 18 months fighting to legally adopt him.

Entries.Title: Chewing Gum
Entries.Description: While chewing gum at his boring work, a mature man thinks about the mistakes of his life, his childhood traumas, his addictions. How did he end up working in a parking lot?

Entries.Title: Calling
Entries.Description: In modern times, we are all desperate to grasp communication methods in a world where understanding each other seems out of reach. In the end, we might vanish silently with no one knowing, but we find comfort in who we are.

Entries.Title: Lullaby
Entries.Description: A horror thesis animation film that depicts a world of nightmares, where the characters do not move—only the backgrounds move.

Entries.Title: Avant de rentrer...
Entries.Description: Lost along the road, someone enters the forest...

Entries.Title: Reality of Obsessive
Entries.Description: Colt is obsessed with the rock band Speedy's Overdrive, to the point of hallucinating conversations with its frontman, Speedy. When he unexpectedly wins a contest to meet his idol, his excitement turns into inner conflict, forcing him to choose between his dream and his friends. As the long-awaited day arrives, Colt finally comes face to face with Speedy, but the encounter doesn’t go as he imagined, leading him to question everything he once believed.

Entries.Title: Paws and Tail
Entries.Description: A spider lady takes her pug child for a walk.

Entries.Title: Tiny's Tale
Entries.Description: Tiny sets off on a journey to save his beloved!

Entries.Title: Paws & Pestilence
Entries.Description: Three strange cats, having a good old medieval time! A tapestry full of silly and absurd moments, inspired by the fascinating world of animals in medieval art. A tribute to the colorful way characters are depicted in old manuscripts, in all their perfect imperfection.

Entries.Title: In the Blink of an Eye
Entries.Description: There are moments when time feels as though it’s standing still, as if we’re trapped in a place where nothing moves forward. For a young girl longing to escape such a moment, she one day discovers a power: the ability to pass through time by blinking her eyes.  As time slips away in the blink of an eye, what might we be missing in those fleeting ‘in-betweens’?”

Entries.Title: Soup!
Entries.Description: God makes soup. The soup is (somewhat) intelligent life. Existential chaos ensues.

Entries.Title: Mamiko's Poop

Entries.Title: Sosuke the Duck
Entries.Description: A girl learns about caring for a duck with special needs during her first year on the farm. An animated documentary rendered in plant based inks about a little runner duck who couldn't.  Director’s Statement: Sosuke was one of the first ducks on our farm. Created over the course of seven years, this animated short tells his story. The animation was created using digital rotoscoping (where the animator traces each frame of live action footage to create hand drawn scenes) and then printed onto over 2,400 pieces of printer paper and coloured in inks made by hand from flowers, nuts, vegetables and berries cultivated and foraged on our farm. This is a story about becoming more connected to ecology, about learning to farm, and what animals can teach us. It is told with colours from the landscape, including acorn, black walnut, goldenrod, sunflower, haskap berry, purple cabbage, sumac and more.

These pregnancy tests changed the world: they expanded our understanding of hormones, gave women more reproductive choice, and caused ecological crisis- decimating certain amphibian populations.

Entries.Title: And I Would Be Beautiful

But in a vivid dream, a final conversation with her friend shifts something in her. Waking up, she begins the painful journey of letting go, learning to honor her friend’s choice and confront her own sorrow.

Entries.Title: Wandering Dot and the Blank Square Page Universe
Entries.Description: An immersive visual poem about a journey within a blank page. Is a blank page ever really empty? Where does an artwork begin or end? Are you the one directing creative flow or is it leading you? One may feel a creative impulse, but confronting daunting emptiness as a point of departure is inevitable. The only thing left to do is to make the first step, first dot, line or movement and suddenly the page transforms into something completely else and the multitudes it contains take up life on its own.

Entries.Title: Copycat's story (and some more)
Entries.Description: A series of interactions between animated animal characters. Digital animation.

Entries.Title: Stormfellers
Entries.Description: On an island plagued by monstrous storms, the Stormfellers guild is the last line of defense... but one field medic is starting to feel overworked and under-appreciated.

Entries.Title: THE PROMOTION
Entries.Description: A hapless salaryman navigates the corporate hierarchy of his surreal office space in pursuit of a raise and a promotion. THE Promotion.

Entries.Title: Abyssness
Entries.Description: If you do business with the abyss that opens up in front of you, you do “abyssness”. But how long can this go on and at what price?  Like every morning, a farmer enters his farm, but now a black hole opens up in the middle of it. Not only does his pistol shot echo in it, but all his garbage can also be disposed of in this way. He quickly makes money by accepting the garbage from the entire surrounding area.

Entries.Title: Henchmen Chronicles

Entries.Title: Petra and the Sun

Entries.Title: Orcagasm
Entries.Description: “Orcagasm” is a fantastical, stop-motion animation that follows two furries as they explore. They are cutting-edge, futuristic orca whale fur suits. Meanwhile, a hapless eraser is tasked with the cleanup of their antics.

Entries.Title: I Remember
Entries.Description: A high school student faces uncertainty when presented with the thought of growing up. As he delves into his memories, he uncovers the blissful childhood that once was.

Entries.Title: Noli me tangere
Entries.Description: An excavational inquiry through photographs, touch, and looking at times and places far from here and now, animating and conjuring a link between past and present.

Entries.Title: Blue Flavored
Entries.Description: An existential goat lady goes to the convenience store to buy a slushee for her roommate.

Entries.Title: Hex the Cat
Entries.Description: Inside the town of Shadow Crest, is a wide cast of characters that live in the balance of good and evil, but little do they know, their world isn’t as balanced as they think...

Entries.Title: Boundaries
Entries.Description: A bus passenger reclines their seat too far back. As a result the  journey of the passenger behind takes an unexpected path. Passing  through ever larger places, with ever larger groups of people joining  her journey, she ends up exploring the very nature of interpersonal  and societal space.

Entries.Title: Les Sommets du cinéma d'animation
Entries.Description: A Pierrot, a Queen of Les Sommets, a Trilobite and a Moth attempt to reach the highest summits: how will the moon react?

Entries.Title: Flares
Entries.Description: After a near-death experience, a person floats in a mysterious space, gradually being reborn by reconnecting with the sensations of their body.

Entries.Title: LE MONDE EST TON HUÎTRE
Entries.Description: It's been several weeks since Hani lost the use of her legs. Faced with immobility, the mourning of her dreams as a sportswoman and a suffocating family atmosphere, Hani finds herself plunged into a new environment. A seaside center for her first months of rehabilitation.  In her dreams, Hani tirelessly pursues a mysterious light.

Entries.Title: Food and Music
Entries.Description: floating images, abstractions, memories. silhouettes of a life lived in Jawaharlal Nehru University

Entries.Title: Cold Home
Entries.Description: A mother and daughter are locked in a cold house. The women have a difficult relationship, silence and emotions hidden by them make it impossible to communicate.

Entries.Title: From Oran to Almeria
Entries.Description: Aghilas, a young Algerian, is consumed by a life that offers him nothing in his native country. The prospect of an elsewhere will push him and a group of harraga to accomplish a dangerous crossing.

Entries.Description: A spiraling comedy of errors about a town of ducks whose mayor fears they’re just too boring, so he hires a monster to liven things up. Hijinks inevitably ensue.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Survivor
Entries.Description: In Survivor we follow 12-year-old Ivor Perl from a small town in Hungary to the gates of Auschwitz, Kaufering, Allach, and Dachau, witnessing the unspeakable horrors of the Holocaust. From being herded onto a cattle truck and narrowly avoiding the gas chambers and ovens, to enduring hunger, typhus, and unimaginable loss, we ultimately see the unbreakable bond between two brothers and their miraculous survival.

Entries.Title: Urban Duo
Entries.Description: In the bustling noise of Shanghai, Longchang Apartment, a century-old building, seems like a haven from time. A father experiences a peaceful life here, where neighbors live in harmony. His son, on the other hand, is caught up in the fast pace of the city day after day. Their lives are parallel yet starkly different...

Entries.Title: Voraces
Entries.Description: Trash birds take over an empty city. They go through it both quiet and destructive.

Entries.Title: Dancing in the Rain
Entries.Description: A girl lying in her room in Taipei gets bored and goes to sleep. Heavy rain starts, and the story goes into a dream world. She mounts on her bed and starts her trip guided by mice. The background music is Maiden’s Prayer which she finds played by mice. After diving into the water, she starts dancing with the mice.

Entries.Title: I Beg Your Pardon
Entries.Description: A man commits a terrible crime and the consequences are not what you’d expect.

Entries.Title: Ladies Night
Entries.Description: During a girl’s night clubbing with her best friend Fiona, Viv spots her ex, Remy. Determined to keep the night going, Fiona helps score Viv a hot new babe to move on.

Entries.Title: Peace of Heart
Entries.Description: After remembering a family-woven island tale, young Ailsa ventures into a dreamlike world, in search of her absent father and a way to heal their hearts.

Entries.Title: Dziedzictwo

Entries.Title: An Island of Forgetful Folks
Entries.Description: A nameless man lives alone on what he calls 'An Island of Forgetful People.' The man himself has no memory but keeps a catalogue of diaries documenting his past, through which he is able to construct some semblance of self.

Entries.Title: Chair Cemetery
Entries.Description: Confusion settles in the house, how to make it a home again?

Entries.Title: Love in Times of whatever the present is called
Entries.Description: In a museum where the paintings come to life inside their frames, a cleaning lady must decide whether to intervene when a new acquisition portrays the rape of a slave.

Entries.Title: Words of Her
Entries.Description: A distressed woman’s soliloquy.  “That woman” comes to her city for a short stay, bringing her the rain season from home. Inexplicable sensations torment her mind and body like mold, so she sinks into the reeds that grow out of the wounds on her finger. This film exposes a young woman's meandering feelings about sex and motherhood in relation to her chaotic perception of time.

Entries.Title: Refugee
Entries.Description: A man walks with a polar bear. After the end of the Earth, only nostalgia remains. In space, people gret the lost beauty and the carelessness of men.

Entries.Title: The Last Gammon
Entries.Description: Dave is on a mission to find the last gammon in London for his bird's brekkie, and nothing — not even the impending apocalypse - can stop him.

Entries.Title: Dulce Hogar
Entries.Description: Emily is a little girl playing tea party at home, when following one of her stuffed animals into a room to continue playing she is confronted with the reality that she is not safe in her own home.

Entries.Title: Dysphoria
Entries.Description: Three figures, each isolated from society, go on a journey of transformation. One trapped in a room of voyeuristic eyes, another whose body is changing in ways they can’t comprehend and the other hidden behind a mask they cannot remove. They each struggle to free themselves, accepting transformation; breaking the mould and becoming their true selves.

Entries.Title: The 9th Continent
Entries.Description: The story is about a fisherman who is searching for fish in a sea full of garbage and pollution, but cannot find any fish. Suddenly, he comes across a school of fish and follows them with his boat until he reaches an island made of garbage. Many fish are trapped among the garbage, and he easily hunts and collects them. But when he returns to his boat, he sees that a lot of garbage has accumulated around it, to the point where he cannot see the shoreline and becomes lost in the garbage island.

Entries.Title: The Sounds of Things Ablaze
Entries.Description: A woman walks down the sidewalk, avoiding the cracks in the pavement like a child. Her body remains on high alert, remembering the horrors of a war that continues to haunt her. The Sounds of Things Ablaze is a charcoal-drawn animated short film about the resilience of women.

Entries.Title: A Kimbap Love Song
Entries.Description: When Julie, a French-Korean teenager, arrives at her family home in Korea, she tries to find her place in her father's family despite the language barrier.

Entries.Title: Anansi The Spider
Entries.Description: Anansi the Spider must outsmart the biggest, most dangerous animals in the jungle… Or be eaten himself!

Entries.Title: Spectral Symbiosis
Entries.Description: An experimental animated short film that explores the relationship between humans and nature. Shot in December 2023 to support the ongoing battle to ban whaling in Iceland, the film takes viewers to spontaneous locations around Reykjavik and poses the question: can humanity find a more harmonious rhythm with nature?

Entries.Title: The Fall
Entries.Description: A ballerina falls in the middle of her most anticipated performance.

Entries.Title: Between the Gaps
Entries.Description: Clément receives a telephone call from Tessa. It’s been a long time since they last spoke. As nightfall approaches, he gets lost in the city.

Entries.Title: The Man Who Loved Flowers
Entries.Description: The life of a South Indian man whose love for flowers goes unnoticed.

Entries.Title: Bulbank
Entries.Description: Carl, the star employee at an idea-generating company, is determined to save his career when a new state-of-the-art robot begins to outshine him with its efficiency. Let the battle between Man and Machine begin!
