Entries.Title: The Cinefile Siege
Entries.Description: AI short by Damon Packard based on the infamous Batman Forever cancelled screening that was due to take place at Cinefile Video on May 29, which made big news.

Entries.Title: The Italians
Entries.Description: A young Italian man brings his new girlfriend home to his eccentric family.

Entries.Title: Adventures in Love & Birding
Entries.Description: A single mom agrees to be the partner of a bird enthusiast for a birding competition but misunderstands the assignment and tells everyone she's his new girlfriend instead of just his teammate.

Entries.Title: Ways to Fly
Entries.Description: When her barrettes mess up her pirouettes, an excitable, hyper-focused Black girl must power through the distractions -- and her mother's expectations -- to fly like the ballerinas do.

Entries.Title: Talk Shit
Entries.Description: Ella wants to move out. Taylor does not take this well. Talk Shit is a queer campy dark comedy thriller about the worst friendship breakup ever.

Entries.Title: The Happy Ending for Sera
Entries.Description: Sera glances into the silhouette of 'The one who died standing on the brick wall.' Detectives are tongue-in-cheek, calling it a bizarre case, and Pil-joong, who works in the film industry together, spreads trivial rumors and adds that he doesn't know why he committed suicide unfairly. Sera asks "Would it have been less unfair if you killed at least one person?" unravels the inner side of a character full of resentment, anger, and 'han' in a black comedy way.

Entries.Title: Murder on the Newfie Bullet
Entries.Description: As Newfoundland and Labrador hurtles toward its Confederation vote, a murder aboard the infamous train turns a routine journey into a chaotic political whodunit where every passenger has a motive, and the future of a nation might just be riding on a narrow gauge.

Entries.Title: C Takımı 2
Entries.Description: The team gets stuck in the town of "Fenk" in Elazığ while running away from Orhan's men. They take refuge in Murtaza Ağa's farm, where they start working to stay out of sight and make a living. Murtaza Ağa is known for being a cruel and stingy landlord. Just as the group is at their wits' end, they receive a call from Abdi's wife, Neriman, and are forced to flee the farm in a hurry and head to Kastamonu. On their way, they steal Murtaza Ağa's money and kidnap his daughter.

Entries.Title: L.I.M.B.O
Entries.Description: When Tom shows up late to an assessment, he’s thrown into an unexpected, surreal purgatory-like place called L.I.M.B.O. Trapped in this strange, bizarre state, he’s forced to confront his habits, face the consequences of procrastination  and find a way to move forward - or risk being stuck in L.I.M.B.O forever…

Entries.Title: The Mask: Gone Viral
Entries.Description: A struggling actress in Brooklyn finds the iconic Loki mask and goes on a wild, drunken escapade for the entire world to see, creating a new viral sensation.

Entries.Title: The Badgers
Entries.Description: When Berny (11) joins a motley Scouting troop called the Badgers, he resolves to win the Golden Scout Trophy, which his deceased father had won. However, when Berny’s radicalized foster mother, Gerdy, weasels her way into becoming the Badger's new co-leader, she cancels all future competitions. This year's competition is Berny's only chance at the trophy, so he cheats through the trials to become the Badger’s selected contestant. This sparks rivalry with jr. troop leader, Lars (13), and ignites a battle for the throne between Gerdy and her naive co-leader, Gunnar. Now Gerdy leads a coup d’état and is about to seize the rights to the Scout house. Unless Berny confesses his charade, the Badger’s will lose everything; will he sacrifices winning the trophy and risk losing his newfound friends?

Entries.Title: Fabien Olicard prend le temps d'en rire
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: For the Sake of a 50!
Entries.Description: On this summer day in 1977, Léon and Eugénie are preparing to welcome their entire family into their small house. It's their grandson Stéphane's birthday, but it's mostly a pretext to gather with the patriarch, weakened by illness. But what appears to be a routine family reunion will highlight everyone's tensions and resentment. It reaches a point of no return.

Entries.Title: La Tournée
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Keluarga Super Irit
Entries.Description: The Sukaharta family lives extremely frugally and happily—until a major pay cut forces them to move into a cramped ex-birdcage above a shop. Using their thrift strategy, TRIK (The Family's Tactics for Thriftiness), they struggle to save money and stay united as challenges threaten their harmony.

Entries.Title: Una siestita peligrosa
Entries.Description: A girl falls asleep during Film History class. Big mistake.

Entries.Title: Yamaneika Saunders: White N*gga
Entries.Description: The next 4 Years are gonna be treacherous for POC, Women, and LGBTQIA+  This may be our last time to laugh out loud!  The next 4 years are dependant on now only how White N*ggas move, but also how we move around them

Entries.Title: People's Child
Entries.Description: After growing up in an orphanage, Abolfazl embarks on a journey to find his real mother. His path leads him through friendship, love, loss, and war—until he discovers where he truly belongs.

Entries.Title: Lotus
Entries.Description: Alice von Trota returns to her father’s manor in Latvia in 1919 to sell it and start a new life. She meets the hostile resistance of the local workers and discovers she has been lured into a carefully tailored trap set by a demonic lawyer, a decadent underground organisation and its necrophile leader. While escaping the clutches of her “helpers”, she meets some silent-cinema enthusiasts and learns to use the cinematograph as a tool for healing and self-discovery, as a weapon against her enemies and as a way to create a masterpiece.

Entries.Title: Yuliya Akhmedova: Personally
Entries.Description: Stand-up concert by Yulia Akhmedova.

Entries.Title: Tonight's Special with Kareem & Johnny
Entries.Description: Kareem and Johnny are two comics in New York struggling on the circuit. In a last-ditch attempt to kickstart their careers, they decide to put together a comedy showcase, but the only place they will let them do it is Kellogg's Diner, an old-school joint in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.

Entries.Title: Love & Loss
Entries.Description: Tom - while attempting to eulogise his very kind, caring mother - is interrupted by his girlfriend Ellie, who feels perhaps she should be receiving these kind of compliments and speeches a little more instead of his sadly passed mum, and can’t help herself from letting the rest of the congregation hear her grievances, even though it isn’t necessarily the best time to bring it up.

Entries.Title: Blootje
Entries.Description: Sixteen-year-old Julia finds herself at a naturist campsite, where she’s confronted with her ideal of femininity and forced to grapple with her insecurities

Entries.Title: Et Tu
Entries.Description: A stage director is driven to madness during a regional production of Julius Caesar.

Entries.Title: Fikar Karo-Na
Entries.Description: Dad wants Harry married, but Harry’s here to mess it up! Will we get a wedding or total chaos? Let’s find out!

Entries.Title: Suffice to Negotiate
Entries.Description: A movie directed by Soheil Movafagh

Entries.Title: The Best You Can
Entries.Description: Cynthia Rand is a buttoned-up New Yorker married to a brilliant professor 25 years her senior. She begins feeling the effects of her husband’s advancing age on their relationship, just as her world is turned upside down by the arrival of sharp but chronically underachieving security guard Stan Olszewski in this smart rom-com that reunites Bacon and Sedgwick on screen for the first time in 20 years.

Entries.Title: Illti
Entries.Description: The story of a mischievous manchild living in a Punjab village surrounded by a lush jungle. After a comical misunderstanding, Illti befriends Bhajno, a spirited girl seeking to reclaim her childhood home from local criminals. Together, they uncover a mafia plot to destroy the village’s jungle and embark on a courageous journey to save their homeland. Amid humor, danger, and an unexpected detour into the Stone Age, the duo fights to protect their environment and discovers love and purpose along the way.

Entries.Title: Greek Mothers Never Die
Entries.Description: 26-year-old Ella dreams of becoming a singer, but her overbearing Greek mother, Despina, insists she take over the gyros business and marry a Greek man. After her sudden death, Despina's larger-than-life presence refuses to fade, haunting Ella with even more unsolicited advice from beyond the grave.

Entries.Title: Cheat Day
Entries.Description: Dennis and Sandy’s marriage is stuck in a rut. They agree to have a “cheat day” once a month, when they are free to meet anyone, no questions asked. Will this save their relationship?

Entries.Title: Molière, le spectacle musical
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Fwends
Entries.Description: Two young women in the world – a reunion weekend in Melbourne. Em’s on a break, Jessie’s always been chill. Dialogue like a babbling brook, sweet, smart, banal to heavy and back again, honest and unafraid of pathos. A generation of happy wounded souls.

Entries.Title: Doug Stanhope: Discount Meat
Entries.Description: Doug Stanhope, comedian, discusses salty topics with his signature demeanor.

Entries.Title: Saving the Christmas Ranch
Entries.Description: When the accountant for Carrie Williams’ family’s Christmas lodge makes off with all their money, Carrie has just two days to come up with nine months of missing mortgage payments or be foreclosed upon. Charming developer John Dunn has been calling Carrie from afar for a while, and now he’s here in person to make an offer on the ranch she can hardly refuse. Can Carrie raise enough funds before the deadline to save her home? Or will she be forced to sell to John, who hasn’t been entirely truthful about how he came to be there.

Entries.Title: Bring It All Back Home
Entries.Description: Former star athlete, Eddie Backus, 35, missing for five years, reappears suddenly in his hometown on a cocaine-inspired “mission from God”, and leads his childhood friends on an ill-fated quest to reclaim the freedom and glory of youth.

Entries.Title: Nancy Boy
Entries.Description: A heartwarming and humorous tale of a tight-knit group of rural LGBTQ+ friends—known as the "Isan Queer Gang"—who may have different dreams but share one common goal: saving up for a trip to Japan.

Entries.Title: Mesopotamia, TX
Entries.Description: Two strangers wait for a Solar Eclipse amid a crowd of eclectic Texans.

Entries.Title: Gulkand
Entries.Description: At least 10 known health benefits of 'Gulkand' (Rose-Petal Jam). This film is about the 11th and perhaps the most important benefit - Happiness—a film as sweet, fragrant and healthy as the condiment itself. Nostalgia re-creates relationship drama like no other emotion. When young lovers unite - the whole world conspires to challenge them at every step...but what happens when 'older lovers' re-unite? Gulkand is one such rosy sweet story that celebrates the innocence; the high-strung emotions; the melodrama; the sweetness and the tragic-comedy nature of the perpetual global pandemic - love.

Entries.Title: Der tote Winkel der Wahrnehmung
Entries.Description: Vienna, 1996. A mini-DV tape with footage for a student documentary. Alina and Flora interview unreliable witnesses to the appearance of extraterrestrial reptilian creatures. But soon they themselves drift further and further into the narrative: Lizards subjugating humanity through hybridization? Sounds plausible. At some point, the Hofburg is in flames, and reason itself is in ruins. Michael Gülzow's mockumentary hilariously satirizes the media logic and spread of conspiracy ideologies.

Entries.Title: The Curse
Entries.Description: Constant misfortune plagues two sisters until they discover a family curse and go on a comical mission to end it.

Entries.Title: Honey
Entries.Description: Honey (13) is shy and lies about herself and her chaotic family, and generally finds it difficult to show who she is in her new class. She loves to play music – and is really good – just no one knows.  Honey just wants a place in Liam's band Full Smash, so when she finds out that her dead, music-loving grandfather Marcel might not be dead at all, she decides to find him. Maybe he's just what she needs so she can finally learn to stand up for herself.

Entries.Title: Feminine Speeches 25'
Entries.Description: Humor and critique blend seamlessly in this year's Female Lines. With stand-up comedy, sketches, and special guest appearances, the show dives into important themes of the female experiences.

Entries.Title: Jackpot
Entries.Description: The 90-minute film follows the story of three young men from Casablanca who seek quick wealth by fabricating fake scandals on social media to manipulate the stock market. Guided by a social media influencer and one of the internet's most notorious scammers, their plan initially brings success, until it all unravels when the cybercrime unit begins to close in on them.

Entries.Title: Shrimp Fried Rice
Entries.Description: A talented shrimp chef with an ego that outweighs his tiny body carries out his vendetta against a certain culinary inclined rat which puts The Shrimp’s human puppet at risk of deportation.

Entries.Title: Haute saison
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Order
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: La Fille d'un grand amour
Entries.Description: Ana and Yves loved each other passionately, then parted ways. Years later, their daughter Cécile made a documentary about their meeting. They meet again. Still scarred by their past love, they set out to find a way back to each other.

Entries.Title: Gosh!!
Entries.Description: Life seems pretty normal at the Forensics Division. Ippei's canine partner, Oliver, appears to him as a womanizing middle-aged drunk in a dog suit, but that's nothing new. However, when "Super Volunteer" Konishi vanishes, the investigation pulls them into a bizarre mystery. Joined by Supervisor Hagoromo, Ippei and Yukina follow Konishi's trail, Urushibara uncovers a family secret, and former handler Mizoguchi stumbles upon a takoyaki-infested town and a tiny fairy man. All while mysterious red doors keep appearing… Something is obviously deeply wrong. Can the team find Konishi and save him from unseen forces before chaos consumes them all?

Entries.Title: De De Pyaar De 2
Entries.Description: A sequel to De De Pyaar De.

Entries.Title: Kill Tony: Kill or Be Killed
Entries.Description: A bucket, a mic and one minute to win over Tony Hinchcliffe and a panel of famous guests. This is stand-up at its most unforgiving — and unpredictable.

Entries.Title: Black to the Future
Entries.Description: In the utmost secrecy, the first African space mission is preparing to take off! The crew, from Africa and its diaspora, is set to explore the planet "NARDAL", assessing its potential as a refuge for all Africans should Earth ever become uninhabitable. The problem is that the journey will be long. Very long. And in interstellar missions, the greatest unknown is whether the astronauts will be able to get along.

Entries.Title: American Wanker
Entries.Description: In the year 1994, a band of misfits, helmed by a frontman too eager to prove himself, undertake a tumultuous road trip to their first, and possibly, last gig.

Entries.Title: Ari Shaffir: America's Sweetheart
Entries.Description: Comedian Ari Shaffir tackles controversial topics like terrorism, gun violence, racism, and more in his stand-up special. With a darkly humorous approach, he explores unexpected perspectives on sensitive social and political issues.

Entries.Title: Generation Necktie
Entries.Description: A film crew follows three aimlessly idealistic skateboarders and their families as they claw for direction in their mundane suburban lives.

Entries.Title: Hat Trick
Entries.Description: A grieving magician must continue the legacy of her infamous father at a bizarre children's birthday party.

Entries.Title: Strangers in the Same Shirt
Entries.Description: At their father's 3rd wedding, estranged siblings Matt & Haley struggle to connect after years apart. Haley faces relationship issues and Matt’s abrasive nature only makes things worse. Eventually Matt sincerely apologizes and supports Haley in addressing her romantic feelings. Haley, in turn supports Matt’s nature by de-escalating tension between him and their father by playing a song from Matt's band. In the end there is hope for a future between them.

Entries.Title: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon 2
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Chhuhara
Entries.Description: A guy just wants to get married, but two ladies are busy playing vicholans! Will they help or create more chaos?

Entries.Title: Драники
Entries.Description: Max, an ordinary schoolboy with somewhat unusual parents, finds himself in a village for winter break, against his will. In the village, he encounters a dish that's familiar to the locals but new to him - potato pancakes. The boys, along with their cousin, decide to start a business: they convert an old UAZ into a food truck and sell potato pancakes. But how can you tackle adult problems when you're still a child yourself?

Entries.Title: You, Me & Her
Entries.Description: On their first vacation after having a baby, Mags and Ash attempt to rekindle the spark in their marriage but can’t help arguing the whole trip. When Mags meets Angela, they have an instant connection that makes Mags seriously question her sexuality for the first time. Suddenly Ash and Mags start to reconnect over the idea of having a threesome in hopes that the excitement of the potential sexual experience will save their marriage.

Entries.Title: Some Like It Bald
Entries.Description: 30 something Zacharie is losing his hair…and his girlfriend! But he can rely on his uncle Joseph, a specialist, to win both of them back.

Entries.Title: 暴走财神6
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Boy
Entries.Description: Actress-director Zabou Breitman embarks on an unusual adventure: imagining the life of a boy discovered in an old photo from an album bought at a flea market. These are the images and memories of an unknown family, which somehow feel familiar. At the center is the boy, with his gaze that is both gentle and melancholic yet joyful. Who is he? What is his true story, the one that unfolds between the lines? What if every individual were also the unwitting hero of a tale? This dizzying family investigation blurs the lines between reality and fiction, sometimes merging them completely.

Entries.Title: Soneriada 5: Crime and Punishment
Entries.Description: Chronicles the events that lead to Charlie Charlison's untimely death employing a cinéma vérité approach.

Entries.Title: Me gusta
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Loathe Thy Neighbor
Entries.Description: When a neurotic city transplant inherits his late father's rural farm, he must survive his unhinged neighbor's psychological warfare while discovering that sometimes your worst enemy might just save your life.

Entries.Title: Mr and Mrs Bachelor
Entries.Description: Stephy, a bride-to-be, escapes from her wedding and meets Siddhu, a carefree bachelor in his 40s. The film follows their spontaneous journey together filled with humorous and emotional moments.

Entries.Title: Tenu Ghodi Kinney Chadaya
Entries.Description: "Tenu Ghodi Kinney Chadaya" is a Punjabi comedy-romantic movie directed by Royal Singh, featuring Harby Sangha and Raavi Kaur Bal. The film follows the story of a young man named Bant, who is searching for a suitable bride for his younger brother, Zorawar.

Entries.Title: The Game
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
Entries.Description: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest among his fellow fairgoers.

Entries.Title: George Lopez: Muy Católico
Entries.Description: George Lopez brings his reflections on aging, Latino family dynamics, and cultural quirks in his final stand-up special. He hilariously embraces the challenges of getting older and touches on generational clashes and Latino superstitions. Bold and personal, Lopez delivers his comedic voice to stories that capture both the humor and heart of his journey one last time.

Entries.Title: Faustino
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Door
Entries.Description: Vafa, who works as a maid in the house of an influential businessman, decides to commit a robbery to start a new life. To do this, she turns to her brother Vidadi, who has not been able to see his son for more than a year due to unpaid child support and has grown tired of such a life. After convincing her brother, they also suggest involving their step-cousin Javad, who has been imprisoned several times for theft. During the robbery, Javad and Vidadi break the door and get stuck in the house. After that, events unfold even more dramatically.

Entries.Title: The Elephant's Present
Entries.Description: James comes home for the holidays with the intention of repairing the strained relationship with his daughter. Despite his attempt to mend things with a gift, his efforts are rejected, leading James to reluctantly toss the present in the trash. What follows is a series of mishaps, missteps, and misanthropic musings, tracing the discarded gift's journey as it returns to its rightful owner.

Entries.Title: She's a Bitch
Entries.Description: The 5th entry in the "I See the Dead" series. The team have been through a lot. What can possibly happen in this quiet, picturesque setting? There’s no one for miles, so those noises can only be animals outside – right? Was that… a howl?

Entries.Title: The Ballad
Entries.Description: A fed up food delivery worker chooses a split second act of rebellion - one that results in an awkward, spiraling dance between the classes of 21st century Sweden.

Entries.Title: Terror at Edgewood Manor
Entries.Description: Join this group of funky kids on their fantastical journey navigating a house full of sickening mugs, scary pendants, and maybe even a possessed penis!

Entries.Title: Noah's Arc: The Movie
Entries.Description: Noah and Wade are expecting twins and must shift gears when each is offered their dream job, forcing one of them to assume the traditional stay-at-home parental role...only which one? What gift can life give the man who has everything? The answer is drama – and tons of it!

Entries.Title: Zorla Güvenlik
Entries.Description: A young man who has never worked in his life and is addicted to computer games starts working as a security guard at a shopping mall under pressure from his mother.

Entries.Title: A Night of Charade
Entries.Description: After his tenure in Los Angeles, a director returns to his hometown theatre to offer unsolicited advice to the new cast. After calling in the chaotic big guns, the production is overtaken and turned into a farce. Will the cast be able to band together and save the show or be forced to embrace the absurd? Starring the totally real Sandra Bullock and Zac Efron.

Entries.Title: Kronika večných snílkov
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Mountain Friends
Entries.Description: A new short film from Jon Millstein and Jon Mackey.

Entries.Title: Meadowhawk
Entries.Description: When washed-up actor David Eastman participates in a comic convention in order to earn money for his granddaughter, he encounters his former co-star and rival Rick Majors for the first time in 40 years.

Entries.Title: Face Off 8: Embrace of Light
Entries.Description: When a son's dream to dance to the beat of his own heart pits him against his father's wishes, family strife boils over in a clash between youthful aspirations and parental expectations.

Entries.Title: Kothapallilo Okappudu
Entries.Description: When a man pursues a local woman, his relationship with her friend is misconstrued by the villagers.

Entries.Title: Urbem
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Every Man in New York Is Named Andrew
Entries.Description: Margo has never been in a relationship, and she thinks she'd be great at being in one. But everywhere she looks, there's just another guy named Andrew.

Entries.Title: Cockroach
Entries.Description: A person just tells a joke and immediately ends up unemployed. That's roughly how urologist Miloš feels. He made an inappropriate joke about a high-ranking official and now he's trying to destroy him. And if only... The whole house smells strange and everyone around him acts suspiciously. Luboš Kučera's stylized feature debut shows the contemporary world as a bizarre panopticon.

Entries.Title: Everything About My Wife
Entries.Description: The film revolves around an unhappy married man who seeks the help of a Casanova to seduce his wife and get her to ask for a divorce.

Entries.Title: UNALIVED
Entries.Description: Suspicions fly in a TikTok house when six wannabe influencers move in together to grow their followings—but begin dying one by one.  UNALIVED is a short satirical whodunnit that examines the depths to which we allow social media to take over our lives.

Entries.Title: HalloWiebe
Entries.Description: On the night before Halloween, security guard Wiebe and his crew are assigned to watch an empty amusement park. Little do they know, they are not alone.

Entries.Title: Fran the Man
Entries.Description: When non-league St Peter's Celtic are drawn to play titans Shamrock Rovers in the first round of the FAI Cup, assistant manager Fran Costello hopes his team will pull off one of the greatest shocks in football history. But it isn't long before the shit really hits the Fran…

Entries.Title: The Cramps: A Period Piece
Entries.Description: Agnes Applewhite, a blossoming young woman caught between her sanctimonious mother and tightly wound sister, defies her family’s expectations by taking a job as a shampoo girl at a lively beauty salon. As she thrives in this new colorful world, she is suddenly confronted by debilitating menstrual cramps that become real-life monsters, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.

Entries.Title: Leave Room For Leonard
Entries.Description: A young couple gets into a tiff one evening after returning home from a performance of one of their plays. As they duke it out, the two begin to unravel, slowly but surely.

Entries.Title: My Friend Eva
Entries.Description: Eva has just turned 50. She’s been married for over 20 years and has two, teenage children. So far, nothing remarkable. But on a business trip to Rome something happens that turns her life upside down. She meets Alex, a scriptwriter who’s spending a few days in the Italian city. The instant attraction she feels for him, the butterflies in her tummy, the seductive hint of possibility… After all this time, she remembers what it feels like to fall in love and it shifts something inside of her. It reignites a fire that had long been extinguished.

Entries.Title: Vellapanti
Entries.Description: Vellapanti story revolves around four childhood friends who struggle to fulfill their ambitions but each time find themselves in a soup.

Entries.Title: Weird Kisses
Entries.Description: Internet friends in Johannesburg, New York City, and Seattle explore intimacy in their offline lives.

Entries.Title: Owambe Thieves
Entries.Description: A struggling married couple take a desperate gamble for survival. Their decision pulls them into a dangerous web of power, betrayal, and consequences they never saw coming.

Entries.Title: The Christopher Nolan Experience
Entries.Description: When struggling creative Christopher Nolan is dumped by his girlfriend upon her discovery that he is not the legendary director of films such as Oppenheimer and Interstellar, he decides to prove himself by staging a play adaptation of The Dark Knight. "The Christopher Nolan Experience" captures the behind-the-scenes efforts leading up to this anticipated disaster.

Entries.Title: Headcase
Entries.Description: In her reach for fame, wannabe influencer Kylie finds herself having to lurk in the shadows after a cheeky hit-and-run threatens to derail her coveted brand partnership.

Entries.Title: Amityvillenado
Entries.Description: In the wake of a devastating storm that destroys the infamous DeFeo house, a paranormal entity merges with a malevolent tornado, unleashing an otherworldly force upon the town of Amityville.

Entries.Title: Straight Outta Melissa
Entries.Description: A kid wants to be a rapper, but his family kicks him out of the house. Out to prove he can spit bars, he joins the school's rap battle tournament.

Entries.Title: Being Bublé
Entries.Description: A deeply unqualified man is inexplicably hired as a Michael Bublé impersonator for a rich stranger’s party. Despite no resemblance, no singing ability, and just one week to prepare, he gives it everything he’s got. A hilarious, oddly inspiring documentary about effort over ability and the joy of letting folks believe.

Entries.Title: Run, Jamie
Entries.Description: Following a little league softball game, a family of four’s journey home is interrupted by disaster: Mark, the family patriarch, has to shit.

Entries.Title: Maddie's Secret
Entries.Description: Follows a content creator on a food network who’s trying to hide her dark past.

Entries.Title: Не Дед Мороз
Entries.Description: Father Frost decides to quit his profession in order to live for himself in his old age. Having relinquished his powers, he leaves Veliky Ustyug for Moscow, goes on a rampage, finds new friends and falls in love for the first time. Attempts to bring the old man to his senses and return him to his normal life by his family - Mother Winter, Stuzha, Metelitsa and Buran - end in failure. This new stage of his life is recorded by a group of documentary filmmakers, and no one suspects what will happen when Father Frost loses his magical powers...

Entries.Title: Tastemaker
Entries.Description: In an alternate world where apps use human spies to generate suggested content, one data analyst struggles with matters of taste.

Entries.Title: The Actor

Entries.Title: Diamond Over Beijing

CUI Dacheng, a rock OG, discovered that as long as his daughter was at home, his creative block vanished, so he tried to persuade ZHAO Xiaolu to stay with him. However, having grown up with her mother, ZHAO Xiaolu was determined to distance herself from this stranger-like father.

Now he has woken up, and he has a plan: during his time in hospital, he came up with the idea of a fairer society. From now on, Mux sees it as his task to save the world from neoliberalism and goes to France, the motherland of revolutions, with his long-term nurse Karsten and a self-written manifesto.

However, he is guilty of violating his king's order, and so he faces either the death penalty or an uncertain and dangerous journey to find Goldilocks, a princess from a mysterious kingdom in the middle of a lake. He therefore sets off on a journey accompanied by Stephen, with whom he grew up since childhood, and a small dog named Lucky, whose life George saved. George is faced with a whole series of adventures and surprises along the way. He has no idea that Stephen is jealous and is not as sincere a friend as he seemed. Fortunately, George has brave allies, the animals he has helped.

A recurring theme is avoidance and how it, as a coping with life mechanism, is not perhaps a good choice. Better perhaps to aspire to be the 1980’s Chico Roll lady.

Entries.Description: Newly engaged and totally friendless, Amelia decides to ask her high school ex-BFF to be her maid of honor: who she hasn't talked to in 10 years, and whose crush she stole back in the day... She'll probably be so excited to see her too!

Entries.Title: Jessica Kirson: I'm the Man

Entries.Description: A 40-year-old first-time mother reconnects with her childhood friends to assist as doulas during her home birth. Together, they revisit old memories, face unforgettable moments, and explore motherhood and friendship from a unique perspective.

Entries.Title: Everybody Hates Communication
Entries.Description: Chris and his friends live ordinary days inside the Federal University of Paraná's Department of Social Communication — Professor Toni's class, lunch at the University Restaurant, photography practice in the studio... Until a terrifying discovery threatens Chris's permanency at the university. A reimagining of the classic "Everybody Hates Chris," and filled with references from "The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air" to "Mean Girls," this short film reflects on the experiences of black people within the university in a sharp and comical way.

Entries.Title: Get Lucky
Entries.Description: Tim and Cathryn are a couple in their early 40's. They haven't really gotten anywhere in life - no career, no college, no direction, no ambition and no kids... And now that the biological clock is ticking they have decided that the most important thing for them is to have a baby.  In a desperate bid to save their dream of parenthood, Tim secretly agrees to drive the getaway car for a bank robbery to raise the money for IVF. But chaos ensues when Cathryn calls demanding he come home immediately to try to conceive. Tim faces an impossible choice: fulfill his promise as the getaway driver or rush home to keep their baby-making schedule.

Entries.Title: Mão Podre

Entries.Title: Capsize
Entries.Description: In search of freedom, our two sidekicks decide to go on a pedal boat.

Entries.Title: Trad
Entries.Description: From their home in the Donegal Gaeltacht, gifted fiddle player Shóna McAnally and her little brother Mickey take to the road with a troupe of wandering musicians, on a cross-country journey of adventure, romance, and musical exploration.

However, that all changes when he has reason to assume Becky is having an affair with their friend Jackson leading him to realize that his sitcom lifestyle may be more sinister than it seems.

Entries.Title: The Wolves

Entries.Title: Volley Joe Spikes Again
Entries.Description: For a millennium, Volley Joe has remained uncontested as the Demi-God of Volleyball. It has been decades since a worthy challenger has surfaced.

Entries.Title: Game of Hearts
Entries.Description: A tough guy is rare, and Robbie, the local heartthrob, is no exception. When he gets entangled with the girlfriend of a shady private investigator, he enters a world of excess and mystery. In the gritty nightlife of Los Angeles, these charming men will compete in nightclubs and bedrooms, leading one lucky woman to decide who wins in the Game of Hearts.

Entries.Title: She Raised Me
Entries.Description: Louie plans to break up with his boyfriend but is thrown off when he discovers his boyfriend’s mother is Marilyn Muff, a gay icon he idolized. Louie clings to Marilyn, but how far will he go to keep her?

Entries.Title: Two Big Feet
Entries.Description: After a conspiracy theorist is unambiguously dumped, his loyal to a fault childhood best friend schemes to fake a Sasquatch sighting to lift his dwindling spirits.

Entries.Title: Atti-Tutor
Entries.Description: When Turquoise gets their first private dance student Aspen-Chloe, who is a nightmare, our insecure dance teacher must work with Aspen- Chole’s Attitude Coach, Rachel Kent to transform this spoiled, entitled child into a kind person. Is it the power of dance that influences Aspen-Chole’s behavior or maybe just the reward of a new toy? Might this encounter help Turquoise become the teacher they are meant to be!?

Entries.Title: The Life of a Satire Influencer
Entries.Description: A Satire Influencer reflects on his career and the effect it has on his life and those around him. As he crumbles deeper into the facade, one question remains - how far will he go for fame?

Entries.Title: Found Footage Festival: 20th Anniversary Show
Entries.Description: Joe Pickett (The Onion) and Nick Prueher (Late Show) have over 14,000 VHS tapes in their collection and have been taking viewers on a guided tour through their latest and greatest finds since 2004. To celebrate two decades of this VHS nonsense, Joe & Nick will serve up their all-time greatest finds, including the dumbest exercise videos, the craziest public access shows, and updates with the most wonderful weirdos they’ve met along the way.

Entries.Title: There Are Aliens in Phoenix
Entries.Description: Made for the Mountain Ridge Flim's, 2nd Annual 48hr Film Festival  Local slack-jaw conspiracy theorist, Cletus (Chrysan Martin) gets word of an abnormal event near him and drags his more level-headed friend Randall (Noah Lefley-Laurant) to find an alien.

Entries.Title: Extremely Unique Dynamic
Entries.Description: Ryan and Daniel, two childhood best friends and aspiring actors, spend one final weekend together before RYAN has to move to Canada with his fiancé. Wanting to create one lasting memory, they decide to make a movie... about two guys making a movie.. about two guys making a movie. Along the way, they unpack their decades-long friendship and prepare for the next chapters of their respective lives.

Entries.Title: Jodoh 3 Bujang
Entries.Description: Three bachelor brothers—Fadly, Kifly, and Ahmad—were asked by their parents to have a joint wedding due to financial limitations in upholding tradition. However, Fadly's fiancée was suddenly arranged by her parents to marry a more well-off man. Now, Fadly must find a new bride in the short time remaining, or their joint wedding will be in jeopardy!

Entries.Title: The Roast of Helen Zille
Entries.Description: South African comedy royalty Tumi Morake and Trevor Gumbi take the reins as co-Roast Masters, ensuring that no punchline lands gently. With Helen Zille in the hot seat and a cross-section of South African voices - anything can happen.

Entries.Title: Crowded Out

Entries.Title: Bert Kreischer: Lucky

Entries.Title: John Bishop: Live From New York

Entries.Title: Close Ur Kopitiam
Entries.Description: Ah Biao inherits his mother's Kopitiam and runs it with his wife, Yuriko. The business once thrived, but Ah Biao's management style and unconventional marketing strategies led to an unexpected crisis that put Kopitiam in unprecedented danger. After a conflict with a popular influencer, Kopitiam becomes embroiled in a media storm, causing the business to plummet. Just as Ah Biao and Yuriko work tirelessly to turn things around, they face the threat of repossession. Will they manage to overcome this crisis and protect their family business? How will their marriage and the Kopitiam fare in the face of adversity?

Entries.Title: Fragments on the flow
Entries.Description: Fragments from Brussels, about the flow of the city, A cinema, A body, A film, and a wind that blows through the town. The film is a Schizomentry experience that blends real stories and fiction. After all, where is the border?

Entries.Title: Budget Paradise
Entries.Description: Seeking a spot to post up and make their art, Chester finds themself tossed from every corner of a city hell-bent on displacing anyone unwilling to fall in line with its profit-driven agenda.

Entries.Title: Popemobile
Entries.Description: To mark his recent appointment, the new Pope prepares for a tour of Latin America, only to find that the Vatican is bankrupt. A rich Mexican woman offers to help out. In return for financing his trip, she demands he attends an event in his honour in the city of Ciudad Juarez – Mexico’s capital of crime. The “guardian angel” turns out to be a drug trafficker, and when she discovers that a lookalike Pope has been sent in his place, confusion, laughter and unexpected chaos ensue.

Entries.Title: The Forest Clown
Entries.Description: A camping trip turns into a nightmare as a group of strangers encounters a mad clown. As they are hunted one by one, secrets unravel. A spin-off of Horror Stories (2024), this slasher is a playful take of classic horror clichés.

Entries.Title: Chaurya Paatam
Entries.Description: Four aspiring criminals plan to rob the local bank at India's most richest and peaceful village, on the pretext of shooting a documentary. But their heist plans are disrupted when they discover the seemingly tranquil community harbors sinister secrets.

Entries.Description: In the small and historic suburb of Mazkeret Batya, two sarcastic, rebellious teenagers dream of escaping their boring reality with their rock band. But when their disloyal bandmate unexpectedly quits, the two embark on a surprising journey that challenges their intense friendship.

Entries.Title: Racewalkers
Entries.Description: Will could never compete in the sport he’s always loved: racewalking. While struggling to find respect as a coach, Will’s fortunes change when he spots a burnout pitcher with the most impeccable racewalking stride he’s ever seen. Together, Will and Matt team up, face the challenges of a sport that doesn’t want them, and to try to take down the best walker in the country.

Entries.Title: Gavin & Stacey: A Fond Farewell
Entries.Description: An uplifting and touching documentary special which tells the story of one of Britain's best loved sitcoms as it comes to an end after 17 years. Featuring unprecedented access to creators James Corden and Ruth Jones as well as the cast and crew, including filming the final episode as they all say goodbye to the much-cherished show.

Entries.Title: Soneriada 3: The Prodigal Son Returns
Entries.Description: Menti is miraculously revived after his suicide attempt and tries to make sense of the events following Charlie Charlison's murder. However things aren't like he originally thought as a new player reveals himself in the plot.

Entries.Title: Om Shanthi Shanthi Shanthi

Entries.Title: Betting with Ghost 2: The Gem Hunter
Entries.Description: Five individuals embark on a darkly comedic journey, each with their own schemes, to transport the body of actress Anh Thu (Ngoc Xuan) back to her hometown. In return, her ghost promises them a diamond ring worth 9 billion VND. Who will claim the prize, or will the trip reveal their darkest selves?

Entries.Title: In The Land of Fish and Honey
Entries.Description: A mute man searches far and wide for fish and honey amongst the tapestry of Vancouver Island.

Entries.Title: Fame And Other Four Letter Words

Entries.Title: Before You Fade Away Into Nothing

Entries.Title: A Barber Who Cuts His Own Hair

Entries.Title: Fang mich doch
Entries.Description: Georg, a professional improviser, wants the best for his epileptic child—and he finds it in a chic daycare center in Leipzig. He can't admit that he's unemployed and his wife works as a cleaning lady. With a doctored biography and rusty charm, he fakes his way into the hip parenthood scene as a supposed event manager, organizing flea markets, barbecuing, smoking weed, and taking over the cash register. The fact that there is almost half a million euros in it is initially a "gift" that Georg soon uses to treat himself to a lavish lifestyle without anyone noticing – and to become more and more like the hip parents. But as he juggles credit cards, his shady dealings increasingly begin to turn against him.

Entries.Title: Revenge of the Boogeyman
Entries.Description: A group of friends take their recently sober friend, to the remote Hills to help him stay clean. But when eerie events unfold and people start disappearing, they must question whether it's the Boogeyman or their own unraveling minds.

Entries.Title: Kalbermatten
Entries.Description: A deposed dictator and a persecuted imam find church asylum in the idyllic mountain village of Kalbermatten. At the community meeting, the proud villagers want to show the poor refugees what democracy is. When a dispute over a vote escalated there, the women quickly abolished men's right to vote by majority vote and replaced the mayor with his wife. Out of defiance, the men join the refugees in the church, where the women have nothing to say. While the imam in the church tries to comfort the disempowered men, the deposed dictator helps the deposed mayor to overthrow his beloved wife.

Entries.Title: The Kidnapping of Arabella
Entries.Description: A young woman is convinced she is the wrong version of herself, until a chance encounter with a 7-year-old changes her mind.

Entries.Title: Las coordenadas exactas

Suspects include Bello's family friends and associates all confined in his beautiful mansion until the culprit can be identified.

Entries.Title: Project Eggman

Entries.Description: One day, a struggling couple, Jack and Ashley, notice a truck stopped in their driveway with a dying man and duffel bags filled with a life changing amount of cash, leading them to grapple with moral dilemmas and dangerous consequences as they attempt to change their lives. Their decision to keep the money intertwines their fate with the suspicions of Sheriff Dolion and the menacing forces of the local criminal underworld, escalating tensions and jeopardizing their dreams of a better future.

Entries.Title: Chelsea Handler: The Feeling
Entries.Description: From ruining Thanksgiving to a wild summer fling, Chelsea Handler recounts coming of age, unexpected encounters and that time she met Bill Cosby.

Entries.Title: Nate Jackson: Super Funny
Entries.Description: Sharp jokes meet savage roasts as Nate Jackson blends his infamous crowd work with takes on topics from judgment-free gyms to catfishing.

Entries.Title: love_proxy
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Things to Worry About
Entries.Description: A mother's love is put to the test when her 13-year-old son changes into someone she can no longer recognize. Will she accept the stranger he has become, or fight to reclaim the boy she once knew?

Entries.Title: Villa Benavente
Entries.Description: One stormy night, Mr. Horacio Benavente gathers a group of strangers at his mansion. However, someone is murdered in the middle of the evening. Caught in the storm, the guests are forced to solve the crime and face its consequences.

Entries.Title: Les Bodin's en folie : La Soirée des 30 ans
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Untitled (Without Sound)
Entries.Description: A highfalutin art movie crumbles into a meta-fictional disaster that betrays its director’s incompetence in real time, and it’s all on film.

Entries.Title: Egykutya
Entries.Description: Patika unexpectedly invites her former university classmates to her newly inherited apartment for a get-together for apparently no reason, after eight years without contact.  As a good host, Patika prepares dinner, and thanks to the old campus heart-throb Honda, there’s plenty of wine. Once everyone has arrived—including Vica, now a turbo-charged mother of two, and Nóra, a successful artist freshly returned from abroad—it becomes clear that their host does have a pressing reason for gathering them. A very pressing one.

Entries.Title: Семьянин
Entries.Description: Millionaire Georgiy celebrates his birthday all alone. Not being quite sober, he demands that his faithful assistant Ilya organize a real family for him by the morning. Imagine Georgiy's amazement when he wakes up surrounded by his wife, son and daughter, who claim that he has always had them. Their words are confirmed by documents, family photos, employees, partners and even Georgiy's own mother. Now he has to learn how to be a husband and father, and in this matter, money will not solve all the problems.

Entries.Title: Touched by Eternity
Entries.Description: Self-proclaimed cryptocurrency expert Fatso is a middle-aged curmudgeon frittering away his days with video games and conspiracy theory videos. Obsessed with the concept of eternal life since childhood, Fatso experiments with various quack theories in the hopes of becoming immortal, despite his miserablism. When Egons and Carlos inexplicably appear outside of his remote woodland trailer, asking for an invitation inside, they bring glad tidings that he has recently been selected as “the chosen one.” Appealing to his nature as a “cowardly, passive, antisocial sluggard,” who has squandered his humanity so thoroughly that the transition to undead would prove practically seamless, the friendly duo make promises of a new, more fulfilling life as a vampire.

Entries.Title: Sales Are Dope
Entries.Description: SALES ARE DOPE is a satirical workplace sitcom about a scandal-ridden startup where the sales team will do whatever it takes to hit their quota.

Entries.Title: A Farmer and the Killer
Entries.Description: The peaceful day of the farmer came to an end when the ruthless Killer trespassed onto his land, leading to a confrontation between the farmer and the killer.

Entries.Title: Fucktoys
Entries.Description: Part-time sex worker, full-time chaos magnet, AP is convinced that the universe has it out for her… and she might be right. She decides on seeking a cosmic reset after a tarot reader floating in a swamp tells her she needs $1,000 and a sacrificial lamb to lift her curse. Armed with neither, she meets up with her long-lost kindred spirit Danni, and together the two moped off on a bizarre quest through Trashtown USA — a dystopian, neon-drenched sprawl of strip clubs and urban decay, stocked with a series of assorted oddballs, Tom of Finland cops, and some all-too-familiar type clients. Fucktoys is rude, crude, unhinged, girlypop middle finger to filmic convention, and a comedic calling card for anyone who finds themself asking the question: am I cursed???

Entries.Title: The Space Worriers
Entries.Description: On a planet where a long-standing martial law prevailed, the earthman living in exchange for time, strictly adhered to discipline and worked tirelessly. One day, they were invaded by the Devil's Party from the “Funkmi Galaxy”, where indulgence and obscenity rules day and night, posing an unprecedented threat to the Earthman’s morals. Meanwhile, the Space Worriers from the same Funkmi Galaxy were determined to protect these hardworking creatures at all costs.

Entries.Title: Boca de asno
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Oysters

Entries.Title: Caleb Hearon: Model Comedian
Entries.Description: ​In his debut stand-up special, actor, comedian, writer, and podcaster Caleb Hearon takes us back to his roots in Kansas City...where it all started. Newly 30, Hearon deploys his generational Midwestern wisdom to solve most of the world's problems: politics, internet trolls, learning we're not that different from our parents, and more.

Entries.Title: A Glimpse Through The Bennington Lens
Entries.Description: A Glimpse Through The Bennington Lens follows Will and Ana, two journalist theater students at Bennington, as they interview faculty and administration members to get to the bottom of some uncanny events

Entries.Title: Gala & Kiwi

Entries.Title: Coisa de Novela
Entries.Description: An estranged grandmother reconnects with her granddaughter after a difficult diagnosis and asks her for help to accomplish the dream of going to Rio de Janeiro and being on a telenovela.

Entries.Title: Revolução da TV

Entries.Title: Las ovejas del planeta Tierra
