Entries.Title: Earworm
Entries.Description: Ulph (Adam Lundgren) is in the hospital since he suffered from a serious form of earworm. Rednex's unmistakable "Cotton Eye Joe" ruins his life and drives him to the brink of insanity. The all-too-familiar phenomenon takes on physical form in Patrik Eklund's psychological thriller with a comic undertone.

Entries.Title: Prudence at the grocery store
Entries.Description: Her name is Prudence, but she has been anything but careful. By sharing her intimacy with her family, they ended up inviting each other under her sheets. Between a disinhibited mother, an over-militant sister, a clumsy boyfriend and a capricious vagina, the fivesome promises to be hot!

Entries.Title: Jenseits vom Jenseits
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Immaculate Perception
Entries.Description: A young woman named Maggie - knows she isn’t crazy. She’s also not particularly motivated or skilled, but she is not crazy. She knows her body, and she knows that she is the next Virgin Mary. Except, her body is growing something that seems much, much more sinister. Can she survive a doubtful friend, a conniving nurse, and her own body - or will she succumb to her "baby"?

Entries.Title: Malik Ni Varta
Entries.Description: In a fearful town, whispers of Malik, a mysterious and intimidating figure, spread like wildfire. As the community grapples with fear, individuals speculate about Malik's true identity.

Entries.Title: How to commit the perfect murder
Entries.Description: A dark comedy short film about grappling with the presuure put upon oneself for being perfect, even when just starting out, and learning to deal with things not always going according to plan.

Entries.Title: High Wire
Entries.Description: A British-Chinese takeaway girl discovers artistic bravery and the freedom in forging her own path when a circus comes to her small English town.

Entries.Title: Anak Medan: Cocok Ko Rasa!?
Entries.Description: The story of the friendship of four young men namely Ucok, Rafly, Joko and Chisa. Due to an incident, those who originally wanted to achieve their dreams together are far from each other.

Entries.Title: Utopia
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Andrew Santino: White Noise
Entries.Description: Andrew Santino's new hilarious stand-up special will undoubtedly solve all the world's problems for eternity.

Entries.Title: Dog Fugitive
Entries.Description: A brutally honest dog psychiatrist, Dr. Fluffy, skips town when her patient is accused of killing their cheating husband and Dr. Fluffy thinks she's to blame.

Entries.Title: Carnal Vessels
Entries.Description: Two friends swap bodies the moment they fall in love and are thrust on different sexually-charged adventures as each other over one long, hot weekend.

Entries.Title: Marino, My Love
Entries.Description: Professor Toad repeatedly attempts and fails to confess his love to his friend T. Ode, and each setback pushes him into an increasingly destructive spiral.

Entries.Title: Soos Pynappel Op Pizza
Entries.Description: Waldo and Becca have exactly three things in common. Both are chefs. Both are single. And both dislike each other equally.  When they end up at a crazy singles retreat in the mountains, fate throws them together in one absurd scenario after another. This forces them to reconsider their opinions on love.

Entries.Title: High Tension
Entries.Description: A happy couple celebrates their six-month anniversary, wrapped in the illusion of a perfect love. But as the night unfolds, buried truths resurface, forcing them to confront whether their relationship is built to last or just a beautiful lie.

Entries.Title: Directors on Directors
Entries.Description: Kunhee Jin and Esau Gomez-Ang discuss pushing boundaries, embracing diversity, and cinema's enduring nature.

Entries.Title: Self-Tape
Entries.Description: An actor receives an impossible note. She devolves.

Entries.Title: First Place
Entries.Description: The drama behind the scenes of the biggest Polynesian Dance festival in the world. Who has what it takes to stand in the front row, and who will win First Place?

Entries.Title: Hot Breath/Cold Air
Entries.Description: Fates align as a moody non-believer meets the woman of his dreams, and both of their groups of friends have to deal with the consequences.

Entries.Title: Human Affairs
Entries.Description: Their relationship problems are out of this world.

Entries.Title: Outside De Familia
Entries.Description: A story of two senior citizens who have found solace and companionship in each other, filling the void left by their families.

Entries.Title: The Golden Squacco Heron
Entries.Description: Two childhood friends search for the fabled Golden Squacco Heron, the reward to a treasure hunt unsolved for 29 years. As they continue their search, they make up their own games, to pass the time…

Entries.Title: Untitled Mockumentary Comedy
Entries.Description: Three student filmmakers set out to capture each other's inner life struggles in an avant-garde documentary, but as the lens turns inward and time begins to lose meaning, they drift into an existential spiral of insanity—where memory fractures, selves unravel, and nothing remains quite real.

Entries.Title: Doctor Imperfect and the Perfect Man
Entries.Description: A failing scientist, Azrael Thran, decides to clone himself as a last minute effort to achieve success and escape his controlling father.

Entries.Title: La Tournée du Trio
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Timeless
Entries.Description: Uncertain whether his bus will arrive, a hesitant and anxious young man begins to question the point of waiting. As he stands at the bus stop, his interactions with those who arrive lead him to reflect on the passing of time and how he should face it.

Entries.Title: Hotel Loo
Entries.Description: Murad is a well-known psychologist, appears as an expert on various social programs. A famous singer named Aliya seduces Murad and they decide to spend their first night at a hotel. Murad, in a fit of passion, involuntarily grabs Aliya by the throat and squeezes her tightly. As a result, Aliya faints from excitement. Murad thinks that Aliya is dead and panics. He looks for ways out of this difficult situation. Finally, he is forced to call his wife, Sabina, a forensic expert, for help...

Entries.Title: We Don't Say Retard Anymore
Entries.Description: When disabled Finnish influencer Y-Man attracts a loyal female fanbase, his jealous online girlfriend demands a meeting in America. However, his condition limits his ability to travel, testing the boundaries of his faith.

Entries.Title: Britpop Conservation Society
Entries.Description: Henry runs the Britpop Conservation Society and no one else cares. This mockumentary shows how everyone is a bit obsessed with something, but some more than others.

Entries.Title: Exhaustion Lines
Entries.Description: After nearly crashing his car, a sleep deprived drifter decides to find a place to get some much needed shut-eye. But one outrageous obstacle after another keeps him wide awake.

Entries.Title: 10 Little Bloggers
Entries.Description: The characters find themselves trapped in a film studio, where an enigmatic individual orchestrates a deadly game. Every ten minutes, the online audience votes to determine the next victim.

Entries.Title: Brother Sister Keeper
Entries.Description: When her brother goes missing following a painful breakup, a cynical young woman enlists the help of his ex in order to find him.

Entries.Title: Tupperware
Entries.Description: In a chaotic student apartment, a missing tupperware leads to a hilarious series of accusations and cultural clashes among four international roommates, only to reveal that the truth has been under their noses the entire time.

Entries.Title: Festival de Viña del Mar 2025: Edo Caroe
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Duck Sketch
Entries.Description: When a hand model for a dish soap commercial gets too immersed in his "role", arguments and turbulence on set ensue.

Entries.Title: Zombie Strain
Entries.Description: During the zombie apocalypse, survivors trapped in a sound stage make an amazing discovery about a potent strain of marijuana. But tensions rise, mistakes are made, and they start to wonder, who's more dangerous, the undead or each other?

Entries.Title: Astro TV
Entries.Description: TV astrologer Sigrid guides people through sleepless nights, but one caller seems worrying. Can Sigrid help them before Jupiter and Pluto align?

Entries.Title: The Legend of the Happy Worker
Entries.Description: Follows Joe who battles to save what he and others have spent years building.

Entries.Title: Mukk Gyi Feem Dabbi Cho Yaaro
Entries.Description: It centers on a relatable situation that spirals into chaos, leading to a wild road trip to Rajasthan.

Entries.Title: The Great Christmas Snow-In
Entries.Description: After his engagement is called off, Justin retreats to a secluded cabin meant for his honeymoon, only to be snowed in with Jane, his ex-fiancée’s cousin. As tension builds, a spark forms between them, but when Justin’s ex shows up with her new boyfriend, things get even more complicated. In the close quarters of the cabin, secrets unravel, leading to unexpected discoveries about love and second chances.

Entries.Title: 人间一天
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Friendzoned
Entries.Description: After Mikey gets a new girlfriend, his friend Claire, who friendzoned him, tries to get him. The film tells the story with awkward comedy with sudden transitions.

Entries.Title: Marketplace
Entries.Description: Upcoming comedy short film written and directed by Isaac Joesph

Entries.Title: How to Live Together
Entries.Description: Six roommates share a cramped four bedroom apartment. One moves out. Another moves in. In the process, the precarious balance of their routines is comically disrupted.

Entries.Title: Playa de lobos
Entries.Description: Manu works at a beach bar. Klaus won't leave the last beach chair. What seems like a clash between opposites turns suspicious when Manu doubts Klaus's presence is coincidental. Tension builds until Klaus makes a disturbing offer.

Entries.Title: De Knuppel
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Domestication of Vampires in Essex
Entries.Description: A trio of Essex girls offer their special brand of hospitality to a morose mysterious stranger.

Entries.Title: Kang Solah (From Kang Mak) x Nenek Gayung
Entries.Description: Solah Vincenzio returns to his hometown, accompanied by Fajrul, Jaka, and Supra. Solah imagines his homecoming will be celebrated like that of a hero but instead, he’s mistaken for a ghost. His disappointment deepens when he learns that the girl he’s long had feelings for, Dara Gonzales, is about to marry his own younger brother, Iqbal. However, their wedding is disrupted by terrifying appearances of a ghostly figure—Nenek Gayung, the corpse-washing spirit searching for her next victim to bathe. The only way to save Iqbal and Dara’s wedding is for Solah and his friends to confront Nenek Gayung and seek help from Kangmas Pusi.

Entries.Title: The Holy Office
Entries.Description: A writer, who wants to make a film about today's Chile, departs from the usual forms of filming to grasp the mystery of things. He approaches the desired film, in the middle of a relationship crisis, caused by Marcy, a disturbing woman-child who drags him into a fascinating crazy-love relationship. And because the writer understands that true creation involves detaching himself from any subjection to the practical world and accepting the catastrophic as a form of secular holiness, he performs, in the end, an act of immense generosity.

Entries.Title: John Cleese Packs It In
Entries.Description: Will he make it home ... or is this the end of the road?  One of the most recognisable figures in British comedy, John Cleese's career spans six decades - from his early days with the Cambridge Footlights to co-founding Monty Python, co-creating Fawlty Towers, and writing and starring in the Oscar-nominated “A Fish Called Wanda”. His unique brand of black humour has made him a global icon and intergalactic  treasure.

Entries.Title: A Charlie Brown Christmas
Entries.Description: Christmastime is here. Happiness and cheer.  And for Peanuts fans everywhere. It just wouldn't be Christmas without this classic holiday delight.  Christmas lights may be twinkling red and green, but Charlie Brown has the Yuletide blues. To get in the holiday spirit, he takes Lucy's advice and directs the Christmas play. And what's a Christmas play without a Christmas tree? But everyone makes fun of the short, spindly nevergreen Charlie Brown brings back - until the real meaning of Christmas works its magic once again in this Remastered Live-Action Edition with Improved Picture and Audio. Happy Holidays!

Entries.Title: Step 10
Entries.Description: When Phoebe goes on a camping trip with her best friend Kate, Something horrible happens and changes everything, leaving Phoebe and Kate questioning what's going on.

Entries.Title: Behind the Signal: The Making of Blood Signal 4G
Entries.Description: A behind the scenes look at the making of the fourth film in the groundbreaking Blood Signal franchise, in which the filmmakers attempt to once again break new ground in the horror genre.

Entries.Title: Just Beads
Entries.Description: An avid craftswoman is completely over her ex-husband through the power of beading.

Entries.Title: Clementine
Entries.Description: A young woman finds her childhood doll at her parents' yard sale.

Entries.Title: Gamophobia
Entries.Description: Marja always has a fear of starting a serious relationship. As a friend, Gupa always gives advice to Marja, even though he is still single.Marja and Kirina are ex-girlfriends who meet again. Their relationship always fails, Kirina thinks this is because of her actions. They agree to find the whereabouts of the Shaman and the Doll that Kirina used to come to play a trick on Marja. Their efforts fail. Marja's love for Kirina grows again, but it's too late.

Entries.Title: Big Jay Oakerson: They
Entries.Description: Part 2 of Big Jay Oakerson’s two-part crowd work comedy special, filmed live in Denver at Comedy Works.

Entries.Title: Baa-Baa!
Entries.Description: A family that just moved to their new city apartment, has to figure out what to do with a goat that was suddenly gifted as part of a charity program.

Entries.Title: Passionate Women
Entries.Description: Lilla, a forty-something couples therapist devoted to her family, is blindsided when her husband suddenly leaves her for a younger nail technician. Struggling with heartbreak, Lilla finds herself being pushed by her headstrong daughter, Zsófi, and her no-nonsense mother, Vilma, to snap out of her depression and start dating again. In a bid to lift her spirits, Vilma introduces Lilla to a charming journalist — but things take an unexpected turn when Zsófi discovers a potential match of her own for her mother.

Entries.Title: La paciente desconocida de Freud
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Fonso Y Las Paritarias
Entries.Description: Fonso, Las Paritarias, two clowns, a stray dog, gay cops, a biker and his girlfriend, and a cursed poet inhabit the irreverent and metafictional world of Fonso y Las Paritarias.

Entries.Title: SOKO Loco
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Yellow Face
Entries.Description: Tony winner David Henry Hwang’s comedy starring Daniel Dae Kim as an Asian American playwright who protests “yellowface” casting in the musical “Miss Saigon” only to mistakenly cast a white actor as the Asian lead in his own play.

Entries.Title: Number 2
Entries.Description: The Queens are back! Facing the prospects of being phased out with their old gags, the team engage in sideline odd jobs to keep their livelihoods aﬂoat. Chee Beng, who is moonlighting as a property agent got into a bad altercation while being humiliated during one of his viewings. The result of this bad PR causes Chee Beng to be expelled from the drag community and barred from performing in Singapore. However, an opportunity arises, a drag competition in Thailand! Chee Beng pushes for the team to compete and regain their former glory while dealing with his rebellious teenage son, Mason.

Entries.Title: Jakob Thrane: SART
Entries.Description: With Jakob Thrane's new comedy show Sart, he gives the audience plenty of opportunities to laugh at postmodern man. Have we all become too delicate? With his new show, Jakob exposes the delicate sides of us all, but is embarrassingly aware that every time he points at others, there are three fingers pointing back at himself and a thumb pointing at someone standing off to the side.

Entries.Title: How sweet
Entries.Description: Sweety, a runaway bride, accidentally tosses Adnan's beloved camera into the river. Determined to seek compensation, Adnan and his friend chase her to Barisal. There, they find themselves tangled in a web of troubles as Sweety struggles to escape another marriage. How will they get out of this mess?

Entries.Title: Galaxy 360: A Woman's Playground
Entries.Description: In 2195, women rule the world and men dream of getting married.

Entries.Title: Angél Pol
Entries.Description: Jati and Lastri form a traveling “dangdut” orchestra with a truck to survive among marginalized communities.

Entries.Title: Kultūras pils
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Friendchips
Entries.Description: Two hungry guys discover the meaning of ‘Friendchips’ when they see it right in front of them.

Entries.Title: Oh, Otto!
Entries.Description: Otto is 26 and has his life together. Or so he thinks. When his first love Boris dumps him and his best friend Lente leaves their beloved Brussels, he is left full of doubts and questions. He decides to fill his heart with fleeting love and searches for his place within the vibrant Brussels queer scene. With his online alter ego in his pocket, he dives into a world full of nocturnal escapades, gay bars and self-discovery.

Entries.Title: Sampling
Entries.Description: A punk guy, gifted with perfect pitch, invites various people in his recording studio to participate to his odd project.

Entries.Title: DIY
Entries.Description: After a bizarre mishap hanging a picture frame in her apartment, a young woman runs to check on her neighbor, inadvertently entering a life-or-death situation.

Entries.Title: Бесы. Верховенский
Entries.Description: Teenagers from the provincial town of Nechayevsk organize a club in which they repeat scenes from foreign films in real life. Their leader is determined to bring the matter to perfection, but everything changes when his right hand decides to leave the club.

Entries.Title: My Absurd Journey of True Loves First Kiss and How I Became Mortal
Entries.Description: An immortal man searches for true love.

Entries.Title: El monito se fue de viaje
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Govan Fair Queen
Entries.Description: Nine-year-old Abigail is reluctantly roped into the Govan Fair Queen competition by her grandmum Linda. With a holiday to Florida on the line and an old rivalry reignited, it's all to play for.

Entries.Title: I Didn't Like You
Entries.Description: As Emilia and Maxine spy on their best friend's first date, they come to realize the chemistry might not be between the couple they anticipated.

Entries.Title: Mothers, Lovers and Others
Entries.Description: This ensemble drama explores a number of interweaving relationships, all grappling with polyamory and sexual expression, amid the personal and societal expectations faced by each character.

Entries.Title: Universal
Entries.Description: A couple of academics enjoying a romantic break in a remote log cabin find their stay interrupted by someone who has tracked them down, seeking their help with what could be the biggest discovery in history...

Entries.Title: RAW 20 år
Entries.Description: RAW Comedy Club turns 20 and this is celebrated with a grand stand-up show in the Avicii Arena. Several of Sweden's most beloved comedians take the stage, including Måns Möller, Özz Nujen, Babben Larsson, Elina Du Rietz, Messiah Hallberg and others, to offer a great comedy show. Over 11,000 in the audience have a hard time keeping from laughing in what is the biggest stand-up show, so far, in Sweden.

Entries.Title: The People Upstairs
Entries.Description: A drama about two couples who meet due to noise between floors and have dinner together.

Entries.Title: La Bonne étoile
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Mandatory game
Entries.Description: Synopsis: The owner of the hall does strange things to advertise and make money...

Entries.Title: Dollar Store Killers
Entries.Description: Dollar $tore Killers" is a chilling thriller delving into the dark side of internet fame and disaffected youth. A true crime documentarian is pulled into the orbit of masked killers who livestream their disturbing acts, all while using everyday items from a dollar store. As reality blurs with online notoriety, the line between observer and accomplice vanishes.

Entries.Title: Erich's New Shirt
Entries.Description: After an unfortunate internet purchase, Erich finds himself with a problem: he now has a terrible shirt that threatens to ruin his life. Thankfully, his friend Robin has a way to get a replacement, but it comes at the cost of having to visit the enigmatic Shirt Dealer. Will Erich be able to get a new shirt, or will he be doomed to a life of shame?

Entries.Title: Dove osano le cicogne
Entries.Description: A couple is desperately looking to conceive a child and moves to Spain to get the help of a renowned doctor. Their plans change after they meet an apparently perfect girl that volunteers to carry on the pregnancy in their place.

Entries.Title: Sword of the Nightingale
Entries.Description: Thaddeus Nightingale, a bloodthirsty peasant looking to avenge the death of his family, is blessed with a blade by the gods. Armed with his new weapon, Thaddeus sets off to do battle with a very powerful necromancer, known as The Necromancer.

Entries.Title: Prom Party Massacre
Entries.Description: A gay high school student throws a swinging prom party in the hopes of finally wooing the football captain - but when popular kids start turning up dead, the partygoers discover a slasher killer amongst the student body!

Entries.Title: Sorella di Clausura
Entries.Description: 36-year-old Stela has higher education but unable to keep a job. Since she was 12, she's been in love with a Serbian musician from the former Yugoslavia. One of the musician's alleged mistresses promises Stela that she will help her meet her idol.

Entries.Title: Little Miss Sociopath
Entries.Description: A downtrodden daughter and her delusional boyfriend hatch a get-rich-quick scheme that involves fraud and a possible 10-year prison sentence.

Entries.Title: Portal to Hell
Entries.Description: After a debt-collector finds a portal to hell in a washing machine at his local laundromat, he’s propositioned into feeding it sinners to save his neighbor’s soul, maybe even at the expense of his own.

Entries.Title: Old Guys in Bed
Entries.Description: A gay film historian enlists his tech-savvy teenage niece to help him pursue the 70-year-old man of his dreams.

Entries.Title: One Hundred and Eighty
Entries.Description: The winner  of a regional women's darts final suspects her opponent of letting her win, and won't let her leave until she finds out why.

Entries.Title: Six Days in Spring
Entries.Description: Despite adversity, Sana wants her twins to have a spring vacation, but all her plans fall through. They secretly decide to stay in her former in-laws' villa on the Riviera, without telling anyone. Six days of sunshine that mark the end of innocence.

Entries.Title: The Wasps
Entries.Description: In ancient Athens, a son is forced to parent his crazy, conservative father-but things get complicated when dad's drunk war buddies come a-knocking.

Entries.Title: Walking with Students
Entries.Description: Join nature presenter Barnaby Clutterbuck in this deep dive into the rich and beautiful lives of the creatures that inhabit universities.

Entries.Title: Evil Puddle
Entries.Description: When evil, deadly water starts pooling around their feet, the citizens of Medialight must figure out a way stay alive until it evaporates.

Entries.Title: عيال إبليس
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Killerwood
Entries.Description: Fiction, reality and delusion gradually merge during the making of ‘Killerwood’, a thriller about a series of unsolved murders in modern-day Athens.

Entries.Title: Uno Para Todas
Entries.Description: Alba, Marta, and Celeste call upon supernatural forces to battle the greatest evil of all: a man.

Entries.Title: Into The Poster
Entries.Description: Three teens enter an old film shop only to discover all isn’t well in the quaint store

Entries.Title: Stinker
Entries.Description: While the district administration prepares for the arrival of high-ranking guests, local alcoholic Sadyq Ospanovich solves intergalactic problems.  Two large-scale events, developing simultaneously, lead to an inevitable conflict. The life-weary saleswoman Nadezhda and the naive policeman Baur find themselves between two fires.

Entries.Title: Chicken Town
Entries.Description: In a dead-end town in the East of England, a young man is released from prison after serving time for a crime he didn't commit. He returns home looking for answers only to become embroiled in a scheme to sell a crop of cannabis grown by an elderly neighbour on his allotment.

Entries.Title: White Guilt
Entries.Description: Eleven affluent white individuals in their twenties and thirties embark on a journey aboard a bus, seeking to assuage their white guilt through a pay-to-play service.

Entries.Title: Declan Sennott’s A Fair Trade
Entries.Description: In this black comedy crime epic, eighth grader Tommy Uris is pushed into a teenage drug dealing business run by his two classmates Frank Newton and Patrick Reynolds after walking in on a drug deal between them. As their business falls apart, so does their trust for each other, and they need to either resolve, or kill each other in the process.

Entries.Title: Manee Mana: Friendship
Entries.Description: The story begins in Lamsonthi District, a town known for its peace, simplicity, and self-sufficient way of life. The people are kind, and the children go to school happily. However, peace is rarely everlasting, especially when modernization arrives. With progress comes both good and bad, and when something harmful like drugs starts creeping into the community, trouble follows. This marks the beginning of an unavoidable mission for five children—Manee, Mana, Piti, Chujai, and Veera—who must face the growing threat and uncover the truth behind it.

Entries.Title: Moritz Neumeier: Unangenehm
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Incredible Snow Woman
Entries.Description: Travelling solo across Greenland, camping on an ice floe, single-handedly wrestling a bear. Not much daunts Coline Morel – except, perhaps, confronting her own existence when it starts to spiral out of control.

Entries.Title: Square Peg
Entries.Description: Edwin, a lonely, narcissistic vampire, returns home after a restock to lament about life and his yearning to be normal to his best friend Morris - a decapitated head that loathes his guts.

Entries.Title: A Light That Never Goes Out
Entries.Description: Successful classical flutist Pauli returns to his small hometown after a breakdown. Reconnecting with old schoolmate Iiris, he is drawn into experimental music. Pauli, who has always sought perfection, is drawn to her chaotic energy, and finds comfort in their sonic experiments.

Entries.Title: I Laugh, Therefore I Am
Entries.Description: Bruno quits his job after a divine revelation: God assures him that becoming a stand-up comedian is the only way to achieve wealth, fame and Carla’s love.

Entries.Title: Erwartet nicht zu viel
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Cameron James: Bangers
Entries.Description: Cameron James' full comedy special "Bangers" premieres on Grouse House YouTube 6 March 7pm AEDT!

Entries.Title: Crybaby
Entries.Description: In a utopian near future where crying has ceased to exist, an emotional young woman — the only person who can still shed tears — teams up with her protective older sister on a journey into the underground world of weeping.

Entries.Title: That Summer in Paris
Entries.Description: Paris, the 2024 Olympic Games. Blandine (30) arrives from Normandy to watch the swimming competitions. Disorientated by the hustle and bustle of the city where nothing seems to go her way, she navigates the chaos of Paris and an unexpected reunion.

Entries.Title: Rolling Papers
Entries.Description: Sebastian, working as a store clerk, finds his ordinary workday shaken up when he meets Silo, a free-spirited wanderer. Together they smoke weed and dream of a one-way ticket to Brazil.

Entries.Title: Gym Classes
Entries.Description: Siblings Clara and Pietro aren't close, but they share a hatred for the high school that she's recently started attending and that he graduated from years before. Forced to wait in the school with their father, familial tensions arise.

Entries.Title: Labyrinth of Lost Boys
Entries.Description: A kid from the country gets lost in the big city looking for love, going on a series of increasingly bizarre dates while a serial killer is on the loose targeting boys his age.

Entries.Title: Straatcoaches vs Aliens
Entries.Description: Best friends Amin and Mitchell work as street coaches in the lively neighbourhood of Schijndrecht. Not exactly a flashy job, but that changes when residents suddenly turn into creepy, slimy creatures. Together with a motley crew of local residents, the duo gets the ultimate chance to prove themselves.

Entries.Title: In the Nguyen Kitchen
Entries.Description: French-Vietnamese actress Yvonne Nguyen dreams of a successful career in musicals, to the great displeasure of her mother, who would like her to pursue a more serious path. When Yvonne has no choice but to move back home, both women are strangers to each other. But in the intimacy of the Vietnamese family restaurant’s kitchen, they grow closer. Meanwhile, Yvonne is still after her dreams and finally gets the chance to audition for a big show.

Entries.Title: Gateway to the Goulash
Entries.Description: A private detective and his assistant try to solve a series of killer food combinations in the city of Beloit, Wisconsin.

Entries.Title: Robbers
Entries.Description: Inspired by a viral theft trend, a wannabe musician schemes to afford studio time by convincing his bassist to burglarize a small business—but someone else might have the same idea.

Entries.Title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Chrome Alone 2 – Lost in New Jersey
Entries.Description: When a mysterious toy company seeks to profit off the turtles' new hero status, the brothers follow the clues to New Jersey and make a shocking discovery in this all new original short.

Entries.Title: Candy Bar
Entries.Description: A young girl thinks a man in the candy bar line looks like her dad.

Entries.Title: Essling
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Soda Pop Spencer Storms Atlanta
Entries.Description: When a naive online “soda influencer” is radicalized against the Coca-Cola Corporation by an AI misinformation video, he travels to Atlanta on January 6th to expose the conspiracy. He is joined by his friend/documentarian and a new cameraman hired off of Craigslist to film the journey. But what started as a righteous political cause turns into a nightmare of deceit, libations, and, ultimately, a horrific act of violence.

Entries.Title: Pasa Faho
Entries.Description: When Azubuike’s 12-year-old son moves in with him, the struggling shoe salesman finds himself balancing fatherhood and the slow collapse of his small shop. As the pair navigate their estrangement, the unspoken becomes a language of its own; one shaped by pride, duty, and the quiet weight of expectation. With the future of both the shop and their relationship hanging in the balance, father and son must find a way to bridge the distance between one another.

Entries.Title: Thanks For Having Me
Entries.Description: A former YouTube star must reconnect with his opportunistic father while attempting to attain independence and come to terms with his exploited childhood.

Entries.Title: Uma Advogada Brilhante
Entries.Description: In the film, actor Leandro Hassum plays lawyer Michelle Barbieri, known as Mike. The company where he works is bought by an office that decides to keep only women in its positions. However, the character is not fired, since, due to her name, the HR department believes that she is a woman. The character then starts dressing in women's clothing to stay in his job.

Entries.Title: Three Chicken Dinners
Entries.Description: Grayson, a young film production assistant, must get food for set from a small-town Wisconsin dive bar. Facing pressures to perform on his first day, he struggles to please the obstinate locals that view him as an ill-intentioned outsider.

Entries.Title: the Occasion
Entries.Description: Jack Jarlsberg is a guest to one of the most awkward dinner parties of his life. Invited by his mute friend Boots, Jack explores the stranger parts of the apartment with emphatic glee. Peter Alfred Runsible, the uninvited guest, is on a quest to retrieve all of his belongings after a frustrating breakup with the long standing tenant Shelby Denehee. Her girlfriend Bonnie Watt has made a feast for the eyes and guts of all these broken people. Boots, quiet for his own reasons, takes notes on every little thing that could unlock the mysteries of the Apartment. Shelby would love more than anything for everyone to leave. Together they take an anxiety ridden journey into the human psyche thru bread crumbs, peanuts, and otherworldly delights.

Entries.Title: Clues
Entries.Description: A detective investigates a crime scene using knowledge from a familiar board game.

Eternal youth, the absence of problems and the liberty to do whatever he wants seem to be the perfect future. But when he finds out that time stopped passing only for him, all of a sudden, what seemed to be a dream come true, becomes a nightmare.
