Entries.Description: When the best friend of the charming and always funny erotica poet Ines moves in with her boyfriend, Ines' life gets disrupted and she is confronted with a childhood trauma that she thought had been hidden away a long time ago.

Entries.Title: Kelsey Cook: Mark Your Territory
Entries.Description: A comedian shares hilarious takes on dating an older guy, health care adventures, family challenges, and life changes after relocating to Minnesota with her fellow comic boyfriend.

Entries.Title: Dragon's Breath
Entries.Description: A group of middle schoolers must convince their friend to perform in the school talent show after she reveals an embarrassing and fantastical secret.

Entries.Title: Asog
Entries.Description: This unique narrative incorporating documentary elements follows Rey, a 40-year-old non-binary teacher and typhoon survivor, on a roadtrip to fame. With surreal comedy and social portrait realism, filmmaker Seán‌ Devlin explores climate change, LGBTQ+ issues, and the impact of colonialism on contemporary Philippines.

Entries.Title: National Theatre Live: The Fifth Step
Entries.Description: Olivier Award-winner Jack Lowden (Slow Horses, Dunkirk) is joined by Emmy and BAFTA-winner Martin Freeman (The Hobbit, The Responder) in the critically acclaimed and subversively funny new play by David Ireland.  After years in the 12-step programme of Alcoholics Anonymous, James becomes a sponsor to newcomer Luka. The pair bond over black coffee, trade stories and build a fragile friendship out of their shared experiences. But as Luka approaches step five – the moment of confession – dangerous truths emerge, threatening the trust on which both of their recoveries depend.  Finn den Hertog directs the provocative and entertaining production filmed live from @sohoplace on London’s West End.

Entries.Title: Peninsula
Entries.Description: A weekend in the city park is meant for recreational activities. During a twenty minute period, several men seek out a way to pass their time at a cruising spot located in the heart of a small peninsular grove.

Entries.Title: Cheerleader Camp Elimination
Entries.Description: Mascots fight cheerleaders, all with suspicious pasts, where the winner takes all--including lives--to be on top of the pyramid.

Entries.Title: Check In Cheque Out
Entries.Description: A Bengali movie directed by Satrajit Sen and produced by Meghdut RoyChowdhury.

Entries.Title: Stumbl-
Entries.Description: The young lady is chased by the killer in a bridge falling into pieces, until she stumbles

Entries.Title: TAKEN
Entries.Description: When of bunch of friends go missing, its up to three friends to solve the mystery.

Entries.Title: Mr.Rani
Entries.Description: Raja dreams of becoming an actor but is forced by his parents to become an engineer. While struggling to become an actor, he accidentally gets a chance to play a girl's role and goes on to become the No. 1 actress.

Entries.Title: New India
Entries.Description: In this sharp and unapologetic stand-up special, comedian Kunal Kamra dissects the absurdities of modern-day India with biting satire and fearless political commentary. Tackling topics like hyper-nationalism, media propaganda, and political hypocrisy, Kamra delivers brutally honest punchlines aimed at both leaders and the culture of blind devotion. With viral-worthy bits-including a controversial parody targeting Maharashtra's Deputy CM Eknath Shinde-Kamra walks the line between humor and dissent, sparking both laughter and backlash. Naya Bharat is a bold reflection of a country caught between comedy and chaos.

Entries.Title: Kein Kino
Entries.Description: A neurotic film bro learns his lesson.

Entries.Title: MY KIND OF PEOPLE
Entries.Description: After a DNA test uncovers his father's adoption, a proud paesano from Providence, Rhode Island grapples with the revelation that he's not actually Italian American, and never has been. With the foundation of his identity destroyed, and his familial bonds broken, he begins to spiral.

Entries.Title: Ratols & Ransom
Entries.Description: A bustling and average police precinct is disrupted when a frantic teenager enters with a huge problem.

Entries.Title: My Name Is Love
Entries.Description: Taptal is the name of the main character, a middle-aged woman played by Tatyana Legantieva. She lives in a village with her parents and her brother's family. For the past 5 years, she has been dreaming of changing her life, but she doesn't know where to start... On her birthday, she makes a wish to get married. That same evening, she hears a horoscope that says she needs to act right now! And then she sees an ad for the reality show "The Bachelor" on NVK "Sakha". Love decides to go to Yakutsk and find her soulmate on the reality show. She is not stopped even by the fact that her vacation was suddenly cancelled...

Entries.Title: Esperando a Godoy
Entries.Description: A group of left-wing intellectuals take over a building with the purpose of forming a Ministry of Culture, however, the workers oppose the takeover. Intellectuals and workers establish a coexistence pact while waiting for Godoy, a union boss. After conflicts over ideological differences about culture, the takeover dissolves, just when Godoy appears with a totally elitist and apolitical discourse.

Entries.Title: Mimi au pays du métal
Entries.Description: Between the hydraulic press and the plasma saw, Mimi, a young factory worker, dreams of escaping in the sun with her two best friends Iris and Chris. When their boss Mister Babin refuses to grant them their leave, Mimi is ready to do anything to make him change his mind.

Entries.Title: Musical Horrifically Funny Women
Entries.Description: Seok-gu, a documentary producer specializing in current events and accusations, wishes to find meaning in the dark and inconvenient things of the world. Old women who fell in love with Hangeul (Korean alphabet) appear in front of him. Over and over again, they say "old people should die," but their joyful lives are more exciting than anyone else's.

Entries.Title: Walzer Allein
Entries.Description: A man escapes to a bar late at night to avoid being alone. But when more and more partying people come into the bar and start encouraging him to join in, he is faced with the question: fit in or remain himself.

Entries.Title: Miłość ma cztery łapy
Entries.Description: Jowita, who seemingly has it all with her boyfriend Krystian, yearns to start a family, just to discover he isn’t ready for commitment. When Krystian adopts a shelter dog named Lucy to steer Jowita’s affections, the clever border collie sets Jowita on a path toward a new suitor, forcing Krystian to prove his love or lose her forever.

Entries.Title: CLICKBAIT
Entries.Description: An ensemble of influencers collide when a hard drive falls into the wrong hands.

Entries.Title: Grandma Nai Who Played Favorites
Entries.Description: During her chaotic family’s Qingming visit, dead Grandma Nai sneaks away from her peaceful afterlife after overhearing that her queer grandson is about to get engaged to a woman.

Entries.Title: Caroline Vigneaux : faut-il toujours dire la vérité aux enfants ?
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Asparagus Bear
Entries.Description: The residents of a quiet Mediterranean town are thrown into speculation overdrive with the unusual appearance of a bear in the midst of asparagus season.

Entries.Title: Vacuumin’ Around
Entries.Description: A documentary about a person who cleans his room with a vacuum cleaner, filled with disasters and mishaps.

Entries.Title: Rotina
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Telecau Beach Movie
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Assis, pas bouger
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: По-братски
Entries.Description: Two married couples of neighbors, the Lebedevs and the Bubliks, are forced to go on a long journey together to one of the northern cities - Nezhnogore, where some are going to get divorced, and others - to spend the holidays. But crazy adventures and discoveries await them along the way.

Entries.Title: Zombucha!
Entries.Description: After one particularly catastrophic day at their respective workplaces, busy professionals Maddie and Leo find themselves both unemployed. Dreaming of a fresh start but needing reliable income to support the family they hope to start together, the couple have a chance encounter with Kai, a smouldering kombucha artisan raking in the cash. Seeing dollar signs, Maddie and Leo swipe Kai's kombucha culture to kickstart their own enterprise, but when they mix in some mysterious herbs from a neighbour's garden, the culture gains sentience and proves deadly. With their relationship hanging by a thread, can Maddie and Leo unite to prevent a full-blown zombucha apocalypse?

Entries.Title: Tongue
Entries.Description: When a college student discovers her tongue can read minds through touch, she reluctantly teams up with her best friend to solve a mysterious death at a frat party—but as she licks her way through a parade of suspects, she uncovers a dark secret that could cost her more than just her sanity.

Entries.Title: The End of The Punchline
Entries.Description: Set in 2011, we follow a trio of high school boys, Nick, Edd, and Viggo, as their senior year of high school comes to a halt when a secret kept by a shady government foundation is exposed, turning our heroes' worlds upside down.

Entries.Title: Ein ganz großes Ding
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Messy Legends
Entries.Description: A group of wayward Millennials embark on their own unique, regressive journeys during the same night out on Montreal’s Plateau strip, chasing the past and losing the plot.

Entries.Title: Fakhr AlSuwaidi
Entries.Description: In a new step, the director of Al-Suwaidi National High School decides to establish a Sharia class, especially with the presence of a number of students with rebellious behavior.

Entries.Title: El Vestimudo
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Poetry Syndrome
Entries.Description: Two young souls meet for a poetry reading in an urban forest pavilion. The woman begins: “If you love too much, you become a ghost.” She hopes to convey her feelings through poetry, but the man is fixated on the form.

Entries.Title: Slowly
Entries.Description: A tale of unrequited love told in front of the backdrop of modern technology.

Entries.Title: Abrahams Special Day
Entries.Description: A baby experiences family drama at a special celebration. This event takes a dark, mysterious turn.

Entries.Title: Cemeterror
Entries.Description: A serial killer evades police by taking up a job as groundskeeper of a cemetery. When a gang of punks throw a party there, the killer dispatches them one by one.

Entries.Title: Arlekino
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Mega Blood Moon: The Freelancer
Entries.Description: After arriving early to an empty workplace on his last day of work, a Freelancer discovers that he may not be alone. Under the light of the mysterious Mega Blood Moon, he'll find out that his last day is going to be a fight... to the death.

Entries.Title: License to Love
Entries.Description: For many years Katerina has worked at a civilian registry office. Every day she binds together loving hearts while her own family life has been on hold for some time. Katerina’s husband has been in a coma for 5 years and her whole family has been living as though in a coma too.

Entries.Title: Sarah Silverman: PostMortem
Entries.Description: After losing her parents, Sarah Silverman finds laughter and solace in celebrating their lives, from deathbed binge-watching to an ill-timed fart.

Entries.Title: Slouching Towards Branson
Entries.Description: The film version of the theatrical performance "Slouching Towards Branson," shot at concerts during the 2024 "Slouching Towards Bethlehem Tour." Written and performed by Will Wood, shot & edited by Jake Feldman.

Entries.Title: My Uncle Jens
Entries.Description: Akam, a young literature teacher, lives a comfortable life in Oslo until his estranged uncle from the Iranian part of Kurdistan comes for a surprise visit. Despite limited space in his shared flat with friends, Akam feels obligated to invite his uncle to stay for a few days. However, his uncle quickly makes himself at home and shows no sign of leaving anytime soon. Torn between his sense of familial duty and growing tension in the flat, Akam begins to suspect there's more to his uncle's visit than just a casual trip. What follows is a series of revelations and unexpected events that could have life changing consequences for them both.

Entries.Title: I Am Happy
Entries.Description: Cheerful and mischievous, Moon Haet-nim is a freelance voice actor. She voices the main character, Happy Mong, in the lively children's animation Detective Happy Mong—a role that perfectly fits her personality. One day, while accompanying her friend Young-hee, who is struggling with depression, to a psychiatric clinic, Haet-nim takes a test out of boredom... The result? Depression?! This can't be real! In denial, Haet-nim embarks on a journey, just like her animated character, to uncover the cause of her depression!

Entries.Title: Пари
Entries.Description: The story of a dispute between two friends, screenwriter Guerra Tonino and director Federico Fellini, about creating the shortest script, 10 seconds long, based on real events.

Entries.Title: Clown-N-Out in Valley Village
Entries.Description: In "Clown n Out," a down-on-his-luck clown gets caught up in a dangerous criminal underworld and must navigate a treacherous maze of lies, deceit, and violence to survive.

Entries.Title: En avant, en arrière
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Hi, Hide, High
Entries.Description: Hi, Hide, High

Entries.Title: Confessions of a Romance Narrator
Entries.Description: A romance audiobook narrator quarrels with her noisy neighbor, pines for her co-worker, and races to meet her deadlines, all while struggling to find her voice.

Entries.Title: Appendage
Entries.Description: Emma’s quiet morning of work is interrupted as invading creatures from another planet arrive, bearing striking resemblances to certain appendages.

Entries.Title: O Combinado Não Sai Caro
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Steal My Girl
Entries.Description: Amidst the anxiety of their impending graduation from UW, 2 best friends must decide whether to take a chance on something new blossoming between them.

Entries.Title: Frankie Maniac Woman
Entries.Description: Battling against the legacy of childhood trauma, internalised misogyny, and the image-obsessed fat shaming of the LA music business, aspiring singer-songwriter Frankie Ramirez finally snaps, with bloody results.

Entries.Title: The Eviction
Entries.Description: A group of university dorm students tackle the ethical dilemma of whether or not to evict one of their own over a morally ambiguous offence. Does the punishment fit the crime?

Entries.Title: Max Amini: Randomly Selected
Entries.Description: Max Amini’s comedy special is here, straight from the world tour—where the crowd was on fire, but his TSA stories might land him on a no-fly list.  In Randomly Selected, Max brings his signature charm, quick wit, and razor-sharp crowd work to screens from all across the globe. His unique blend of humor is on full display while reflecting on a career that’s put him in front of crowds on almost every continent. At Max’s show you see people from all backgrounds, colors and cultures it’s like being at the United Nations of comedy.  From chaotic travel adventures to family anecdotes and unexpected moments with the audience, this special is a celebration of everything that makes Max one of the most dynamic comedians of his time. Buckle up for laughs, surprises, and the one-of-a-kind storytelling that only Max Amini can deliver.  Randomly Selected is not just a comedy special; it’s an experience. Enjoy it!

Entries.Title: Luke Null: Pretty Songs, Dirty Words
Entries.Description: Luke Null’s comedy special ‘Pretty Songs, Dirty Words’

Entries.Title: Steven Rogers: Half of We
Entries.Description: In his second stand-up special, produced by comedy icons Nate Bargatze and Brian Regan, Steven Rogers blends wit and vulnerability as he shares relatable mishaps, personal struggles, and stories from his engagement — all building to a shocking twist.

Entries.Title: The Skipper Social Quarter Hour
Entries.Description: The Skipper is a television personality who likes to collect the strangest guests to talk to, from all walks of life. Creatures like The Mothman or Dick Cheney. In trying to contain a quarter hour of quality television, things go arise as his broadcast is interrupted by video commentators and a man who kidnaps everyone he suspects is a werewolf.

Entries.Title: ¡Hasta enterrarlos!
Entries.Description: The one with a Neoesperpento style. (Synopsis pending)

Entries.Title: Part Time Messiah
Entries.Description: A streamer accidentally joins a cult.

Entries.Title: Chelonoidis Carbonaria
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Haunted House of Pancakes
Entries.Description: On Halloween night an evil waffle maker transforms all the food in a sleazy diner into killer creatures out for revenge against the patrons.

Entries.Title: The Human Supremacist
Entries.Description: To fight plant and animal cruelty, a vegan joins a cult and must harness photosynthesis before starving to death.

Entries.Title: My Roommate's a Vampire
Entries.Description: Wesley thinks his roommate Max who claims he is terminally ill is secretly a vampire. Is Max telling the truth, or will his deception get the best of Wesley?

Entries.Title: What Happens After the Massacre?
Entries.Description: Dawn has illuminated Camp Kiwassee, and after a night of brutal killings from the infamous Red Face, Mike and Henry are tasked with putting the pieces of the camp back together.

Entries.Title: Mulvahill
Entries.Description: A young South Boston realtor decides to sell the family home, against the wishes of his townie uncle. But after making a gruesome discovery, the two have to get rid of the problem before developers come.

Entries.Title: Guy Meets Girl
Entries.Description: A romantic comedy with a twist.

Entries.Title: Parent-Teacher Conference
Entries.Description: When the daughter of a teacher wins the school presidential election, outraged parents suspect fraud and convene a parents’ meeting that spirals into fierce debates, exposing gaps in upbringing and revealing secrets no one could have imagined.

Entries.Title: Screw Mickiewicz 2
Entries.Description: The rebellious IIIB crew and their unconventional teacher Jan Sienkiewicz are back! Love, troubles and school dramas make up everyday life of Dante, Nel and the whole gang. It is joined now by a young mathematical genius - Korek. The guys intend to teach him how to pick up girls, but it turns out that their know-how is rather theoretical…

Entries.Title: Молоко матери
Entries.Description: A satirical story about a world where adult children continue to drink their mothers' milk. The mother of the main character Olya, tired of such a life, decides to deceive her daughter and declares that the milk has disappeared. Olya spends time with her mother and, getting closer to her, looks for ways to get the milk back.

Entries.Title: Passion Pop
Entries.Description: A woman on the eve of her 30th birthday is given a surprise gift she'll never forget.

Entries.Title: Dela Cruz, Juan P.
Entries.Description: After being forced to resign from his previous job, Juan attempts to apply for a new one with absurd qualifications.

Entries.Title: Plateau
Entries.Description: After the death of his mother, Kareem decides to write a screenplay based on the lives of him and his friends.

Entries.Title: The Nature Man
Entries.Description: Two ghost-seeking Youtubers happen to meet the bizarre man who lives in the forest by himself.

Entries.Title: Through The Grapevine
Entries.Description: Wesley, an awkward, plant-enthused community radio host has his daily life and radio show documented by a youth film group. We watch as his simple, lonely life unfolds over the course of this mocumentary, with some appearances from family and friends (questionable) sprinkled throughout. However, beyond the laughs and heart-wrenching moments, a somewhat darker truth of Wesley's life reveals itself in the film's final act.

Entries.Title: Amore Bestiale
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: What's The Deal With Birds?
Entries.Description: A trailblazing young birder sets out to answer the age-old question – what’s the deal with birds? When a strange bird offers her answers, things begin to take flight.

Entries.Title: Vitor&Marina
Entries.Description: Vitor is 18 years old. Recently graduated from high school, he's not quite sure what to do with his life. He enjoys soccer, watches superhero movies, and plays video games in his free time. Vitor is also extremely romantic—in his own way. Marina is 24 years old and a Virgo. Finishing the final semester of her veterinary medicine degree at the university she always dreamed of, she's preparing for a new chapter in her life. She likes Brazilian Popular Music (MPB), astrology, cycling, and French cinema. Marina isn’t easily won over—until now. In a completely awkward date, Vitor and Marina discover what their age difference can bring.

Entries.Title: Literally Slay!
Entries.Description: A Grooks Spinoff series starring Angela Smith, a True-Crime influencer who attempts to solve crimes, from renowned director Carter Canfield

Entries.Title: Joe List: Small Ball
Entries.Description: Showcasing List's sardonic comedic style and self-depricating humor, Small Ball finds him tackling themes of fatherhood, friendship, and the absurdities of everday life shortly after the birth of his first child.

Entries.Title: Lady Attila
Entries.Description: Agathe loves tractors, and rock! She works in the family farm machinery garage with her father and older brother. When she finds out about an upcoming Airguitar competition, she decides to enter, but her brother doesn't see it that way.

Entries.Title: Aşağı Mahalle
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: No Trainers
Entries.Description: Three friends go overboard with a celebration and accidentally set a local mobster's new car wash on fire. With only 30 days to pay for the damages, they decide to find a better-paying job — becoming male strippers.

Entries.Title: Distorted Consciousness
Entries.Description: A college student, Spencer, parties with a friend, Ethan, and uses drugs to escape the overwhelming stress of everyday life, but what starts as a fun way to cope quickly spirals into nightmarish hallucinations. As her grip on reality weakens, she struggles to distinguish between what is real and what’s imagined. Her mental state deteriorates leading to a traumatizing internal /external battle that threatens her as the night continues, the boundary of sanity become increasingly blurred, pushing towards breaking point.

Entries.Title: Growing Pains
Entries.Description: Two best friends reevaluate their friendship all while driving aimlessly in a car.

Entries.Title: I'll Be Home for National Margarita Day
Entries.Description: When a big-city developer threatens a town holiday tradition, exes Liz and Sam must team up to stop him.

Entries.Title: Full Metal Basket
Entries.Description: France, 2025. 99.9% of the country's city stadiums are occupied by men, only one field stands free from their conquest.

Entries.Title: Sunday Sauce
Entries.Description: A repressed father. A buried secret. A chaotic family dinner. As tensions rise, Catholic guilt warps reality—and his hidden desires erupt into something surreal.

Entries.Title: Regal Studio Presents: My Stage Mom
Entries.Description: With the hopes of fulfilling her dreams to be an actress, Joy pushes her daugther to audition for a lead role in a movie.

Entries.Title: Bury Your Gays
Entries.Description: Grace, a masc-presenting queer actor, is shooting yet another death scene on a low-budget hospital drama—something she blames on her management. But this time, she snaps, arguing her character has more potential. When the director refuses, she storms off set—only to step into a surreal white void. There, she finds a woman in a white power suit behind a desk—an iconic queer actor from her childhood. Spotting headshots scattered across the desk and a whiteboard covered in faces circling the word death, Grace assumes the woman is now an agent.

Entries.Title: Kadukka
Entries.Description: In a peaceful village, Two Young best Friends fall for the same Beautiful Girl. What starts as friendship soon turns into a comedy-filled Love war. Each tries to win her heart with charm, tricks, and emotions, but the girl has a surprise of her own is shown in a Comedy Suspense with Fun filled power packed manner.

Entries.Title: Altweibersommer
Entries.Description: Astrid, Elli and Isabella go camping together as they used to. However, not only because Elli has breast cancer, nothing is like it used to be. Only when Astrid steals the savings of a man who has died in an accident the three leave old habits to renew their friendship in Italy.

Entries.Title: Sur la route de papa
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Vem fan är Hugo Alfvén?
Entries.Description: The conductor starts a symphony by the Swedish composer Hugo Alfvén in front of a sea of ​​graying heads. But playing to an aging crowd is proving to have its challenges. Questions about the survival and relevance of classical music are brought to a head in a satire that feels relatable to anyone who has visited the country's cultural institutions.

Entries.Title: Sci-Fan: The Movie
Entries.Description: Years after abandoning their popular YouTube channel and going their separate ways, Bree and Felix are approached with an offer to bring back Sci-Fan for one last project.

Entries.Title: Old Man
Entries.Description: Lewis Segovia, a naive young director, abandons his film mid-production in search of "meaning." As pressure from his crew mounts, the line between fiction and reality blurs, forcing him to confront his broken past to complete the project.

Entries.Title: Hunter's Refuge
Entries.Description: Fast on his feet with a fat mustache, short stature, and investigative gaze. For a couple of days in the mountain, in his native land, we approach a man, strange and loud but nevertheless genuine and sensitive, a hunter. In his own way, Mr. Sotiris shines light on our bond with nature, history and man.

Entries.Title: Multi Theater
Entries.Description: New Comedy Theater

Entries.Title: Twin Flame
Entries.Description: Siji Martin, a destitute but determined young man, opts to navigate the upper-class world in Nigeria by getting engaged to a wealthy heiress. When his true love from his past arrives from the USA, he must decide what is more important.

Entries.Title: Like Us
Entries.Description: After the police officer Bob Stubbings was murdered by the mysterious Umbrella Killer, Bob's two partners Shawn, and David vow to take their revenge to defeat the Umbrella Killer. However, Shawn and David's plans change when Police Captain Donovan assigns the new officer Casey on to their case. Shawn and David must learn if Casey is truly Like Us.

Entries.Title: Jean Jacket
Entries.Description: Jean Jacket needs to win big at the lottery to get back her dreams. Will today be the day her number is drawn?

Entries.Title: Being Famous for Beginners
Entries.Description: Author Gregor writes successful romance novels under a female pseudonym and makes his readers' hearts beat faster. When a woman suddenly has to appear on stage at an awards ceremony to protect his secret identity, his publisher comes under pressure. Without further ado, she hires the quick-witted cab driver Elke, who has clear ideas about how this literary double role should be played.

Entries.Title: Sold! Who Broke the Australian Dream?
Entries.Description: Mark Humphries examines Australia's housing crisis, with renters, journos and comics asking who broke the dream and how can the country fix it before it's too late.

Entries.Title: Ali Siddiq: Rugged
Entries.Description: Ali Siddiq is many things—a master storyteller, a comedy powerhouse—but a handyman?  Not even close. In his brand-new special, RUGGED, Ali trades the past gripping tales of his Domino Effect series (40+ million views on YouTube!) for a hilarious deep dive into his current home life, where his DIY attempts go horribly wrong.  From botched repairs and general home maintenance failures, to a family that has zero faith in his handyman skills, Ali delivers his signature blend of sharp wit and real-life storytelling. You’re going to laugh, cringe, and feel a little better about your own abilities.

Entries.Title: Роман с того света
Entries.Description: 1989. A young garbage truck driver and musician Roma, far from the ideals of virtue, finds a carpet with mystical properties that takes him to the future so that he can correct the mistakes of the past.

Entries.Title: Duvet
Entries.Description: A woman's day unravels when she accidentally gets trapped in her duvet cover.

Entries.Title: F*CKS NEWS: Demandados en Pantalla Grande
Entries.Description: “Coming to Movistar F*cks News” takes us behind the scenes of an unprecedented event, showcasing the emotion, chaos and humanity of its creators, Camilo Pardo and Camilo Sánchez. As they prepare to fill the Movistar Arena with their irreverent show, F*cks News, the documentary reveals the balance between their meticulous preparation and creative chaos. It highlights the backstage moments, the energy of the audience and the surprises that make this event a cultural phenomenon.

Entries.Title: Grey Days
Entries.Description: Teenage boy Jake navigates his way through Secondary School in Glasgow and the violent culture. Jake becomes more and more involved in the fighting scene after being persuaded by his best friend Camron to fight a classmate in his school...

Entries.Title: Crazy Old Lady
Entries.Description: Pedro receives a desperate message from an ex-girlfriend asking him to look after her senile mother, Alicia. What seems like a simple mission soon becomes his worst nightmare. Pedro needs to escape; but Alicia won’t let him...

Entries.Title: Как холодцы попадают в холодильник
Entries.Description: A thirty-year-old amusement park worker named Vitaly is looking for his missing bride together with his psychic mother.

Entries.Title: #300Letters
Entries.Description: Jero (25) and Tom (25) are the perfect couple everyone wants to be. Jero takes care of his aesthetics and his cryptocurrencies. Tom is alternative and loves poetry. On the day of their first anniversary, Tom abandons Jero and, as his only explanation, leaves a box with 300 letters. Jero, reading them, discovers a different Tom and the great love story they were living collapses under the title of "The Jero Project". But all pain has an end and the hope of a new love could be the cure for their suffering.

Entries.Title: Rosimeire´s Baby
Entries.Description: Rosimeire has been knocked up by an extraterrestrial and now has to deal with his disappearance and a film crew chasing her.

Entries.Title: Larry the Cable Guy: It's a Gift
Entries.Description: A stand-up special featuring Larry the Cable Guy at his best, delivering all new jokes with his signature rapid fire wit. Filmed at the historic Capitol Theater in Clearwater, Florida, this high energy show is packed with laughs and classic Larry charm.

Entries.Title: The Murders of Whitney Manor
Entries.Description: After murdering his business partner Donald Whitney is haunted by his ghost. Ten years later a familiar priest gets stopped in the rain and seeks shelter in Whitney manor for the night.

Entries.Title: Wash is forbidden from publishing
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Boss Up, The Musical
Entries.Description: Get ready to boss up and break out in song! Boss Up, The Musical is the dazzling, laugh-out-loud feature film debut of viral sensation Tony Talks (Antonio Baldwin), bringing his beloved character Cassandra to life in a fabulous, larger-than-life spectacle. When high-powered executive Cassandra—flawless, fierce, and always in charge—suddenly gets fired, her world turns upside down. Stripped of her title and prestige, she embarks on a hilarious and heartfelt journey of self-discovery, proving that true confidence comes from within. Featuring original songs, show-stopping dance numbers, and side-splitting performances—including a scene-stealing turn by musical artist Ocean Kelly—this musical comedy is an instant classic.

Entries.Title: Naale Rajaa Koli Majaa
Entries.Description: On the day of Gandhi Jayanti, when meat sale is prohibited nationwide, an 11-year-old girl goes on a quirky adventure in pursuit of a forbidden chicken curry.

Entries.Title: Hello, Spring
Entries.Description: A rebellious student sparks a transformative journey for a traditional Chinese teacher. Confronted by Xiaohua, a defiant pupil in his writing class, Teacher Ma's conventional methods are challenged. On the verge of conflict, they discover unexpected common ground, catalyzing a profound change in their lives and the constrictive educational system. As the academic year draws to a close, a blossoming of creativity and understanding unfolds, heralding the rebirth of a teacher.

Entries.Title: The Rise Of Harris Banks
Entries.Description: A film displaying the adventures of Harris Banks and his best friend, James Chazwick.

Entries.Title: Tamales
Entries.Description: The film tells the story of Rosa, a tamale maker from the Quebrada de Humahuaca, who invested all her life savings in gold nuggets and suddenly passes away. Her physical disappearance unleashes the madness of her dystopian family, who enter into conflict over the fortune that Rosa left hidden. In the midst of the chaos, Matías, her beloved grandson, must decide whether to escape the madness or embrace his destiny.

Entries.Title: We Are Always Hiding
Entries.Description: Trevor seeks a resolution amid a life filled with confusion and ennui.

Entries.Title: No. 5
Entries.Description: A group of American Military Intelligence officers are given a new form of torture to get information out of a captured pilot.

Entries.Title: A THING ABOUT NOBODY
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Fishy Friends
Entries.Description: When friendship meets competition at a roadside fish stand, things get messy fast.

Entries.Title: Lost Dog
Entries.Description: Lost dog' is a film about Jim, who, funnily enough, is on the search for his lost dog after she ran off in the park. Or at least we think he is, he gets easily distracted and we're not 100% sure the dog even exists. So maybe it's not a film about a lost dog, maybe it's a comedy about loneliness and the desperate need for meaningful human connection.

Entries.Title: Red Egg & Ginger
Entries.Description: Hannah, a half-white and half-Chinese teenager, meets her 100% Chinese half-sister for the first time at an event to celebrate her birth, forcing Hannah to question where she fits in.

Entries.Title: Dive Tour Documentary
Entries.Description: The full tour doc, with all episodes combined & some unseen footage.

Entries.Title: L'Effet Guêpe
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Bluffmaster Gujjubhai
Entries.Description: The craziest Gujjubhai adventure where chaos happens as a mysterious girl proposes Gujjubhai in front of his wife, and his mother-in-law is supposed to arrive with ₹10 crore as per his father-in-law’s wish. Can Gujjubhai tackle all this through his bluff and insane hilarity?

Entries.Title: Just For You, Budiman
Entries.Description: Due to his father's back pain, Ilham must become an impromptu courier, promising to take him to a massage parlor at 3 p.m. However, along the way, he encounters a slew of drama. From angry customers, dead phones, broken-down motorcycles, to rumors that the final recipient is a former cannibal! There's only one mysterious package left. Who exactly is this "Budiman"?

Entries.Title: Alan at Night
Entries.Description: An internet prankster documents the increasingly odd behavior of his new roommate, Alan.

Entries.Title: The Men From Down Under
Entries.Description: Two Australian gangsters attempt to have a peaceful picnic but they soon become suspicious of each others actions and the would be peaceful getaway plunges into total madness.

Entries.Title: Alistair in the Attic
Entries.Description: Henry pays a visit to his cousin Colin, a sculptor and social recluse.

Entries.Title: Neustadt by Night
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Slight Change Of Plans
Entries.Description: A sticky note. A smile. A plan. And a tiny little "ting" that changes everything

Entries.Title: His Last Cigarette
Entries.Description: First short film made by Marcus van Aefst & Luka Welling.

Entries.Title: Cristela Alonzo: Upper Classy
Entries.Description: Cristela seeks joy through various experiences - outdoing her old bully, overdoing spa treatments, and taking her first family vacation - while teaching everyone to embrace life's pleasures.

Entries.Title: Arrebol
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Evil Bookstore
Entries.Description: When an innocent bookstore awakens a century-old evil, a world of terror rises. Dare you face the dead?

Entries.Title: Oasis: The Reunion: The Movie
Entries.Description: The biggest reunion of the decade gets the Comic Relief treatment all in the aid of charity.

Entries.Title: Which Way Should My Chimney Face?
Entries.Description: Gergő and Liza, a young couple in their early twenties living a carefree life with their cats. Gergő’s mother is the character that brings the conflict by representing the generational differences especially when it comes to the subject of starting a family today. The plot revolves around a very typical Sunday family gathering where all the disagreements keep coming up, leading us to tense, uncomfortable situation. The film addresses issues such as the housing crisis, dysfunctional family patterns, and how these effects the younger generation's plans for the future. This mess is presented in a fresh, undramatic way, using experimental elements.

Entries.Title: Bioscope
Entries.Description: Villagers with no filmmaking experience embark on an extraordinary journey to create a movie.

Entries.Title: INK
Entries.Description: Ian Bexley is in over his head after an accident drives him to turn to his A.I. companion, "INK," for help, but just when the two think they're in the clear the police arrive and a trial ensues.

Entries.Title: Difficult Woman
Entries.Description: In a flashback, a woman is accused of over-narrativizing her life and makes that accusation into a narrative.

Entries.Title: If Looks Could Kill
Entries.Description: In a social-media addicted version of the Regency, a girl is driven by her favourite influencers to madness in the name of popularity.

Entries.Title: Andrea
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Must-see Movie Before You Die
Entries.Description: Kino, his wife Via, and their best friend Wahyu celebrate one million subscribers on their YouTube channel by reviewing ‘Must-See Movies Before You Die,’ unaware it will be their last video together. Now, Kino sits alone, haunted by memories and wrestling with overwhelming despair, desperately trying to find hope.

Entries.Title: Um Dia Daqueles...
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Vile & Miserable
Entries.Description: In a world where books and cars share a sales floor, a misanthropic and immortal bookselling demon is forced to team up with a young, enthusiastic human assistant to save his bookstore.

Entries.Title: Virgin Boys
Entries.Description: Arya, Rony and Dundi three naive boys joins posh co-ed college and clash with a rich brat's gang. Arya finds love, Rony forms a bond and Dundi causes chaos with his antics. A fun emotional journey of campus life, friendship and first love.

Entries.Title: Checkout
Entries.Description: Agnes’ bargain hunt turns deadly when she finds herself trapped in a supermarket murdering spree.

Entries.Title: Hampus Hedström – En kanske kul kväll på Scala
Entries.Description: You probably recognize the name Hampus Hedström, the comedian who for over ten years has been, and is, one of Sweden's most well-known profiles from TV, YouTube and Instagram. Now he will be doing his first solo show live at Scalateatern in Stockholm.

Entries.Title: There is a Hausen Everywhere
Entries.Description: What happens when seven women meet in one place for a week? Refreshingly unorthodox, THERE IS A HAUSEN EVERYWHERE addresses the fundamental questions of the present. Can we accept other people as they are and as they live? What is perception and what is reality? And when we talk about truth, what do we mean? In this comedy that plays with the absurdities of everyday life, the seminar community in Hausen becomes a microcosmic image of society.

Entries.Title: Saboteurs
Entries.Description: When two actresses find out they're competing for the same role, they go to dangerous measures to stop each other from getting the part.

Entries.Title: Super Wangwang
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: AJ Goes to the Dog Park
Entries.Description: When AJ loses his favorite dog park, he must fight, fish, scrap, scrape, and sap to get it back.

Entries.Title: Rocky's
Entries.Description: After a shocking death, a group of old high school friends reconnect in the parking lot of a 24/7 deli to catch up ahead of the funeral.

Entries.Title: TV4:s Nyårskarameller 2024
Entries.Description: A colorful full evening from Nalen in Stockholm led by Tilde de Paula Eby. Together with a star-studded list of viewer favorites and double husbands, we look back at the past year and take the first steps into 2025. We are visited by, among others, Peter Haber, Valter Skarsgård, Renée Nyberg, Pär Lernström, Mauri Hermundsson, Tina Nordström, David Hellenius and David Sundin.

Entries.Title: Heroes of Jokes
Entries.Description: What happens if Vasily Ivanovich, Teshcha, Chukcha and Novyi Russkiy end up in modern Moscow? The naive provincial Petya learned the answer to this question by accidentally reviving the characters from his favorite collection of jokes. Now he will have to figure out how to bring them back to their world. After all, if Petya doesn’t make it in time, the jokes will disappear from people’s memories forever…

Entries.Title: The Box Trap
Entries.Description: The world of a blissfully detached woman in her 20s turns upside down when she's forced to adjust to the ordinary life that exists beyond working at The Box Trap, an off-the-wall lesbian bar, and its rivalry with the gay club across the street, The Cock Catcher.

Entries.Title: Timpi Tampa
Entries.Description: After his mother develops cancer from dépigmentation, Khalilou fights toxic beauty standards. Disguised as Leila, he enters the "Miss Students" pageant, where light skin reigns, to give dark-skinned girls a chance to shine.

Entries.Title: In the Mouth
Entries.Description: A perpetual worrywart finds himself unable to leave his house after discovering a giant version of himself protruding from his front lawn.

Entries.Title: The Kink
Entries.Description: The Kink is the suburban story of a past-his-use-by-date, sex obsessed conman who is blackmailed by his lawyer’s overprotective mother to do the unthinkable. When he employs his lover’s husband to assist, his world becomes literally, a farce.  Swingers, swindlers, gold diggers and mummy’s boys…It’s all about The Kink!

Entries.Title: Stuart Laws Has to Be Joking?
Entries.Description: Last year Stuart started telling the truth on stage and was diagnosed autistic: he got the best reviews he’s ever got and his show was a must-see. He's back baby! And has to lean into it further. It’s funny, it’s real, it’s immaculately structured and it’s a chance to see a comedian at the top of his game.

Entries.Title: How the Mormons Conquered Utah
Entries.Description: On a beautiful day in the province of Dickersville, settlers roll into town trying to spread their religion. When the offer is turned down, things turn hostile. This is the "true" and "uncensored" story about how the Mormons became so prominent in Utah.

Entries.Title: Brain Rot
Entries.Description: Two video store employees discover a rare VHS tape contaminated with a bizarre mold that could hold deadly consequences.

Entries.Title: Vaibhavam
Entries.Description: Vaibhav, a righteous young man with entrepreneurial dreams, finds himself entwined in a profound mosaic of love, family, and friendships.

Entries.Title: 14 Days (Girlfriend Intlo)
Entries.Description: Harsha gets trapped in his girlfriend Ahana's house with no way of escaping without being seen by her parents.

Entries.Title: Chris Distefano: It's Just Unfortunate
Entries.Description: Chris Distefano is trying to be the best father he can be but nowadays, words speak louder than actions—so Chris is acting with the right intentions, but not always the right moves.

Entries.Title: Fleeting
Entries.Description: Gem is all hustle and grit, moving to Mati, Davao to chase a childhood dream. JC is a wealthy, easygoing cafe owner who never needed one. Their clashing worlds and beliefs surprisingly spark a meaningful romance. But when Gem’s big break finally comes, she must decide - should she chase the future she planned or stay with the love that changed her?

Entries.Title: Beach-O
Entries.Description: This 16mm short film is an homage to the campy beach movies of the 1960s, set within a late 90s time capsule. Shot in 1998 and completed in 2025, the music-driven film features performances by DC and Boston indie rock legends The Make Up, Victory At Sea, and The Wicked Farleys. The film follows Greg and Lesley as they enjoy a summer’s day at the beach. After they befriend a group of locals, their day takes an unexpected turn when everyone gets hungry…

Entries.Title: Alvin
Entries.Description: During a hot summer afternoon, a peculiar, wide-eyed 5th grader asks his teacher for advice about telling his crush how he feels. They discuss different tactics, and, ultimately, the boy sort of gains the courage to overcome his fears... sort of. He also inspires the teacher to maybe ask out his own crush... sort of.

Entries.Title: Before Nikkah
Entries.Description: Sara and Is(Isaam) are fated to meet in advance of a possible marriage they don't want and end up having to the spend the day together to kill time.

Entries.Title: Slash
Entries.Description: A group of friends are terrorized by a masked killer on Halloween.

Entries.Title: The Elephant in the Room
Entries.Description: In December 2020, a lonely progressive woman meets a guy she might be interested in dating. The only problem is he voted for President Trump. Twice. Can she give him a chance? Can she possibly impact his views? Could it work for them as a couple?

Entries.Title: Os Perebas
Entries.Description: Duda and Diego love soccer but they play it very badly. Everything will change, for better and for worse, when a magical event empowers them to be the best players of the world.

Entries.Title: The Heist
Entries.Description: One cold and fateful schoolnight, friends Kasey, Lyn, Ry, Zane, & AJ attempt to steal Kasey’s stuff back from her ex, Kyle. What could possibly go wrong?

Entries.Title: Шла Саша
Entries.Description: Escaping from her husband's abuse, Sasha goes to the very edge of the country - to Teriberka. The long road teaches her absurd but necessary lessons: how to persuade stubborn cars, run away from "antelope hunters", and most importantly - find and accept help in the most unexpected places. But the cherished sea will remind: to build a new life, you need to return the most important thing.

Entries.Title: Female 5
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Deeper Love: The Story of Miss Peppermint
Entries.Description: Drag Race star Peppermint takes center stage in this up close and personal documentary about her journey with fame, identity, and the art of drag. Sharing her story alongside a close network of trans individuals, one of the world’s favorite drag performers takes you inside her rise from humble beginnings to her current reign as outspoken trailblazer for the trans community.

Entries.Title: Umm
Entries.Description: After years of working in seclusion, Chef Umm is given an order that requires his best efforts and all the love he can give.

Entries.Title: Wally Meets Popeye
Entries.Description: Popeye has been dealing with a creature on the island of Ohio. It put a hole in his boat and keeps trying to kidnap Olive Oyl! At the same time Wally Griswold won a trip to Ohio from a mysterious contest.  Can these two heroes solve the mystery of this malicious monster?

Entries.Title: Across the Line
Entries.Description: A mockumentary comedy following student teacher Emma, who finds herself working at a Dublin Gaelscoil without a word of Irish. Two teachers are enlisted to get her across the line.

Entries.Title: Jante Bakhro
Entries.Description: A story revolves around Kamal, who is seeking a bride to settle down with, but is having trouble finding the right one. When Samjhana and her father move into his neighborhood, his life takes a complete turn, and he sets out to win her over, believing she might be the one as Kamal's mom is well-prepared to offer the Jante Bakhro too.

Entries.Title: Island
Entries.Description: Vlado, a misanthropic screenwriter, clings to solitude until unexpected encounters shake his worldview, forcing him to confront the life he's avoided.

Entries.Title: Eth Nerathaanavo
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: In Da House 3: In Korea
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Slow Ass Night
Entries.Description: When a bored worker looks for something to do on his fruitless shift, he finds something that adds a kick to the SLOW ASS NIGHT.

Entries.Title: L'Aventura
Entries.Description: Summer holidays. Sardinia, Italy. A family (road) trip. Claudine, soon to be 11 y.o., decides to tell the story of their adventures as they go along. When Raoul, her 3-y.o. brother, doesn't bother her...

Entries.Title: Philippe Laprise: Pourquoi Pas
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: I Agree With You
Entries.Description: A 30-something couple has a rare day off together at home. As the day goes on it’s clear that there are deep-seated problems within their relationship that neither of them possess the emotional intelligence to tackle head-on. Instead, they engage in their usual routine of jokes and games and it devolves into a role play that gradually consumes their entire existence. However, it is through this experience that they are finally able to genuinely communicate with each other and determine whether or not they should even be a couple at all.

Entries.Title: Unspeakable Acts of Cruelty
Entries.Description: A new and horrible gaming experience is announced

Entries.Title: Plein Cagnard
Entries.Description: In the middle of a heatwave, François has trouble waking up for a job interview. As he begins to get ready, he realizes that he's going to be very late, and his interview rival keeps leaving him voicemails.

Entries.Title: Button Pusher
Entries.Description: A broken air conditioner, a cancelled coworker, and a cheating husband.  A hair braider struggles to maintain composure after finding out her client is having an affair with her husband.

Entries.Title: Goodbye Las Lilas
Entries.Description: A frustrated film director convinces famed actor Jorge Marrale to play his father, a gambling merchant who, after taking a trip to the Grand Canyon in flip-flops, has supposedly lost his life after falling off a cliff.

Entries.Title: Odd Socks
Entries.Description: In a world where humans live alongside sock-monsters, a maverick human detective must battle lies, deception, and every movie cliché in his hunt for the truth when a sock monster is murdered.

Entries.Title: Zoe
Entries.Description: Zoe, an Italian woman, has all the things we’ve been told should make a person happy but  she isn’t. On Mardi Gras, a kid dressed up as a wizard grants her three chances to find what  she yearns for but if she doesn’t, she will be stuck with him forever. Zoe will find herself living  in Ibiza, London and Paris experiencing different versions of Zoe, lifestyles and lovers.  Although she won’t find what she was looking for once back home she will realize she has  found much more.

Entries.Title: Frutafizz
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Houdini
Entries.Description: Robert, a security guard at a corporate company, has always had a crush on his work colleague Marta. When he finally got the nerve to ask her out, she refused. Robert, however, did not let go and, by way of grog and impulse, he ... kidnapped her. Now he has to get out of the situation and prove that he had no bad intentions.

Entries.Title: Lentejas para tres
Entries.Description: A frustrated writer tries to sell his soul to the Devil, in exchange for the perfect novel.

Entries.Title: Дедушка Мороз
Entries.Description: The story of a young actor who works as Santa Claus during the holidays. One day, he meets an attractive girl who asks him to put on a holiday performance for her older boyfriend. However, the meeting becomes the beginning of unexpected and dramatic events that reveal the dark secrets of the protagonist's past and his connections with the people he meets.

Entries.Title: Red Lights and Blue
Entries.Description: The WSAP Theater Club is thrown into turmoil when the recently fired JROTC instructor, Sergeant Murphy, begins co-teaching the club as a last ditch effort to save his job. As the winter recital creeps closer, Murphy must put aside his anti-theater biases in order to get along with the club’s seniors and co-teacher, Ms. Austen, before he’s fired for good.

Entries.Title: 我们终将要和世界握手言和
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Buzzkill
Entries.Description: A disturbed man makes a friend.

Entries.Title: Sahanam
Entries.Description: A failed UPI sparks a chance encounter between Adarsh and his longtime crush, Aadhya. As a playful bond blossoms in a dreamy, aesthetic world, an unexpected twist threatens it all, A tale of love, patience and a fight to make things right.

Entries.Title: Drink and Be Merry
Entries.Description: At a struggling New York dive bar in the days leading up to Christmas 2019, Chet, a beleaguered bartender in a state of extended arrested development, must balance caring for his misanthropic, aging regulars — who have nowhere else to go, and rely on him for far more than pouring drinks — with his naive desires to muster some Christmas spirit.

Entries.Title: The Redeemables Part 2
Entries.Description: A true events squatter comedy that focuses on New York City's landlord tenant laws. When his love interest invites suspicious people to move into his house a young man seeks out ways to evict them which includes hiring want-to-be mobsters

Entries.Title: Fair Game
Entries.Description: A drug dealer, Michael, is forced to go on the run with his girlfriend, Sarah, after a dead body shows up in her flat. But very quickly, Sarah realises that there's more to the story than Michael is letting on.

Entries.Title: Help! I'm a Fish The Movie 2
Entries.Description: A guy whose life is in the dump goes on a journey to rescue his mother after he neglects his Brita filter.

Entries.Title: Ketchup
Entries.Description: The tale of a woman, Andrea, who finds meaning in ketchup.

Entries.Title: Trick or Treat with Reed Richmond
Entries.Description: Join cult icon Reed Richmond (star of beloved b-movies like “Hell Ninja 4” & “Beverly Hills Graverobber”) on a jack-o-lantern–lit journey through history and mystery as he explores the origins of Halloween and the most memorable monsters it celebrates.

Entries.Title: Buffet Infinity
Entries.Description: Picking from hundreds of hours of original, low-budget TV ads, Glassman tells the sinister tale of two restaurants battling it out in the town of Westridge County.

Entries.Title: Tom Hornets
Entries.Description: In the midst of a 90s housing crisis, ex-forensics photographer Tom Hornets seeks a new life working under the charismatic but elusive Curtis Dombroski. But as he digs deeper, Tom discovers that the horrors of his past are nothing compared to the monster he works for now.

Entries.Title: John Crist: Emotional Support
Entries.Description: John Crist's 2025 release, EMOTIONAL SUPPORT takes aim at topics like fights in the family group chat and being petty in the Neighborhood Facebook groups. In his fourth full-length comedy special, filmed  5.7 miles from his childhood home in Lilburn, Georgia, Crist makes several nods to his upbringing, including purity pledges, banned movies and not being allowed to celebrate Halloween. Filmed at the Gas South Theater in Duluth Georgia.

Entries.Title: Cajarse en Todo
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: FREE BIRD
Entries.Description: FREE BIRD – Stop Motion Escape Story | Vertical Short Film Made on Mobile.  Trapped on a desk high above the ground, a tiny diecast car finally breaks free from its cage. With its owner distracted in the shower, loud music covers its daring escape—until the phone rings. Time is running out. Can the car find a way off the table before the bathroom door opens, or will freedom slip away forever?

Entries.Title: Три свадьбы и один побег
Entries.Description: The village of Khuap, Abkhazia. Amra, a well-known rebel and prankster, is about to graduate from school. Her lifelong dream is to become an actress, and her mother Nutsa's dream is to successfully marry off her two older sisters as soon as possible. Amra does not want the same fate, so she fraudulently applies for acting, assuring Nutsa that she is entering medicine. However, the plan fails when her mother finds out that her daughter has been leading her on. There can be no talk of entering acting, since Nutsa considers all actresses unworthy. The disappointed mother tells Amra that she will only take care of her fate after she marries off her older daughters. Now, to fulfill her dream, Amra needs to speed up the marriage of her older sisters or run away from home.

Entries.Title: Handball
Entries.Description: When his girlfriend expresses interest in opening their relationship, Charley turns to a handball rival for advice.

Entries.Title: Festival de Viña del Mar 2025: Pedro Ruminot
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Night at the Park
Entries.Description: A film sequel to Brandon Rogers' viral shorts A Day at the Park and A Day at the Beach.

Entries.Title: old memories
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Ben and Suzanne, A Reunion in 4 Parts
Entries.Description: A couple in a long-distance relationship reunite for a road trip through Sri Lanka. Things go awry.

Entries.Title: Mike Vecchione: Low Income White
Entries.Description: Mike Vecchione’s “Low Income White” turns clean comedy on its head with a razor-sharp set that’s equal parts smart, self-deprecating, and relentlessly funny. With the gritty rhythm of the Northeast and the polish of a comedy veteran, Vecchione unloads a barrage of fast-paced, observational humor that hits on everything from aging and generational divides to the absurdity of modern life.  Navigating the world with sarcastic precision and deadpan charm, Vecchione doesn’t pull punches—but he doesn’t play favorites either. No one is safe, including himself. It’s clean comedy with an edge, and a masterclass in making the mundane feel hilariously high-stakes.

Entries.Title: On Walking in Cinema
Entries.Description: Two filmmakers reflect on the act of walking in cinema.

Entries.Title: Rosa's Dilemma
Entries.Description: Rosa finds herself in a whirlwind of emotions as she navigates an unexpected love triangle between her two coworkers at a fast food joint.

Entries.Title: Gelenek Görenek
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Ian Karmel: Comfort Beyond God’s Foresight
Entries.Description: Comedian Ian Karmel, former head writer of James Corden and host of the All Fantasy Everything podcast, debuts his live stand-up special recorded at Revolution Hall in Portland, Oregon.

Entries.Title: Беги
Entries.Description: A burglar-safecracker Sasha breaks into a house where he witnesses a crime: the owner of the house, Chernov, has killed his wife. Chernov begins to pursue the escaped witness. Meanwhile, Sasha has to make it to his son's party, because the future of his marriage, which he is trying to save with all his might, depends on it.

Entries.Title: Egghead Republic
Entries.Description: An alternative reality where the cold war did not end, and Soviet Kazakstan has been struck by an atomic bomb.

Entries.Title: Jack Paints It Red
Entries.Description: A painter unleashes his craft onto a blank canvas.

Entries.Title: The Big Fat Quiz of Everything
Entries.Description: Harry Hill, David Mitchell, Roisin Conaty, Sophie Willan, Josh Pugh and Fatiha El-Ghorri tackle Jimmy Carr's comprehensive quiz, from Henry VIII to the first meme and lots more in between.

Entries.Title: Race to the Pentagon
Entries.Description: After a workplace incident, Alan finds himself desperately looking for a new job when he is visited by an angel from heaven.

Entries.Title: Dragon Seduction
Entries.Description: After breaking free from a millennium-long imprisonment, the Black Dragon Ye Ying escaped, seized the Golden Dragon's magic power and gravely wounded the old Dragon King. The new Dragon King Fu Xi ventured into the Demon Market to seek the legendary Demon-Subduing Sword in a bid to reclaim the Golden Dragon's magic power. However, he fell into a cunning trap where the sacred sword was briefly recovered only to be lost again. Ultimately, Fu Xi tapped into his latent potential and reclaimed the old Dragon King's Golden Dragon magic power.

Entries.Title: The Last Audition
Entries.Description: A struggling actress tries to blackmail her way into stardom but opens a can of worms and ends up being in the centre of a love and crime triangle.

Entries.Title: Stripper Boyz
Entries.Description: Two best friends head to Vegas for a bachelor party with a twist: instead of hiring strippers, they decide to become them. Training with a real male revue troupe, they meet colorful characters on a wild, heartwarming journey.

Entries.Title: Aitana Needs a Gun
Entries.Description: When two reckless best friends get evicted from their apartment, they embark on a road trip with a pair of German immigrants attempting to trap them into green-card marriages.

Entries.Title: Boys Are Cats (music is bad)
Entries.Description: A group of band members and their lead, encounter a new member in a bus.

Entries.Title: Emily Wilson: FIXED: How I Got REJECTED by Reality TV
Entries.Description: Emily Wilson's debut comedy special about her humiliating experience as a contestant on The X Factor USA at 15-years-old.

Entries.Title: SUICIDE WATCH
Entries.Description: Quarantine. Dionysis, Giorgos, Stathis and Orestis have set up a guard at the house of their fellow student Anestis and are watching their friend Tony, who lives across the street. Dionysis planned this operation and is the only one who initially believes that Tony is planning to commit suicide. The other three, after sharing a story in which Tony seems not to be doing so well, are convinced. Suddenly, smoke comes out of Tony's apartment and they run across the street. Tony has simply burned his food. Relieved, the children stay there and Tony suggests that they call Anestis too.

Entries.Title: Fool Me Once by Keo & Them
Entries.Description: When Keo & Them gets screwed over by a shady venue owner, the band takes it into their own hands to get the money they earned for their show. What do they do with it? Throw a killer party, of course.

Entries.Title: Ronald Goedemondt: Met Knielende Knikjes
Entries.Description: The larger themes of life have slowly found their way into Goedemondt's small, safe world. He wasn't been waiting for that at all. How long can you deal maturely with, for example, parenthood, the future, and death as a forty-something? If it's up to Goedemondt: quite a while. He still doesn't stop his childish shouting and ranting, and he still taunts, rebukes, resists, stuns and ignores. Can he get by in society with that behavior? He's quite hard headed about that.

Entries.Title: Serial Rabbit One
Entries.Description: A serial killer who wears a bunny rabbit outfit slashes his way across San Antonio before finally reaching the city's smallest rave.

Entries.Title: TomTom
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Tom Green: I Got a Mule!
Entries.Description: Tom Green shares humorous insights about his experience transitioning from Hollywood to a simpler lifestyle in the countryside. He also provides amusing observations about modern social media pitfalls and other relatable topics.

Entries.Title: Miénteme
Entries.Description: One summer evening, Martin is forced to face his unresolved feelings for his best girlfriend’s future groom, whilst attending their engagement party.

Entries.Title: Tip$
Entries.Description: Struggling to make ends meet in their day-to-day life, five young men decide to take to the stage to get their finances to align with their needs.

Entries.Title: Give Me Flowers
Entries.Description: Three friends - Baaska, Sashok and Petka - gather in an old village club and learn that their childhood friend Vadim, who came from abroad, did not invite them to his wedding. Trying to cope with the bitterness of lost friendships, they immerse themselves in memories and fantasies about a better life.

Entries.Title: Малай
Entries.Description: The young rich kid, Chyna, got carried away with his glamorous lifestyle and decided that he could do anything he wanted. Desperate to set his son straight, his oligarch father takes extreme measures. Together with an eccentric psychologist, he devises a unique project: somewhere in the steppe, they recreate the atmosphere of a 19th-century Kazakh village. Chyna ends up in this village, believing he has traveled back in time.

Entries.Title: Louis-José Houde : Tu n'es pas spécial
Entries.Description: It is a question here of deploying all the humor inherent in the act of having a first child at the age of forty-five... But it is also a question of civic-mindedness, respect for intelligence, weight words, the weight of the self, the triumph of the “I”, then a little bit of Henri Richard and people who say “knock on wood”. A vibrant soliloquy on life and the art of living it.

Entries.Title: City of Pigs

Entries.Title: Dating Mark Silcox
Entries.Description: Unable to get a second date, Mark Silcox attempts to find love by learning to be funny. But could his joking go too far?

Entries.Title: Retail!
Entries.Description: Retail is a Workplace Comedy about a Man named Marty Benson who runs a Furniture store with his Sister Barb. When the Tax bill comes, they decide to have a Huge Weekend Blow Out Sale.

Entries.Title: Wheel Gone Kid 4
Entries.Description: When the plane crashes, Houdini lands in hospital, The Wheel Gone Kid lands on his feet. Can Spanners and Tuppance follow Conker's tip off and help Houdini recover his millions from The Wheel Gone Kid?

Entries.Title: Y2Kevin
Entries.Description: As his Y2K hysteria subsides, Kevin steps out of his DIY bunker, into the unfamiliar surface world. He is confronted with past loves, nostalgia, and curiosity if there's still a place for him in a world that's spun forward without him.

Entries.Title: Amen Break
Entries.Description: A crew of fixers working behind the scenes for a trendy New York City restaurant recap the morning after a deal gone bad.

Entries.Title: Wellbeing Assessment
Entries.Description: Young employee Devon meets with his superior Jack for a company mandated Wellbeing Assessment.

Entries.Title: Les Toxiques
Entries.Description: In the world of poison, three determined best friends work to develop the first poison that exclusively kills men with skewed moral compasses.

Entries.Title: The Courage to Stand Up
Entries.Description: Deep in the "grassroots" world of the booming British stand-up comedy scene, real performers give their unique insights of their real life stories, aspirations, and struggles - on and off stage

Entries.Title: Iron Pills
Entries.Description: When 20 year old Tommy is left alone with her little roach brother, she is for the first time, forced to deal with responsibility and with her neglected anemia.

Entries.Title: Can I Just Tell You?
Entries.Description: After a few weeks of dating, Izzy wants to avow her feelings to her girlfriend Mabel for the first time, but this proves to be harder than expected...

Entries.Title: The Hit-List
Entries.Description: Daniel's list of past sexual partners falls into wrong hands. A hitman targets eliminating them. Daniel and friends race to stop the killer from harming his fiance Kristina and others on the list.

Entries.Title: Thick Trip
Entries.Description: Four friends facing life challenges take a summer road trip through Texas together.

Entries.Title: Bukan Film Superhero

Entries.Title: Coffee(and)Machine
Entries.Description: The office routine is ideal for a perfectionist Clerk: every day is the same and everything is on schedule. But in this atmosphere, it is becoming increasingly difficult for a Clerk to work, and a regular lunch break will change his outlook on life, work, and, most importantly, himself.

Entries.Title: A Bloody Mess
Entries.Description: A true-crime documentarian and her trusty crew investigate a small-town tragedy that’s faded into memory as a national joke. As her determination to uncover the truth becomes more and more intense, her methods become less and less ethical—until they become dangerous.

Entries.Title: A Ver Navios
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Dream Canyon
Entries.Description: A traveling sex worker named Dhalia becomes stranded in a small desert town in Idaho. She meets a group of locals willing to help, but only as long as she stays.

Entries.Title: Mysteriet Myrna Vep
Entries.Description: A newlywed named Vanessa moves into a mysterious mansion with her husband. As strange and terrifying events unfold, she learns of her husband's obsession with the disappearance of Myrna Vep, a woman tied to the mansion's dark past. As secrets unravel, Vanessa must navigate supernatural forces to survive and uncover the truth.

Entries.Title: Call Me Barbie
Entries.Description: A very attractive lady skips her way into a group's life claiming to be Barbie. She takes a liking to Rod, a blind man who is abused by his wife, and they form an unlikely friendship. Will Barbie find her happy ending with Brady or fall apart at the seams trying?

Entries.Title: A Peculiarly Bizarre Day for Josie Joan
Entries.Description: Josie Joan loses everything in one day: their job, their home, and the love of their life. At their lowest point, they stumble upon something life-changing. As a mysterious ring pulls them into an increasingly surreal chain of events, Josie must navigate absurd encounters, shifting fortunes, and the creeping sense that their newfound luck comes with a dangerous cost.  A bold, heartfelt comedy about friendship, failure, and the strange beauty of becoming who you were before you grew up.

Entries.Title: Pirouette, cacahuète
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Clay's Feast
Entries.Description: Acclaimed stand up comic Clay Horwitz embarks on a culinary adventure of New York City, bringing the funniest comedians to try the most iconic restaurants & hidden gem food spots in the city. Hilarity and deliciousness ensue.

Entries.Title: Skewers
Entries.Description: A chef named Ģirts from the countryside is encouraged to move to Rīga and open a new restaurant.

Entries.Title: Khaki Fever
Entries.Description: A group of rangers working on a private game farm challenge each other to see who can have sex with the most tourists during a holiday season. The prize? The “King of Khaki” title as well as the collective tips that all the losers have collected for the season. The challenge? To outwit the conservative lodge manager, who has made it clear: Anyone caught socializing unprofessionally with guests will be summarily fired.

Entries.Title: Don't Put Your Dreams Away!
Entries.Description: An egotistical Frank Sinatra impersonator hopes to make it big time, but nothing seems to go his way.

Entries.Title: The Blue Orb
Entries.Description: The world is in chaos after a gigantic blue orb arrives in the centre of Auckland City. It is up to two hapless men to travel into the “O-Zone” - the area surrounding the orb - to save their brother from within.

Entries.Title: Under the September Sun
Entries.Description: Abel takes his girlfriend Meryem to Quetzaltenango to meet his conservative family during the Guatemalan Independence Day celebrations. While Abel struggles to live up to family expectations, Meryem ventures into the city in search of her idol. With secrets and misunderstandings, the couple faces comical and heartwarming challenges during a night of parades and revelations.

Entries.Title: Across the Aisle
Entries.Description: An idealistic congressman attempts to woo his colleague from the other side of the aisle.

Entries.Title: The Man Who Saw the Bear
Entries.Description: Two men from different generations form an unlikely bond while protecting a runaway circus bear in the French countryside, discovering shared passions for nature and wisdom along the way.

Entries.Title: Lucky Lacki
Entries.Description: Hopeless romantic Lacki flies halfway around the world from Slovakia to Australia for a Tinder date with a woman who doesn't remember chatting with him. When his romantic grand gesture goes disastrously wrong, he wanders the streets of Melbourne, discovering that sometimes getting lost is the only way to find yourself.

Entries.Title: Drifting Laurent
Entries.Description: Laurent, 29 years old, is looking for meaning in his life. He ends up in a deserted ski resort in the off-season and quickly blends into the surprising lives of its few locals. When the tourists arrive with winter, Laurent can't leave anymore…

Entries.Title: The Guardians of Christmas
Entries.Description: Trying to discover who now presides over the winter holidays in Ukraine, three legendary gift-givers - Saint Nicholas, Santa Claus, and the ancient Spirit of Winter - race to grant little Vira’s every wish. But Vira, embittered, demands that Christmas be wiped from existence. Instantly, carols and holiday cheer vanish from the city and from everyone’s memory, leaving only sorrow in their place. Stripped of their magic and turned into ordinary mortals, the three must join forces to avert the Armageddon unleashed by Christmas’s disappearance, and to restore Vira’s faith in miracles and hope for a bright future.

Entries.Title: Love Bites
Entries.Description: Just out of their teens, young men Liam and Anatole were in the throes of an exciting new relationship- until they had a fight, and Anatole disappeared.  Liam can’t accept the breakup.  And, since his ex-boyfriend doesn’t reply to his calls and text messages, Liam decides to follow him to a Halloween party organized by one of Anatole’s friends to try and find him.  The wild night that ensues will test both boys’ true feelings for each other, as well as force them to confront some hard inner truths once and for all.

Entries.Title: Donny's Orange
Entries.Description: An orange comes to terms with her purpose in life.

Entries.Title: The Weight Of Waiting

Entries.Description: A dickish man-child desperate to save his relationship taunts a stranger on the NYC subway to prove himself in front of his girlfriend, but what he finds funny is no joke to the stranger.

Entries.Title: Die Drei von der Müllabfuhr - Schutzgeld
Entries.Description: The three garbage collectors accidentally get on the trail of a protection racket in the Neukölln neighborhood: Snack bar owner Mohammed has to fend off an aggressive gang of youths and eventually resorts to drastic measures - but Werner discovers that the situation is not quite as clear-cut as it seems. Meanwhile, Tarik's extreme jealousy puts his relationship with Werner's daughter Annika at risk.

Entries.Description: The duo Tiến Luật and Ngô Kiến Huy, with their unusual professions of body retrieval and ambulance driving, promise endless laughter for the audience through their one-of-a-kind journey to find a missing corpse in Vietnamese cinema. With the help of a supernatural force, they not only face hilariously awkward situations but also uncover chilling secrets hidden behind the bodies. Will they successfully complete this challenging mission, or will unexpected twists await them?
