Entries.Title: Watermelon of Death
Entries.Description: Three friends sit down to enjoy a watermelon, but its taste is unlike anything they expected—strange, unsettling, almost wrong. Two of them stop, but one refuses to give up and keeps eating. His stubbornness leads to one devastating event, a single moment so terrible it changes everything. A chilling horror where one bite is enough to seal your fate.

Entries.Title: البيت المسكون شارع 6 قطعة 6 منزل 6
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Emma's World
Entries.Description: Emma, who lives in a small boring town, writes about her life and inner thoughts in her diary.

Entries.Title: I WANT MY MOMMY
Entries.Description: Mourning the death of his mother, a man is presented with a unique opportunity to talk to her again.

Entries.Title: Badmashulu
Entries.Description: Two mischievous middle-aged friends regularly stir up trouble in their village, causing chaos. A police constable tries to keep their antics under control.

Entries.Title: The Shepherd's Last Hour
Entries.Description: Two FBI agents, Agent Whitney and Agent Mallory, set out to find a criminal mastermind who calls himself The Shepherd.

Entries.Title: El Laburo
Entries.Description: A mockumentary-style dramedy that chronicles the chaotic and absurd lives of night shift employees at a burger company, all under the unpredictable leadership of their charming yet unorthodox manager, Santino.

Entries.Title: Swim Hard
Entries.Description: A new recruit joins a group of dedicated swimmers on their journey to the 2028 Olympics.

Entries.Title: Brett to the Present
Entries.Description: A stereotypical 80s bully is transported to the Present day and must find a way to get back to his time.

Entries.Title: Not If I See You First
Entries.Description: In town for work, Kenny meets Aaron, who convinces him to extend his trip a few days to check out the famous sights of Chicago. But when Kenny's car explodes and Aaron gets selective amnesia, will their fledgling friendship lose its way?

Entries.Title: Tamyr
Entries.Description: Arman, Arsen, and Askhat have been competing with each other since childhood—over everything from toys to their parents' attention. Over time, nothing has changed. Every year, when they return to their hometown to celebrate their father Duman’s birthday, they resume their rivalry, boasting about their achievements and trying to one-up each other. Askhat sincerely hopes that this time will be different, and even promises his wife Saule that he won’t react to his brothers’ jabs. However, his hopes are dashed when Arman and Arsen drag him into yet another battle for the title of “Best Son.”

Entries.Title: Stephanie Stevens
Entries.Description: The morning after a bungled suicide attempt, a failing Chicago comic is surprised when his pregnant ex-girlfriend knocks on the door. This lo-fi, post-mumblecore dark comedy takes an uncomfortable stroll through what it means to become a parent, and the excuses we make to avoid growing up.

Entries.Title: Paper Airplane
Entries.Description: Two high schoolers scared of their future create a magical paper airplane.

Entries.Title: The Rise and Rise of Girard eh Denique
Entries.Description: Girard eh Denique are the hottest french DJ duo. They've come to New York to become superstars...

Entries.Title: Wilma will mehr
Entries.Description: Wilma has many qualifications and talents, yet suffers just as many disappointments in life. After she catches her husband cheating, she runs away to Vienna in search of a new life. There she lives with bustling bohemians, tries her luck at a variety of jobs and perhaps... at love again.

Entries.Title: Ring Ring
Entries.Description: An entertaining and light-hearted depiction of how a seemingly innocent game can unravel deep secrets and test the strength of friendship and relationships.

Entries.Title: A Lake
Entries.Description: Rich is a thirty year-old filmmaker whose career seems to go nowhere. While wasting his days in Tequesquitengo, he falls in love with Daniela, a young woman who shares his place in the world, but not the same feelings. A weekend with her and her young friends will make him question his life so far and his concept of love.

Entries.Title: Collisions & Damages
Entries.Description: On the morning of her sister’s wedding, dutiful Lyall Chan spirals after catching wind of the bride and groom’s plans.

Entries.Title: The Rendezvous
Entries.Description: After a planned robbery goes awry, a group of amateur robbers regroup at their designated getaway point.

Entries.Title: The Most Normal Dude
Entries.Description: A story about a young man named Joonatan, who seeks closeness and practical physical touch from doctors.

Entries.Title: Rei dos Galos
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 1+1+1 Life, Love, Chaos
Entries.Description: Off-beat dramedy following Pat (she hates Patricia), exuberant and melancholic author during a winter stay in her childhood cabin where buried memories resurface. Pat needs to look into the mirror and forgive herself in order to heal and save her relationship with her musician boyfriend Jan and maintain the fragile bond with her tween daughter Flavie. 1+1+1 features a restless but strong female lead and a blended family trying to live together, where each member is learning to love him.herself and to love each other.

Entries.Title: New York Manhattan
Entries.Description: Emotions run high as a young mother abandons her son at Grand Central Station with just a cell phone in hand. The boy’s only hope? Answer the call and get a job! All while navigating a place beyond your wildest imagination… a place known only as: ‘New York Manhattan’

Entries.Title: What Happens on Earth
Entries.Description: Brian's night out takes a seriously wrong turn when he and his mate Reg ingest some bizarre pills. The night devolves into hallucinogenic chaos, physical mutations, and a close encounter of the alien kind.

Entries.Title: Pastime
Entries.Description: Told through the first-person lens of first love, this film follows Crosley, a theater worker stuck in nostalgia for a time when life felt full—surrounded by friends, pursuing dreams, and in love. As memories of youth haunt him, Crosley must confront a quiet crisis: is it better to chase passion, or simply hold on to what once brought joy?

Entries.Title: This Sucks
Entries.Description: The Cottage Boys will stay at a cabin for a few days. The fact that it will rain while they are there is a shame. Is Hank, their friend, able to save the atmosphere?

Entries.Title: Tetanus
Entries.Description: A man is infected with tetanus, but refuses to accept the truth.

Entries.Title: Palliative
Entries.Description: Low on money and time, free spirited Brian risks anything and anyone to get what he needs by the end of the day.

Entries.Title: Limp
Entries.Description: When an old friend drops by with a broken heart, Max rises to the occasion… sorta.

Entries.Title: Teddy Bears
Entries.Description: A comedy about men who crave a carefree, commitment‐free life. The “bears” are grown‐up boys, mature in age but perpetually immature as partners.

Entries.Title: Una película con suerte
Entries.Description: David and Enrique have been friends for over 15 years. Both film lovers, they decide to venture to the Atacama Desert to shoot a feature film. With no acquaintances, no locations, no actors, and only $11,000 and a lot of enthusiasm, they travel to Chile for 21 days with the dream of making a movie. Everything seems to be going well until, on the last day of filming, a tragic accident ends their friendship.

Entries.Title: Heaven Can't Hold Me
Entries.Description: A young and impassioned artist struggles to maintain her humility amid lofty dreams, encroaching deadlines, and a turbulent relationship.

Entries.Title: Cuming Out
Entries.Description: Kennedy’s desire for a heteronormative experience sees her embark on a one-night stand. What could possibly go wrong?

Entries.Title: More Than Football
Entries.Description: As a result of another outrage by fans of the England national team, which escalated into multi-day clashes, the leadership of European football disqualifies the English from the European Football Cup. Instead, the Russian team enters the final stage. The Russian Football Federation has only two weeks to assemble a team. Head coach Sorokin and his assistant Mikhalych invite to the team the football players who have today become "downed pilots": forwards Matveev and Sanaev are under investigation for a fight, defender Bushagov, after a loud scandal, is divorcing his wife, who demands huge alimony, young forward Kizyakov because of of his character sits on a bench and so on. They all lost the opportunity to play, earn big money, be idols and real stars. But Sorokin's plan - to give them a chance to return to their former life - does not work: the new team cannot work together, each player pursues his own goals, and therefore they do not form a team.

Entries.Title: The Fun-Raiser
Entries.Description: A married couple who run a performing arts high school throw a last ditch fundraiser to save the school and their students, despite a leaking roof, a flammable cake, a no-show celebrity, food poisoning, and their inner demons.

Entries.Title: Ketchup on Waffles
Entries.Description: On an ordinary Friday night, three masked gunmen take control of a 24-hour diner in a college town. The gunmen, led by a man in a white mask, sadistically torture and murder the customers over a few hours for their entertainment. Each killing is more violent than the last.

Entries.Title: Unfamiliar Territory
Entries.Description: Rafi Bastos first special in English. I hope you enjoy it!

Entries.Title: Horseheads
Entries.Description: Horseheads is a comedy/crime short film that takes a wild spin on the classic buddy story. It follows Billy, a clueless young drifter searching for meaning, and Frank, a washed-up crook long past his prime. When Billy’s genius plan to rob the local chinese burger joint goes hilariously sideways, the duo stumbles into an unexpected journey of botched heists, unlikely friendship, and maybe figuring out what the heck they’re doing with their lives.

Entries.Title: Sam
Entries.Description: Set in a New York City bar, Samantha is meeting with Florence for what we're meant to assume is a first date.

Entries.Title: Yung Boi: Ryze of the King
Entries.Description: The rise to fame of Melbourne's next big rapper: Yung Boi. Facing adversity, challenges, confrontations, disagreements, inconveniences, problems, and more, he learns to overcome anything that gets in the way of his ride to the top.

Entries.Title: Il capo del mondo
Entries.Description: A Sicilian filmmaker is contacted by a local producer to shoot a film about an important character in the province of Catania. Realizing that the project is not in line with his artistic message, he declines. However, the producer is not one to be turned down, forcing him to make the film under threat of death.

Entries.Title: Death by Execution
Entries.Description: A confession, a consequence, and a severe lack of interest.

"Lyosha is going through a series of problems: his girlfriend leaves and his best friend, with whom he shared an apartment for three years, moves in with his new girlfriend. Finding himself alone, Lyosha faces the fact that he has to learn to live with himself and, perhaps, finally love himself, which becomes an arduous task for him"

Entries.Title: Smith Peaks
Entries.Description: In a city of factories, bare trees, and looming cell towers, a graduate student named Smith disappears from his home. His disappearance is reported to a crew of four former amateur ghosthunters, whose investigation uncovers a web of conspiracies.

Entries.Title: Fat Mouth
Entries.Description: Marcus is about to watch the National Rugby League grand final game with his son Max. However he is surprised when Max brings his girlfriend Chloe and brother Jack, and an AA mediator named Yuki. It turns out it was a trap set up by Max to get Marcus into an intervention for his weight.

Entries.Title: Teahouse Tales of Laughter
Entries.Description: Set in a century-old teahouse on Suzhou's historic Shantang Street, the film follows the daily lives and humorous escapades of the teahouse staff and patrons. From romantic misunderstandings to comedic mishaps, the story weaves together tales of love, ambition, and community in a traditional Chinese setting.

Entries.Title: Have A Word: Finn Day
Entries.Description: The Have A Word lads come together to celebrate Finn Day - and things get a little dramatic.

Entries.Title: 2V24
Entries.Description: The ghost with the most is back

Entries.Title: Emma Holland: Here Comes Mr. Forehead
Entries.Description: Come take a little looksie into my sick and twisted mind.

Entries.Title: Startup
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Ballooming
Entries.Description: A surrealist tale of love, masculinity, and the pursuit of happiness, which follows the journey of a young man who tries to fix his life in all the ways that don’t work.

Entries.Title: Eddie Pepitone: The Collapse
Entries.Description: A comedian's energetic tirade explores modern anxieties and self-analysis, covering various small topics while examining his own behavior and deep-seated insecurities.

Entries.Title: Intimate Apparel
Entries.Description: Two buddies attempt to keep their lingerie store afloat by running an App-based male escort service.

Entries.Title: The Ned Kelly
Entries.Description: A 20-something rebels against the stinking government!

Entries.Title: Marijuambies
Entries.Description: "Marijuambies" is a hilarious new comedy that follows the story of a weed dealer and his hippie friend who accidentally sell poisoned weed, turning their customers into zombies. As the duo realizes the dangerous effects of their tainted product, they embark on a wild journey to find a cure and stop the zombie apocalypse they inadvertently caused. Along the way, they encounter various challenges and eccentric characters, leading to a series of mishaps and adventures that will keep audiences laughing from start to finish.  Directed by Brian Foster.

Entries.Title: The Incubator
Entries.Description: A hesitant wife and her blabbermouth husband try to keep their new pregnancy news a secret when attending their nosey family Christmas party.

Entries.Title: OMG! Mom's Big News
Entries.Description: In an era of rapidly declining birth rates, a 53-year-old mother unexpectedly becomes pregnant! A once-peaceful family is suddenly thrown into a whirlwind of a "pregnancy preservation battle." What kind of impact and changes will the arrival of this new life bring to them?

Entries.Title: Are You There Satan? It's Me, Bryan
Entries.Description: Feeling dissatisfied with his life, a depressed satanist decides to take it out on the leader of his cult and a secret is revealed that changes his life.

Entries.Title: BLUNT
Entries.Description: When your knife turns blunt, do you sharpen it or let it become a glorified butter knife at dad's company brunches? Something only you can answer.

Entries.Title: How To Make The *Perfect* Paper Airplane
Entries.Description: Edgy, entitled, spazzy content creator Violet Strom enforces paper airplanes as the topic of the next video she and her collaborators will upload, which just might be their last.

Entries.Title: Wayward Cinema
Entries.Description: Two brothers mourning the loss of their father discover a camera which seems to harness abilities beyond their comprehension, yet fate is close behind.

Entries.Title: Kyllä isä osaa Lapissa
Entries.Description: The father and mother flee to Lapland to prepare for Christmas, but peace is at a standstill when the children tag along. When Jussi's new girlfriend Viktoria is revealed to be the millionaire's only child, the father does everything he can to make the best possible impression on the family's new daughter-in-law. As one surprise follow after another, the father must put all his “expertise” into play.

Entries.Title: L'Étrange Anthologie bis
Entries.Description: A surprise selection of the wildest images from the Gaumont library. This year, Sylvain Perret is back with a second coming of exclusive unseen nuggets, dug out from GP Archives for a new insane journey: mad collectors, odd animal experiments, disco and many other surprises, all under the auspices of Alejandro Jodorowsky.

Entries.Title: Sunburn
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Justice: The Movie
Entries.Description: Attorney Harry Franklin takes on the case of a man he's convinced is wrongfully accused of murder.

Entries.Title: Down to Zero
Entries.Description: “Down to Zero” follows Kyle as he goes on an introspective journey after a harsh truth is delivered by his childhood barber.

Entries.Title: Janus
Entries.Description: A pizza delivery guy is invited into a stranger's house towards the end of New Year's Eve.

Entries.Title: Call Me When You're There
Entries.Description: Following my performances of “Hardened Trauma” and “There's Someone Else,” my show “When You Arrive, Call”—which I performed over 200 times during the 2024-2025 season—is now with you. Enjoy the show :)

Entries.Title: Paul Foot: Dissolve
Entries.Description: In the year 2022 something momentous changed for Paul, and in Dissolve he will reveal how he discovered the secret of life on the outskirts of Lancaster.* Inevitably he does get distracted by King Tutankhamun, the House of Lords, officious lollipop ladies and what Jesus might have achieved if he’d been a plumber.

Entries.Title: Kevin James Doyle: Fool Proof
Entries.Description: Filmed live at New York City's Soho Playhouse, comedian and storyteller Kevin James Doyle weaves a story of love, risk, reward, theater history, motorcycles, green cards, a $15,000 loan, and more. This jaw-dropping story has an unforgettable conclusion.

Entries.Title: In The Cards
Entries.Description: Damien embarks on a harrowing journey to fix his own devastating mistake...without taking an ounce of responsibility.

Entries.Title: The Youth of Today
Entries.Description: An angel falls in love with a young man.

Entries.Title: Cooked
Entries.Description: After finishing high school, Ethan and his best mates commemorate their final night out together. As the night unfolds, the boy's friendship is tested as inevitably, nothing goes to plan.

Entries.Title: Cameron Mitchell Gets His Face Smashed
Entries.Description: Through exaggerated tales of distant rumors, two frat guys speculate over a fight between their brothers.

Entries.Title: Maybe…
Entries.Description: An inventor who creates a time machine to correct his past mistakes encounters an unusual situation. One day, souls wanting to return to life begin to flock to his house...

Entries.Title: nineoneone
Entries.Description: An exercise in no-budget filmmaking made over a two day span.

Entries.Title: Tout Va Très Bien !
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Great American Broadcast
Entries.Description: A recent college graduate with big dreams picks up a dead-end job at a small town news station, where he unwittingly befriends an infamous serial killer who could make all his dreams come true.

Entries.Title: Trey Kennedy: Grow Up
Entries.Description: Trey Kennedy discusses white people's weddings, homeschoolers, his entrance into fatherhood and more in this clean comedy special breaking down how maybe we all need to grow up in front of a sold-out Salt Lake crowd.

Entries.Title: Quick Fix
Entries.Description: A young man attempts to fix his car, but soon realizes there's no manual to life's problems.

Entries.Title: The Vocho from Hell
Entries.Description: During a rainy night, in the streets of what used to be the Federal District, Bartolo, a sad young man, boards an old and peculiar taxi, inside which he claims to have been left by his wife for another man, to which the driver, Damián, responds by inviting him for some drinks in a very charming and familiar little place where he was already headed anyway. After a couple of hours and another of caguamas, amid confessions and smoke, Bartolo will end up sealing his fate by being taken to the hellish destiny he deserves.

Entries.Title: Joe Kardos, el último cowboy
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Gettysburg
Entries.Description: A family melodrama wrapped up in an absurdist comedy punctuated by an American history lesson. Pitched between irony and sincerity, the classical and the experimental, national allegory and domestic drama, Gettysburg is the simple story of a man who hates his grandma.

Entries.Title: Rat King
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Bros
Entries.Description: The bond between best friends Adam and Jake is put to the test when Adam makes a startling discovery...

Entries.Title: Staying Still
Entries.Description: When a mannequin shows signs of life at her long-time restaurant job, Penny must find a way to escape with her incompetent new manager

Entries.Title: The Rabbit Hole
Entries.Description: Isaac, a neurotic tree-hugger, builds a god-like supercomputer in order to save the natural world. But, when the machine comes to life and his existence begins to crumble, Isaac is forced to choose between destiny and the person he loves most.

Entries.Title: To Fear a Spider
Entries.Description: Two friends learn to face their fears when they're confronted with a deadly spider, rabies, and many Oreo Cakesters.

Entries.Title: Колбаса
Entries.Description: The son of an oligarch goes to a village to revive a dying sausage factory to prove to his father that he is not just a rich kid.

Entries.Title: Exquisite Corpse
Entries.Description: Documentary about the eccentric figure of Mario Bazterrica Oliver. Following his recent death, various interviewees analyse, remember and portray, from multiple points of view, the importance and meaning of his person and his actions, which made him an important and not very popular person in Mallorca.

Entries.Title: The Case of the Dirty Dishes
Entries.Description: A Noir Detective investigates why his flatmate leaves the kitchen so damn dirty!

Entries.Title: По любви
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: La Güira y La Tambora
Entries.Description: A humble Merengue performer falls in love with the mayor's niece, facing the opposition of her family and his rival.

Entries.Title: The Chandelier
Entries.Description: A newlywed Egyptian man struggles to attend a crucial job interview due to a visit from his needy in-laws.

Entries.Title: Everybody Calls Redjo
Entries.Description: In a village where everyone left, Redjo stays behind, he becomes the heart of Sllupkovo. A heartwarming comedy celebrating community resilience. Everybody Calls Redjo, the village hero.

Entries.Title: Маленький шеф
Entries.Description: The boy decides to save the family on the verge of divorce by buying an old food truck.

Entries.Title: Una Carta al ARPARO
Entries.Description: After noticing the shortcomings of its university BUAP by its students, it suffers its biggest unemployment in recent years. The faculty of plastic and audiovisual arts show the life they had and the ties that were formed during thirty-three days

Entries.Title: Une crotte sur le coeur
Entries.Description: A man is getting ready for a peculiar date.

Entries.Title: Pei Kottu
Entries.Description: Kavya, a reporter, unknowingly picks up a haunted button camera. Soon, she is mistaken for Shruti, a missing musician whose music was stolen by a film crew. Shruti’s spirit possesses Kavya, seeking justice for her murder. The spirit kills those responsible, and evidence from the button camera exposes the truth. Shruti’s spirit finally departs after gaining her rightful recognition.

Entries.Title: The Photographers
Entries.Description: Two bumbling photographers are hired for a blackmail job—but their simple gig soon spirals into chaos and danger.

Entries.Title: Red Pocket
Entries.Description: A magical Red Pocket interrupts an anxiety ridden family dinner.

Entries.Title: What the Cat Dragged
Entries.Description: A man visits someone who seems to be an old acquaintance, but happens to be more of an entity...

Entries.Title: Sniffin' 4 Cryptids: The Geezer Squeezer
Entries.Description: After six seasons of monster hunting, the "Sniffin' 4 Cryptids" team meets their match.

Entries.Title: Bandi-Man
Entries.Description: An overly obsessed comic book nerd is at odds with who he loves more: His girlfriend or BANDI-MAN

Entries.Title: Threesome
Entries.Description: When a couple invites a Tinder rando over for a threesome, they're surprised to find out she's an absolute train wreck. But - she is hot..., so they're gonna go for it.

Entries.Title: Macarena, una comedia espiritual
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Vitrival – The Most Beautiful Village in the World
Entries.Description: Benjamin and Little Pierre, cousins and local policemen, patrol Vitrival while listening to Radio Chevauchoir. They have a lot to do: dick graffitis are popping up on the village walls. Of course, no one has seen or heard anything. At the same time, one villager commits suicide, then two, then three. Season after season, dick graffitis and suicides proliferate. What can Benjamin and Pierre do about it? Days and celebrations will keep flowing, no matter what.

Entries.Title: Day of the Draugr
Entries.Description: An ancient Viking zombie is woken up with the mission to take revenge by killing the descendent of the one who killed him. Unfortunately for high school freshman Luke Romero that happens to be him.

Entries.Title: Jerrod Carmichael: Don't Be Gay
Entries.Description: Jerrod Carmichael returns to the stage for his fourth HBO stand-up special.

Entries.Title: Ритмы мечты
Entries.Description: Varya lost her hearing several years ago due to an accident. But, despite the tragedy, she continues to pursue her favorite hobby - dancing. Now her dream is to get to the most important dance competition in the country and, of course, win. Varya meets Nik, a famous dancer and blogger. A friendship develops between the guys, and they decide to compete at the competition together. But Nik's wealthy and influential mother does not accept her son's choice, which deprives the boys of important financial support. Varya and Nik will have to find adult solutions on their own to follow their dreams. Their "team" on this journey will be Varya's dad, Toshka, the girl's smart friend, and Pegasus, a charismatic street dancer. They are all united by faith in victory, hope that the impossible is possible and, of course, a love of dancing. It is she who pushes young dancers to answer the main question for them: "Can I dance better than myself?"

Entries.Title: DE4TH DRIVE
Entries.Description: After a celebratory drink goes wrong, Looney accidentally kills the lead singer of his band. He must pull his bandmates into a cover-up before it is too late.

Entries.Title: Svingerid 2
Entries.Description: If you’ve put a cast on a broken bone, do you then wonder why you can’t just spring to your feet and dash off? It turns out it’s the same with swinging - more precisely, with hoping that a little (but never entirely innocent) partner-swapping will magically solve all your relationship problems.

Entries.Title: The Mole
Entries.Description: Román Aguirre (Sebastián Rubio) is a former Peruvian action film star. He had his best moment between the 70s and 80s, years in which he played his most famous role of all: "The Mole". Years later, a fast-paced life full of addictions has left Román almost forgotten. However, a meeting with Hugo Valcárcel (Pablo Saldarriaga), the most successful filmmaker of the moment, is about to return him to glory.

Entries.Title: Oh no.
Entries.Description: As Cassandre prepares her best friend's birthday she is plagued by visions of a bad future.

Entries.Title: Clean House
Entries.Description: On an ordinary day off, a man starts his day by cleaning his room as usual. But when he tries to sweep up the dust, he finds that it won't go into the dustpan as expected. He then tries every possible way to make sure the room is spotless.

Entries.Title: Your Own Flavor
Entries.Description: After being stood up on a date, Renee is grateful to find solace in an unexpected friendship with one of the good guys: a seemingly harmless puppet named Chompers. As their bond deepens, Chompers takes a chilling turn that forces Renee to wonder if she was ever his friend or if she was his prey.

Entries.Title: The Cora Walshe Stealing Moon
Entries.Description: When three friends hangout on a normal day, they discover an emoji of a moon that looks like it wants to steal Cora Walshe!

Entries.Title: Laia* EXPRESS
Entries.Description: Laia needs help, so she decides to gather four mysterious characters for a meeting that quickly spirals out of control.

Entries.Title: Visions Of Strangers
Entries.Description: A man attempts to process a recurring vision of two strangers on a beach.

Entries.Title: It's A Girl Thing
Entries.Description: Charlie + Ingrid <3

Entries.Title: Viernes Santo
Entries.Description: An American faces the Spanish tradition of celebrating Good Friday, the same day that he meets his girlfriend's parents.

Entries.Title: Dance Still
Entries.Description: Dance Still is an affectionate comedy about two friends in Beijing who find a poster offering a huge reward for the recovery of a lost pigeon. They decide to spend the next year of their lives searching for it. Over the course of the year that follows, their friendship grows and deepens, even as they come to face the disappointment of unrealised dreams and shattered love. This journey represents a microcosm of the lives of contemporary Chinese youth.

Entries.Title: Platée
Entries.Description: Platée, a silly and conceited nymph, falls for a fake wedding to Jupiter, king of the gods. This new staging of Jean-Philippe Rameau’s Baroque masterpiece is colourful, eccentric, full of wit and free of taboos, yet also surprisingly deep. Filmed 1st june 2025  at Czech National Theatre, Prague

Entries.Title: AstroVan
Entries.Description: Social media influencer Max's simple van life in the Pacific Northwest's woods takes an unexpected twist when he teams up with his eccentric neighbor, Roger, to fix his TV for a Blazer's game night.

Entries.Title: The Trolley Problem
Entries.Description: In a quiet parking lot, a small decision sets fate in motion, whilst a sentient trolley takes matters into its own wheels.

Entries.Title: Beyond the Deli Door
Entries.Description: A distraught deli worker takes a mysterious drug during a morning rush at his job and must escape another dimension he’s entered.

Entries.Title: Palate Cleanser
Entries.Description: Bart Lewis, a young father desperate to pay for his daughter’s cancer treatment, finally lands an interview with a mysterious company offering excellent benefits (including much-needed health insurance) despite being vastly unqualified. Nervously fumbling through his lunchtime meeting with the intimidating Ms. Goodwin, he finds himself excruciatingly out of place, from his soggy sandwich to his lack of credentials.  Just as he’s about to be dismissed, a heartfelt plea about his daughter catches her attention. But instead of an opportunity, Lewis is faced with a chilling ultimatum – one that could secure his daughter’s future, but at an unimaginable cost.

Entries.Title: Love Letters
Entries.Description: Céline is expecting her firstborn. But she’s not the one who’s pregnant. In three months, her wife Nadia will give birth to their daughter. Under the gaze of her friends, her mother, and the law, Céline looks for her place and sense of legitimacy.

Entries.Title: The Regulars
Entries.Description: Set in London's iconic Prince Charles Cinema, The Regulars follows a day in the life of its hapless employees. During their shift they watch movies, argue with customers, and, above all, deal with each other.

Entries.Title: Thanks To Meet You!
Entries.Description: Five businessmen do a business.

Entries.Title: The Long Road Ahead
Entries.Description: Two friends are on the way to visit one's sister when their car breaks down, leading to one of the world's most awkward carpools.

Entries.Title: HITMAN
Entries.Description: A retiring hitman must convince a normal guy to take his place for his boss. Little does he know, this "average joe" has an agenda of his own.

Entries.Title: The Influence
Entries.Description: Two young creatives pitch their latest ideas to the Board of Mictrotrends.

Entries.Title: The Caterer
Entries.Description: When the catering of a film set has canceled, one of the runners is burdened with the task of fixing lunch against impossible odds.

Entries.Title: Nathan And His Dad Go Hiking
Entries.Description: Nathan goes hiking with his dad

Entries.Title: Becoming Strong with Andrey
Entries.Description: A short humorous story about how you can play sports with a tree.

Entries.Title: BITE
Entries.Description: After discovering the body of an eccentric businessman, a middle-class delivery driver finds himself wrestling with the moral and physical repercussions of eating a dead person's groceries.

Entries.Title: Babayaga's Bitches: Book of Darell
Entries.Description: In this final installation of the Babayaga’s Bitches series, former wiccan youtubers Barb and Blaire have escaped hell, aided by Satan and the power of their love. Now, they must fulfill their destiny: avenging their former incarnation as a mistreated angel by killing G-d. Live streaming this mission, Barb and Blaire sway the spiritual citizens of the afterlife through empty appeals to progressivism, leading to disastrous results. Meanwhile, their former roommate and murder victim, Darell heads up the Apocalypse Prevention Committee. He watches as his team slips through his fingers, successfully influenced by Barb and Blaire.

With the veteran storytelling skills of a seasoned comic—and former collegiate wrestler—Greg revisits the coach who’s been living rent-free in his head for over 30 years. Yes, high school fishing teams are real. So are their cheerleaders. And with a routine you won’t forget, The Champ sticks the landing and scores big laughs.

Tired of her relationship troubles, Jannica wants anything but new romantic worries for the coming year – until she encounters a ghost from her past at the hospital. New Year's Eve offers Jannica the chance for one last adventure of the year, but the clinic's new and demanding surgeon, Eero Mustonen, adds challenges to Jannica's plans.

Entries.Title: Yunus Emre Gündüz - Call Me When You're There
Entries.Description: Yunus Emre Gündüz’s new stand-up show is a wild mix of sharp humor, chaotic energy, and brutally honest storytelling. With his signature fast-paced delivery and unpredictable punchlines, he dives into everyday absurdities, cultural quirks, and personal traumas—turning them into laugh-out-loud moments. It’s raw, clever, and refreshingly different from typical stand-up. If you like comedy that’s both smart and a little unhinged, this one’s worth watching.

Cycling through plans, libraries, and failures, the team valiantly fights the monster with their wits, power, and physics knowledge. Through friendship and triumph, anything is possible.

Suddenly, Sanya receives an urgent order: the hijacking of a "Gelendwagen" (or simply "Gelya"). And for the sake of a comfortable future for his family, he agrees, promising his wife to be in time for childbirth. But everything is not going according to plan, and the case turns into a conflict with a criminal gang of premium car thieves. Now Sanya faces a task of increased complexity: not only to deal with criminals, but also not to be late to the hospital.

Faced with this blatant theft, a group of people from San Carlos organizes a powerful social movement, which aims to obtain the precious "Denomination of Origin" for their longaniza sausages, and thus repair the damage and recover the dignity of their beloved town.

Entries.Title: Fawlty Towers: A Very British Comedy

While Basil Fawlty’s antics continue to make people laugh, the show’s availability today in a re-cut, edited format raises questions. Why does a comedy masterpiece, so beloved by many, now exist with missing scenes? “Fawlty Towers: A Very British Comedy” sets out to answer that very question.

From the very beginning of the film, we see a determined old man who fulfills orders and step by step climbs the career ladder. Nikolai Borisovich always has an old Polaroid camera around his neck, and he records each new success and sends the photo somewhere in an envelope... Overcoming obstacles, Nikolai Borisovich, a true teacher by vocation, will prove that in one summer you can build a happy life. The main thing is to do it honestly. Just live.

Entries.Title: Reuben Solo: Please Clap

Laughing? Maybe. Yes. Of course. Clapping? Yes, please, dammit it's in the title of the show. He's ready. Lights on. Cameras rolling. Nothing can go wrong.

Witching hour in the club, fruity beauties, an unhinged gymnastics class, a virtual fighting pit or an out-of-control after party: this film brings it all to the big screen by covering various types of fun such as authenticity, energy and thrill. Don’t even try to keep up, darling!  Prepare yourself for a bombastic interplay of DIY film and a hard techno soundtrack. It’s sexy, it’s glam, it’s wild, it’s fun, it’s BRRRP.

Entries.Title: Confessions of a Menopausal Femme Fatale

Framed around a return trip to Hawaii nearly 40 years after she once called it home, the story unfolds when a panic attack triggers deep introspection, forcing Shakoor to confront unresolved struggles, including addiction, postpartum depression, loss, and self-reinvention. Through wit, song, and unflinching truth, Shakoor breaks the silence surrounding menopause in a powerful performance that challenges stigma, invites laughter, and inspires radical self-acceptance.

Entries.Title: Закрытие

These are not stories with a beginning and an end, but statements written into the rhythm of the festival, where cinema becomes a way to be together and a way to be alone. Any almanac is a film cypher: everyone goes to the microphone, says their piece, and leaves, leaving room for someone else. "Closing" is exactly that: a collection of voices in which you can hear laughter, fatigue, love, and meaninglessness. This is a film about how cinema closes the day and opens the night.

On August 5th, Archive of My Own proudly took home Best Production and Best Director (Zoé Zifer) at the NY Theater Festival Awards. Entries.Title: Reborn Dolls Don't Cry
Entries.Description: In the depths of the tropical metropolis, where nature contends with concrete and silence is ceaselessly broken by invisible propellers and honking horns, a ritual unfolds. It is not a religious ceremony, nor a convention of medical science. It is something more profound: it is a human attempt to domesticate absence. These beings, simulacra of life, are tended to with more care than many real souls have ever received. The gathering begins without spectacle, like a silent dance between the real and the imagined. These women — mothers, artists, devotees, pilgrims — are not pretending. They believe. At the heart of Ibirapuera Park, where Oscar Niemeyer once imagined futuristic curves for a nation under construction, vinyl bodies now lie, untouched by time. In this encounter, contemporary Brazil brushes against the edge of post-reality.

From joining a mother’s group and sitting next to the patchouli mum to being held hostage in Africa by a man with a plastic police badge, Bron is no stranger to pretending everything is under control. Never shying away from an act-out, Lewis’ comedic physicality and formidable stage presence brings every story to life, and ‘Obviously’ will be an hour of laughter you don’t want to miss. Obviously.

Entries.Title: If I'm Afraid This Movie Is Finished

Introduced by Kitti, an ambitious film producer, and Rossi, a creative director working on a new project, Ardi expresses his disdain for local horror films, which he believes are of poor quality and rely too much on cheap jump scares.  Through interviews and interactions with his friends, including humorous moments shared while watching horror films together, Ardi's arrogance and skepticism toward the genre are evident. His friends challenge him to watch clips from some of the most terrifying horror films, hoping to make him experience fear. However, Ardi remains unimpressed by each clip shown, continuing to mock the genre's ability to frighten him.  As the film progresses, Ardi's journey becomes not just a challenge of fear but a humorous exploration of his own biases and the nature of horror in contemporary Indonesian cinema.

Join her as she explores what butch identity means in a world moving beyond labels, and tries to work out where it, and she, belong in the new frontline of queer liberation. Sounds funny, right? Her eagerly-awaited standup debut has been a long time coming – and was a runaway success at 2022’s Edinburgh Festival.

Entries.Description: Three years after he graduates from high school, Zack has an awkward encounter with a girl who signed his yearbook with her phone number.

Entries.Title: The Audition
Entries.Description: An over confident actor's audition goes hilariously wrong.

Entries.Title: Baste
Entries.Description: Just lay there and baste.

Entries.Title: Drifting
Entries.Description: At a divey roller rink, two childhood friends reunite after their separate ventures into life after high school.

Entries.Title: Too Many Crooks
Entries.Description: A young crime boss and his two henchmen get distracted from some business and end up getting caught up in a messy, dangerous adventure that winds up bringing them closer together.

Entries.Title: We Missed You
Entries.Description: A night of filmmaking with the lads

Entries.Title: Balada Para Un Loco
Entries.Description: Astor leads a normal life with his girlfriend and his job as a publicist, but everything changes when, for no apparent reason, he wakes up unable to stop dancing and singing.

Entries.Title: The Case of the Missing Pizza
Entries.Description: A classic whodunnit of cheesy proportions. 1st place for Nashua Public Library's 3rd Annual Tiny Film Festival.

Entries.Title: Ratman Goes to Therapy
Entries.Description: In order to receive medical treatment, the feral and monstrous Ratman is subjected to perverse psychoanalytic experiments.

Entries.Title: The Bottle
Entries.Description: A man is confused when his water bottle mysteriously starts filling up with different liquids.

Entries.Title: Pag-ibig ko at Siomai Rice
Entries.Description: Unexpected circumstances derail two high school lovers’ romance, forcing them to abandon what had started to bloom.

Entries.Title: film guy.
Entries.Description: film guy. is a film about a guy who likes film. It's a multilayered satire on American culture and dependence on reference humor and definitely is not related to the director at all. Bryan Sheehan is an engineer who wishes he went to a city college for film study. He was helped in filming this project by Cecil Mitchell and Aryana George.

Entries.Title: A Casa da Vitória
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Verona, Amores e Jogos de Verão
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Who’s Watching Who?
Entries.Description: On a night out with his friends, a lovesick protagonist discovers a hilarious and frustrating new companion: the audience, who offers unsolicited advice and commentary on his every move.

Entries.Title: Daluyong
Entries.Description: Have you ever known the taste of 'sikap at tiyaga' (effort and perseverance)?  Based on a true life story from a local residing in Batangas, Philippines, "Lando" is a young man looking to help out with the financial burden of his family. Gaining advice from his friends, he then seeks to become a vendor who sells ice cream to tourists in the middle of the ocean, sacrificing his education in exchange for earning money. In order to do so, he swims from cottage to cottage in the blazing sun, looking for a consumer that is willing to buy popsicles from a styrofoam box, where he keeps the frozen desserts cool.  But to what extent should Lando keep on pushing through, and how did he know when he was going to get to the fruitful path? Lando did not have the answers to these questions, and still he managed to push through everything. He lived to get the fruits of his labors, and for every second of it he had no regrets.

Entries.Title: Vampire on Tinder
Entries.Description: A horror short film.

Entries.Title: Beetlemania
Entries.Description: A mischievous boy opens a mysterious parcel from Chernobyl, Russia, advertising that children can raise their own insect family. As playful as it seems, this package contains a sinister secret that turns your ordinary home into a battleground for a horrible infestation.

Entries.Title: This Year's Interns
Entries.Description: In this workplace comedy, Aaron, an easygoing intern, and Jayden, his arrogant and overly competitive coworker, are wrapping up their final week at a marketing firm. With only one full-time position up for grabs, tension between the two escalates. When Aaron is tasked with getting the boss's birthday cake, Jayden seizes the opportunity to sabotage him. Their fierce rivalry spirals into a series of chaotic and hilarious office mishaps as both interns scramble to outdo each other in a last-ditch effort to secure the job.

Entries.Title: Insomniac
Entries.Description: A sleep deprived man searches for sleep, but the harder he tries, the further it slips away.

Entries.Title: 468-6 Mangwon-Dong
Entries.Description: The owner of a car presents himself in front of the person in charge of reporting a no-parking zone.

Entries.Title: Los caóticos trucos del mago Robert
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Oliver Theory
Entries.Description: A teenage girl texts the wrong boy about going on a date.

Entries.Title: The Last Live Stream
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: ZUMBIDO
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Humo's Comedy Cup 2023
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: the sticker
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: CINEPHILE (1996/2023)
Entries.Description: A man passionate about film adopts the personas of his screen idols in order to kill inconsiderate moviegoers interrupting his cinematic experience. This 16mm short film was shot in 1996 and hidden away in an attic for nearly 30 years...until now.

Entries.Title: The Take-Out
Entries.Description: Escalating tensions in the criminal underworld threaten the safety and friendship of Dennis and Larry- and set in motion events that will dig up dark truths from the past of Pizza By Wiggins.

Entries.Title: supercoincés
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: El show de Topo
Entries.Description: After his show got cancelled, Topo has to deal with a new life and a new family.

Entries.Title: Not That Kind of Clown
Entries.Description: When social hermit May hires a birthday clown for herself, she doesn’t expect Germayne, a disillusioned Pierrot to show up for the job. After May’s emotional baggage spills through her carefully constructed facade right in the middle of it, Germayne takes matters into her own gloved hands.

Entries.Title: LArirang
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Seltser City 4: The Infected
Entries.Description: The furious beast ‘The Tickle Monster’ has changed his face and he’s back for revenge. In this star-studded film, the infection is introduced, a deadly virus created by The Tickle Monster’s deadly master, Curtis The Crusader. Curtis and his evil henchmen want their diamond egg back, and they will stop at nothing to get their grubby little paws on it. Can Magic Matthew, Henry the Bartender and the rest of the gang stop this daring duo before it’s too late?

Entries.Title: Stoppage Time
Entries.Description: After winning a soccer tournament, four team friends spend the night alone in the sports club. Ramiro, announces that he is moving to Ushuaia with his father tomorrow morning. Tomás, his best friend, receives the news as a shock since he is in love with him and has never been able to confess it.

Entries.Title: Highest 2 Lowest
Entries.Description: When a titan music mogul, widely known as having the "best ears in the business", is targeted with a ransom plot, he is jammed up in a life-or-death moral dilemma.

Entries.Title: The Accountant²
Entries.Description: When an old acquaintance is murdered, Wolff is compelled to solve the case. Realizing more extreme measures are necessary, Wolff recruits his estranged and highly lethal brother, Brax, to help. In partnership with Marybeth Medina, they uncover a deadly conspiracy, becoming targets of a ruthless network of killers who will stop at nothing to keep their secrets buried.

Entries.Title: Night Always Comes
Entries.Description: Facing eviction in a city her family can no longer afford, a woman plunges into a desperate and increasingly dangerous all-night search to raise $25,000.

Entries.Title: STRAW
Entries.Description: What will be her last straw? A devastatingly bad day pushes a hardworking single mother to the breaking point — and into a shocking act of desperation.

Entries.Title: Laws of Man
Entries.Description: A pair of U.S. marshals search for a wanted murderer in Nevada at the height of the Cold War and encounter more than they bargained for.

Entries.Title: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
Entries.Description: The Four Horsemen return along with a new generation of illusionists performing mind-melding twists, turns, surprises, and magic unlike anything ever captured on film.

Entries.Title: Stolen: Heist of the Century
Entries.Description: Antwerp, 2003. A gang of thieves rob the impenetrable Diamond Center. Who was behind one of the world's biggest heists - and how did they pull it off?

Entries.Title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
Entries.Description: When they learn that one of their victims, Maya, is still alive, they return to finish what they’ve started.

Entries.Title: A Private Life
Entries.Description: When renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner learns of the death of one of her patients she is deeply troubled. Convinced that it was murder, she decides to investigate…

Entries.Title: Gyanvapi Files: A Tailor's Murder Story
Entries.Description: In June 2022, Kanhaiya Lal Sahu, a tailor in Udaipur, India, was brutally murdered. The events surrounding the murder are explored, delving into the conspiracy and the deeper issues of religious extremism, digital radicalization, and intelligence failures that led to the tragic event.

Entries.Title: Barren Land
Entries.Description: Barren Land is the story of three friends. All three trapped between the abandonment of the institutions, the violent and unstoppable rise of the narco in the province and the dangerous increase of social discontent. Three friends trapped in a powder keg that will test their friendship.

Entries.Title: The Girl Who Survived: The Alina Thompson Story
Entries.Description: 15-year-old Alina Thompson, an aspiring model in 1980s Los Angeles, pulls a fast one on her parents and sneaks away to an amateur photo casting call, where she meets photographer William Bradford. Unbeknownst to Alina, William is a serial killer, and she may be next.

Entries.Title: King Ivory
Entries.Description: Based on extensive research involving law enforcement and gang members, a never-before-seen, authentic look inside the underworld of fentanyl trafficking from gangs inside the Oklahoma State Penitentiary at McAlester a.k.a. "Big Mac."

Entries.Title: The Alto Knights
Entries.Description: Two of New York's most notorious organized crime bosses, Frank Costello and Vito Genovese, vie for control of the city's streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that will reshape the Mafia (and America) forever.

Entries.Title: Akkenam
Entries.Description: A brave cab driver and a released convict find themselves unlikely allies as they confront a greater evil that threatens to destroy many lives.

Entries.Title: Ponyboi
Entries.Description: Unfolding over the course of Valentine’s Day in New Jersey, a young intersex sex worker must run from the mob after a drug deal goes sideways, forcing him to confront his past.

Entries.Title: Dead Man's Wire
Entries.Description: Set in 1977 and based on a true story, Tony Kiritsis, a former real estate developer puts a dead man's switch on himself and the mortgage banker who did him wrong, demanding $5 million and a personal apology.

Entries.Title: Strange Harvest
Entries.Description: Detectives are thrust into a chilling hunt for “Mr. Shiny”—a sadistic serial killer from the past whose return marks the beginning of a new wave of grotesque, otherworldly crimes tied to a dark cosmic force.

Entries.Title: The Stone
Entries.Description: When Ake desperately needs money to pay for his gravely ill father's medical treatment, he takes his father's sacred amulet to be appraised by the renowned expert Seng Paradise.

Entries.Title: Barron's Cove
Entries.Description: When his young son is viciously murdered by a classmate, a grieving father with a history of violence kidnaps the child responsible, igniting a frenzied manhunt fueled by a powerful politician -- the father of the kidnapped boy.

Entries.Title: Echo Hunter
Entries.Description: A clone hunter in a future society where elites harvest clones for organs experiences memories from his past life, leading him to uncover a truth that threatens the entire system.

Entries.Title: Me Too
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: In the Hand of Dante
Entries.Description: A handwritten manuscript of Dante Alighieri's poem "The Divine Comedy" makes its way from a priest to a mob boss in New York City, where it is taken by author Nick Tosches after he's asked to verify its authenticity.

Entries.Title: The Art Of Abuse
Entries.Description: To some art is simply a painting, a sketch, perhaps a photograph - but to others, art is pain. That kind of art can't be framed, it has to be captured in a different way. At least that's what a villain would think.

Entries.Title: Kidnapped by a Killer: The Heather Robinson Story
Entries.Description: This is the TRUE STORY of how Heather Robinson grew up in a loving family in Illinois and, by the time she was a teen, had long known that she had been adopted as an infant. But in 2000, the then-15-year-old’s world was shattered when she learned that the man she knew as her uncle, John Robinson, was actually a serial killer accused of murdering multiple women in the Kansas City area, including her biological mother. Following her uncle’s arrest, Heather learns the shocking truth about her birth mother’s disappearance.

Entries.Title: Murderbaad
Entries.Description: A Jaipur tour guide's romance with an NRI unravels when a fellow tourist goes missing. As suspicion mounts, he vanishes-sparking a nationwide hunt that leads to one of modern India's most shocking crime twists.

Entries.Title: Tiger's Pond
Entries.Description: In the sleepy hamlet of Vaghachipani, an under-aged sheperdess is discovered to be pregnant. Her employer who is hellbent on becoming the chairman of the village-council is making every effort to cover it up, resulting in more cover-ups threatening to be exposed. Mentally-deficient, the young sheperdess has no idea what a pregnancy is.

Entries.Title: The Calendar Killer
Entries.Description: Klara is going to die today unless she kills her husband instead. The Calendar Killer has given her that impossible choice. When Jules starts his night shift at a telephone safety helpline for lonely women on their way home, Klara's call reaches him. He soon becomes her last hope for survival and races against time to save her.

Entries.Title: Never a Thief
Entries.Description: An insurance investigator infiltrates a Pacific island relic-smuggling gang with his lock-picking skills, navigates perilous heists to help police bust the syndicate, and unravels the mystery behind his father's disappearance.

Entries.Title: Kuberaa
Entries.Description: A ruthless billionaire, Neeraj, uses beggars as benamis to launder money, with the help of a disgraced civil submit servant, Deepak. One of the beggars, Deva, escapes with ₹10,000 crores and becomes the target of a deadly manhunt. He meets Sameera, who joins him in his mission to use the money to uplift society's poor. With Deepak's help, Deva fights back.

Entries.Title: The Wrath of God
Entries.Description: Ilija is a member of the Croatian Defence Council (HVO) somewhere in Central Bosnia in late 1993. One morning, after a routine mine laying campaign, he learns his younger brother Goran was killed far beyond enemy lines, together with eight other soldiers. Through a friend from the secret service, he finds out the mission was an unofficial one and that Goran and the others were acting as mercenaries. Ilija begins to expose a network of illegal activity involving not only the military, but high-ranking officials. As the investigation becomes more dangerous, his original intention to find out the truth slowly turns into a pathological mission of vengeance.

Entries.Title: Street Queens
Entries.Description: Three formidable women, Nia, Bella, and Dragon rise to power in the male-dominated realm of organized crime. This high-stakes gangster film explores a world where ruthlessness often determines who reigns supreme.

Entries.Title: BAKA's Identity
Entries.Description: Takuya and Mamoru are two young men from disadvantaged backgrounds who've been sucked into Japan's criminal underworld. Their job involves posing as women on social media to exploit isolated men and sell their personal identities. When they're not working, they're just ordinary friends who like hanging out together and sometimes letting loose. But when Takuya turns to Kajitani—a big brother figure who introduced him to the world of underground crime—to help him and Mamoru escape, they discover it isn't so simple.

Entries.Title: Madam Sengupta
Entries.Description: A famed cartoonist's search for her daughter's killer unravels a sinister trail of poetic murders, leading back to her estranged ex-husband, whose forbidden play threatens to expose Kolkata's darkest secrets.

Entries.Title: The Mastermind
Entries.Description: In a sedate corner of Massachusetts circa 1970, an unemployed carpenter turned amateur art thief plans his first big heist. When things go haywire, his life unravels.

Entries.Title: Salvable
Entries.Description: When a battered boxer past his prime finds his dreams and his relationships on the ropes, he falls back in with a dangerous crowd and has to take the biggest swing of his life to reclaim his hope and his family.

Entries.Title: Rani
Entries.Description: The film follows Dr. Manorani Saravanamuttu's relentless pursuit of justice after the tragic abduction and murder of her son, Richard de Zoysa, a journalist, writer, and human rights activist, in 1990.

Entries.Title: The Juice
Entries.Description: Douglas McCann, a street-smart LA attorney, risks everything when conspiracy theorists draw him into the divisive O.J. Simpson saga in this satirical thriller.

Entries.Title: Jilabi
Entries.Description: Corrupt Inspector Vijay Karamarkar takes charge of a wealthy industrialist's murder case, seeing it as a chance to profit. However, he soon finds himself entangled in deeper troubles, complicating his life further.

Entries.Title: Raid 2
Entries.Description: Set seven years after the events of the first film, it follows the return of IRS officer Amay Patnaik, who is attempting to take down a seemingly benevolent politician.

Entries.Title: 916 Kunjoottan
Entries.Description: A man with a small frame but a massive presence leads a double life as a beloved villager and a sharp city tycoon. As love and secrets collide, he must prove that true worth comes from the mind, not the size..

Entries.Title: She's Got No Name
Entries.Description: A bizarre case caused thousands of waves. There are different opinions on the truth. When the whole story of the case was gradually restored like pieces of a puzzle, people realized that the truth was not that important anymore.

Entries.Title: Sovereign
Entries.Description: Struggling single father Jerry indoctrinates his son Joe into the sovereign citizen movement, teaching him that laws are mere illusions and freedom is something you take. But, as Jerry’s ideology consumes them, they are set on a collision course with a police chief who has spent his life upholding the rules that Jerry has spent his tearing down.

Entries.Title: Ghaati
Entries.Description: Follows the story of an empowered woman who gets entangled with weed trade due to circumstances.

Entries.Title: Bound
Entries.Description: Đorđe and Divna are young people whose freedom is limited. Divna dreamed of being a famous singer, but she is forced to sing in a bar and perform striptease, and Đorđe's birth mother limits his freedom for fear of leaving her, like his father. The two meet and connect through music, and experience a love affair. They plan to help each other, to throw off the "strains and shackles" that bind them, but they face many obstacles that "bind" them, and which they must overcome in order to succeed.

Entries.Title: Chaos: The Manson Murders
Entries.Description: In August 1969, Charles Manson's followers killed seven people on his orders. Why? Explore a conspiracy of mind control, CIA experiments, and murder.

Entries.Title: Tuner
Entries.Description: A talented piano tuner's life is turned upside down when he discovers that his meticulous skills for tuning pianos can equally be applied to cracking safes in this jazz-infused crime drama about love, loss, and the lengths we’ll go to for the people who matter most.

Entries.Title: Maargan
Entries.Description: ADGP Dhruv, a seasoned high-ranking police officer haunted by a tragic past, grapples with a labyrinthine case, where every clue unearths a darker secret. As he uncovers clues linking to a mysterious swimmer, he races against time to stop a cunning serial killer driven by dark secrets.

Entries.Title: A Deadly American Marriage
Entries.Description: Murder or self-defense? Told from both sides, this documentary explores the killing of Jason Corbett during a dispute with his wife and her father.

Entries.Title: Revelations
Entries.Description: A pastor who believes in divine revelation and a detective haunted by visions pursue a missing person case — exposing their own demons in the process.

Entries.Title: The Serial Killer's Apprentice
Entries.Description: Dr. Katherine Ramsland interviews Elmer Wayne Henley, the sole survivor of the 1973 Houston Mass Murders, to unravel his chilling journey from manipulated teen to convicted killer — and the terrifying truth behind the line between victim and predator.

Entries.Title: Project Y
Entries.Description: Mi-sun and Do-kyung might be used to struggling in the most dangerous part of Seoul's Gangnam district, but that doesn't mean they've settled into it. With no one but each other to rely on, the two friends grind away to save the money needed to leave their dangerous lifestyles behind. But just as "retirement" comes within reach, the world betrays them, shattering their hopes. On the edge of a dead end, they discover a hidden fortune of dirty cash and gold in Gangnam – and place all their bets on one final high-stakes gamble of a lifetime.

Entries.Title: Devi Kusumasana
Entries.Description: Devi Kusumasana lets you deep dive into a world of stunning visuals, powerful storytelling, and unforgettable performances that explore the essence of love, sacrifice, and the beauty of life. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of Sri Lanka, this film promises to touch your heart and inspire your soul.

Entries.Title: The Stranger
Entries.Description: In 1930s Algeria, Frenchman Meursault's emotional detachment leads to a murder, scrutinized by a skeptical trial, adapted from Camus' "The Stranger."

Entries.Title: Little Jaffna
Entries.Description: The district of 'Little Jaffna' in Paris is the heart of a vibrant Tamil community, where Michael, a young police officer, is assigned to infiltrate a criminal group known for extortion and money laundering for the benefit of separatist rebels in Sri-Lanka. But as he works his way deeper into the heart of the organization, his loyalty will be tested, in a relentless pursuit against one of Paris' most hidden and powerful gangs.

Entries.Title: Thanal
Entries.Description: Fuelled by a lifetime of suffering, an ex army man embarks on a vengeful quest. Standing in his way is a police constable whose own past pain transformed into a dutiful son. When their paths converge, hero either can flee for his life or take a stand against the villain’s scheme of things.

Entries.Title: Irish Ashes
Entries.Description: When the son of an infamous Irish mobster returns home for the internment of his Mother's ashes, he discovers his sister is missing. Tristan McGowan tracks down the gang responsible for her kidnapping and uncovers a dark family secret.

Entries.Title: Stitched
Entries.Description: After a violent attack, former counterfeit criminal Ted Terger awakens in a surreal state—forced to witness his life through every conversation ever held about him behind it back. From whispers of admiration to scathing truths, Ted watches as his mother, ex-wife, son, and granddaughter recount their versions of who he was. As the decades unfold in fragments of personal truth and blunt honesty, Ted must confront the legacy he’s left behind.

Entries.Title: A Lion's Game
Entries.Description: Kurt Oberhaus, Michael Joseph Pierce, Mohamed Hakeemshady, Bella Dontine, and Gabriela Kostadinova in A Lion's Game (2025)  Facing a crippling company debt and a looming deadline from a ruthless loan shark, corporate executive Autumn Bennett's desperate scramble for a solution spirals into a whirlwind of greed and betrayal, threatening the world she's built and the relationships she values.

Entries.Title: Officer on Duty
Entries.Description: A demoted police inspector investigates a counterfeit jewelry racket, becoming entangled in a dangerous web of crime that puts his life at stake.

Entries.Title: Oklahoma City Bombing: American Terror
Entries.Description: This gripping documentary revisits the shocking 1995 bombing of an Oklahoma City federal building, the deadliest act of domestic terrorism in US history.

Entries.Title: Bikini Nuns
Entries.Description: A fearless trio of nuns is out for revenge. After being wronged by ruthless men, they trade their habits for high-powered weapons, taking justice into their own hands.

Entries.Title: Amongst the Wolves
Entries.Description: On the streets of Dublin, Danny, a homeless man grappling with the ghosts of his past, finds himself caught in a cycle of despair and survival. Haunted by memories of his time serving in the Royal Irish Army, Danny's life takes a turn when he encounters Will, a young teenager on the run from a dangerous drug gang.

Entries.Title: iHostage
Entries.Description: When a gunman enters an Apple Store in the heart of Amsterdam, the police face a delicate challenge to resolve the standoff.

Entries.Title: The Cavern Crimes
Entries.Description: An intense suspense thriller with an attractive blend of crime and mystery set in the unique historical backdrop of the Atapuerca paleontological site, home of the oldest human remains outside of Africa.

Entries.Title: The River of Fury
Entries.Description: A veterinarian vanishes from a pig farm, possibly linked to an evil ghost killer who terrorized the area 20 years ago. As new victims emerge, a police officer investigates the farm family's suspicious behavior, uncovering darker secrets.

Entries.Title: Maldoror
Entries.Description: When two girls go missing, Paul Chartier, an impulsive young police recruit, is assigned to “Maldoror”. This secret unit has been set up to monitor a dangerous sex offender. When the operation fails, fed up with the limits of the legal system, Chartier embarks on a solitary hunt to bring down the culprits.

Entries.Title: The Mediator
Entries.Description: It's 2009 and Mick Gatto is at the height of his powers. After receiving a job mediating a dispute in London, Mick consults his clairvoyant for guidance.

Entries.Title: Cosa Nostra
Entries.Description: Joseph, a callow ex-mobster, and George, his long-time mafioso mentor, find themselves adrift after successfully getting away with “one last job.” With the rest of the gang dead or in jail, Joseph and George grapple with finding a place in the world and are forced to choose to either move forward and embrace the unknown, or regress to what they once knew. Although they made it out of the mob together, will they both come to terms with their new lives? Or, will they remain unwavering in their inability to see eye-to-eye?

Entries.Title: Beyond the Sin
Entries.Description: Le Yiyan, a Macau Judicial Police inspector, is devastated when his daughter, Le Jiaqi, is found murdered. Suspect Qiu Junwen, is arrested and convicted, but when another girl is killed months later, Le Yiyan begins to doubt that the real killer is behind bars. Determined to uncover the truth, he reopens the case, uncovering dark secrets and suspicions.

Entries.Title: Broken Pieces: The Nygil M. Cullins Story
Entries.Description: Delves into the 2022 police shooting of a beloved 22-year-old man and the wrongful death lawsuit filed by his parents against the city of Atlanta.

Entries.Title: In Cold Light
Entries.Description: Fresh out of prison, Ava's attempt to reclaim her drug operation collapses when she witnesses a brutal crime, forcing her to flee into a nightmarish underworld where allies are scarce and enemies multiply by the minute.

Entries.Title: A Bad Summer
Entries.Description: Sasaki is a sincere civil servant, working at city hall. Due to his timid personality, he can't properly deal with nasty people, including a single mother on the verge of giving up her own child, another civil servant pressing him to have a physical relationship, and a person who receives welfare benefits unfairly. His passivity leads him to get caught up in a terrible crime.

Entries.Title: Candlestick
Entries.Description: In Japan today, there is a demand for "100 million people to become shareholders" due to the "20 million yen retirement problem" and the spread of NISA and iDeCo. It is no exaggeration to say that we live in an age where "billionaires" are born through cryptocurrencies and stocks, and that anyone has the chance to become a billionaire.

Entries.Title: Ronth
Entries.Description: Two patrol officers face mounting tensions during a night shift as they navigate dangerous calls while confronting their strained partnership and personal demons.

Entries.Title: Unification of Japan 67
Entries.Description: Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya) and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) returned to Tokyo to confront Okada (Yuki Matsumura). However, waiting for them was a notice of succession from the Hasekai, which was supposed to be under the Kyowakai's control. Upon learning that Okada’s faction had ties to the Hasekai's new successor, Himuro immediately severed ties, bringing the direct showdown between the Kyowakai and Marugami-kai closer.  Meanwhile, Reiko (Reira Arai), who had been hiding with Genji (Kuroishi Takahiro), continued living in hiding, harboring distrust towards Genji and others. Despite this, she remained focused on her vengeance against the Kyowakai. While Himuro and the others tried to clear up Reiko's misunderstanding for Minami (Rin Asuka), Reiko refused to listen. Gradually, she became more involved with Okada’s faction, who were willing to use anything for the war against the Kyowakai.

Entries.Title: Surrender
Entries.Description: The story unfolds Five days prior during election season, where a police team and a notorious gangster are significantly affected by the election. Ultimately, the narrative leads to a decisive resolution of their conflict with many twists, turns, and emotions.

Entries.Title: Rekhachithram
Entries.Description: Having recently served a suspension for gambling online while on duty, Circle Inspector Vivek Gopinath rejoins the police force and is looking to reclaim his lost honour. Awaiting him is a 40-year-old, unresolved murder mystery with a faceless victim.

Entries.Title: Fire
Entries.Description: A physiotherapist mysteriously disappears, triggering a police investigation. As officers question those connected to him, secrets unravel, and shocking truths come to light. Did he vanish, or was he murdered?

Entries.Title: Unification of Japan 68
Entries.Description: A sudden notice of succession from the Hasekai arrived from the Marugami-kai. Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya) and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) were furious and stormed into the ceremony. Mita (Shun Sugata) saw this as a declaration of war and vowed decisive action.  The police, led by Matsumiya (Gento Hongo), ramped up surveillance on the rising tension between the Kyowakai and Marugami-kai, leading to the arrest of Teru (Yutaka Kyan) and Saito (Katsuya), escalating the crisis.  Amid rising tension in the Kyowakai, Nakajima (Yoshimi Tachi) sought revenge for Shoji’s death. Concerned about Minami (Rin Asuka) due to Reiko’s (Reira Arai) involvement, Himuro and the others were encouraged by Kawata (Hitoshi Ozawa) to proceed.  Himuro’s plan set up a clash between Kuramoto Kogyo and the Keihin Rengo-kai. Though it initially went smoothly, Jun (Goro Washida) and Chosaku (Keishi Kawaguchi) interfered, creating new complications.

Entries.Title: Tinsman Road
Entries.Description: In the backwoods of New Jersey a young man navigates the serpentine mystery surrounding his long-missing sister and their family home.

Entries.Title: Muzzle: City of Wolves
Entries.Description: LAPD officer Jake Rosser endeavors to lead a peaceful life with his family and retired K-9 officer, Socks. However, tranquility dissolves into chaos when a gang targets them in a brutal attack. Alongside his new K-9 partner Argos, Jake launches into a relentless pursuit of justice, determined to protect his loved ones.

Entries.Title: The Interrogation of Anna Goode
Entries.Description: While questioning a murder suspect, FBI Agent John Savage inexplicably finds himself on the opposite side of the table. Now framed for the crime, he must go to extreme lengths to reveal the shocking truth.

Entries.Title: Con Mum
Entries.Description: A chef's life is upended when a jet-setting, champagne-sipping, hotel-hopping woman claims to be his long-lost mother. This documentary reveals the untold story.

Entries.Title: Pravinkoodu Shappu
Entries.Description: On a rainy night, a toddy shop owner is found hanging after 11 people stayed inside playing cards in the closed shop. SI Santhosh investigates, uncovering secrets to find the killer.

Entries.Title: Broken Vein
Entries.Description: To keep his home out of a loan shark's clutches, a businessman sets a seemingly flawless plan in motion - and a sequence of events that will ultimately lead to an unthinkable family tragedy.

Entries.Title: AUM: The Cult at the End of the World
Entries.Description: The shocking story of Aum Shinrikyo, the doomsday cult that unleashed a deadly nerve gas in Tokyo’s subway system in 1995. Founded by disillusioned yoga teacher Shoko Asahara, Aum transformed into a terrorist organization while Japan’s police and media turned a blind eye. Featuring rare archival footage and an interview with one of Asahara’s former high-ranking disciples. A Sundance premiere.

Entries.Title: To a Land Unknown
Entries.Description: Cousins Chatila and Reda are saving to pay for fake passports to get out of Athens. When Reda loses their hard-earned cash to his drug addiction, Chatila hatches an extreme plan to pose as smugglers in an attempt to get them out of their desperate situation before it is too late.

Entries.Title: The Woman
Entries.Description: An exchange of strawberries and a used household appliance turns into a nightmare for Sun-kyung when her partner turns up dead. Now she must follow the trail of a disturbing stranger.

Entries.Title: Behind the Shadows
Entries.Description: Au Yeung Wai Yip is a private detective who has been focusing on missing persons and adultery investigations for many years. One day, he received a "special" commission: the owner of the travel agency had asked him to investigate his girlfriend, who happened to be Au Yeung Wai Yip’s wife.Being a private detective, he is used to looking for the truth with cold eyes for his clients, but he finds it difficult to face the truth about their own marriage. Unable to withstand his inner torment, Au Yeung Wai Yip gave up on another ongoing case - a client's search for his missing fiancée - and went to the hotel to catch the adulterer. Unfortunately, the marriage could not be saved in the end, and the client's fiancée was killed after he left. A seemingly ordinary affair turned into a murderous incident!

Entries.Title: Die Like a Man
Entries.Description: Set in the heart of a rapidly gentrifying west Los Angeles neighborhood still reeling from decades of guns and gang violence across the four corners near Venice, a working-class single mom desperately tries to wean her 17-year-old son Freddy away from a veteran gangster who has become a father figure to him.

Entries.Title: Mob Cops
Entries.Description: A retired NYPD detective writes a book about his family's ties to the mob, igniting a firestorm between the corrupt cops working for the city's brutal crime boss and the officers trying to bring them to justice.

Entries.Title: Some Kind of Justice
Entries.Description: This brilliantly shot micro-budget film follows the story of Gerald Owens, whose world shatters when his only child is senselessly murdered. With no witnesses and the police at a dead end, he joins forces with another grieving father to hunt down those responsible to make them pay.

Entries.Title: Commission
Entries.Description: Dan-kyung, a mediocre art academy instructor, dreams of becoming a successful comic artist like her talented sister, Ju-kyung. However, opportunities never seem to come her way.

Entries.Title: Muthal Pakkam
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Penance
Entries.Description: A methodical serial killer known as The Inferno Killer terrorizes the beautiful city of San Diego by murdering his victims according to the punishments within the 9 Circles of Hell.

Entries.Title: The Verdict
Entries.Description: When Elisa, a billionaire, is found dead, her close friend and well-wisher Namrutha, who was recently added to Elisa’s will is accused of murdering her. Maya Kannappan, Nami's formidable attorney takes on the case and works through these proceedings, determined to prove Namrutha’s innocence and unmask the real killer.

Entries.Title: Bhaggyo Lokkhi
Entries.Description: A married couple discover a dead body with a suitcase of cash in their house and get entangled in a web of crime involving politicians, police and cold-blooded killers. Can they dispose of the corpse and get out of this mess?

Entries.Title: Unification of Japan 66
