Entries.Description: Following a failed attack, Ervil’s rage reaches an all-time high and causes Rena to fear for her and her daughter’s safety. Determined to protect her daughter and break free from the horrific cult, Rena must navigate her way to safety without falling victim to Ervil’s paranoia or his violent followers. Against all odds, Rena finds the strength to break free from the cult’s grasps and escape with her daughter. Together, they begin a new life, determined to make amends for their role in the cult’s crimes. But will she ever really be able to escape the memory of Ervil? Part two of a two-part film.

Entries.Title: Stolen
Entries.Description: A group of 4 roommates - Mike, Bri, Charles, and Rachel - hit it big after winning a lot of money gambling. The next day, however, the money mysteriously disappeared. The devastating news pushes them to find the money, especially Mike, whose pursuit of the truth strains their relationships.

Entries.Title: Niemand stirbt gern allein. Ein Krimi aus Passau
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Mexia Incident
Entries.Description: A short documentary covering the horrific events behind the Mexia Supermarket which took place in 1999.

Entries.Title: Der Galicien-Krimi: Die Tote vom Jakobsweg
Entries.Description: At Cabo Fisterra, where the Way of St. James ends and the Atlantic crashes against the cliffs, two pilgrims find the body of a woman: Sofía Serrano, an employee of the pilgrims' office in Santiago de Compostela. Chief Inspector David Acosta, freshly transferred from metropolitan Valencia to rugged Galicia, takes on his first case at the remote office. The workaholic wants to use his transfer to keep in touch with his ex-wife Paola and his 15-year-old daughter. A lead leads David and his team - the experienced detective Adrián Martinz, who is reluctant to submit to his superior, and the self-confident detective Mercédes Navarro - to the mysterious pilgrim Carmelo. He turns out to be a criminal with a seductive streak. When he escapes from the police, there is a crisis in the team. While David, who is spoiled by success, comes under pressure, he has no idea that he is about to receive bad news on a personal level.

Entries.Title: Polk: The Trial Of Philip Polkinghorne
Entries.Description: Polk: The Trial of Philip Polkinghorne explores the case of a prominent New Zealand eye surgeon accused of the murder of his wife, Pauline Hanna.

Entries.Title: Too Little Too Late
Entries.Description: James "Honcho" Young II is a well-respected boss but his position is threatened by his ex-love, turned partner, Ryan "Rain" Mills who desperately wants to be next in line. Driven by jealousy, love and money, Rain sets her sights on taking what's hers, causing Honcho to lose more than just his position. Can she afford the cost to be boss?

Entries.Title: What we don't talk about
Entries.Description: In a small town in the interior of Rio Grande do Sul (Brazil), close to the border with Uruguay, crimes against children occur and no one can solve them. The town makes a pact of silence about the events, believing them to be the result of some kind of curse, but this scenario changes abruptly when a documentary film crew goes to the place to decipher the mystery and ends up being involved in it.

Entries.Title: Shadows of Redemption
Entries.Description: Ares, a ruthless criminal, seeks to reclaim his family's underworld empire. Betrayal and deception haunt his path as he battles former allies and lovers. Determined to avenge his father's murder and reunite his family, Ares faces his toughest challenge yet: uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

Entries.Title: Se souvenir est le crime
Entries.Description: Zoe Estola is preparing for an interview to mark the release of her new book. In it, she recounts the botched investigation into the unsolved murder of her younger sister, Eva, conducted years earlier by Inspector Zacchari Memora. As she retraces the case, Zoe seeks to understand why the inspector never submitted the findings of his investigation. This silence seems to be linked to strange memories and repressed promises...

Entries.Title: Magma - Mattarella, the perfect murder
Entries.Description: Through distinguished testimonies, Magma - Matteotti, the Perfect Crime reconstructs a tumultuous period in our country's history, still shrouded in unresolved shadows. Starting from the murder of Christian Democrat politician Piersanti Mattarella, President of the Sicilian Region and brother of our current President, Sergio Mattarella—still without a culprit after 45 years—the film investigates the dark plots, the Red Brigades, rogue intelligence services, Gladio, and everything that simmered in the magma (chosen as a powerful symbol and narrative counterpoint) behind the violent deaths of Honorable Aldo Moro, magistrate and university professor Vittorio Bachelet (with firsthand testimony from Rosy Bindi, his assistant and direct witness to the attack), and the massacre at Bologna station—all events that occurred within the span of two years.

Entries.Title: Turn It Off
Entries.Description: In the early 2010's. A group of amateur YouTube pranksters record a video for their channel which involves them playing ding, dong, ditch. Only for them to discover something sinister about one of the houses they target.

Entries.Title: The Business Diner, a New York crime story.
Entries.Description: Caleb, Paulie and Tony are meeting the potential next supplier : Marcello Legatto

Entries.Title: Idris Elba: Our Knife Crime Crisis
Entries.Description: Idris Elba confronts the reality of knife crime, speaking to those most affected - from the streets to the system - in a quest to uncover how we can break the cycle.

Entries.Title: Get Away
Entries.Description: A getaway driver considers his future.

Entries.Title: Goodbye Fellas
Entries.Description: Two friends bet their pride in the wrong place. Without knowing, a bar, some beers, and a game of Truco will decide their fate.

Entries.Title: Made in Vancouver
Entries.Description: A desperate immigrant is sent to Vancouver to recover a stolen watch. Meanwhile, two low-level gangsters search for the same watch to avoid being executed by their boss. Both groups fight for the same object that has the power to save their lives.
No description available

Entries.Title: Misteri Rumah Darah
Entries.Description: Shafeera, a rising host, is given the chance to host the remake of Percaya Ngga Percaya. While studying old footage, she discovers an unaired tape labeled "Rumah Darah," leading to disturbing paranormal events that threaten her life. As she investigates the mystery behind Rumah Darah, she uncovers dark secrets from the past that put her soul at risk.

Entries.Title: Hasselager Hunchback
Entries.Description: Rememberings of unbelievable things that have happened in the small cult-run suburban town of Hasselager. A beautiful Persian woman, accused of witchcraft and punished with having to spend eternity in Hasselager is guarding the local lake to protect a special fish she has chosen as her mate, but things turn around when a local red haired girl steals the fish to get out of a forced heterosexual marriage.

Entries.Title: Persona
Entries.Description: A talented young impersonator falls for a mysterious stranger and is slowly lured into assuming the identity of a missing ivy-league student.

Entries.Title: Ai wa Tanken (Love is a Dagger)
Entries.Description: Amelia and Wes have had a falling out in Japan, a foreign land neither of them are accustomed to. While doing some soul-searching on her own, Amelia begins to notice that she's being stalked by a strange man. Wes pleads with her to come back for her own safety - but Amelia's about to find that sometimes the most familiar faces are the most misgiving.

Entries.Title: Love & Other Crimes
Entries.Description: Noah Thomas's life takes a dangerous turn when a chance reunion with an old high school friend entangles him in a ruthless crime ring. As he falls deeper into the syndicate's violent world, his budding romance with Shaye Matthews offers a fragile glimmer of hope. Torn between love and survival, Noah must navigate betrayals, escalating stakes, and deadly choices that threaten to destroy everything he values.

Entries.Title: Di Tengah Dua Saudari 3
Entries.Description: Lana’s first night with Nola and Erza turns into a nightmare. Trapped between the two psychopathic sisters, blindfolded and gagged, her freedom is completely stripped away. By morning, they force her to recite a strange prayer, not for safety, but a false confession of happiness in their custody. Repeating it over and over, Lana is finally fed like a prisoner who exists only to obey.

Entries.Title: Unification of Japan: Tokyo Edition
Entries.Description: One late night, a masked trio breaks into a house in a wealthy residential area, carefully choosing a time when no one’s home. But just as they’re searching for valuables, the couple—who were supposed to be away on a trip—suddenly returns. Panicking, the robbers make a run for it toward their car. Just then, another vehicle happens to pass nearby…

Entries.Title: Double Dog Dare: The Pitch
Entries.Description: Seven years after losing his wife and child to a group of sadistic eleven-year-olds, Paul meticulously plans his brutal revenge against the now-teenage perpetrators. In a tense confrontation, Paul is visited by the ghost of his late wife, Helena, who pleads with him to abandon his violent quest. As Helena tries to convince him of the consequences of vengeance, Paul reveals the dark steps he has already taken in his pursuit of retribution.

Entries.Title: Take Me to Dinner
Entries.Description: A woman who'd soured on love finally meets the man of her dreams, but is driven on a murder spree when he stands her up for a dinner date.

Entries.Title: Kwento
Entries.Description: Town's young soccer hero ends up on a surreal odyssey of fear, murder, and vengeance after he is forced to go into hiding from the Yakuza mafia.

Entries.Title: The Legend of Doc Mays
Entries.Description: Follows the story of Dwayne "Doc" Mays, born in North Carolina and raised in Chicago by his streetwise mother. After the death of his mother, his hard life would lead to him becoming one of the most notorious gangsters in the city.

Entries.Title: The Job
Entries.Description: David, a man working a dead-end job who wishes for more, is given a difficult choice with a high risk and even higher reward.

Entries.Title: Macai
Entries.Description: A drug dealer finds himself in hot water when the merchandise he’s carrying for a local kingpin is lost. Fearing his vicious boss’ retribution, he sets off to make amends, in a visceral, kinetic film that knowingly plays with genre conventions.

Entries.Title: Tweestrijd
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Worse Than Enemy
Entries.Description: Two close friends meet again after six years in a  remote cabin, but beneath this friendly reunion lies a buried secret,  and its revelation will be deadly

Entries.Title: Alpentod - Ein Bergland-Krimi - Alte Wunden
Entries.Description: Leon, an eleven-year-old, disappears from a Bavaria-Austrian border region children's home, resembling a previous case five years ago. Investigation involves Inspector Reincke and forensic archaeologist Dr. Marie Sonnleitner.

Entries.Title: Gambling Man
Entries.Description: A down-on-his-luck gambler wins the lottery, but his newfound wealth soon reveals that everything—even friendship—has a price.

Entries.Title: The Last Vendetta
Entries.Description: DEA Agent Keith Miller remains haunted by his wife’s murder. As his partner Stokes eyes retirement and their boss Marks vanishes before a crucial vote, a captured assassin’s secret leads to a dangerous conspiracy and a deadly showdown.

Entries.Title: El Patron De La Plaza
Entries.Description: In a region where power is measured by territoy and loyalties, the Plaza Boss rules with his hand! His control his control over the most lucrative zone has given him fame and respect, but just as many enemies. While he protects his empire, a silent threat emerges. Hidden enemies waiting for the smallest mistake to undergo a war that could destroy everything.

Entries.Title: Surprise
Entries.Description: Two stylish thieves head to Goa with stolen riches. Picking up a stranger who recognizes one of them turns their escape into a dangerous web of lies - revealing dark secrets beyond their heist.

Entries.Title: Goodbye Stranger
Entries.Description: After a botched scam, a seasoned con-man faces a moral crossroads: abandon his 10-year-old daughter or risk her following in his footsteps.

Entries.Title: TAFRI
Entries.Description: Ved takes Sid into an encounter with Guru who is a hotshot, to save himself and his girlfriend Pari, who is also Guru's sister, to have a better life but things take a dangerous turn.

Entries.Title: Unholy Communion
Entries.Description: When Catholic priests with pedophile pasts begin turning up dead, a small town cop's investigation unearths buried secrets that begin to implicate an entire community.

Entries.Title: Jarnail: The Warrior
Entries.Description: After a horrific event strikes a girl, her family and the police race to find the culprits. As secrets unravel, will justice be served or slip away?

Entries.Title: Alpentod - Ein Bergland-Krimi - Gemeinsame Ziele
Entries.Description: Birgit Reincke is a resolute and quick-witted investigator in her early 50s who has seemingly given up her job. She is assisted by Jonas Becker, an aggressive and impulsive rookie detective, and Marie Sonnleitner, a brilliant scientist.

Entries.Title: Meta Take One
Entries.Description: An obsessive young director & his crew plunge into a frantic night long odyssey of desperation to finish his film no matter the cost.

Entries.Title: All the Magazine's Men
Entries.Description: After being tricked into burning his cash on the stock market, a man embarks on an odyssey through the business underworld with a single goal: revenge.

Entries.Title: Chevette
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Memiliki Viola 3
Entries.Description: Viola’s torment continues in a far crueler form. After a month in hiding, she is now under the control of Talia, Elva’s friend who treats her even worse than before. From being a ‘pet cat’ to a ‘baby’ forced into harsh care, Viola is trapped in a new cycle of suffering, veiled under the guise of affection.

Entries.Title: The Disposers
Entries.Description: An upcoming movie by Chris Escorrega and Thomas Petahtegoose

Entries.Title: A Causa Secreta
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Mengintai
Entries.Description: A woman enjoying a relaxing time at a seaside park unknowingly becomes the subject of a mysterious girl's watchful gaze. The unbroken stare soon turns into the beginning of unexpected events, shifting the peaceful atmosphere into one filled with questions.

Entries.Title: OG_Kush: Betting Shop
Entries.Description: Born around gambling, OG_Kush leads his journey to take down casinos by rigging games and stealing money. However, the casino has measures to get in his way.

Entries.Title: Red Handed
Entries.Description: After his boss appoints him to hide a body, Red entrusts his closest friend, Marley, to help him carry out the task.

Entries.Title: Cartel
Entries.Description: He's a well known Fraudster who runs a Cartel, but When the scores are up.the only language he understands is survival ,But Amanda will do anything possible to save her brother who's caught in the web of this syndicate.

Entries.Title: Nowhere to Be Found
Entries.Description: Two sisters go on a senior trip to Mexico, led by Ava's boyfriend Trent. Meanwhile, journalist Jessica Vandross is going to the same Mexican town in search of her sister's killer after escaping a sex trafficking ring. These stories collide, in a thrilling fight for their lives.

Entries.Title: FILIVS
Entries.Description: Blinded by jealousy and pain over his partner's betrayal, a young man kills her lover, convinced that he has restored his honour. But the crime brings no relief: only fear and the weight of a guilt he cannot handle.

Entries.Title: Night in West Texas
Entries.Description: Forty years after a gay Apache man is framed for the brutal murder of a closeted Catholic priest, a police chief uncovers long-buried evidence that shakes up the small, oil-rich West Texas town that imprisoned him.

Entries.Title: GAMBOA
Entries.Description: What are you willing to do to get back those you love?  Gamboa, a young man who has been a drug dealer for a long time, is determined to leave that life behind and win back his family’s trust. After settling his debt with his boss, he tries to negotiate his way out. But his boss won’t let him go so easily. One last job stands in his way, forcing him to risk his conscience in exchange for a chance at freedom.

Entries.Title: Hittin Licks
Entries.Description: A grieving young woman embarks on a path of vengeance against a local crime boss, whom she holds responsible for the tragic death of her mother.

Entries.Title: Aliens in the Hood
Entries.Description: The hood politics of the neighborhood become even more complicated after the arrival of aliens! When one man in the neighborhood is blessed with superpowers, he and the other warring factions are headed to war over control of the current drug trade.

Entries.Title: De hombres y armaduras

Entries.Title: Cold Cut Case
Entries.Description: A detective with a haunted past tackles a gruesome homicide, unraveling mysteries in a case clouded by loss and justice.

Entries.Title: LUMIÈRE

Each day, he tried to weave meaning from brief conversations with strangers, as if hoping that just one might last longer than a mere greeting. In the crowd that felt lonelier than solitude, he wondered how much longer he had to endure before he truly disappeared.

Entries.Title: Inferno

Following the disappearance of a young girl, Mathilde, outside the law, will conduct her own investigation and follow the trail of a man named François Renard. A man with a troubled and violent past who claims to have settled down. As she sinks into a spiral of darkness, Mathilde faces the most monstrous aspects of humanity.

To prove his manhood, he joins a robbery; however, driven by his hormones and his attraction to Gabriela and Johnny, a punk singer, his plans will change.

Entries.Title: wrathslaughter
Entries.Description: Although set in the southern Netherlands and Belgium, the story draws from murders that began in Moscow Oblast, Russia, in 2014. Fedorov, a young man of Russian descent orphaned and raised by his uncle, graduated from a technical university near The Hague but, afflicted by worsening somatic symptoms, failed to secure work. Returning to Russia under sanctions seemed impossible. He wandered the streets, smoking cannabis and throwing stones at drunks. Within this self-made prison he met Helena, a Flemish girl, on an online forum. She lured him into smuggling soap and chemicals to the black market in Liège. The next month he met Helena and two female accomplices at Liège-Guillemins Station. Yet at their suburban hideout—an abandoned factory—he was forced into his first murder and dismemberment. Only then did he realise he had entered their abyss of crime, irrevocably damned. Where will their fates turn in the next manipulative, large-scale ensemble sequence?

As the prosecution struggles, Jay and his business partners work to exist the dangerous world cleanly.

A meeting with the elusive Mr. Nobody. But in a city where luck runs thin and bullets fly fast, making it out clean is never part of the plan.

Entries.Description: When a hitman kills an innocent in a moment of panic, he descends on a religious journey of regret he has not before felt. All the while, a vengeful policeman is hot on his trail, set on his own form of justice.

As Marcus tries to escape his past, he becomes an unwitting pawn in a dangerous game of power, betrayal, and faith. With the help of Sister Maria, who harbors her own scars, and the relentless Agent Nyakundi, Marcus must decide whether to embrace his sins or expose the corruption within the holy grounds. But redemption comes at a cost-one that might claim his life.

The path she must take will not be easy, will Quinn be able to break the cycle of guilt she imprisons herself with? Or will she fail to become better?

Entries.Description: Two old fellow mobsters meet up at hideout to discuss their next job. They plunge into a conversation recollecting their past deeds together, which leads them into argument and rivalry, until one of them realizes something is quite wrong.

Entries.Title: The Gambler
Entries.Description: Nurik is a simple laborer who works as a mover during the day and drives a taxi in his spare time. In the past, he was addicted to gambling, but thanks to his wife, he managed to quit. One day, his friends start mocking him, and difficult life circumstances push him back to the card table. Playing in secret from his wife, Nurik begins to earn good money, buys an apartment, a car, and it seems like life is finally looking up. However, his luck doesn’t last long, as a professional player from Turkey named Kemal arrives in the city.

Entries.Title: I Won't Go Home Empty-Handed

Entries.Title: Raah
Entries.Description: Zafar, a troubled man ensnared in a drug deal, is arrested and taken to a police station. While in custody, he reflects on his life choices and their devastating impact on his younger sister. Through a poignant letter to her, Zafar confronts his regrets, exploring themes of guilt, betrayal, and redemption. As he navigates judgment from both society and himself, he seeks a path to reclaim his humanity and make amends.

Entries.Title: Murder, From a Point of View
Entries.Description: When one man is shot, and there are two sides to the story, who do you believe? There is only one man for this job: Detective Jack Callahan

Entries.Title: Maralinga

Entries.Title: The Last Card
Entries.Description: A washed-up private detective is pressured by a mob boss to find a man who has disappeared under federal protection, and gives him one week to deliver results, threatening him if he fails.

Entries.Title: Bounty

Entries.Title: Outsider

Entries.Title: Memories of Sin

Entries.Title: Backlash: The Murder of George Floyd
Entries.Description: Five years since the murder of George Floyd – the police killing that set America on fire with rage and sparked a wave of protests around the world, director Kwabena Oppong's film explores one of the most important and defining events in modern history.  Featuring ground-breaking interviews with members of George Floyd’s family, the Minneapolis Police Chief who took the bold step of testifying against one of his own officers, Boris Johnson’s advisor on race Samuel Kasumu, and Sal Naseem the former Regional Director for London at the IOPC, as well as cultural figures Che Lingo, Nathalie Emmanuel, broadcasters Andi and Miquita Oliver and Munya Chawawa.

Entries.Title: Sleight of Hand
Entries.Description: Three girls finally face the consequences when they con the wrong man.

Entries.Title: Red*cted
Entries.Description: After the death of his sister, Harry Moore gets revenge on the man responsible for ending her life.

Entries.Title: MARCH OF THE PIGS: A Teenage Snuff Film Story
Entries.Description: A young man plots the assassination of a half-pig, half-man politician.

Entries.Title: In Sect
Entries.Description: After a swelling undercurrent of violence at a peaceful protest erupts into a bloodbath, an elusive cult leader's bodyguard must salvage the plan that he undermined or else lose the object of his obsession... her.

Entries.Title: Ajooba - The Unique
Entries.Description: Dhanush, a top Indian businessman, a multi-billionaire goes to USA on a business trip along with his girl friend Deepika hoping for her acceptance for his love. Unexpected events are unfolding there that could take a toll on their life.

Entries.Title: Passionnément Robert Hie
Entries.Description: Robert's entire life revolves around his passion: his job as a burglar. When a film crew wants to make a documentary about his daily life, he accepts without hesitation. But what facets of himself will Robert bring to the camera?

Entries.Title: Javier Oilpaint
Entries.Description: A struggling artist (Bennet Maglaris) competes with the greatest artist (Oscar Kuplic) in the world for global dominance of the art community. Only he and the artist are more alike than they know.

Entries.Title: Prudence
Entries.Description: Antoine suffers from amnesia after an accident whose cause he cannot remember. He undergoes therapy with Prudence, a psychotherapist. During a walk in the park, where he meets Prudence again, his memories slowly begin to resurface.

Entries.Title: Rangeelee
Entries.Description: A family drama based in rural Haryana tells the story of Himmat Singh who brings colors to the lives of his two blind sons

Entries.Title: Missing in shadow
Entries.Description: A man calls the best detective in town to help him find his missing best friend.

Entries.Title: Dead and Buried?
Entries.Description: Two criminals attempt to dig their way out of a botched heist.

Entries.Title: Death in the Desert: The Nurse Helen Mystery
Entries.Description: In 1979, 23 year old British nurse Helen Smith died in suspicious circumstances in Saudi Arabia. The Saudi authorities quickly ruled it an accident, but their refusal to investigate further created international mystery, with accusations that the Thatcher government was more interested in oil than justice. Now, 45 years on, previously classified documents reveal in this documentary what the British government really knew about Helen's death.

Entries.Title: Incertidumbre
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: ¿Qué Hacemos Con El Cuerpo?
Entries.Description: After a tragic accident leaves their friend dead, two teenagers are forced to confront the consequences of their actions. As guilt sets in and secrets begin to surface, the boys must decide how far they’re willing to go to cover the truth—or if redemption is still possible.

Entries.Title: Dark Hours
Entries.Description: When a hacker hired by a mysterious entity discovers that there is more than one party interested in the task he was assigned, not only will his job be at risk, but also his life.

Entries.Title: Peltipurkkiunelmia
Entries.Description: Mira is released from prison and returns to her hometown, where she lives with her alcoholic father in a mobile home. After settling in, Mira finds herself caught up in underworld disputes and money troubles. At the same time, she is forced to confront her own past. Meanwhile, a shady private investigator and his partner try to make a living by questionable means.

Entries.Title: Wolf in the Pines
Entries.Description: Joe, a grizzled inner city detective, is on the trail of Katy, a young girl he rescued years ago from a harrowing ordeal. Now, she's missing again, and the case points to a sinister cult tied to her original disappearance. With time running out, Joe teams up with his sharp yet unsure new partner, Sammy, to unravel the mystery and save Katy before the cult's ominous plans reach their devastating conclusion.

Entries.Title: My Worst Victim
Entries.Description: Two assassins are in love. One is told to kill the other.

Entries.Title: Polizei
Entries.Description: Berlin, post-corona. Anton is trying to start a new life: an apprenticeship, his own garden shed with his girlfriend, a little happiness without drugs and crime. But then Anton receives a yellow letter. He is accused of "serious breach of the peace" and "resisting law enforcement officers." The incident happened two years ago. The images come flooding back: the May Day demonstration, his arrest. Anton has to return to the life he wanted to leave behind. He, a naive, good-natured boy, feels burning hatred when he realizes that he is not the perpetrator, but the victim.

Entries.Title: Lockerbie: Our Story
Entries.Description: On 21 December 1988, passenger jet Pan Am 103 was blown up over the small Scottish town of Lockerbie, killing 259 on board and 11 on the ground. It was the UK’s largest crime scene and remains the deadliest terrorist attack on British soil.  In this documentary, families and loved ones, most of whom are speaking for the first time, tell the deeply personal stories of six victims, each with their own hopes and dreams.

Entries.Title: Burnt Ends
Entries.Description: A murderer and an arsonist cross paths in prison.

Entries.Title: The Coin
Entries.Description: Carlo is a bum who suffers from recurrent nightmares. He lives by the rule of the coin, tossing the very same coin over and over again to take every single decision of his life. Coin toss after coin toss, he arrives in L'Aquila, a city hit by an earthquake. Here he becomes involved in a gruesome murder case. With the help of Marta, an alcoholic woman he met on the road, he starts an investigation which will soon have a metaphysical perspective.

Entries.Title: Walkin' The Bridge
Entries.Description: Antonio Baruchi is on a hunt to avenge his father's wrongful murder and seeks refuge in the hands of the Marchetti Crime Family. This 1950s black-and-white noir follows his journey of vengeance, love, despair, greed, and hate. Will he be able to free himself from the burden of his father's death? Or will it consume and bury him in a life of crime.

Entries.Title: Abeja Voladora
Entries.Description: Ramona has just entered working as a news reporter in a famous newspaper, however, after her boss sexually assaults her she begins a vengeance that catches detective Benjamin Flores' eyes. He will now investigate Ramona as he begins to fall in love with her without knowing she is the responsible of the nasty crimes.

Entries.Title: My wife is a thief
Entries.Description: In a small town in Mizoram, a newly married couple turns their playful games into dangerous adventures when the wife urges her husband to steal. What begins as harmless fun quickly escalates as they stumble into the world of smugglers, drug lords, and political corruption. Caught between loyalty and survival, they use wit and courage to outsmart criminals while risking everything to expose the truth. Blending crime, suspense, and dark humor, Ka Nupui chu Rukru is a daring story of love, trust, and the fight for justice.

Entries.Title: Tatort – Ein guter Tag
Entries.Description: Federal police officer Thorsten Falke and his colleague Mario Schmitt are tasked with solving the mysterious disappearance of Joe Glauning in the German-Dutch border region. Was he kidnapped? Or murdered? Was he involved in organized crime? Together with Lynn de Baer, they find evidence of a bloody crime and find themselves in mortal danger...

Entries.Title: Welcome to Maula Prison
Entries.Description: The film follows Jaliwa's journey as he goes through the harsh realities of life inside Maula Prison. The prison is depicted as a place of confinement and a symbol of wider societal issues such as injustice and overcrowding, as well as human neglect. With bad living conditions and limited access to medical care, as well as a strict inmate hierarchy, Jaliwa must confront the brutal truths of prison life while fighting to maintain his dignity and hope.

Entries.Title: Reverend Titus
Entries.Description: Dive into "Reverend Titus," where a Reverend grapples with his faith and ambition. Follow his heartfelt journey toward redemption amid complex family and church dynamics.

Entries.Title: What Remains Of Him
Entries.Description: What Remains of Him is a tense, morally charged short film about obsession, vengeance, and the haunting cost of grief.  Ten years after witnessing his mother’s death in a hit-and-run, David has spent every waking moment preparing to destroy the man responsible

Entries.Title: Counterfeit Criminal
Entries.Description: Daniel Cruz, a criminal who's been on the run from the law, is finally caught by the police. In exchange for all his charges being dropped, the police ask for his help in taking down a criminal known as the “Green Man”, who is running a counterfeit money operation. However, Daniel is forced to work with Officer Michael Hudson, a novice cop. Daniel wants to use his own criminal connections to take down the “Green Man”, while Michael wants to use the law to take him down, causing the two to conflict. However, the investigation soon becomes obvious that it is much deeper than it seems.

Entries.Title: Who is the Killer?
Entries.Description: A detective investigates a girl's strange death.  The truth leads to a surprising ending.

Entries.Title: Tredje Mission
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Love Scam: An Unbelievable Fraud
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Trondheim Nocturno
Entries.Description: Two friends meet again in Trondheim, where a series of disappearances has been reported and authorities believe serial killers may be involved. As they move through the city, routine shifts and silence spreads. Based on  Clavel's "Trondheim Is No Game" , the film uses scenes from other works to trace a path through suspicion, disappearance, and unresolved presence.

Entries.Title: The Final Descent | A Murder Mystery
Entries.Description: A college murder with clues scattered around—can the detective piece them together and uncover the truth? Is it the usual suspects... or the unexpected ones?

Entries.Title: Who did it?
Entries.Description: Three suspects are being interrogated for the murder of Dr Eric Pierce. There is only one question the detectives want to know the answer to... WHO DID IT?

Entries.Title: Forsaken Justice
Entries.Description: When SWAT sergeant Joel McGraw's brother is murdered, he travels to the small town of Breaux Bridge, Louisiana to say his goodbyes - only to find out his brother was looking into the town's deepest darkest secrets.

Entries.Title: Snípéir
Entries.Description: Upon returning from his second tour in Iraq, John O'Neil comes home to find his younger brother lost on a path of crime which he must save him from and ultimately heal their estranged relationship in the process.

Entries.Title: Sore Thumb
Entries.Description: Graffiti documentary covering the history of graffiti, the opinions on the topic from a wide range of people and a close insight into a graffiti crew based in the West Midlands.

Entries.Title: Rotten Apple
Entries.Description: After a heist goes completely wrong, the remaining crew members barge into a suburban home trying to figure out a way to escape from the growing police force outside, whilst trying to discover and eliminate the police mole among their ranks.

Entries.Title: Surprise Detective
Entries.Description: Between a serious detective and their laid back partner, can the two solve a strange case that threatens the detective's personal life? Will they succeed or will they fall victim to unwanted... surprises.

Entries.Title: Édit(u)eur
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: La fuga
Entries.Description: Rodrigo Quintero is a businessman from the city of Pereira, Colombia; who in the year 1989, due to certain past mistakes, ends up fleeing his country, being imprisoned in the National Prison of Panama; a country governed at that time by the dictatorship of General Manuel Antonio Noriega. Sergeant Lino, director of the prison, protected by the corrupt military government, begins to extort him with the threat of being extradited to the United States of America; in the end Rodrigo is pushed to his physical and rational limits in the midst of his eagerness to escape and find his freedom.

Entries.Title: нелегальная доставка//illegal delivery
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Description: A gangster gets caught up in some shady business at a butcher shop.

Entries.Description: The bone-chilling story of two hitmen—Foxy and Chachi—who part ways when Chachi decides to retire. Feeling betrayed, Foxy dives into his work with ferocious intensity, leading to disastrous hits, vengeful mobsters, and an encounter with a deranged pig farmer.

Entries.Title: Room Number 2011
Entries.Description: A short film inspired by true events in Bangladesh at BUET (Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology) in 2019.

Entries.Title: One Pizza, Bloody as Hell
Entries.Description: Obsessed with maintaining an illusion of his lush apartment, a meticulous man's world starts to crumble when a seemingly innocent encounter leads him down a dark path, forcing him to confront his reality.

Entries.Title: The Dynty Heist
Entries.Description: Dynty and Koku steal the custom made diamond but get into a fight after an argument.

Entries.Title: Mindi
Entries.Description: Abdi is about to deliver a machete as part of his final tasks in the criminal underworld. This is after he has been out dealing with his partner in crime, Malik. But things start to go wrong when Malik convinces Abdi to take his innocent cousin along for the ride.

Entries.Title: Paper Rowdy
Entries.Description: Two friends chasing gangster dreams get entangled in a deadly mix-up over a suitcase, only to face an unexpected twist.

Entries.Title: Inside Britain's Fascist Fight Club
Entries.Description: An undercover investigation by ITV News has filmed a white supremacist group masquerading as a fitness club whilst secretly working to build a far-right militia.

Entries.Title: Don't Mess With The Don
Entries.Description: A mobster watches his world fall apart after getting too ambitious for his own good.

Entries.Title: Inhibition
Entries.Description: Emilio, a teenager tormented by the harassment his family receives from his neighbor, experiences a psychedelic state caused by the thought of murdering him.

Entries.Title: ErrorFatal
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Mirrors
Entries.Description: Mirrors follows the inner journey of Lucien Hale, a detective haunted by an unsolved murder case, one that remains unresolved, at least in his conscience. Years after the system closed the file and the world moved on, Lucien uncovers a new clue that pulls him into a series of conversations with someone believed to be connected to the crime.  When a man named John Corwin is brought in for interrogation, Lucien is convinced he's finally closing in on the truth. But their exchange is far from ordinary. Fragmented memories, hazy flashbacks, and cryptic, blood-stained messages begin to collide with Lucien's own beliefs, blurring the line between the truth he seeks and the reality he fears.

Entries.Title: El murmullo de los grillos
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: While There Is a Hierarchy
Entries.Description: We all have a responsibility to the role of justice and truth. In the journalism industry, junior reporter Maria Magdalena is faced with a case that still haunts a bitter past. In her investigation of the truth, dignity and justice are paramount.  What is the most important thing in a journalist's life?

Entries.Title: Second Mission
Entries.Description: A businessman has been having nightmares lately. Nightmares about a corpse being dragged.

Entries.Title: You Shall Have the Body
Entries.Description: Kaloy, a 22-year-old embalmer who illegally moonlights for a corrupt syndicate, extracting bullets from bodies and replacing them with counterfeits for extra cash. But when he finds a familiar face buried within the violence, the reality of his younger brother’s death jolts back his senses.

Entries.Title: Waterfall
Entries.Description: A young adult woman leaves her home in Spokane, Washington for a better life but is stopped along the way by the leader of a minor drug cartel.

Entries.Title: Gentle yexhand 3: La creación de Gentlestein.

Entries.Description: Murder in a bar. Only detective Sam Spade can help now.

Entries.Title: For Me to Be Me
Entries.Description: FBI agents John McKinley and Taylor Jennings conduct a series of interviews with a notorious serial killer.

Entries.Title: BHEEM-A
Entries.Description: BHEEM-A is an independent film based on a political crime drama. In it, a corrupt politician exploits his power and takes over a village and its people for his benefit. An honest lawyer tries to bring him down using the people working for him and does justice to the villagers.

Entries.Title: Dressed For Crime
Entries.Description: A solitary detective tackles a murder case after the victim's brother testifies as a witness. Due to the mysterious nature of the crime, he calls upon another detective in his local force for assistance.

Entries.Title: Mudcake
Entries.Description: Three strangers are employed to live together in an old house several hours from civilisation and cook for a man they do not know. When the pantry is missing an ingredient a series of bad decisions is played out in an effort to find it.

Entries.Title: The Shepherd Code: Road Back
Entries.Description: Alex Lapierre was once a professional assassin. He now leads a peaceful existence, far removed from his tumultuous past. However, the past never stays buried for long.

Entries.Title: 10 Steps and 15 Beats

Entries.Description: The illustrious Gomez invites six fellow businessmen to his manor only to find that amongst them is a killer. Who? He must find out.

Entries.Title: RiverStone
Entries.Description: Through the journey of three police officers escorting a suspect who has no grudges against them, this film explores their inner struggles and moral dilemmas when carrying out this "targeted elimination" mission.

Entries.Title: Omertà
Entries.Description: After a diamond heist goes wrong, a mafia crew turns on each other, convinced there’s a rat—but the real enemy is much more deep than it seems. As trust crumbles and bullets fly, an ex-member manipulates their downfall, watching from the shadows.

Entries.Title: The Clinic 2
Entries.Description: The Clinic is back, the Criminals are back, Tony and Khatab also Came Back, one more time and one last time.

Entries.Title: JV HRWCGWCVN CY
Entries.Description: Vincent, now settled, recalls his past affiliations with the mob and the crime family he was initiated into.

Entries.Title: 7Spade
Entries.Description: 7Spade was once the greatest magician in the world; now, he's retired, old, and washed up. And when he meets a shady back-alley time traveler, he takes the precautions needed to ensure his past self doesn't suffer the same fate.

Entries.Title: The Money Boys
Entries.Description: The Money Boys rob a house

Entries.Title: On The Rail
Entries.Description: Pool player Ray Bennett plays his final game while under the watchful eye of mob boss Mr Galand.

Entries.Title: O Poderoso Decão
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Randap
Entries.Description: Maryam, who lives with her father, is constantly raped by him. She decides to put an end to this torment.

Entries.Title: Death²
Entries.Description: The resentment from two former friends reaches a boiling point after a bank heist

Entries.Title: Portofino
Entries.Description: Portofino follows Jose, who just wants a fresh start—but the past won’t let him go. As Asher hunts him down and Eli pulls the strings, Jose must fight to survive.

Entries.Title: Liquidation
Entries.Description: A man faces the consequences of sleeping with his bosses wife. Hilarity Ensues...

Entries.Title: Break
Entries.Description: Jake a 32-year-old rule-abiding police officer has to solve a murder after a heavy night out drinking and remembers nothing the next morning. Could he be guilty of the murder?

Entries.Title: VULTURE
Entries.Description: Two detectives Kent and Hansen investigate a string of violent and cannibalistic murders.

Entries.Title: Amoureusement
Entries.Description: Lily, a lonely young woman, meets James at a party. Together, they embark on a passionate love affair. But the relationship eventually comes to an end. Lily recalls the memories of her relationship and tries to explain what caused their separation.

Entries.Title: Unknown Number: The High School Catfish
Entries.Description: Vulgar, taunting texts blow up the phones of a teen and her boyfriend. Who's sending them — and why? This twisty documentary reveals the shocking answer.

Entries.Title: Van Gogh by Vincent
Entries.Description: In a career that lasted only ten years, Vincent Van Gogh painted one subject more than any other: himself. This is the story of Vincent told using eight of his most iconic self-portraits.

Entries.Title: Millionaire
Entries.Description: A Chilean man hits the headlines when his damaged lottery ticket claiming a life-changing jackpot sparks a national investigation.

Entries.Title: Christopher - A Beautiful Real Life
Entries.Description: Pop icon Christopher is on the brink of global stardom, but the birth of his second child challenges his priorities. Is the dream worth the cost?

Entries.Title: The Truth About Jussie Smollett?
Entries.Description: The shocking true story of an allegedly fake story that some now say might just be a true story. With first-hand interviews from those at the helm, including investigating police, lawyers, journalists and Jussie himself, this compelling documentary invites the audience to decide for themselves who is telling The Truth About Jussie Smollett?

Entries.Title: Squid Game: Making Season 2
Entries.Description: From set designs to character arcs, get exclusive cast and director interviews on how Season 2 of the globally most-watched series was brought to life.

Entries.Title: Deaf President Now!
Entries.Description: Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most people have never heard about. During eight tumultuous days in 1988 at the world's only Deaf university, four students must find a way to lead a revolution—and change the course of history.

Entries.Title: Conference Marking 80th Anniv. of China's WWII & Global Anti-Fascist Victory
Entries.Description: On the morning of September 3, 2025, a grand military parade will be held at Tiananmen Square in the capital. Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, will attend the conference commemorating the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People’s War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War and deliver an important speech.  This parade will not organize formations of veterans who directly fought in the war of resistance; instead, veterans, retired comrades, former militia members, exemplary local figures who supported the front, and relatives of fallen martyrs will be invited to Tiananmen to watch the ceremony. At the same time, veterans of the War of Resistance from the Kuomintang will also be invited to attend as honored guests.

Entries.Title: Entre la tierra y el cielo
Entries.Description: While collaborating with the Andean Condor Conservation Program, photographer Hernán Pepe meets a wise Quechua elder: Tayta Ullpu. For more than 20 years, they traveled through South America and Australia, among mountains, rivers, seas, condors, and whales. They shared conversations, medicines, and ceremonies, and he received his new name: Pacha Jap'iq, the one who captures time and space. Upon turning 49, a turning point in his relationship with Tayta led him to rethink his life, seeking to return home and rediscover himself.

Entries.Title: The Bridge: Wrestling in Milwaukee
Entries.Description: Kyle Albertson and Wave Chapelle, hosts of "The Show on Riverwest Radio," explore Milwaukee's unique culture and untold history. Their journey begins with Great Lakes Championship Wrestling (GLCW), a Midwest staple since 1997.

Entries.Title: The Stringer
Entries.Description: A two-year investigation uncovers a scandal behind the making of one of the mostrecognized photographs of the 20th century. Five decades of secrets are unraveled in the search for justice for a man known only as  “the stringer.”

Entries.Title: We Want the Funk!
Entries.Description: Stanley Nelson's syncopated voyage through the history of funk music, from early roots to 1970s urban funk and beyond.

Entries.Title: Shifting Baselines
Entries.Description: Boca Chica, Texas. Hemmed in by the Gulf of Mexico and the Rio Grande, the village is defined by the rhythmic sound of the waves. But this wild country is in the midst of irreversible change. For the swamps have been drained, the beaches closed and the homes bought out: the shadow looming over the beach is that of a 50-story rocket, being readied for launch into space.

Entries.Title: Conviction of the Heart
Entries.Description: Singer-songwriter Kenny Loggins explains the origins of several hit songs, including “Footloose” and “Danger Zone,” featured in “Top Gun.” The doc also chronicles the music legend’s childhood as a shy, gawky, and unpopular kid with low self-esteem growing up in California; Loggins’ key role in the folk-rock movement with Loggins & Messina, a pop-rock duo he formed with Jimmy Messina in the 1970s; and the singer’s rise to fame in the 1980s as a solo artist who went on to win multiple Grammys and achieved global recognition because of the songs he wrote and sang for hit movies including “Footloose,” “Top Gun,” “Caddyshack,” and  “A Star Is Born".

Entries.Title: Tehran, an Unfinished History
Entries.Description: Tehran's untold sociopolitical history through rare, unseen film archives spanning over a century.

Entries.Title: Squid Game in Conversation
Entries.Description: Take a seat with the director and cast of Squid Game. Discover key moments, hear untold stories and see what this entire journey meant to them.

Entries.Title: Bono: Stories of Surrender
Entries.Description: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.

Entries.Title: Standout: The Ben Kjar Story
Entries.Description: Standout tells the powerful story of Ben Kjar, born with Crouzon Syndrome, a rare craniofacial disorder. From birth, doctors warn that his life will be overshadowed by limitations. Ben yearns for an ordinary life free from the harsh scrutiny he faces daily.  However, each experience of adversity, including relentless bullying and a series of painful surgeries, ignites a fire within him. Wrestling becomes his proving ground, a place where he learns to transform his facial difference into a source of power. Determined to succeed, he pushes himself relentlessly, breaking through physical, social, and even romantic barriers that once seemed insurmountable. But as unexpected challenges arise and ridicule resurfaces, Ben finds himself at a defining crossroads: fade into the background of a “normal” life, or fully embrace his unique path and boldly stand out.

Entries.Title: Ghost Boy
Entries.Description: Martin Pistorius slipped into a coma at the age of 12. Three years later he woke up but was unable to communicate and no-one realized he was fully aware. This is the true story of his remarkable journey back to life.

Entries.Title: Broken English
Entries.Description: A survivor, provocateur and true original, Marianne has spent more than six decades defying expectations — releasing over thirty-five albums while constantly reinventing herself. Made with her full involvement, Broken English is an intimate and unflinching exploration of a fractured yet unbreakable life shaped by fame, creativity and relentless public scrutiny.

Entries.Title: Holding Liat
Entries.Description: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.

Entries.Title: Road 190
Entries.Description: From his prison cell in Texas, Mabry, sentenced to death, imagines the final journey that will one day take him to Walls Unit, the place of his execution, 60 kilometres away.

Entries.Title: The Herzegovina Uprising
Entries.Description: A docudrama about the historical uprising (1875-1877) led by the Christian Serb population against the Ottoman Empire, firstly and predominantly in Herzegovina, from where it spread into Bosnia and Raška.

Entries.Title: EXODUS
Entries.Description: EXODUS is an intimate, lyrical portrait of Trinity Copeland and Assia Serrano as they struggle to make sense of their lives post-release, exploring the overarching question of: What does life after prison look like? Grappling with the weight of what they’ve done—and what society has done to them—the film explores the burden of absence, the toll of separation, and what it takes to rebuild fractured bonds.

Entries.Title: Country Doctor
Entries.Description: Dr. James Graham, a physician in a struggling Oklahoma town, fights to save its bankrupt hospital.

Entries.Title: Pasilip Ni Azi
Entries.Description: Get ready for a wild ride! Join VMX's crush, Stephanie Raz, as she spills the tea on Azi Acosta's most jaw-dropping and sizzling scenes from her hottest movies. You won’t want to miss this!

Entries.Title: Kreator - Hate & Hope
Entries.Description: From a school band from Essen to an internationally celebrated thrash metal legend: To mark Kreator's 40th anniversary in 2024, frontman Mille Petrozza plans to re-record his greatest hits at the famous Hansa Studios in Berlin together with greats from the metal scene such as Metallica, Sepultura, Slayer, Anthrax and many more. With exclusive private archive material, the story of Kreator is told for the first time.

Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth: The Making of a New Era
Entries.Description: A behind-the-scenes look with the cast and crew, featuring thrilling locations, deadly new dinosaurs and the next evolution of the iconic franchise.

Entries.Title: Wick Is Pain
Entries.Description: Witness the never-before-seen footage and true story behind the John Wick phenomenon – from independent film to billion-dollar franchise.

Entries.Title: Forever Home
Entries.Description: Forever HOME  follows a young couple’s dream to provide the best possible life for rescued farm animals by rethinking the concept of “home.” At their refuge, they base their designs on the needs of the individual animals, replacing conventional barns with customized homes. Paul, an architect, calls it "animal centered design." With empathy and boundless imagination, they’re bringing architectural design to the world of animal care and providing a blueprint for a compassionate, sustainable future. This unique film is a celebration of life and creativity!

Entries.Title: Art Spiegelman: Disaster Is My Muse
Entries.Description: Explores the life and career of cartoonist Art Spiegelman including the creation and ground-breaking impact of his Pulitzer Prize-winning graphic novel MAUS.

Entries.Title: Diane Warren: Relentless
Entries.Description: An intimate look at the life, career and process of one of the most accomplished songwriters of all time, Diane Warren.

Entries.Title: Still Pushing Pineapples
Entries.Description: A melancholic yet heartfelt story of the former singer of pop band Black Lace and his journey on the road with his aging mother and his partner, as he aims for a comeback.

Entries.Title: Flat Tire Down Memory Lane
Entries.Description: This newly completed work – made after Johnston’s death – constructs a highly revealing portrait of the artist via interviews with his sister, Marjory (who in his later years collaborated with Daniel on his artwork and continues to advocate for and promote his work), a special focus on his drawings, as well as documentation of his last home, a house in Waller, Texas, which he filled with a truly mind-boggling volume of books, records, VHS tapes, and other collections, all of which serve as a kind of self-portrait of a unique mind and sensibility.

Entries.Title: Stans
Entries.Description: A revealing, edgy, and disarmingly personal journey into the world of superfandom, told through the lens of one of the world's most iconic and enduring artists, Eminem, and the fans that worship him.

Entries.Title: John Levene In Conversation
Entries.Description: In Conversation was a series of Doctor Who Blu-ray interviews, released as part of The Collection box sets. Each are hosted by Matthew Sweet, where he interviews Doctor Who celebrities about their lives and careers in and outside of Doctor Who.

Entries.Title: Reach for the Stars: The Starwatch Story
Entries.Description: Back in the early 1990s, a stunning new science fiction series Starwatch premiered on British television. It was a massive success and became a global phenomenon, giving its star Jon Pertwee his greatest role as Jason Havlin… well perhaps in an alternative reality this is what happened. Who knows? But here, on this Earth, all that remains is, quite literally, a teaser of what might have been. In this new documentary, we delve into the story of Starwatch, how it was created and why it never reached our screens.

Entries.Title: Death of a Fantastic Machine
Entries.Description: Documentary film from 2025 by directors Axel Danielson and Maximilien Van Aertryck.  A short film about how economic interests have, throughout history, influenced how we use the camera — from the earliest photographs to today’s algorithms and AI. This visual essay expands on themes from the acclaimed documentary about the history of the camera and our relationship to it, “And the King Said, What a Fantastic Machine.”

Entries.Title: Nothing But a Winner: The Alabama Football Story
Entries.Description: Chronicles the rise of the greatest college football program in the history of the sport – the University of Alabama Crimson Tide. But behind the ruthless competition in the Southeastern Conference and Alabama’s staggering number of National Championships lies a deeper story: the making of men. At the heart of Alabama’s dynasty are two coaching giants – Bear Bryant and Coach Nick Saban – who, in very different eras, built a culture defined not just by winning, but by relentless transformation.

Entries.Title: True North
Entries.Description: Centers on the 1969 student protests against racism at Montreal’s Concordia University and their contribution to the story of Black liberation.

Entries.Title: Parrot Kindergarten
Entries.Description: Dive into the fascinating tale of a woman raised in a cult, whose journey of healing through teaching her parrot to read reshapes our understanding of interspecies communication.

Entries.Title: Stiller & Meara: Nothing Is Lost
Entries.Description: Ben Stiller tells the story of his parents—comedy icons Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara—exploring their impact on popular culture and at home, where the lines between creativity, family, life, and art often blurred.

Entries.Title: Nobu
Entries.Description: High-quality ingredients, simple and fresh. Those are the pillars of Nobu Matsuhisa, the celebrated chef of the Nobu restaurants, which are globally renowned for their distinct blend of Peruvian and Japanese flavors.

Entries.Title: Parama: A Journey with Aparna Sen
Entries.Description: Documentary on Aparna Sen's life.

Entries.Title: Hock E Aye Vi Edgar Heap of Birds: Family - An Oral History Project
Entries.Description: In preparation for his first major retrospective at the Oklahoma Contemporary in 2025, Hock E Aye Vi Edgar Heap of Birds reveals thoughts, formal approaches, and philosophies toward various works, including the oral history details behind his new wall installation work, Family, that continues his practice of 'primary' and 'ghost' printing.

Entries.Title: Edge of Life
Entries.Description: We all know our lives will end and yet act as if death is a mirage. A pair of palliative care specialists allow renowned Emmy Award-winning artist Lynette Wallworth an opportunity to explore death with calmness, and even joy, through their use of psychedelics in a world-first trial for palliative care patients.

Entries.Title: Dakar: Race Against the Desert
Entries.Description: Drivers prepare and compete to win the notoriously tough off-road Dakar endurance rally in this sporting documentary.

Entries.Title: Flintoff
Entries.Description: Looks back at Andrew 'Freddie' Flintoff’s incredible life and cricketing career that saw him win two Ashes series with England and become a national sporting hero, whilst charting his life today and return to cricket following his life-altering car crash in 2022.

Entries.Title: Disintegration: An Album, A Band, A Generation
Entries.Description: The Cure are pop outsiders. Over a fifty year career, the English band have released 14 studio albums to great acclaim but it was their 1989 album Disintegration, released during a pivotal year in Europe and the world, which would capture the imagination of so many fans. This documentary tells the story of this landmark work of art in the history of popular music.

Entries.Title: Alpe-Adria Underground!
Entries.Description: Between 2013 and 2023, Slovenian Cinematheque preserved and digitized 179 short films created on a tiny stretch of land between the Alps and the Adriatic Sea in the period of socialism (1945-1991), but mostly outside the prevailing state production. Today, we belatedly recognize these films as experimental and as an important, innovative part of the Slovenian film heritage, visible again for the first time after decades. The production of Alpe-Adria Underground! has radically accelerated efforts to preserve, digitize and restore this segment of Slovenian cinema.

Entries.Title: Tulsa Terrors
Entries.Description: Tulsa Terrors follows the direct-to-home-video movie boom of the late 1980s, which began in part due to some tenacious Oklahomans. "Thanks to RSU TV – northeastern Oklahoma’s public-television station – and its senior producer-director, Bryan Crain, I was recently able to co-produce and direct a documentary that I’ve been itching to do for a long time. I was on the scene as a Tulsa World entertainment writer at the time, so I was lucky enough to have witnessed firsthand the start of the whole phenomenon and how it impacted home entertainment across the country and even the world.

Entries.Title: Leviathan
Entries.Description: Why is social trust breaking down, and how do we find it again? This is the question at the heart of Leviathan. Directed and produced by Alexander Beiner, it draws on sociology, myth, psychology, economics and systems theory to delve into the deep code of culture and make sense of the times we live in. It’s a journey that invites the viewer to confront the shadows lurking at the heart of our systems, and points the way toward hope, healing and action.

Entries.Title: In Dispute: Lively v. Baldoni
Entries.Description: The special examines the legal complaint brought against Justin Baldoni by Blake Lively, alleging he engaged in sexual misconduct on the set of his film, It Ends With Us, and hired a PR firm to engage in an online smear campaign against her to keep her quiet. Baldoni denies the allegations and has responded with a $400m counter-suit, accusing her of defamation. With the trial set for March 2026, the special examines the evidence on both sides and the response to the dispute on social media.

Entries.Title: Kamikaze: An Untold History
Entries.Description: On the Pacific front, towards the end of World War II, Japan's imperial armed forces launched 'kamikaze' attacks - suicide missions by aircraft laden with bombs. It was a mad operation with no hope of returning alive, but the nation went wild, and the attacks continued for ten months, literally until the very last day of the war.  Close to 4,000 Japanese airmen died, and nearly 7,000 Allied military personnel were killed, and thousands more were injured by the attacks. How could this happen?  Utilising 15 years' worth of extensive interviews with US and Japanese World War II veterans, Takayuki Oshima’s film delves into the mechanism of how a crazed madness swept through an entire nation.

Entries.Title: The Killer
Entries.Description: When the lines become blurred between reality and fiction, the only thing that remains real is the suffering we choose to endure and why.

Entries.Title: Videoheaven
Entries.Description: Since the 1980s, the video shop has been a desperately necessary space for film culture. In Videoheaven, Alex Ross Perry tells the story of the neighbourhood video shop to consider wider, changing social histories, using appropriated footage from the high and lowbrow.

Entries.Title: A Chip Odyssey
Entries.Description: A Chip Odyssey features interviews with over 80 key figures who witnessed and shaped the development of the semiconductor industry — from the first generation of engineers and female factory workers, to policymakers and technology veterans, and today’s young engineers facing new crossroads. This feature-length documentary chronicles how Taiwan built its semiconductor industry from scratch and transformed it into a global technological force, capturing a vital and transformative chapter in the island’s modern history.

Entries.Title: You Know: Uncovering What Lies Beneath
Entries.Description: A feature-length retrospective documentary on the making of “What Lies Beneath.”

Entries.Title: Jaws @ 50: The Definitive Inside Story
Entries.Description: The authorized documentary celebrating the film that redefined Hollywood, 50 years after its premiere. Featuring rare archival footage and interviews with acclaimed Hollywood directors alongside Steven Spielberg, top shark scientists, and conservationists, the film uncovers the behind-the-scenes chaos and how the film launched the summer blockbuster, inspired a new wave of filmmakers, and paved the way for shark conservation that continues today.

Entries.Title: The Invasion
Entries.Description: A comprehensive chronicle of the consequences of Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022. How citizens live in wartime, how violence and death condition daily life: from schools in bomb shelters to rehabilitation centers for the maimed; wounds and silences, gestures and words.

Entries.Title: Dancing with the Devil: The Making of Sinners
Entries.Description: Making of documentary featurette on the Sinners home video release

Entries.Title: Sunday Best: The Untold Story of Ed Sullivan
Entries.Description: Ed Sullivan broke barriers by booking Black artists on his Sunday night variety show. This documentary spotlights the TV pioneer's legacy of equality.

Entries.Title: Imago
Entries.Description: I received a land in Pankissi, Georgia, a valley at the foot of the Caucasus, right by the Chechnyan border, where I was born. In exile, I am thinking of building a house in this remote place, inhabited by descendants of my Chechen clan. But how could I possibly live in such a place?

Entries.Title: Empire Skate
Entries.Description: Empire Skate chronicles the colorful rise and enduring influence of New York skateboarding culture in the 1990s, through the global phenomenon of Supreme and intimate portraits of the skaters who breathed life into that world.

Entries.Title: John Candy: I Like Me
Entries.Description: Those who knew John Candy best share his story, in their own words, through never-before-seen archival footage, imagery, and interviews.

Entries.Title: Art Attack! The Dissection of Terrifier 3
Entries.Description: ART ATTACK. Dives into the making of Terrifier 3, exploring its shocking practical effects, Art the Clown's rise, and its bold impact on modern horror.

Entries.Title: Creede U.S.A.
Entries.Description: A documentary that explores the unexpected culture clash in Creede, Colorado—a remote mining town that invited a theater company in 1966 to revive its economy. What followed was a decades-long negotiation of identity, values, and belonging, as queer artists and progressive ideas took root in a place proud of its conservative heritage. With personal stories, tense town meetings, and reflections from original members like Mandy Patinkin, the film reveals how this tiny town became a powerful, poignant mirror of America’s larger divisions—and a testament to the complexity of living side by side.

Entries.Title: Titan: The OceanGate Submersible Disaster
Entries.Description: OceanGate's Titan tourist submersible imploded in 2023 on a deep-sea dive to the Titanic. This documentary details how a bold vision ended in tragedy.

Entries.Title: Underland
Entries.Description: Based on Robert Macfarlane’s bestseller, UNDERLAND is a cinematic voyage beneath the surface of the earth.

Entries.Title: While the Green Grass Grows
Entries.Description: First, there is the Appenzell countryside, and the melting snow that makes the streams overflow. Then the death of his mother, and the need to spend time with his father. On top of that, a global pandemic. Peter Mettler is a rare gem of a filmmaker. Here he (re)constructs the filmed diary of his intimate relationship with the world and the beings that inhabit it, in this work of documentary goldsmithery.

Entries.Title: Blood & Myth
Entries.Description: When a series of shocking, violent crimes shatters a remote native village in Northern Alaska, one man embarks on a journey to investigate a frightening paranormal connection.

Entries.Title: Race/America
Entries.Description: Race/America follows Robb Holland, one of the few Black professional race car drivers in the United States, as he fights for the GT America Championship behind the wheel of a Ford Mustang. After decades of breaking barriers in a sport known for its lack of diversity, Robb builds his own team—Rotek Racing—bringing together a dynamic, multicultural crew that reflects the change he wants to see in motorsports. This high-octane documentary takes you beyond the track and into the heart of a season-long battle, offering unprecedented access to one of the most diverse teams in the paddock. Race/America is a story of speed, grit, and the drive to make history.

Entries.Title: View From a Balcony
Entries.Description: Filmed from one perspective overlooking a lake, we see leaves, water and wildlife. Accompanied by Chopin.

Entries.Title: Bomba Bernal
Entries.Description: "This is not a film by Khavn". Bomba Bernal is the hardcore pornographic bomb handjobbed in the hidden love-hotels of Philippine cinematographic history detonated by the satirical deep throat of one of the greatest 20th century Filipino filmmakers, Ishmael Bernal (1938-1996).

Entries.Title: Bearing Witness Native American Voices in Hollywood
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Not One Drop of Blood
Entries.Description: In the remote expanses of Eastern Oregon, a rash of unexplained cattle mutilations reignites a decades-old mystery of the American West. What unravels is an ode to the steadfast ranchers and farmers clinging to the legacies of the Western cowboy life in contemporary America.

Entries.Title: Landmarks
Entries.Description: In 2009, a man and two accomplices try to evict members of the Indigenous community of Chuschagasta in northern Argentina. Claiming ownership of the land and armed with guns, they kill the community’s leader, Javier Chocobar. The murder is caught on video. It takes nine years of protests before court proceedings are finally opened in 2018. During all this time, the killers remain free. The film combines the voices and photographs of the community with courtroom footage to explore the long history of colonialism and land dispossession that led to this crime.

Entries.Title: Murewa
Entries.Description: In the quiet seaside town of Worthing, Marlon and Murry (Murewa) form a deep friendship, bonding over skateboarding, photography and the carefree adventures of youth. But as they grow older, their lives take different turns. Marlon leaves for university in London, while Murry, facing mounting pressure at home, makes choices that lead to prison. Through years of home video, Murewa reflects on the complexities of growing up, and how opportunity and circumstance shape the futures of young people in ways they don’t fully grasp at the time. Intimate and deeply personal, the film explores boyhood, belonging and the lingering question of what might have been.

Entries.Title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
Entries.Description: Three filmmakers dive deep into the storied and complex legacy of Ms. magazine through the lens of some of its most iconic covers, featuring never-before-seen archival footage and engaging interviews with the powerful women who shaped the magazine at its inception over fifty years ago

Entries.Title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2024/25: Ballet to Broadway: Wheeldon Works
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Tambaú
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Titanic: The Digital Resurrection
Entries.Description: Using cutting-edge scanning technology and state-of-the-art CGI, a team of experts creates the first high-resolution 3D digital twin of the Titanic wreck. Through a groundbreaking immersive investigation, they uncover the ship’s final moments, shedding light on the acts of heroism and cowardice aboard—and revealing the true story behind the sinking of the “unsinkable” ship.

Entries.Title: We Are Pat
Entries.Description: Pat, the evasive, androgynous character made famous on Saturday Night Live by Julia Sweeney, was an inescapable figure in 1990s pop culture. As a child, filmmaker Ro Haber became obsessed with Pat—a character whose popularity stemmed from making others uncomfortable by defying gender norms. Decades later, and now an out trans filmmaker, Haber still grapples with Pat’s legacy. Thirty-five years after It’s Pat first aired, Haber assembles a group of queer and trans comedians, writers, and even Sweeney herself to revisit the character. Through conversation and critique, they aim not to erase Pat but to reframe them, transforming a symbol of ridicule into one of reflection and empowerment.

Entries.Title: The Librarians
Entries.Description: Librarians unite to combat book banning, defending intellectual freedom on democracy's frontlines amid unprecedented censorship in Texas, Florida, and beyond.

Entries.Title: Mr. Kim Goes to the Cinema
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Later in the Clearing
Entries.Description: In a small Hungarian town painter Péter Molnár leads filmmaker Márton Tarkövi on a journey through meadows, clearings and Molnár’s drawings. The viewer joins them, as they discuss art, time and life itself.

Entries.Title: Rebbeca
Entries.Description: As chart-topping Latin music superstar Becky G embarks on her most personal and ambitious project to date, her debut Mexican regional album, she is prompted to revisit her roots and dive deep into a beautiful and complicated past.

Entries.Title: Eraserheads: Combo On The Run
Entries.Description: When the Eraserheads formed in 1989, their music swept the country. But the REAL story behind the group has remain untold. Until now...

Entries.Title: A Serbian Documentary
Entries.Description: A documentary that takes an exclusive look at "A Serbian Film", with never-before-seen footage of the film and the worldwide reactions of one of the most talked about and controversial films of the last decade.

Entries.Title: Don't Die: The Man Who Wants to Live Forever
Entries.Description: In this documentary, wealthy entrepreneur Bryan Johnson puts his body and fortune on the line to defy aging and extend his life beyond all known limits.

Entries.Title: The Story of Super Mario
Entries.Description: Whether collecting coins, eating mushrooms or stomping on Goombas, Mario is an icon who has graced our screens for generations. Everyone remembers their very first time jumping around in one of his iconic games, but you may not know the full history of Nintendo's greatest hit. Join us as we do just that, and reach for the goal as we learn The Story of Super Mario.

Entries.Title: Barbara Walters: Tell Me Everything
Entries.Description: Few American journalists have had a career as trailblazing and transformative as Barbara Walters, whose astonishing life and work are recounted in her own words in this raw, intimate, decades-spanning doc.

Entries.Title: The Python Hunt
Entries.Description: Every year, the Florida government invites the general public to compete in an invasive python removal contest in the Everglades. For ten nights, an eclectic group of hunters confront the dangerous terrain, nocturnal creatures and their own desires.

Entries.Title: Velvet Vision: The Story of James Bidgood and the Making of Pink Narcissus
Entries.Description: Velvet Vision is a raw and intimate portrait of James Bidgood, the visionary artist behind the cult classic Pink Narcissus, who’s groundbreaking 1960s homoerotic imagery helped redefine queer aesthetics.

Entries.Title: The Ozu Diaries
Entries.Description: Unveiling Yasujiro Ozu’s legacy through his personal diaries, letters, and interviews, the documentary delves into his life, creative process, and lasting impact on filmmaking.

Entries.Title: Mighty Indeed
Entries.Description: In one of the harshest places on Earth, three women from different generations chase a hidden and ephemeral world beneath the Antarctic sea ice. Dr Natalie Robinson leads a world-first expedition to McMurdo Sound, joined by microbiologist Jacqui Stuart on her first trip south. Mentoring them from afar is veteran sea ice physicist Professor Pat Langhorne.

Entries.Title: Laterna Magica
Entries.Description: A film by Séverine Barde, adapted from Dorian Rossel's play, based on Ingmar Bergman's fictional autobiography. A powerful self-portrait, at the crossroads of theater and cinema, from the collection De la scène à l'écran.

Entries.Title: Underground Breath
Entries.Description: A documentary feature that combines behind-the-scenes footage from director Juval Marlon's previous films with freshly shot interviews and performances to reflect on the character of underground exploitation cinema.

Entries.Title: The Cycle of Love
Entries.Description: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

Entries.Title: How Deep Is Your Love
Entries.Description: The deep sea is the last unknown territory on Earth. Here, biologists struggle to study the enigmatic wildlife that looks like something from another planet. But time is running out as deepsea mining threatens the fragile ecosystems.

Entries.Title: Pimenta no Clima
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: There Was A Comedian Called Cecchelin
Entries.Description: Life and career, lights and shadows, successes and misfortunes of Angelo Cecchelin, the greatest comic actor Trieste has ever had. Who was Angelo Cecchelin? Rome had Petrolini, Naples had Totò. Trieste had Cecchelin.

Entries.Title: Breath
Entries.Description: “Where does the soul go once it leaves the body?” For religious and philosophical reasons, viewpoints may all differ, but fundamentally, human beings have constantly asked this question. Like a lit matchstick, human life ignites the beauty and ugliness of life intensely and without reserve. The undertaker says, “The more funerals I hold, the more I think that death might not be a period but a comma.

Entries.Title: Marlee Matlin: Not Alone Anymore
